original.name: 寒冰路灯花
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>冬天是思考的季节，寒冷让思维变得清晰。凛冽的寒风与冷寂的夜晚，这么适合思考的时间可不能白白浪费。几天来，守夜的寒冰路灯花都在思考自己应该思考些什么——有了，就思考自己应该思考些什么！</color>
original.info:
能赋予激光冷却效果，散发的清冷光辉会冻伤僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>光照范围：</color><color=red>3×3,1级</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>每秒1次，对半径1.1格内的僵尸造成20伤害，施加1.5秒寒冷状态，并使冻结的僵尸冻结时间延长1秒（只能为每个目标延长1次冻结时间）</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>流光大灯菇的激光/流光仙人掌的对地激光会在穿过后变蓝，可施加寒冷状态</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>路灯花+寒冰菇</color>

english.name: Aurora Plantern
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Winter is the season for meditation. The cold sharpens the mind. With gnawing winds and silent nights, such a perfect time for reflection should not be wasted. For days on end, the night-watching Aurora Plantern has been pondering what he should be thinking about. Oh wait, that's it! Thinking about what to think about!</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Aurora Platern chills zombies near it and gives lasers going through it chilling properties.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Inherits Plantern traits.
<color=black>•</color> Once per second, deals 20 damage and applies Chill to zombies in within a 1.1-tile radius, and prolongs the Freeze duration of the zombies already frozen by 1s (cannot be reapplied to the same zombie).
<color=black>•</color> Anti-ground Lasers from Lumos Cactus/Ray-shroom turn cyan and gain the ability to apply Chill after passing through.</color>

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>

original.name: 玉米小投手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“本次实验结果：密集种植不利于植物生长，玉米的果穗明显变小。”戴夫弯下腰，拿出放大镜对着玉米小投手，“不适合做玉米卷了。”玉米小投手气鼓鼓地说：“本次实验结果显示浓缩的都是精华！”​</color>
original.info:
小小的玉米投手，有概率投出让僵尸缩小的小黄油。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮，可密植</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>优先攻击未缩小的僵尸</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>有25%概率投出小黄油，造成40伤害，使未缩小的僵尸缩小（体型和血量变为0.7倍），使缩小的僵尸定身1.5秒，秒杀小鬼类僵尸</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color>
<color=red>小喷菇（底座）+玉米投手</color>

english.name: Baby Corn
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"The results of this experiment: dense planting is not conducive to plant growth, and the corn ears have obviously shrunk." Dave bent down, took out a magnifying glass, and looked at the Baby Corn, "Not suitable for making corn rolls anymore." Baby Corn said angrily, "The results of this experiment show that the concentrated ones are all the essence!"</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Baby Corn has a chance to throw a small butter that shrinks zombies.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20/3s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant. Has a 25% chance to throw a small butter that deals 40 damage, which shrinks the size and health of non-shrunken zombies by a factor of 0.7, otherwise it will be stunned for 1.5s, while Imps are killed instantly. Prioritizes zombies that are not shrunken.</color>

original.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black></color>
original.info:
<size=36>Ball Cactus projectiles shrink flying zombies!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>30/1s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Can attack both land and flying zombies in a full lane. Currently shrinks all zombies. This is not intended.</color>

original.name: 海灯菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“我在海盗泳池派队当过气氛组，在亚马逊深水打捞公司任职了三个月，睡觉时还曾被人拿去当作夜钓灯光诱饵!”海灯菇似是气愤却又带点炫耀地向植物们分享自己的冒险经历，“现在我想找个安稳工作，那个叫戴夫的大叔骗我说后院的池子缺乏照明，可没说里面游满了僵尸!”</color>
original.info:
可以当作路灯的海蘑菇，长大后光照范围更大。

<color=#3D1400>光照范围：</color><color=red>3×3,1级</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>水生，低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>出场30秒后长大，提供光照等级的范围提升至5×5</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>海蘑菇（底座）+路灯花</color>

english.name: Beacon-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I've been a light system at a pirate pool party, worked for an Amazon deep-water salvage company for three months, and even served as night fishing bait while I was sleeping!" Beacon-shroom shared, a mix of anger and pride evident in his voice. "Now, I'm looking for a stable job. Uncle Dave mentioned that the backyard pool needed lighting, but he forgot to mention it was infested with zombies!"</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Beacon-shroom dispels fog and gives off light, growing in size to increase its Lumos Level output after a while.

<color=black>Growth Time: </color><color=#8B0000>60s</color>
<color=#99582a>Lumos System: </color><color=#8B0000>Gives 1 Lumos Level to a 3×3 area, then 5×5 after growth.</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles). Inherits traits from Plantern.</color></size>

german.name: Meerlampenpilz
german.introduce: <size=31><color=black>„Ich war das Beleuchtungssystem bei einer Piraten-Poolparty, habe drei Monate lang für ein Amazon-Tiefwasserbergungsunternehmen gearbeitet und wurde sogar als Nachtangelköder verwendet, während ich geschlafen habe!“ erzählte Meerlampenpilz, mit einer Mischung aus Ärger und Stolz in der Stimme. „Jetzt suche ich einen festen Job. Onkel Dave meinte, der Pool im Hinterhof bräuchte Beleuchtung, aber er hat vergessen zu erwähnen, dass er von Zombies überrannt ist!“</color></size>
german.info:
<size=31>Vertreibt Nebel und spendet Licht, wächst mit der Zeit.

<color=black>Zeit für Wachstum: </color><color=#8B0000>60 Sekunden</color>
<color=#99582a>Leuchtkraft-System: </color><color=#8B0000>Ergibt 1 Leuchtkraft-Stufe in einem 3x3 Raster, 5x5 nach Wachstum.</color></size>

original.name: 流光豌豆射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>流光豌豆射手最开始是位喜欢给别人照激光笔的小孩，后来流光仙萤伞交给了他怎么用这招对付僵尸。</color>
original.info:
高频发射靶向激光，吸收光能可增加威力。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>10</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>每0.5秒，获得（光照等级）点光能，存储上限1000点。每道激光在攻击或输送时，均会消耗（1+当前光能×10%）点光能</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>能锁定本行前方的流光中继射手（不可紧邻），每0.1秒输送一次，为目标补充攻击力×10%的光能，每点消耗的光能使补充量增加1倍</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>每0.2秒消耗光能攻击一次，使单次伤害增加（消耗光能）倍</color>
<color=#3D1400>④</color><color=red>手动点击会重新锁定目标</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手+路灯花</color>

english.name: Beamshooter
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Lumos Pea started out as a kid who loved shining laser pointers at people. Later, Pharos Umbrella taught him how to use that trick on zombies instead.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Beamshooter shoots a beam of light at a single zombie, its damage increasing the more energy it has.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>10/0.2s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Gains Lumos energy equal to Lumos level every 0.5s, up to 1000. Each laser beam consumes (1 + current energy × 10%) energy when attacking or transferring.
<color=black>•</color> Can lock onto a Split Beam in front in the same lane (not directly adjacent). Transfers energy every 0.1s, restoring energy equal to 10% of its attack. Each point of energy spent doubles the amount transferred.
<color=black>•</color> Consumes energy every 0.2s to attack, increasing damage by the amount of energy spent.
<color=black>•</color> Click on it will reset its target.</color>

german.name: Leuchterbse
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Lumos Pea started out as a kid who loved shining laser pointers at people. Later, Pharos Umbrella taught him how to use that trick on zombies instead.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Fires high-frequency targeted lasers; absorbs Lumos energy to increase power.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>10/0.2s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Gains Lumos energy equal to Lumos level every 0.5s, up to 1000. Each laser beam consumes (1 + current energy × 10%) energy when attacking or transferring.

<color=black>•</color> Consumes energy every 0.2s to attack, increasing damage by the amount of energy spent.
<color=black>•</color> Click on it will reset its target.</color>

original.name: 大嘴喷菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>大嘴喷菇有两张嘴，长得像垃圾桶的那张嘴是用来吃饭的，可以喷出孢子的那张嘴是用来赶跑那些把他当垃圾桶的家伙的。</color>
original.info:
吞下接近的僵尸，并在消化中喷出威力更强的烟雾。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>消化时间：</color><color=red>40秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>消化时间内，伤害翻倍且附带击退</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大喷菇+大嘴花</color>

english.name: Belch-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Belch-shroom has two mouths. The one that looks like a trash can is for eating, while the one that spits belch is for chasing away anyone who mistakes him for a trash can.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Belch-shroom swallows nearby Zombies and emits more powerful smoke while digesting them.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5s (Piercing)</color>
<color=black>Digestion Time: </color><color=#8B0000>40s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>During digestion, damage is doubled and attacks inflict knockback.</color>

german.name: Belch-shroom
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Belch-shroom has two mouths. The one that looks like a trash can is for eating, while the one that spits belch is for chasing away anyone who mistakes him for a trash can.</color>

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>During digestion, damage is doubled and attacks inflict knockback.</color>

original.name: 辣椒小蘑菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>每一个小辣椒的力量都是有限的，但当他们团结起来的时候也能形成巨大的力量，这正是他们喜欢群居的原因。而对于小辣椒的组合，其他植物喜欢根据他们的数量称呼他们为“微辣”、“中辣”和“特辣”。</color>
original.info:
身躯虽小，脾气依旧火爆。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>600（灰烬）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮，可密植</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>非空中僵尸接近时自爆，根据攻击力释放火爆辣椒效果</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>小喷菇（底座）+火爆辣椒</color>

english.name: Bell Pepper
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Each little Bell Pepper may be small and insignificant on its own, but together they pack serious heat. That's why they like to stick in groups. Other plants even rate them by size: mild, medium, and extra hot.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Bell Pepper explodes into small lane-wide damage when zombies get close to it.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>600 (Cremator)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant. Explodes when non-flying zombies get close, triggering a Jalapeno effect with less damage.</color>

german.name: Jalapeñito
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Each little Bell Pepper may be small and insignificant on its own, but together they pack serious heat. That's why they like to stick in groups. Other plants even rate them by size: mild, medium, and extra hot.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Small body, fiery temper.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>600 (Cremator)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant. Explodes when zombies get close, triggering a Jalapeno effect with less damage.</color>

original.name: 毁灭樱桃
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“想在花园举办派对，不提前申请可不行。”毁灭樱桃悠闲地驱离不合规定的僵尸。“第一次只是警告，警告后还不离场的，我才会进行强制驱离。很遗憾，部分僵尸连警告都承受不住。”</color>
original.info:
先释放樱桃爆炸，借助产生的爆炸粉尘，再释放威力增强的毁灭菇爆炸。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1800（灰烬）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>出场时释放樱桃炸弹效果，1.5秒后释放毁灭菇效果</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>自身的樱桃炸弹效果每伤害一个僵尸，自身的毁灭菇效果伤害增加1/6倍</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>樱桃炸弹+毁灭菇</color>

english.name: Black Cherry
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"You can't host a party in the garden without a permit." Black Cherry casually tells the unregistered zombies off. "The first time's just a warning. If they still don't leave after that, I'll take action. Well, some can't even handle the warning."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Black Cherry unleashes a Cherry Bomb blast, then explodes as a Doom-shroom explosion, its damage increasing the more zombies it killed initially.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Cremator)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Triggers a Cherry Bomb explosion on fusion, and explodes like a Doom-shroom after 1.5s.
<color=black>•</color> The Doom-shroom blast deals 1800 base Cremator damage, increasing by a factor of (# of zombies hit by the initial Cherry bomb explosion) × 1/6. (For reference, if one zombie is hit by the initial cherry explosion, the cremator damage will be 7/6 times the original damage).</color>

german.name: Teufelskirsche
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"You can't host a party in the garden without a permit." Black Cherry casually tells the unregistered zombies off. "The first time's just a warning. If they still don't leave after that, I'll take action. Well, some can't even handle the warning."</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Unleashes a Cherry Bomb blast, then uses the resulting ash to trigger an even stronger Doom-shroom explosion.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Cremator)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Triggers a Cherry Bomb explosion on fusion, and explodes like a Doom-shroom after 1.5s.
<color=black>•</color> The Doom-shroom blast deals 1800 base Cremator damage, increasing by a factor of (# of zombies hit by the initial Cherry bomb explosion) × 1/6. (For reference, if one zombie is hit by the initial cherry explosion, the cremator damage will be 7/6 times the original damage).</color>

original.name: 毁灭路灯花
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>毁灭路灯花并不是靠吞噬黑暗来创造光明。他的光芒源于对僵尸的蔑视，以及几克钚。“我的光芒中燃烧着愤怒。祈祷你不会发现它正对着你。</color>
original.info:
能赋予激光爆破效果，萦绕的躁动光晕会促使余烬复燃。

<color=#3D1400>光照范围：</color><color=red>3×3,1级</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>每3秒一次，为3×3范围内的余烬树桩提供3点余烬能量</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>流光大灯菇的激光/流光仙人掌的对地激光会在穿过后变紫，命中目标时造成半径1格爆炸，伤害10点</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>路灯花+毁灭菇</color>

english.name: Blacklight Plantern
english.introduce:
<align=left><size=36><color=black>Blacklight Plantern doesn't consume darkness to create light. Their light is fueled by their contempt for the Zombies, and a couple grams of plutonium. "My light burns with rage. Pray you don't find it pointed at you."

-Written by Goober</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Blacklight Plantern can give Doomwood extra charges, and gives lasers explosive properites!

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Inherits Plantern traits.
<color=black>•</color> Every 3s, supplies Doomwoods in a 3×3 area with 3 Irradiation value.
<color=black>•</color> Anti-ground Lasers from Lumos Cactus/Ray-shroom turn purple and gain the ability to trigger a 1-tile explosion dealing 10 damage on hit after passing through.</color>

german.name: Schwarzlicht-Pflanterne
german.introduce:
<align=left><size=36><color=black>Blacklight Plantern doesn't consume darkness to create light. Their light is fueled by their contempt for the Zombies, and a couple grams of plutonium. "My light burns with rage. Pray you don't find it pointed at you."

-Written by Goober</color>
german.info:
<size=36>His UV light is radioactive and grants lasers explosive effects.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Inherits Plantern traits.
<color=black>•</color> Every 3s, supplies Doomwoods in a 3×3 area with 3 Irradiation value.
<color=black>•</color> Anti-ground Lasers from Lumos Cactus/Ray-shroom turn purple and gain the ability to trigger a 1-tile explosion dealing 10 damage on hit after passing through.</color>

original.name: 樱桃胆小菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>她是樱桃家族中最温和的一位，不会整天发脾气，也不会整天大吼大叫，大家都很乐意与她相处。“其实……我挺想骂人的……”樱桃胆小菇支支吾吾的说。“但是……我不敢……”</color>
original.info:
容易恼羞成怒的胆小菇，害怕时释放樱桃爆炸。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>害怕时蹲伏，释放伤害为600的樱桃炸弹效果</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>胆小菇+樱桃炸弹</color>

english.name: Blasty-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The meekest Cherry in the family, no tantrums, no shouting, and loved by many. "I… kinda want to swear sometimes," she admits. "But… I'm afraid someone might yell back."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Blasty-shroom creates an explosion when scared!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>When scared, hides and sets off a Cherry Bomb blast that deals 600 AoE damage.</color>

german.name: Angstbombenpilz
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The meekest Cherry in the family, no tantrums, no shouting, and loved by many. "I… kinda want to swear sometimes," she admits. "But… I'm afraid someone might yell back."</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Frightened easily, but causes an explosion when it happens.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>When scared, hides and sets off a Cherry Bomb blast that deals 600 AoE damage.</color>

original.name: 火辣豌豆射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>火辣豌豆射手十分贪吃，即使在战场，仍不忘带上一些烤豌豆进行品尝。“啊啊啊！我的豌豆！” 不用想，肯定又是他在吃的时候本能的把烤豌豆当成子弹吐了出去。</color>
original.info:
发射施加红温状态的火辣豌豆。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>30/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>攻击施加红温状态</color>
<color=#3D1400>火辣豌豆：</color><color=red>被点燃时，变为伤害+30的浴火豌豆</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手+火爆辣椒</color>

english.name: Blaze Pea
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>This Peashooter loves roasted peas so much that even on the battlefield, he snacks between shots. "Ahh! My peas!" - looks like he accidentally spat out his snack again.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Blaze Pea fires peas that inflict Enflamed.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>30/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000> Attacks inflict Enflamed debuff.

german.name: Flammen-Erbse
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>This Peashooter loves roasted peas so much that even on the battlefield, he snacks between shots. "Ahh! My peas!" - looks like he accidentally spat out his snack again.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Fires Blaze Peas that inflict Enflamed.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>30/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000> Attacks inflict Enflamed debuff.

original.name: 火辣双发射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“双倍火力，双倍激情，双倍快乐！我和火辣豌豆射手相比，就像连续吃了两顿火锅一样过瘾！”但火辣双发射手没有意识到，超级火炬树桩的工作量其实也翻倍了。</color>
original.info:
发射火辣豌豆的双发射手。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>30×2/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>攻击施加红温状态</color>
<color=#3D1400>增生豆荚：</color><color=red>出场15秒后手动点击，即可升级为火辣裂荚射手</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手×2+火爆辣椒</color>

english.name: Blaze Repeater
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Double firepower, double thrill, double fun! Compared to Blaze Pea, I like eating hotpot twice in a row!" He doesn't realize that Infernowood now has double the workload.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Blaze Repeater fires Blaze Peas in pairs.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>30×2/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Attacks inflict Enflamed debuff.
<color=black>•</color> Tap to auto-fuse with a free Peashooter 15s after planting.</color>

german.name: Flamminator
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Double firepower, double thrill, double fun! Compared to Blaze Pea, I like eating hotpot twice in a row!" He doesn't realize that Infernowood now has double the workload.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Fires Blaze Peas in pairs.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>30×2/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Attacks inflict Enflamed debuff.
<color=black>•</color> Tap to auto-fuse with a free Peashooter 15s after planting.</color>

original.description:
<color=#11037A>Blood Sunflower, an economic crop that produces extra sun for you. Try to plant as many as possible!</color>

Blood Sunflowers can't help but dance to the beat. What beat? Why, the earth's own jazz beat to keep itself energized—a frequency only they can hear.

english.info: Produces 25 sun every 25 seconds. Infects the plant immediately to its right after 10 continuous seconds, turning it into another Blood Sunflower. Toughness: 300.
english.introduce: Blood Sunflowers cannot help but dance to the beat. What beat? The earth keeps its own jazz rhythm, at a frequency only they can hear.

german.info: Produces 25 sun every 25 seconds. Infects the plant immediately to its right after 10 continuous seconds, turning it into another Blood Sunflower. Toughness: 300.
german.introduce: Blood Sunflowers cannot help but dance to the beat. What beat? The earth keeps its own jazz rhythm, at a frequency only they can hear.

original.name: 三叶花盆
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>植物飞行班的学员们终于迎来了自己的第一个休息日。此前，教官三叶花盆总是以最严厉的态度对待他们——“你的飞行姿态不对！下来重飞！”不过最近他一直不便露面，因为他不小心打搅了杨桃们的“1437”纪念日，正在被他们通缉追查。</color>
original.info:
牺牲飞行植物，滋养上方植物。

<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮，载体，可种裸地</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每1秒铲除本格的飞行植物，铲除后为本格植物回复150血量并提供持续5秒的20%攻击力加成</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>花盆（底座）+三叶草</color>

english.name: Blover Pot
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The trainees of the plant flight academy have finally received their first day off. Until now, instructor Blover Pot always treated them with the strictest attitude: "Your flying posture is wrong! Get down and calibrate again!" However, he has recently been unable to show himself, as he accidentally disturbed the Starfruit's "1437" anniversary celebration and is now wanted by them.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Blover Pot sacrifices flying plants to nourish plants above it.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant. Every 1 second, removes the flying plant on his tile. After removal, restores 150 HP to the plant on the tile and grants a 20% attack power boost for 5s.</color>

german.name: Blover Pot
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The trainees of the plant flight academy have finally received their first day off. Until now, instructor Blover Pot always treated them with the strictest attitude: "Your flying posture is wrong! Get down and calibrate again!" However, he has recently been unable to show himself, as he accidentally disturbed the Starfruit's "1437" anniversary celebration and is now wanted by them.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Blover Pot sacrifices flying plants to nourish plants above it.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant. Every 1 second, removes the flying plant on his tile. After removal, restores 150 HP to the plant on the tile and grants a 20% attack power boost for 5s.</color>

original.name: 火炬大喷菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>火炬大喷菇靠着一手快速把豌豆炒制成浓香豌豆液并加工成“豌豆蛋挞”的技术在业界闻名，和技术同样出名的则是他糟糕的经营，他以每年一家饭店的速度破产，因为他总是要消耗过量的豌豆来维持自己的发型。</color>
original.info:
燃烧穿入的豌豆，将其能量压缩后化为旺盛的火焰喷出。

<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>不会主动攻击</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>吸收经过的豌豆子弹，每1秒向前方4格喷出无限穿透的火焰。伤害等同于本次吸收子弹的总伤害，上限300</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>融化寒冰豌豆：变为豌豆</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大喷菇+火炬树桩</color>

english.name: Blowtorch-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Blowtorch-shroom made a name for himself by quickly cooking peas into rich pea paste and turning them into "pea tarts." His skills are famous, but so is his terrible business sense. His business goes bankrupt at the rate of one restaurant per year, mostly because he burns through far too many peas just to maintain his hairstyle.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Blowtorch-shroom consumes peas in order to shoot a high damage fume!

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Does not attack on its own.
<color=black>•</color> Absorbs passing peas. Every 1s, exhales a piercing flame 4 tiles forward. Damage equals the total damage of absorbed peas, up to 300.
<color=black>•</color> Melts Snow Peas into normal peas.</color>

german.name: Lötlampenpilz
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Blowtorch-shroom made a name for himself by quickly cooking peas into rich pea paste and turning them into "pea tarts." His skills are famous, but so is his terrible business sense. His business goes bankrupt at the rate of one restaurant per year, mostly because he burns through far too many peas just to maintain his hairstyle.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Burns incoming peas, compressing them into a burst of flame.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Does not attack on its own.
<color=black>•</color> Absorbs passing peas. Every 1s, exhales a piercing flame 4 tiles forward. Damage equals the total damage of absorbed peas, up to 300.
<color=black>•</color> Melts Snow Peas into normal peas.</color>

original.name: 黄油黏黏菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>来，尝一块新鲜的黄油！这可是黄油黏黏菇用新配方制作的。“好吃吗？不好吃就摇摇头。”他对一动不动的僵尸说道。</color>
original.info:
被挤压时，从头顶喷出黄油，让周围的僵尸感受“醍醐灌顶”。

<color=#3D1400>攻击范围：</color><color=red>3×5内</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>不会索敌。受击时或手动点击时，如果攻击范围内有僵尸，攻击一次</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>攻击时，流失30韧性（和血量），并向范围内每个僵尸各投出一个黄油，造成40伤害并使目标定身4秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大喷菇+玉米投手</color>

english.name: Blubber-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Come on, have a taste of my fresh butter!" Blubber-shroom says proudly, showing off his new recipe. "If you don't like it, just shake your head," he adds. Everyone seems to be diggin' it, or at least they are completely motionless.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Bludder-shroom can be clicked on to sacriface some of its max health in exchange for launching butter at all zombies in an area.

<color=black>Attack Range: </color><color=#8B0000>An area within a 2.2-tile radius</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Does not actively target zombies. When damaged or manually tapped and if there are zombies within attack range, it performs an attack.
<color=black>•</color> When attacking, loses 30 max HP (and current HP), throwing one pat of Butter at every zombie in range, dealing 40 damage and immobilizing them for 4s.</color>

german.name: Buttermüffel
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Come on, have a taste of my fresh butter!" Blubber-shroom says proudly, showing off his new recipe. "If you don't like it, just shake your head," he adds. Everyone seems to be diggin' it, or at least they are completely motionless.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Sprays butter from the top of its cap onto nearby zombies.

<color=black>Radius: </color><color=#8B0000>An area within a 2.2-tile radius</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Does not actively target zombies. When damaged or manually tapped and if there are zombies within attack range, it performs an attack.
<color=black>•</color> When attacking, loses 30 max HP (and current HP), throwing one pat of Butter at every zombie in range, dealing 40 damage and immobilizing them for 4s.</color>

original.name: 毁灭小蘑菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>毁灭小蘑菇看起来挺小的，但是他的脾气可不小。一言不合，他可能就自爆了，甚至眼神没对上都会，无端的拉进距离更是不被允许的。所以，看一眼就够了，不要再多看，也别再靠近了。</color>
original.info:
用小小的身躯毁灭超小范围的敌人。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1800（灰烬）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮，可密植</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>接触非空中的僵尸时，范围内每有一只僵尸，就释放一次半径0.74格的爆炸</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>小喷菇（底座）+毁灭菇</color>

english.name: Boom-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Boom-shroom may be small, but his temper is explosive. Disagree with him, and he might blow up—no eye contact needed. It's best to admire him from afar—just don't get too close, or things might get messy.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Boom-shroom will explode when it comes into contact with a zombie.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Cremator)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant. Will explode when zombies get close.</color></size>

german.name: Mini-Unheilpilz
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Mini-Unheilpilz mag klein sein, aber sein Temperament ist explosiv. Streite dich mit ihm, und er könnte hochgehen – ohne dass du ihm in die Augen schaust. Es ist besser, ihn aus der Ferne zu bewundern – komm ihm nur nicht zu nahe, sonst könnte es chaotisch werden.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Mini-Unheilpilz explodiert, wenn er mit einem Zombie in Kontakt kommt.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Einäscherung)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Explodiert, wenn sich Zombies nähern.</color></size>

original.name: 樱桃火炬树桩
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>为什么樱桃火炬树桩能让樱桃子弹“长了眼”一样跟踪呢？她站在台上：“其实樱桃子弹也是一个生命……”究极磁爆南瓜不语，只是一味生产樱桃僚机。</color>
original.info:
红烟滚滚的火炬树桩，能生成全场索敌的飞火樱桃。

<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>拥有火炬树桩的特点。影响经过的特定子弹。爆炸樱桃：转化为伤害相同的飞火樱桃。每影响超过30个其他子弹也能生成1个伤害300的飞火樱桃。飞火樱桃全场索敌，命中时释放爆炸樱桃效果，存储上限3个</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>死亡时释放樱桃炸弹效果</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>火炬树桩+樱桃炸弹</color>

english.name: Boomwood
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Boomwood's Afro bounces rhythmically, as if dancing to a beat only it can hear. Some say his groove inspires his fiery creations, while others just appreciate the spectacle — both the style and the explosions leave a lasting impact.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Once Boomwood ignites enough projeciles, it summons a heat seaking explosive drone!

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Generates a homing cherry drone for every 30 peas that pass through.
<color=black>•</color> Converts any explosive cherry that passes through into a cherry drone.
<color=black>•</color> There can be up to 3 cherry drones at once.
<color=black>•</color> Upon death, it triggers a Cherry Bomb explosion.</color>

german.name: Zündkirsche
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Boomwood's Afro bounces rhythmically, as if dancing to a beat only it can hear. Some say his groove inspires his fiery creations, while others just appreciate the spectacle — both the style and the explosions leave a lasting impact.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Spawns a seeker cherry drone after igniting a number of projectiles, and turns explosive cherries into drones directly.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>For every 30 peas it passes, it generates a seeking cherry drone. Also converts any explosive cherry that passes through into a cherry drone. There can be up to 3 cherry drones at once. Upon death, it triggers a Cherry Bomb explosion.</color>

original.name: 豌豆大喷菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>豌豆大喷菇在生活中从来不被认真对待。工作？演讲？婚姻？回应他的只有笑声。豌豆大喷菇甚至不能在游泳池边休息一下，因为只要游泳池里有一颗豌豆，他就会被指责为同谋。</color>
original.info:
射程长远的大喷菇，喷射的烟雾还能赋予平射子弹动能。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>射程为前方整行</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>攻击时，为前方向右的平射子弹加速，并使其每0.02秒增加1点伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大喷菇+豌豆射手</color>

english.name: Boost-shroom
english.introduce:
<align=left><size=36><color=black>"To pea or not to pea?" for Boost-shroom, that is the question. From a young age he rejected shooting peas. He stated he would rather help other plants. when asked where his desire to help others came from, he said, "Plantern has been a huge role model for me growing up."

-Written by Berfy Boy</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Boost-shrooms fume can give projectiles extra momentum and damage.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Has full-lane range. While emitting fumes, boosts straight-shooting projectiles ahead, increasing their speed and +1 damage every 0.02s. The boost is stackable.</color>

german.name: Stink-Erbse
german.introduce:
<align=left><size=36><color=black>"To pea or not to pea?" for Rush-shroom, that is the question. From a young age he rejected shooting peas. He stated he would rather help other plants. when asked where his desire to help others came from, he said, "Plantern has been a huge role model for me growing up."

-Written by Berfy Boy</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Long-range sprayer; his fume can also give projectiles extra momentum.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Has full-lane range. While emitting fumes, boosts straight-shooting projectiles ahead, increasing their speed and +1 damage every 0.02s. The boost is stackable.</color>

original.name: 寒冰三叶草
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>寒冰三叶草是-4℃的空调，迎风吹来，就像进了冬天一样。连寒冰射手都怔住了，这寒风竟然把他的子弹都冻结了，还有什么比它更冷呢？答曰：极寒冰豆的冷笑话。</color>
original.info:
持续刮起寒风，并强化寒冰豌豆。

<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>存在的10秒内：
·每1秒对全场僵尸造成1点伤害，施加寒冷状态，赋予20点冻结值，可对空
·将场上的寒冰豌豆变为极冰豆，伤害和赋予的冻结值翻倍</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>三叶草+寒冰菇</color>

english.name: Breeze Blover
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Breeze Blover is a -4°C air conditioner. When his chilly breeze blows, it feels like stepping straight into winter. Even Snow Pea is frozen, the cold wind actually froze his own projectiles. What could possibly be colder than that? Answer: The atmosphere after Coldsnap Bean's told one of his totally tone deaf jokes.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Breeze Blover chills zombies across the entire lawn for a limited time, and converts Snow Peas to Polar Peas!

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Lasts for 10s before disappearing.
<color=black>•</color> Every second, deals 1 damage and applies 20 Cryo points to all zombies on the lawn. Can target air.
<color=black>•</color> Converts all snow peas on screen to polar ice peas.</color>

german.name: Frierblatt
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Breeze Blover is a -4°C air conditioner. When his chilly breeze blows, it feels like stepping straight into winter. Even Snow Pea is frozen, the cold wind actually froze his own projectiles. What could possibly be colder than that? Answer: The atmosphere after Coldsnap Bean's told one of his totally tone deaf jokes.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Blover of a freezing breeze that constantly applies chill.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Lasts for 10s before disappearing.
<color=black>•</color> Every second, deals 1 damage and applies 20 Cryo points to all zombies on the lawn.
<color=black>•</color> Converts all snow peas on screen to polar ice peas.</color>

original.name: 铁桶坚果
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​铁桶坚果总是觉得自己缺乏安全感，直到有一天他遇到了一个合身的铁桶，“戴上它确实感觉好多了!危险的东西都被隔绝在外面了！”可是他似乎并不知道，他的铁桶也觉得自己没有安全感。</color>
original.info:
坚硬如铁的坚果。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>8000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>铁植物</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>坚果（底座）+铁桶</color>

english.name: Buck-nut
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Plants hold conflicting feelings about Buck-nut. As an exemplary soldier, he executes orders with unwavering precision, yet his cold demeanor leaves much to be desired. The rust at the corners of his mouth hints at a storied past. In the quiet moments, however, Buck-nut wrestles with an unspoken worry: "How do I prevent rust in a humid garden?"</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Buck-nut blocks the zombies' advance with a wall of iron.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>8000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Metal plant. Can be fed corresponding metal objects to restore 500 Toughness. This also applies to other Metal Plants. All Bucket plants receive half the damage from explosive cherries.</color></size>

german.name: Eisen-Nuss
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Pflanzen haben gemischte Gefühle gegenüber Eisen-Nuss. Als vorbildlicher Soldat führt er Befehle mit unerschütterlicher Präzision aus, doch sein kaltes Wesen lässt viel zu wünschen übrig. Der Rost an den Ecken seines Mundes deutet auf eine bewegte Vergangenheit hin. In den stillen Momenten jedoch ringt Eisen-Nuss mit einer unausgesprochenen Sorge: „Wie verhindere ich Rost in einem feuchten Garten?“</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Eisen-Nuss blockiert den Vorstoß der Zombies mit einer Wand aus Eisen.

<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>8000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Kann mit Metallgegenständen gefüttert werden, um 500 PS wiederherzustellen. Dies gilt auch für andere metallische Pflanzen.</color></size>

original.name: 铁豆小喷菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>铁豆小喷菇有一个烦恼：他一直很害怕磁力菇，因为他总是担心对方一不小心把自己给吸过去，“我的螺丝钉怎么不见了？”随着戴夫向他们走来，看来铁豆小喷菇马上又要多一个烦恼了。</color>
original.info:
坚硬如铁的豌豆小喷菇，发射造成击退且对手持防具特攻的小铁豆。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1000</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>80/2.25秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮，可密植</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>铁植物。攻击造成击退，并附加目标二类防具当前血量的伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>小喷菇（底座）+豌豆射手+铁桶</color>

english.name: Buck-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Buck-shroom has a constant worry: he's terrified of Magnet-shroom accidentally pulling him in. 'Where did my screws go?' As Crazy Dave walks up, it seems he is about to have a brand-new concern.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Buck-shrooms can knockback zombies too.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>1000</color>
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>80/2.25s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Metal plant. Short plant. Projectiles knock back zombies and instantly destroy Type 2 Armor (before damage reduction).</color>

german.name: Eisenerbsenpilz
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Eisenerbsenpilz hat eine ständige Sorge: Er hat Angst, dass der Magnetpilz ihn versehentlich anzieht. „Wo sind meine Schrauben hin?“ Als Crazy Dave näherkommt, scheint er bald eine ganz neue Sorge zu haben.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Kann Zombies auch zurückstoßen.

<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>1000</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>80/2 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Projektile stoßen Zombies zurück und zerstören mit Leichtigkeit Gittertüren.</color>

original.name: 铁桶豌豆射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​“我继承了前辈的意志，没有理由在这里倒下！”铁桶豌豆每次见到大家都要强调自己的视死如归。“可是，你的头盔明明是从铁桶僵尸那抢来的”“那就…向遗志祈愿，再乘风破浪！”</color>
original.info:
坚硬如铁的豌豆射手，发射造成击退且对二类防具特攻的铁豌豆。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>2000</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>80/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>铁植物。攻击造成击退，并附加目标二类防具当前血量的伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>铁植物：</color><color=red>韧性较高。受到的樱桃爆炸伤害减半。可以消耗铁器回血500</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手（底座）+铁桶</color>

english.name: Buckshooter
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I carry my ancestors' spirit - I won't fall here!" Buckshooter declared. When told his helmet looked like Buckethead Zombie's, he retorted, "Then let's invoke their will and ride again!"</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Buckshooter can knock back zombies and instantly destroy handheld armor.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>2000</color>
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>80/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Metal plant. Recovers 500 Toughness when fed metal object.
<color=black>•</color> Takes half the damage from explosive cherries.
<color=black>•</color> Projectiles knock back zombies and instantly break Type 2 armor (before damage reduction).</color></size>

german.name: Eisenkanone
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>„Ich verkörpere den Geist meiner Ahnen; hier werde ich nicht fallen!“, verkündet die Eisenkanone stolz allen, die ihr begegnen. Als man sie darauf hinwies, dass ihr Helm dem eines Blecheimer-Zombies verdächtig ähnlich sah, konterte sie: „Dann lasst uns ihren Willen beschwören und noch einmal Wind und Wellen reiten!“</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Eisenkanone kann Rüstungen durchbrechen.

<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>2000</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>80/1.5 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Wird bei Kontakt zurückgeschlagen. Verursacht immensen Schaden an Eisenzombies und zerbricht Eisentüren.</color></size>

original.name: 保护伞大喷菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“这是当下最潮流的发型，不仅能凸现出我的帅气稳重，而且非常安全，阻挡灰尘、篮球、和从天而降的僵尸。”保护伞大喷菇毫不吝啬地夸奖自己的新发型。当然，他的朋友都知道他如此满意的真正原因，这个发型能够遮挡他长歪了的喷口。</color>
original.info:
强力吸收僵尸的进攻压力，用以增强喷射的烟雾威力。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1000</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>烟雾会附加等同于能量值的伤害，然后清空能量值</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>因伞类击退以外的方式受击时，获得伤害量50%且至多为1倍韧性的能量，然后使此次伤害降低90%</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>弹走投掷物后，获得与子弹伤害同等的能量</color>
<color=#3D1400>④</color><color=red>伞类击退：根据自身攻击力，造成同等伤害1次，获得同等能量[击退僵尸数量]次</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大喷菇+叶子保护伞</color>

english.name: Bush-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"This is the hottest hairstyle around. Not only does it bring out my handsome, dignified side, it's also incredibly safe—it keeps out dust, basketballs, and Zombies falling from the sky." Bush-shroom is more than happy to praise his new hairstyle. Of course, all his friends know the real reason he's so pleased: the hairstyle hides his crooked nozzle./color>
english.info:
<size=36>Bush-shroom absorbs the force of zombie attacks and converts it into more powerful fume.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>1000</color>
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1.5s (Piercing)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Fume deals additional damage equal to its currently stored Energy, then consumes all Energy.
<color=black>•</color> When taking damage from anything other than knockback self-damage, gains Energy equal to 50% of the damage taken, up to 1× Toughness, then reduces that instance of damage by 90%.
<color=black>•</color> After deflecting a projectile, gains Energy equal to the projectile's damage.
<color=black>•</color> Umbrella knockback: Deals damage equal to its attack power once, then gains the same amount of Energy once for each zombie knocked back.</color>

german.name: Bush-shroom
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"This is the hottest hairstyle around. Not only does it bring out my handsome, dignified side, it's also incredibly safe—it keeps out dust, basketballs, and Zombies falling from the sky." Bush-shroom is more than happy to praise his new hairstyle. Of course, all his friends know the real reason he's so pleased: the hairstyle hides his crooked nozzle./color>
german.info:
<size=36>Bush-shroom absorbs the force of zombie attacks and converts it into more powerful fume.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>1000</color>
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1.5s (Piercing)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Fume deals additional damage equal to its currently stored Energy, then consumes all Energy.
<color=black>•</color> When taking damage from anything other than knockback self-damage, gains Energy equal to 50% of the damage taken, up to 1× Toughness, then reduces that instance of damage by 90%.
<color=black>•</color> After deflecting a projectile, gains Energy equal to the projectile's damage.
<color=black>•</color> Umbrella knockback: Deals damage equal to its attack power once, then gains the same amount of Energy once for each zombie knocked back.</color>

original.name: 玉米浮艇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>玉米浮艇报名参加了花园联欢会、准备在节目中扮演UFO，但最终还是没能成功。因为他总是在不停地掉落玉米和黄油，遭到了地勤的坚决反对，还让原本支持他的导演摔了一跤。</color>
original.info:
通过投下玉米粒或黄油，提供近距离空中支援。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20×3/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>飞行</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>攻击时，向本格和左右两格各扔出一个玉米粒（25%概率为40伤害的黄油）</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>玉米投手+三叶草</color>

english.name: Butter Fly
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Butter Fly signed up for the Garden Variety Show, hoping to play a UFO on stage, but it never made the cut. He just kept dropping corn and butter everywhere, drawing fierce opposition from the ground crew, and even causing the director who supported him to take a nasty fall.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Butter Fly can drop 3 kernels onto zombies, these each have a chance to be butter instead.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20×3/3s</color>
<color=black>Attack Range: </color><color=#8B0000>Own tile and 2 adjacent tiles in the same lane</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Flying plant. Has a 25% chance to drop butter, dealing 40 damage.</color>

german.name: Maisdrohne
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Butter Fly signed up for the Garden Variety Show, hoping to play a UFO on stage, but it never made the cut. He just kept dropping corn and butter everywhere, drawing fierce opposition from the ground crew, and even causing the director who supported him to take a nasty fall.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Provides close-range air support by dropping corn kernels or butter.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20×3/3s</color>
<color=black>Radius: </color><color=#8B0000>Own tile and 2 adjacent tiles in the same lane</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Flying plant. Has a 25% chance to drop butter, dealing 40 damage.</color>

original.name: 玉米花盆
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>最喜欢的花朵：毛茛。最喜欢的食物：黄油。最喜欢的容器：杯子。最喜欢的歌曲：《Buttercup》。</color>
original.info:
用玉米段制成的花盆，提升上方玉米投手类植物投出特殊子弹的概率。

<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>可种裸地，低矮，载体</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>上方玉米投手类植物投出特殊子弹的概率由25%提升至50%</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>花盆（底座）+玉米投手</color>

english.name: Butter Pot
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Butter Pot believes he's more than just delicious. In his view, buttered corn provides more nutrients than soil, especially for fungi. Butter Pot's favorite plant is the Kernel-pult, his favorite food is butter, his favorite container is a cup, and his favorite song is "Buttercup."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Butter Pot increases the butter chance of all Kernel-type plants above it.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Raises the butter chance from 1/4 to 1/2.</color>

german.name: Korntopf
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Korntopf glaubt, dass er mehr ist als nur lecker. Seiner Ansicht nach liefert Buttermais mehr Nährstoffe als Erde, besonders für Pilze. Korntopfs Lieblingspflanze ist der Kornapult, sein Lieblingsessen ist Butter, sein Lieblingsbehälter ist eine Tasse und sein Lieblingslied ist „Buttercup“.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Korntopf erhöht die Butter Chance aller Kornpflanzen darüber von 25% auf 50%.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Erhöht den Butter Chance von 1/4 auf 1/2.</color>

original.name: 黄油坚果
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“太可怕了，这些僵尸，就像是灾难片里面拍的那样。”黄油坚果瑟瑟发抖，用黄油遮住自己的脸。但是近距离观察僵尸的机会又让他非常好奇，最终他还是忍不住睁开眼睛、从黄油后面偷偷观察这些电影定格般的生命。</color>
original.info:
僵尸每次啃咬都会受到定身——这就是“醍醐灌顶”的感觉。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>被啃咬时，对啃咬者施加2秒黄油定身</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>坚果+玉米投手</color>

english.name: Butter-nut
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"They're terrifying, just like in disaster movies." Butter-nut trembles as he hides his face behind butter. But the chance to observe zombies up close fills him with curiosity, and in the end, he can't help but peek out from behind the butter, studying these creatures frozen in the last frame of their lives.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Butter-nut butters zombies every time they try to bit him, now that's what you call a "head-butter awakening."

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>When bitten, immobilizes the attacking Zombie with Butter for 2s.</color>

german.name: Butternuss
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"They're terrifying, just like in disaster movies." Butter-nut trembles as he hides his face behind butter. But the chance to observe zombies up close fills him with curiosity, and in the end, he can't help but peek out from behind the butter, studying these creatures frozen in the last frame of their lives.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Zombies are immobilized each time they bite - now that's what you call a "head-butter awakening."

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>When bitten, immobilizes the attacking Zombie with Butter for 2s.</color>

original.name: 玉米窝窝投手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>玉米窝窝投手从小生物学就不好，他始终认为“顶端优势”的说法是错误的，不过他现在已经学会把这个观点隐藏起来，倒不是想要隐藏自己学习不好的秘密，而是不想暴露自己是一根顶端发育不良的玉米。</color>
original.info:
投出的子弹会像窝瓜一样重压僵尸，还有概率为压到的僵尸糊上黄油。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>60（压扁）/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>子弹落地时造成范围压扁伤害。有25%概率投出黄油窝瓜，造成80伤害并对伤害到的最多3个目标施加4秒定身</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>玉米投手+窝瓜</color>

english.name: Butternut-pult
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Butternut-pult was never good at biology. He's always believed that the idea of "apical dominance" is wrong, but he's learned to keep that opinion to himself, not because he's embarrassed about his grades, but because he doesn’t want anyone to realize he's a corn with an underdeveloped tip.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Butternut-pults projectiles slam zombies like a Squash, and have a chance to butter the ones that get crushed.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>60/3s (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Projectiles deal area squash damage when they land. Has a 25% chance to throw a Butter Squash, dealing 60 damage and applying 4s of Butter stun to up to 3 damaged targets.</color>

german.name: Maismatschapult
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Butternut-pult was never good at biology. He's always believed that the idea of "apical dominance" is wrong, but he's learned to keep that opinion to himself, not because he's embarrassed about his grades, but because he doesn’t want anyone to realize he's a corn with an underdeveloped tip.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Thrown projectiles slam zombies like a Squash, with a chance to butter the ones that get crushed.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>60/3s (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Projectiles deal area squash damage when they land. Has a 25% chance to throw a Butter Squash, dealing 60 damage and applying 4s of Butter stun to up to 3 damaged targets.</color>

original.name: 黄油地刺
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>和别的地刺不同，黄油地刺非常温柔，他没有锋芒毕露的尖锥，也不喜欢看危险暴力的球赛，他甚至想让僵尸们尝一尝自己制作的黄油蛋糕。然而，由于并不算敏锐的视力，他总是把黄油递错位置。</color>
original.info:
黏糊糊的黄油减速带，无法攻击。

<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>使本格非飞行僵尸速度减半</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>每3秒一次，对接触的僵尸施加1秒黄油定身</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>地刺+玉米投手</color>

english.name: Butterweed
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Unlike other Spikeweeds, Butterweed is exceptionally gentle. It has no sharp spikes, dislikes violent sports, and just wants zombies to try a slice of its homemade butter cake. Unfortunately, with his poor eyesight, he always offers the butter to the wrong spot.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Butterweed slows down zombies and sometimes butters them, but deals no damage.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>0</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Slows down all non-flying zombies that walk over it and Butters them for 1s every 3s.
<color=black>•</color> No longer pops tires and is ignored by vehicles.</color>

german.name: Butterkraut
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Unlike other Spikeweeds, Butterweed is exceptionally gentle. It has no sharp spikes, dislikes violent sports, and just wants zombies to try a slice of its homemade butter cake. Unfortunately, with his poor eyesight, he always offers the butter to the wrong spot.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Sticky, buttery slow trap that doesn't deal damage.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>0</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Slows down all non-flying zombies that walk over it and Butters them for 1s every 3s.
<color=black>•</color> No longer pops tires and is ignored by vehicles.</color>

original.name: 卷心菜浮艇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>多年来漫无目的地扔卷心菜之后，从高处俯瞰世界真的会让人思考。如果这些卷心菜有生命呢？它们有梦想和希望吗？它们有家庭吗？它们有孩子吗？所有这些问题都在卷心菜浮艇的绿叶大脑里盘旋。</color>
original.info:
通过投下卷心菜，提供近距离空中支援。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40×3/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>索敌范围：</color><color=red>本格和左右两格</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>飞行</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>攻击时，向本格和左右两格各扔出一个卷心菜</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>卷心菜投手+三叶草</color>

english.name: Cabbage Dropper
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>After years of mindlessly throwing cabbages, seeing the world at that height really makes you think. What if those cabbages had a life? Hopes and dreams? Families? Children? All of those questions run through Cabbage Dropper's leafy mind.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Cabbage Dropper drops 3 cabbages onto zombies below!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40×3/3s</color>
<color=black>Attack Range: </color><color=#8B0000>Own tile and 2 adjacent tiles in the same lane</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Flying plant.</color>

german.name: Kohldrohne
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>After years of mindlessly throwing cabbages, seeing the world at that height really makes you think. What if those cabbages had a life? Hopes and dreams? Families? Children? All of those questions run through Cabbage Dropper's leafy mind.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Provides close-range air support by dropping cabbages.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>40×3/3s</color>
<color=black>Radius: </color><color=#8B0000>Own tile and 2 adjacent tiles in the same lane</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Flying plant.</color>

original.name: 卷心菜花盆
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“我不是用来装菜的花盆，卷心菜也不是最菜的植物，我和卷心菜是好哥们。”卷心菜花盆自信的说道。其实他们两个一个秃头一个脱发。</color>
original.info:
卷心菜叶包裹的花盆，提升上方卷心菜类植物的攻速。

<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>可种裸地，低矮，载体</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>上方卷心菜类究极植物攻击间隔减少25%，其他卷心菜类植物攻击间隔减少33%</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>花盆（底座）+卷心菜投手</color>

english.name: Cabbage Pot
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I'm not just a pot to hold cabbages, and Cabbage-pult is not the weakest plant! Cabbage-pult and I are best buddies," Cabbage Pot says confidently. Their friendship might have come to be because... one of them is balding, and the other is already bald.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Cabbage Pot provides an attack speed bonus to Cabbage-type plants above it.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Lowers the attack intervals of Wither-pult, Helios Cabbage and Selene Cabbage above it by 25%, other Cabbage plants by 33%.</color>

german.name: Kohltopf
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>„Ich bin nicht nur ein Topf, um Kohlköpfe zu halten, und Kohlapult ist nicht die schwächste Pflanze! Kohlapult und ich sind beste Freunde“, sagt Kohltopf selbstbewusst. Ihre Freundschaft könnte entstanden sein, weil... einer von ihnen Haarausfall hat und der andere schon kahl ist.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Kohltopf gewährt einen 50%igen Angriffsgeschwindigkeitsbonus für Kohlpflanzen, die sich darüber befinden.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Erhöht die Angriffsgeschwindigkeit von Pflanzen vom Typ Kohl um 50%.</color>

original.name: 三线卷心菜炮手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“投筐吗？这是我自己编的。我的篮球之路就靠它啦。”面对采访时，三线卷心菜炮手笑着介绍道，“我的得冠诀窍就在这些投筐上，我还没遇见过能一次拦住三颗球的对手。”</color>
original.info:
向三行快速投出能够“弹射”的多层卷心菜。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40×3/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>每轮在本格及上下两格各攻击一次，攻击享受边路补偿</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>子弹命中后，向上下邻行最近的僵尸弹射一次。原本就在本行发射的子弹可以额外弹射一次</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>卷心菜投手+三线射手</color>

english.name: Cabbage Tri-pult
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"The basket shots? I made those myself. My basketball career depends on them." Cabbage Tri-pult laughed during an interview. "My secret to winning championships lies in these shots. I've never met an opponent who could block three balls at once."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Cabbage Tri-pult rapidly throws layered cabbages across three lanes.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40×3/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Each attack cycle targets his own lane and the two lanes above and below. Attacks benefit from edge lane compensation.
<color=black>•</color> After hitting a target, projectiles split into a regular cabbage targeting the nearest zombie in the adjacent upper and lower lanes. Projectiles originally fired in its own lane can split one additional time.</color>

german.name: Cabbage Tri-pult
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"The basket shots? I made those myself. My basketball career depends on them." Cabbage Tri-pult laughed during an interview. "My secret to winning championships lies in these shots. I've never met an opponent who could block three balls at once."</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Cabbage Tri-pult rapidly throws layered cabbages across three lanes.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40×3/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Each attack cycle targets his own lane and the two lanes above and below. Attacks benefit from edge lane compensation.
<color=black>•</color> After hitting a target, projectiles split into a regular cabbage targeting the nearest zombie in the adjacent upper and lower lanes. Projectiles originally fired in its own lane can split one additional time.</color>

original.name: 卷心菜坚果
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>每年的卷心菜总是迫不及待的出土，但卷心菜坚果总是个例外，他总是将自己裹得非常厚实再离开，“僵尸们没有耐心一层层剥下去的，相信我。”</color>
original.info:
受到一定程度伤害后，获得短暂护盾保护并反击一发卷心菜。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>存储等同于最终受伤的能量，伤害高于100/500/1000时，储存2/3/4倍。能量上限为1倍韧性</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>能量超过1000时，消耗所有能量，弹射出1个造成等量伤害的卷心菜，获得等量的会在5秒内完全衰减的护盾</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>坚果+卷心菜投手</color>

english.name: Cabbage-nut
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Every year, Cabbages can't wait to sprout, but Cabbage-nut is always the exception. He wraps himself up tightly before stepping out. "Zombies don't have the patience to peel layer after layer. Trust me."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Cabbage-nut grows a temporary shield and retaliates with a cabbage after taking a certain amount of damage.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> When taking damage, stores 1× the damage taken as Retaliation Charge. If the damage exceeds 100/500/1000, stores 2/3/4× the damage instead.
<color=black>•</color> Retaliation Meter is capped at max HP.
<color=black>•</color> When the Retaliation Meter exceeds 1000, consumes all charges to launch a cabbage dealing the same amount of damage and gains a shield of equal value that fully decays over 5s.</color>

german.name: Nusssalat
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Every year, Cabbages can't wait to sprout, but Cabbage-nut is always the exception. He wraps himself up tightly before stepping out. "Zombies don't have the patience to peel layer after layer. Trust me."</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Grows a temporary shield and retaliates with a cabbage after taking a certain amount of damage.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> When taking damage, stores 1× the damage taken as Retaliation Charge. If the damage exceeds 100/500/1000, stores 2/3/4× the damage instead.
<color=black>•</color> Retaliation Meter is capped at max HP.
<color=black>•</color> When the Retaliation Meter exceeds 1000, consumes all charges to launch a cabbage dealing the same amount of damage and gains a shield of equal value that fully decays over 5s.</color>

original.name: 地刺大喷菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>对于地刺大喷菇，我们只知道他原先是警察，因伤离职，而他先前的工作内容我们一概不知。近期的一项发现可能有助于我们了解他的过去：有植物发现他正在疯狂寻找由玩家扮演钉刺带的追车游戏。</color>
original.info:
趴在地上的大喷菇，喷出烟雾腐蚀轮胎。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>不会阻挡僵尸</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>接触载具时施加扎胎，然后消失</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>攻击会附加车辆30%韧性的伤害，领袖僵尸除外</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大喷菇+地刺</color>

english.name: Caltrop-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>What we know about Caltrop-shroom is that he was once a police officer who resigned due to injury. Beyond that, we know nothing about his previous work. A recent discovery may help uncover his past: a plant spotted him frantically searching for a race game where players control Spikeweed.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Caltrop-shroom sprays spiky fumes that pop tires.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant. Cannot block zombies. Can pop vehicle tires on contact then disappears.
<color=black>•</color> Attacks deal 30% max HP damage to vehicles (excluding mini-boss vehicles).</color>

german.name: Caltrop-shroom
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>What we know about Caltrop-shroom is that he was once a police officer who resigned due to injury. Beyond that, we know nothing about his previous work. A recent discovery may help uncover his past: a plant spotted him frantically searching for a race game where players control Spikeweed.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Caltrop-shroom sprays spiky fumes that pop tires.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant. Cannot block zombies. Can pop vehicle tires on contact then disappears.
<color=black>•</color> Attacks deal 30% max HP damage to vehicles (excluding mini-boss vehicles).</color>

original.name: 三叶胆小菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>三叶胆小菇很关心他的朋友们。即使他能飞离僵尸的威胁，飞向高空的电波，他也无法轻易抛弃自己的根。为了保护他们，他用树叶覆盖他们，并恳求僵尸不要伤害他们。而僵尸们不知为何，竟然听从了他的劝告。</color>
original.info:
悬浮的迷彩伪装者，使附近害怕的胆小菇类植物不被啃咬。

<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>飞行</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>3×3范围的胆小菇类植物在害怕状态不会被僵尸啃咬</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>胆小菇+三叶草</color>

english.name: Camo-shroom
english.introduce:
<align=left><size=36><color=black>Camo-shroom cares for his friends. Even though he can fly away from the danger of zombies, into the clouds of high above, he can't simply abandon his roots. In an attempt to protect them, he covers them with his leaves and begs the zombies not to hurt them. And the zombies, for some reason, listen.

-Written by Ultra Badlander</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Camo-shroom provides camouflage to nearby Scaredy-shrooms hiding from zombies.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Flying plant.
<color=black>•</color> Zombies won't eat hiding Scaredy-type plants in a 3×3 area around the Camo-shroom.</color>

german.name: Angstdrohne
german.introduce:
<align=left><size=36><color=black>Camo-shroom cares for his friends. Even though he can fly away from the danger of zombies, into the clouds of high above, he can't simply abandon his roots. In an attempt to protect them, he covers them with his leaves and begs the zombies not to hurt them. And the zombies, for some reason, listen.

-Written by Ultra Badlander</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Floats above ground, providing camouflage to nearby Scaredy-shrooms hiding from zombies.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Hovering plant.
<color=black>•</color> Zombies won't eat hiding Scaredy-type plants in a 3×3 area around the Camo-shroom.</color>

original.name: 猫尾草
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“嗷！”猫尾草说，“嗷！嗷！嗷！这让你困惑了么？你不会看到我的名字里有'猫'，而且我也长得像猫咪，就期待我像猫儿一样'喵喵'地叫吧？那种想法在这儿可不管用。我可不想被擅自归类。”</color>
original.info:
发射可以扎破气球的追踪尖刺。
<color=#800080>需要种植在睡莲上</color>

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20×2/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>水生</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>全场索敌，优先对空</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>睡莲（底座）+猫尾草或其卡片/肥料</color>

english.name: Cattail
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Woof!" says Cattail. "Woof woof woof! Does this confuse you? Do you expect me to say 'Meow' like a cat because the word 'cat' is in my name and I also look like a cat? That's not how things work around here. I refuse to be pigeonholed."</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Cattails can attack any lane and shoot down balloon zombies.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20×2/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Can only be placed on existing Lily Pads.</color></size>

german.name: Katzenschwanz
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>'Wau!', sagt Katzenschwanz. 'Wau, wau, wau! Verwirrt dich das? Sollte ich lieber ''Miau'' sagen, so wie eine Katze, bloß weil ich ''Katze'' im Namen trage und auch wie eine aussehe? So läuft das hier nicht. Ich lasse mich nicht in eine Schublade stecken.'</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Katzenschwänze greifen beliebige Reihen an und schießen Ballon-Zombies ab.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20*2/1.5 Sekunden</color></size>

original.name: 灰烬三线射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>烈火焚烧着他残存的身体，高温磨砺着他最后的意志，生命如风中奄奄一息的残烛，每一次的喘息都带来万箭攒心的痛楚。可是看，看啊，灰烬三线依然屹立于大地之上！他坚信那些依旧在身体深处灿烂的闪耀，都将在一场最为盛大的爆炸与绽放中迎来永生。 </color>
original.info:
被彻底烧焦，无法攻击。

<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>焦黑三线射手+火爆辣椒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>失去攻击能力</color>

english.name: Charred Threepeater
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The flames consume his broken body, each breath a torment, yet the Charred Threepeater stands tall. He believes the fire within will achieve eternal glory in one final, grand explosion.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Charred Threepeater awaits his rebirth.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Loses attack capabilities after being thoroughly burnt.</color>

german.name: Aschfahl Triplinator
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Die Flammen verzehren seinen gebrochenen Körper, jeder Atemzug ist eine Qual, doch der Aschfahl Triplinator steht aufrecht. Er glaubt, dass das Feuer in ihm in einer letzten, großen Explosion ewigen Ruhm erlangen wird.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Der Aschfahl Triplinator wartet auf seine Wiedergeburt.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Verliert seine Angriffsfähigkeit, nachdem er gründlich verbrannt wurde.</color>

original.name: 樱桃大嘴花
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​自从跟樱桃炸弹喝了次酒，大嘴花就老是“炸炸呼呼”的。“尝尝这个！”这是他的饭前新口头禅，咀嚼声变成了爆炸声，碟碗乱飞，没有人愿意和他一起吃饭。最后经过一次举手表决，樱桃大嘴花不得不去院子里吃饭。现在，他倒是在僵尸上找到了乐趣，“尝尝这个！”——至少不用再买新餐具了。​</color>
original.info:
吞下僵尸时在前方释放樱桃炸弹效果。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>秒杀（吞食）</color>
<color=#3D1400>消化时间：</color><color=red>40秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>吞食成功时，在前方1格释放樱桃炸弹效果</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大嘴花+樱桃炸弹</color>

english.name: Cherry Chomper
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Ever since her drink with Cherry Bomb, Chomper has been constantly "buzzing." She turned into an absolute menace every meal. The sound of chewing transformed into explosive pops as plates and bowls flew everywhere, leaving everyone unwilling to dine with her. After a show of hands, Cherry Chomper ended up eating in the yard… at least she no longer has to buy new tableware.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Cherry Chomper produces a cherry explosion upon eating a zombie.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>Insta-kill (Devour) + 1800 (Cremator)</color>
<color=black>Digestion Time: </color><color=#8B0000>40s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Creates a 3×3 Cherry explosion in the tile directly ahead on successful biting.</color></size>

german.name: Kirschnapper
german.introduce: <size=32><color=black>Seit ihrem Drink mit Kirschbombe war Schnapper ständig „aufgedreht“. Sie verwandelte sich bei jeder Mahlzeit in ein wahres Ungeheuer. Das Geräusch des Kauens verwandelte sich in explosive Knalle, während Teller und Schalen überall durch die Luft flogen, was dazu führte, dass niemand mehr mit ihr essen wollte. Nach einer Umfrage landete Kirschnapper im Garten… wenigstens muss sie nun kein neues Geschirr mehr kaufen.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=32>Kirschnapper erzeugt eine Kirschexplosion, nachdem er einen Zombie gegessen hat.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000> Sofortiges Töten + 1800 (Einäscherung)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Erzeugt beim Beißen eine Kirschenexplosion in einem 3x3-Raster.</color></size>

original.name: 樱桃小蘑菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>樱桃小蘑菇非常调皮开朗，他们喜欢宴会、喜欢游戏，每当有人过生日，他们就会跳到生日蛋糕上面、吓寿星一跳。他们对自己的味道口感非常自信，绝对比蛋糕上原本的樱桃更加脆爽。</color>
original.info:
爆裂时挂载半熟樱桃，一段时间后产生更强的爆炸。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>900</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮，可密植</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>接触非空中的僵尸或死亡时，为半径1.5格内的随机一只僵尸挂载基础伤害为自身攻击力的半熟樱桃，再造成半径1.5格樱桃爆炸伤害(效果同爆炸樱桃)</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>小喷菇（底座）+樱桃炸弹</color>

english.name: Cherry Pop
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Cherry Pops are mischievous and cheerful. They love parties and games, and whenever someone has a birthday, they jump onto the birthday cake to give the birthday boy or girl a fright. They're very confident in their own flavor and texture: definitely crispier and juicier than the cherries that normally go on cakes.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Cherry Pop attaches a half-ripe cherry to zombies, which produces a stronger explosion after a delay.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>900 (Cremator)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant, can be stacked.
<color=black>•</color> Upon contact with a non-flying Zombie or dying, attaches a half-ripe cherry with base damage equal to its own attack power to a random Zombie within 1.5 tiles, then deals Cherry explosion damage in a 1.5-tile radius (same effect as Cherry Bomb explosion).</color>

german.name: Cherry Pop
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Cherry Pops are mischievous and cheerful. They love parties and games, and whenever someone has a birthday, they jump onto the birthday cake to give the birthday boy or girl a fright. They're very confident in their own flavor and texture: definitely crispier and juicier than the cherries that normally go on cakes.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Cherry Pop attaches a half-ripe cherry to zombies, which produces a stronger explosion after a delay.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>900 (Cremator)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant, can be stacked.
<color=black>•</color> Upon contact with a non-flying Zombie or dying, attaches a half-ripe cherry with base damage equal to its own attack power to a random Zombie within 1.5 tiles, then deals Cherry explosion damage in a 1.5-tile radius (same effect as Cherry Bomb explosion).</color>

original.name: 樱桃花盆
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>樱桃花盆宁可不去禅境花园领取自己的那一份植物工资，也要证明自己不是一株植物。“那群疯子，他们吃不到樱桃，就想去吃所有樱桃味的植物。”每当提起自己的经历，樱桃花盆都心有余悸。</color>
original.info:
喜爱樱桃爆炸的花盆，能借之治疗本格植物并强化樱桃系射手。

<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>可种裸地，低矮，载体</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>免疫樱桃爆炸伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>受到樱桃爆炸时，为本格植物回复20点血量，并为樱桃射手类植物提供50%攻速加成持续5秒，持续时间不可叠加</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>花盆（底座）+樱桃炸弹</color>

english.name: Cherry Pot
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Cherry Pot would rather give up her pay at the Zen Garden than be mistaken for a plant."Those lunatics can't get real cherries, so they're out here trying to eat anything cherry-flavored!" Just talking about it makes her shudder.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Cherry Pot heals the plant on her tile when it's affected by cherry explosions, and empowers Cherry-type shooters.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Immune to cherry explosions.
<color=black>•</color> Heals the plant on herself by 20 HP when affected by cherry explosions.
<color=black>•</color> While healing, also grants an attack speed boost (50%) for 5s to cherry shooting plants (unstackable).</color>

german.name: Kirschtopf
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Cherry Pot would rather give up her pay at the Zen Garden than be mistaken for a plant."Those lunatics can't get real cherries, so they're out here trying to eat anything cherry-flavored!" Just talking about it makes her shudder.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>A pot with a passion for cherry explosions, using them to heal the plant on her own tile and briefly empower cherry-type shooters.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Immune to cherry explosions.
<color=black>•</color> Heals the plant on herself by 20 HP when affected by cherry explosions.
<color=black>•</color> While healing, also grants an attack speed boost (50%) for 5s to cherry shooting plants.</color>

original.name: 樱桃南瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>樱桃南瓜是樱桃坚果的远房亲戚，可每次樱桃南瓜与樱桃坚果相约时樱桃南瓜总是迟到。“我也想早来呀”樱桃南瓜诉着自己的苦，“可我一遇到红红的东西就忍不住往那跳啊”</color>
original.info:
免疫并阻挡樱桃爆炸伤害的南瓜。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫樱桃爆炸伤害，阻止爆炸樱桃溅射。受到各类樱桃爆炸效果时回血200</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>南瓜（底座）+樱桃炸弹</color>

english.name: Cherry Pumpkin
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Cherry Pumpkin is a distant relative of Cherry-nut, but every time Cherry Pumpkin meets Cherry-nut, he is always late. "I want to come early too," Cherry Pumpkin says, "but I can't resist jumping to anything red."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Cherry Pumpkin is a pumpkin that cannot be exploded by cherries!

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Absorbs explosive cherries and heals 200 Toughness instead.</color>

german.name: Kürschbis
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Pump-Kaboom is a distant relative of Cherry-nut, but every time Pump-Kaboom meets Cherry-nut, he is always late. "I want to come early too," Pump-Kaboom says, "but I can’t resist jumping to anything red."</color>
german.info:
<size=36>A pumpkin that cannot be exploded by cherries!

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Cannot be damaged by zombie Cherry Bomb explosions and heals instead.</color>

original.name: 樱桃窝瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>即便在窝瓜中，樱桃窝瓜也算得上是脾气暴躁、一点就着。“当你背后背着那么沉重的累赘，你也会很暴躁。”樱桃窝瓜说。不过比起暴脾气，其他窝瓜更好奇，樱桃窝瓜头顶的叶子是怎么做到没被他的怒火烤焦的。</color>
original.info:
蕴含樱桃炸弹力量的窝瓜，比较冲动好斗。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1800（压扁）</color>
<color=#3D1400>索敌范围：</color><color=red>左侧2格~右侧3格</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>落地时，释放伤害与自身攻击力相同的樱桃炸弹效果</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>窝瓜+樱桃炸弹</color>

english.name: Cherry Squash
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Even among Squashes, Cherry Squash is famously short-tempered and quick to explode. "Try carrying something that heavy on your back," he grumbles. Other Squashes are less concerned about the temper, and more curious how he could jump so high and so far with the thing on his back.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Cherry Squash unleashes a Cherry Bomb explosion upon squashing a zombie.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Squash) + 1800 (3×3, Cremator)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>2 tiles to the left; 3 tiles to the right</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Upon landing, triggers a Cherry Bomb explosion.</color>

german.name: Kirschmus
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Even among Squashes, Cherry Squash is famously short-tempered and quick to explode. "Try carrying something that heavy on your back," he grumbles. Other Squashes are less concerned about the temper, and more curious how he could jump so high and so far with the thing on his back.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>A very explosive Squash.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Squash) + 1800 (3×3, Cremator)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>2 tiles to the left; 3 tiles to the right</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Upon landing, triggers a Cherry Bomb explosion.</color>

original.name: 樱桃坚果
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​“我听说有僵尸抱怨总是吃不到樱桃，你看，我不就来了？”憨憨的樱桃坚果摇了摇头上的叶子，并表示自己是纯正樱桃味。“不过先说好，下次有樱桃的时候要分我点哦，没关系，‘热情’点也能接受，毕竟我就是为此而生的呀”</color>
original.info:
喜爱樱桃爆炸的坚果。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>免疫樱桃爆炸伤害。受到各类樱桃爆炸效果时回血200</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>死亡时释放樱桃炸弹效果</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>坚果+樱桃炸弹</color>

english.name: Cherry-nut
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I heard some zombies grumbling about their inability to eat cherries. Well, here I am!" The cheerful Cherry-nut shook the leaves atop his head, boasting about his pure cherry flavor. "But first, you have to promise me something: when you have cherries, share a bit with me. In fact, just give me everything you've got! I was born for this!"</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Cherry-nut can absorb explosion damage to restore his Toughness.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Absorbs Cherry explosion damage to restore 200 Toughness.</color></size>

german.name: Terroris-Nuss
german.introduce: <size=32><color=black>„Ich habe gehört, wie einige Zombies über ihre Unfähigkeit, Kirschen essen zu können, murrten. Nun, hier bin ich!“ Der fröhliche Kirsch-Nuss schüttelte die Blätter auf seinem Kopf und prahlte mit seinem reinen Kirschgeschmack. „Aber zuerst musst du mir etwas versprechen: Wenn du Kirschen hast, teile ein bisschen mit mir. Gib mir eigentlich alles, was du hast! Ich wurde dafür geboren!“</color></size>
german.info:
<size=32>Terroris-Nuss kann Explosionsschaden absorbieren und seine Zähigkeit wiederherstellen.

<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Absorbiert Cherry-Explosionsschaden, um die Zähigkeit wiederherzustellen. (Vom Verbündeten: 25, Vom Feind: 200)</color></size>

original.name: 樱桃三线射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“好吃的樱桃。”“新鲜的樱桃。”“便宜的樱桃。”樱桃三线射手的三张嘴一起卖力吆喝，然而他的樱桃生意始终没有起色。买过的人都表示，这种樱桃实在是太粘牙了。</color>
original.info:
向三行发射半熟樱桃，留在僵尸身上一段时间后成熟并爆开。
