<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20×3/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>子弹会挂载在目标身上，6秒后造成半径1格物理爆炸。每个目标身上最多挂载1个半熟樱桃</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>子弹挂载期间，目标僵尸受到的各类樱桃子弹和樱桃爆炸伤害的25%会累计到子弹伤害上</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>三线射手+樱桃炸弹</color>

english.name: Cherry-spreader
english.introduce: "Delicious cherries!" "Fresh cherries!" "Cheap cherries!" Cherry-spreader's three mouths shout tirelessly, yet their cherry business never seems to take off. Those who have tried them say these cherries are just too sticky.
english.info:
<size=36>Cherry-spreader fires half-ripe cherries across three lanes. They stick to zombies and mature after a short delay, then explode.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20×3/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Projectiles attach to targets and explode after 6s with a 1-tile splash radius. Each zombie can only have one half-ripe cherry attached.
<color=black>•</color> While attached, half-ripe cherries absorb 25% of all cherry-type projectile and cherry explosion damage the zombie takes, adding that to its final explosion damage.</color>

german.name: Tripli-Bomber
german.introduce: "Delicious cherries!" "Fresh cherries!" "Cheap cherries!" Cherry-spreader's three mouths shout tirelessly, yet their cherry business never seems to take off. Those who have tried them say these cherries are just too sticky.
german.info:
<size=36>Fires half-ripe cherries across three lanes. They stick to zombies and mature after a short delay, then explode.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20×3/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Projectiles attach to targets and explode after 6s with a 1-tile splash radius. Each zombie can only have one half-ripe cherry attached.
<color=black>•</color> While attached, half-ripe cherries absorb 25% of all cherry-type projectile and cherry explosion damage the zombie takes, adding that to its final explosion damage.</color>

original.name: 樱桃双发射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​樱桃双发射手信奉“好事成双”，所以他什么时候做事都是成双成对的，不论是对付僵尸还是出门送礼。“可是老兄。”樱桃射手对他说道，“你这一对樱桃根本没熟啊。</color>
original.info:
发射粉樱桃子弹的双发射手。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40×2/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>增生豆荚：</color><color=red>出场15秒后手动点击，即可升级为樱桃裂荚射手</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手×2+樱桃炸弹</color>

english.name: Cherrypeater
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Cherrypeater lives by the motto "good things come in pairs." Whether it's fighting zombies or handing out presents, he does it all in twos. "But come on," Repeater teased, "those cherries of yours aren't even close to ripe."</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Cherrypeater can fire two cherries at a time.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40×2/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Tap to auto-fuse with a free Peashooter 15s after planting.</color></size>

german.name: Kirsch-Duplinator
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Kirsch-Duplinator lebt nach dem Motto „Alle guten Dinge sind zwei.“ Ob es darum geht, Zombies zu bekämpfen oder Geschenke zu verteilen, er tut alles zu zweit. „Aber komm schon,“ neckte Duplinator, „diese Kirschen von dir sind noch lange nicht reif.“</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Kirsch-Duplinator kann zwei Kirschen gleichzeitig abfeuern.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>60*2/1.5 Sekunden</color></size>

original.name: 樱桃射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​“我红温了？呸！你才红温，你全家都是红色的”樱桃射手讨厌别人对他的后脑勺开玩笑。不过大家后来就不这么说了——在吃了特制樱桃后，樱桃射手确实容易红温了，而且他真的会射樱桃子弹。”</color>
original.info:
发射粉樱桃子弹的射手。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手+樱桃炸弹</color>

english.name: Cherryshooter
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"You think I have red-hot anger issues? Me? Bah! You're red and hot! Your whole family is red!" Cherryshooter despised being teased about the color of his head. But the jokes didn't last long. It was just a happy incident. After eating special cherries, Peashooter found himself turning red and hot, and surprisingly, he could shoot cherries.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Cherryshooter fires cherries that deal twice as much damage!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1.5s</color></size>

german.name: Kirschkanone
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>"Du denkst, ich habe Probleme mit meiner Wut? Ich? Ha! Du bist rot und heiß! Deine ganze Familie ist rot!" Kirschkanone hasste es, wegen der Farbe seines Kopfes gehänselt zu werden. Aber die Witze hielten nicht lange. Es war nur ein glücklicher Vorfall. Nachdem Erbsenkanone spezielle Kirschen gegessen hatte, fand er sich plötzlich rot und heiß wieder, und erstaunlicherweise konnte er Kirschen schießen.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Kirschkanone schießt kraftvolle Kirschen ab.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>60/1.5 Sekunden</color></size>

original.name: 辣椒土豆雷
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>当一份辣椒和一份土豆混合在一起，是什么味道呢？作为一名优秀的厨师，辣椒土豆雷已经迫不及待的想请僵尸品尝她的这道新菜了！</color>
original.info:
利用爆炸时的能量，在本行播种土豆雷并催熟。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1800</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>死亡时释放土豆雷爆炸，并在本行生成7个只需5秒出土的土豆雷</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>土豆雷+火爆辣椒</color>

english.name: Chip Mine
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Chip Mine is a capable assistant to Cluster Mine, but most of her dishes are given low ratings by customers. "What's going on—" Chip Mine feels really guilty but doesn't know why. The truth is, she is not sensitive to spicy flavors and always adds too much chili.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Chip Mine splits into 7 Potato Mines in her lane. 

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>1800</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant. Explodes like a Potato Mine and spawns up to 7 Potato Mines that only need 5s to arm themselves in her lane upon defeat.</color>

german.name: Chilimine
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Chili Mine is a capable assistant to Explod-o-tato Mine, but most of her dishes are given low ratings by customers. "What’s going on—" Chili Mine feels really guilty but doesn't know why. The truth is, she is not sensitive to spicy flavors and always adds too much chili.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Splits into 7 Potato Mines in her lane. 

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Spawns 7 Potato Mines in her lane upon defeat.</color>

original.name: 土豆大嘴花
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​土豆大嘴花十分美味，宛如一份自热的土豆泥，僵尸们对此十分狂热，其中最被广大僵尸们称道的就是那根薯条。当一只只僵尸被薯条的芳香吸引而至，殊不知他们也是土豆大嘴花的美味。“守株待兔罢了。”土豆大嘴花咀嚼着说，“他们的养分将会转化为新的地雷。”</color>
original.info:
守株待兔的大嘴花，消化完成时在前方生成土豆雷。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>秒杀（吞食）</color>
<color=#3D1400>消化时间：</color><color=red>20秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>出场时返还75阳光，死亡时释放土豆雷爆炸</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>消化完成时，在前方生成一个立即出土的土豆雷</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大嘴花+土豆雷</color>

english.name: Chomp-mine
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Delicious and enticing, Potato Mines taste just like self-heating mashed potatoes, earning rave reviews from zombies. Among them, fries take the top spot in popularity. As zombies flock to the tantalizing aroma of French fries, they have no idea they're also indulging in tasty potato chips. "Just wait and see," Chomp-mine said with a mouthful, "Their nutrients will soon become new mines."</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>After swallowing a zombie, Chomp-mine will grow Potato Mines in front.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>Insta-kill (Devour)</color>
<color=black>Digestion Time: </color><color=#8B0000>20s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Fusion returns 75 Sun.
<color=black>•</color> Plants a fully armed Potato Mine in front of it upon finishing digesting a zombie. Also explodes like a Potato Mine on death.</color></size>

german.name: Kau-Mine
german.introduce: <size=32><color=black>Lecker und verlockend, Kartoffelminen schmecken genau wie selbstwärmendes Kartoffelpüree und erhalten begeisterte Kritiken von Zombies. Unter ihnen nehmen Pommes den Spitzenplatz in der Beliebtheit ein. Während die Zombies sich zum verlockenden Aroma von Pommes frites versammeln, haben sie keine Ahnung, dass sie auch köstliche Kartoffelchips genießen. „Wartet nur ab“, sagte Kau-Mine mit vollem Mund, „Ihre Nährstoffe werden bald zu neuen Minen.“</color></size>
german.info:
<size=32>Nach dem Verschlingen eines Zombies wird Kau-Mine Kartoffelminen vor sich wachsen lassen.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000> Sofortiges Töten</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Legt eine Kartoffelmine vor sich hin, wenn er einen Zombie verschluckt.</color></size>

original.name: 大嘴坚果
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​大嘴坚果小时候很挑食，从不一口吞食僵尸，这让他的父母很烦恼。在父母的规劝下，大嘴坚果最终像前辈们那样一口吞。“我不是挑食，我只是想模仿僵尸们进食罢了。总该尝试点新东西不是吗？绝对不是没有脖子而不方便一口吞的缘故。”咀嚼着僵尸的大嘴坚果如是说道。​​</color>
original.info:
可以吞食僵尸的坚果，消化完成时回复一定血量。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>秒杀（吞食）</color>
<color=#3D1400>消化时间：</color><color=red>40秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>消化完成时回血1000</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>坚果+大嘴花</color>

english.name: Chomp-nut
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>As a young plant, Chomp-nut was notoriously picky about food, never swallowing zombies in one bite, which frustrated its parents. After much persuasion, Chomp-nut finally learned to consume zombies whole, just like its predecessors. "I'm not picky! I just want to imitate how zombies eat. I should try something new, right? It's definitely not because I don't have a neck!" Chomp-nut said while chewing on a zombie.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Chomp-nut can restore its Toughness after eating zombies.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>Insta-kill (Devour)</color>
<color=black>Digestion Time: </color><color=#8B0000>40s</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Restores 1000 Toughness after digestion.</color></size>

german.name: Schnapp-Nuss
german.introduce: <size=32><color=black>Als junge Pflanze war Schnapp-Nuss notorisch wählerisch beim Essen und verschlang nie Zombies auf einmal, was seine Eltern frustrierte. Nach viel Überredungskunst lernte Schnapp-Nuss schließlich, Zombies ganz zu verschlingen, genau wie seine Vorgänger. „Ich bin nicht wählerisch! Ich möchte einfach nachahmen, wie Zombies essen. Ich sollte etwas Neues ausprobieren, oder? Es liegt definitiv nicht daran, dass ich keinen Hals habe!“ sagte Schnapp-Nuss, während er auf einem Zombie kaute.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=32>Schnapp-Nuss kann seine Zähigkeit nach dem Verzehr von Zombies wiederherstellen.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000> Sofortiges Töten</color>
<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color></size>

original.name: 豌豆大嘴花
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>也被称为“裂颊”​大嘴花，嚼食僵尸时，总有残渣从裂开的嘴角漏到地上。​</color>
original.info:
咀嚼时吐出可以穿透的滚地尸块。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>秒杀（吞食）；80/3秒（尸块）</color>
<color=#3D1400>消化时间：</color><color=red>30秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>咀嚼时吐出滚地的尸块子弹，无限穿透</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手+大嘴花</color>

english.name: Chomp-shooter
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Chomper has always envied Chomp-shooter's ability to spit out zombie remains, and he's tried to learn the trick more than once. Little did he know, though, that the secret wasn't a special skill—it was just that Chomp-shooter's mouth was slightly deformed, causing bits of zombie to leak out while chewing.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Chomp-shooter can fire zombie parts down the lane after devouring.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>Insta-kill (Devour); 80/3s (Zombie part)</color>
<color=black>Digestion Time: </color><color=#8B0000>30s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Spits out rolling zombie parts while chewing that deal 80 damage each and have infinite pierce.</color></size>

german.name: Schnapp-Kanone
german.introduce: <size=34><color=black>Schnapper hat immer die Fähigkeit von Schnapp-Kanone beneidet, Zombieüberreste auszuspucken, und er hat mehr als einmal versucht, den Trick zu lernen. Was er jedoch nicht wusste, war, dass das Geheimnis keine besondere Fähigkeit war—es war einfach, dass der Mund von Schnapp-Kanone leicht deformiert war, wodurch beim Kauen Stücke von Zombies herausliefen.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=34>Schnapp-Kanone kann Teile nach dem Beißen abfeuern.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000> Sofortiges Töten</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Spuckt nach dem Biss rollende Zombieteile aus, die 80 Schaden verursachen.</color></size>

original.name: 大嘴南瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>大嘴南瓜开了一家大嘴健身房，本意是帮助大嘴花们快速消化食物、防止脂肪堆积、塑造好的体型。健身房一炮而红，生意兴隆，但大嘴南瓜却高兴不起来。“那些大嘴花根本不是来健身的，而是把健身房当成了餐馆，在这里他们能多吃三顿饭！”他愤愤道。</color>
original.info:
为内部的大嘴花提供袋装的消化液，帮助其快速消化。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>出场7.5秒后生产一袋消化液，此后每40秒生产一袋。最多同时拥有三袋</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>如果壳内的大嘴花类植物处于消化时间，消耗一袋消化液，使其立即消化完成</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>南瓜（底座）+大嘴花</color>

english.name: Chompkin
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Chompkin opened a gym for Chompers, meant to help them digest better, burn fat, and stay in shape. It became wildly popular, but he's not happy. "They're not training, they're eating! My gym’s become a buffet!" he vents.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Chompkin can instantly end the disgestion time of chompers inside if it has the Stomach Sac to do so.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Periodically uses a reserve Digestive Sac to help the Chomper plant in the same tile to instantly finish digesting (or to instantly recharge the Devour abilities of Chompzillas and its fusions).
<color=black>•</color> Generates 1 Digestive Sac every 40s, up to a maximum of 3 at the same time. First Digestive Sac takes 7.5s to generate.</color>

german.name: Schnabulürbis
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Chompkin opened a gym for Chompers, meant to help them digest better, burn fat, and stay in shape. It became wildly popular, but he's not happy. "They're not training, they're eating! My gym’s become a buffet!" he vents.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Provides digestive aids for Chomper-type plants inside his shell to speed up digestion.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Periodically uses a reserve Digestive Sac to help the Chomper plant in the same tile to instantly finish digesting (or to instantly recharge the Devour abilities of Chompzillas and its fusions).
<color=black>•</color> Generates 1 Digestive Sac every 40s, up to a maximum of 3 at the same time. First Digestive Sac takes 7.5s to generate.</color>

original.name: 超级大嘴花
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​超级大嘴花向来注重养生，每次吃饭都是细嚼慢咽的，也许那不算咽。所以嘴也变小了许多。“那些大嘴巴不仅吃没吃相，还不去健身，果然一碰就碎，这能上前线？”超级大嘴花一边举着哑铃一边不屑地说，“你问我为什么那么精神？我只吃僵尸肉的精华部分，那些残渣我都吐掉了，丝毫影响不了我的身体。”最近后院的垃圾不少啊？——戴夫​​</color>
original.info:
能抗能打的前排小战神。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000，限伤1/3倍韧性</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>200（啃咬）/1.75秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>血量最高为4倍韧性，超过韧性的血量以(5%韧性/1秒)的速率流失</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>啃咬后，回复等于造成伤害量的血量，吐出80伤害的滚地尸块</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>目标血量不大于500且没有一类防具时，啃咬伤害提升为500，回血400，且吐出的滚地尸块可以击退</color>
<color=#3D1400>④</color><color=red>啃咬能造成100万伤害。该效果触发后，需要消化40秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手+大嘴花+坚果</color>

english.name: Chompzilla
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Chompzilla savors every meal, despite his smaller mouth. "Chompers are sloppy and don't hit the gym; they fall apart on the front line," he scoffs. "I only eat the essence of zombie meat and spit out the rest," he grins, though his backyard is filling up with leftovers.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Chompzilla is both a bulwark and fierce attacker.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000> 200/1.75 (Chomp); 80/3s (Zombie part)</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Chomping zombies restores 200 Toughness and deals 200 damage. Spits out rolling zombie parts after that deal 80 damage and pierce infinitely.
<color=black>•</color> Instantly kills unarmored zombies with less than 500 Toughness, restoring 400 Toughness. Also spits out parts that knockback zombies. 
<color=black>•</color> Every 40s, devours a zombie and restores to max (up to 16k HP). Excess Toughness drains at 200 per second.
<color=black>•</color> Damage taken per hit is capped at 1/3 Toughness.</color></size>

german.name: Kauzilla
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black></color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Kauzilla kann sowohl als Schanzkleid dienen als auch ein heftiger Angreifer sein.

<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Das Verspeisen von Zombies stellt 200 Ausdauer wieder her und verursacht 200 Schaden, während es rollende Zombieteile ausspuckt, die 80 Schaden verursachen und unendlich durchbohrt werden können. Zombies mit HP < 500 und ohne Rüstung werden sofort getötet, stellen 400 Ausdauer wieder her und spucken rollende Zombieteile aus.</color></size>

original.name: 蒜玉米投手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“90年代的人们普遍认为对付僵尸最有用的就是糯米和黑狗血。对于我们植物而言大蒜是战略性资源。”蒜玉米投手老神叨叨的说道。其实他只是一只老了的玉米，一直在装蒜。</color>
original.info:
蒜味的玉米投手，投出的玉米粒或黄油也带有蒜味。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>有25%概率投出伤害60的蒜黄油，定身4秒并施加剧毒效果。两种子弹均享受(20×目标蒜值)的伤害加成，造成伤害后赋予1点蒜值</color>
<color=#3D1400>剧毒效果：</color><color=red>施加10秒中毒状态。施加时若蒜值已有5点，则使蒜值上限突破至30，且本次中毒每次被赋予蒜值时，均会附带剧毒效果</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>玉米投手+大蒜</color>

english.name: Clove-pult
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"In the 90's, people widely believed that the best way to deal with zombies was with cornmeal and black dog blood. For us plants, garlic is a strategic resource," Clove-pult says with a wise demeanor.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Clove-pult throws small cloves at the zombies; sometimes they're buttered, which can negate the poison cap!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/3s</color>
<color=#5E1675>Poison System: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Each attack deals an additional 5×(target Poison value) damage and then accumulates 1 Poison point. 
<color=black>•</color> At 5 points, the Toxic Effect is applied.
<color=black>•</color> Has a 1/4 chance to throw garlic butter with 60 damage, immobilizing zombies for 4s, immediately poisoning the zombie for 9s and raising the Poison value cap to 30 points.
<color=#5E1675>Poisoned Debuff: </color>Zombies lose (20×Poison point) Toughness per second while poisoned.</color>

german.name: Gewürznelkepult
german.introduce: <size=30><color=black></color>
german.info:
<size=30>Gewürznelkepult hat eine Chance, Knoblauchbutter zu werfen, die Zombies für 4 Sekunden lähmt und sie dazu zwingt, die Spur zu wechseln, während Giftpunkte gesammelt werden, um den Vergifteten Schwächungszauber anzuwenden.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20/3 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Vergiftungssystem: </color><color=#8B0000>Jeder Angriff akkumuliert 1 Giftpunkt, maximal 5. Bei 5 Punkten wird der Vergifteter Schwächungszauber angewendet. Hat eine 1/4 Chance, Knoblauchbutter zu werfen, die Zombies für 4 Sekunden bewegungsunfähig zu machen, einen Spurwechsel zu erzwingen und die Obergrenze für Giftpunkte zu entfernen. Zombies verlieren (20 × Giftpunkt) HP / Sekunde, solange sie vergiftet sind.</color>

original.name: 樱桃土豆雷
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>樱桃土豆雷是一位一级厨师，他烹饪的“樱桃味土豆泥”和“土豆丝”在植物界广受好评。如果他没有食材了，他就会笑着说:“我去买吧。”</color>
original.info:
利用爆炸时的能量，在周围播种土豆雷并催熟。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1800</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>死亡时释放土豆雷爆炸，并在3×3范围内的每个格子生成1个只需5秒出土的土豆雷</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>土豆雷+樱桃炸弹</color>

english.name: Cluster Mine
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Cluster Mine is a top chef, and his "hash cherries" and "potato jam" are highly praised in the plant world. If he runs out of ingredients, he will cheerfully say: "I'll go buy some."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Cluster Mine splits into 8 Potato Mines in surrounding tiles.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>1800</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant. Explodes like a Potato Mine and spawns Potato Mines that only need 5s to arm themselves in a 3×3 range upon defeat.</color>

german.name: Kar-TnT-offel-Mine
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Explod-o-tato Mine is a top chef, and his "hash cherries" and "potato jam" are highly praised in the plant world. If he runs out of ingredients, he will cheerfully say: "I'll go buy some."</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Splits into 8 Potato Mines in surrounding tiles.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Spawns Potato Mines in a 3×3 radius upon defeat.</color>

original.name: 玉米加农炮
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>玉米加农炮到底是怎么一回事？他曾在哈佛大学深造，就职于纽约一家著名的律师事务所，发射一次炮弹就能歼灭大范围的僵尸。大家都知道这些。不过，内心深处，是什么驱动着他呢？</color>
original.info:
点击以发射一枚致命的玉米炮弹。
<color=#800080>需要种植在一对相邻的玉米投手上</color>

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1800（灰烬）</color>
<color=#3D1400>装填时间：</color><color=red>35秒
*装填完成后需要1秒推弹入膛</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>巨型</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>手动点击发射。炮弹会伤害落点中心半径1.5格的僵尸</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>玉米投手×2（底座）+玉米加农炮或其卡片/肥料</color>

english.name: Cob Cannon
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Cob Cannon is quite the intellectual powerhouse—rumor has it that it studied at Harvard and once worked at a prestigious law firm in New York. Known for its immense power, a single shot from Cob Cannon can decimate a large area of zombies. However, the true source of its formidable energy remains a mystery.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Cob Cannon can be manually operated to launch deadly corn cobs that cause cremator damage.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Cremator)</color>
<color=black>Reloading Time: </color><color=#8B0000>36s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Must be planted on two side-by-side Kernel-pults.</color>

german.name: Maiskanone
german.introduce: <size=33><color=black>Was ist nur mit Maiskanone los? Er ging nach Harvard. Wurde Anwalt in einer angesehenen New Yorker Firma. Er kann ganze Zombiegruppen mit einem Maiskolben sprengen. Jeder weiß das. Aber wer weiß schon, wie er wirklich tickt?</color>
german.info:
<size=33>Klick auf die Maiskanone, um tödliche Maiskolben abzufeuern.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Einäscherung)</color>
<color=black>Scharfschaltzeit: </color><color=#8B0000>36 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Muss auf zwei Kornapulte gepflanzt werden.</color>

original.name: 玉米瓜投手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>玉米瓜到底是糯的还是甜的？僵尸们只觉得脑袋嗡嗡的，无暇去思考这个问题。</color>
original.info:
投出玉米瓜或能范围定身的黄油瓜。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>140/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>有25%概率投出160伤害的黄油瓜，使直击的目标定身4秒，使溅射范围内的僵尸定身(4/溅射总数)秒，最低0.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>西瓜投手+玉米投手</color>

english.name: Cob-pult
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Cob-pult is often seen frowning. When asked why, he says nothing. "People keep asking me if Buttered Corn is sticky or sweet," Cob-pult sighs. "Why ask me? I don't eat it. Only the zombies would know."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Cob-pult throws large corns at the zombies; sometimes they're buttered, which can immobilize all zombies in an area!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>120/3s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Has a 1/4 chance to throw a Buttered Corn with 140 damage, immobilizing the main target for 4 seconds and zombies in the splash range for (4 / total splash spread) seconds (minimum of 0.5).</color>

german.name: Maispult
german.introduce: <size=32><color=black>Maispult wird oft mit einem finsteren Gesichtsausdruck gesehen. Auf die Frage nach dem Grund sagt er nichts. „Die Leute fragen mich immer wieder, ob Buttermais klebrig oder süß ist“, seufzt Maispult. „Warum fragt ihr mich? Ich esse das nicht. Nur die Zombies könnten es wissen.“</color>
german.info:
<size=32>Wirft große Maiskolben auf die Zombies; manchmal sind sie mit Butter überzogen.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>100/3 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Hat eine 1/4 Chance, einen Buttermais zu werfen, der das Hauptziel für 4 Sekunden und Zombies im Sprühbereich für (4 / gesamte Sprühweite) Sekunden bewegungsunfähig macht (Minimum von 0,5).</color>

original.name: 寒冰玉米投手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>为了冻出完美的黄油，寒冰玉米投手专门去了一趟西伯利亚。现在它的黄油就像大理石一样平滑，沉重，坚硬，美丽，并且砸在僵尸脑袋上能发出咚的一声响。</color>
original.info:
投出寒冰玉米粒或“雪糕”。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>投出寒冰玉米粒，施加寒冷状态，赋予10冻结值。有25%概率投出会施加4秒冻结的“雪糕”</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>对冻结的僵尸伤害×4</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>玉米投手+寒冰菇</color>

english.name: Cobsicle
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>To freeze the perfect butter, Cobsicle made a special trip to Siberia. Now, its butter is as smooth as marble; heavy, hard, beautiful, and makes a satisfying thud when smashed on a zombie's head.'</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Cobsicle lobs frozen kernels which chill zombies, it also has a chance to throw a frozen butter instead, freezing the zombie.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20/3s</color>
<color=#0077b6>Cryo System: </color><color=#8B0000>Attacks inflict Chill, add 10 Cryo points and deal ×4 damage to frozen zombies.</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Has a 25% chance to throw a frozen butter stick that freezes zombies for 4 seconds.</color>

german.name: Eismais
german.introduce: <color=#3D1400>To freeze the perfect butter, Cobsicle made a special trip to Siberia. Now, its butter is as smooth as marble; heavy, hard, beautiful, and makes a satisfying thud when smashed on a zombie's head.'</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Lobs frozen kernels and butter.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20/3s</color>
<color=#0077b6>Kryo-System: </color><color=#8B0000>Attacks inflict Chill, add 10 Cryo points and deal ×4 damage to frozen zombies.</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Has a 25% chance to throw a frozen butter stick that freezes zombies for 4 seconds.</color>

original.name: 寒冰卷心菜投手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“你们根本不知道那个地方有多恐怖。”寒冰卷心菜投手心有余悸地说，“那是一个极寒之地，无数的植物被永远地封冻在其中，要不是我冒死打开了通往外界的门，我们这些蔬菜都得死在里面。”哦，他又在讲他在戴夫家冰箱里的历险经历了。</color>
original.info:
投出寒冰卷心菜，击中冻僵的敌人时会变得兴奋。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>子弹会施加寒冷状态，赋予10冻结值</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>子弹命中冻结状态的僵尸时，伤害×4且可以弹射一次，并在3秒内大幅增加攻速。此效果结束1.5秒后，才可再次触发</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>卷心菜投手+寒冰菇</color>

english.name: Coldslaw
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"You have no idea how terrifying that place was," Coldslaw says, still shaken. "A land of extreme cold, where countless plants were frozen forever. If I hadn't risked my life to open the door back outside, we vegetables would've all died in there." Oh, he's talking about his adventure inside Dave's refrigerator again.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Coldslaw lobs frozen cabbages and attacks faster when hitting frozen enemies.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/3s</color>
<color=#0077b6>Cryo System: </color><color=#8B0000>Attacks inflict Chill, add 10 Cryo points and deal ×4 damage to frozen zombies.</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>On hitting a Frozen zombie, the projectile can bounce once, and Coldslaw's attack speed is greatly increased for 3s. This effect can only trigger again 1.5s after it ends.</color>

german.name: Eisbergsalat
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"You have no idea how terrifying that place was," Coldslaw says, still shaken. "A land of extreme cold, where countless plants were frozen forever. If I hadn't risked my life to open the door back outside, we vegetables would've all died in there." Oh, he's talking about his adventure inside Dave's refrigerator again.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Lobs frozen cabbages and attacks faster when hitting frozen enemies.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>40/3s</color>
<color=#0077b6>Kryo-System: </color><color=#8B0000>Attacks inflict Chill, add 10 Cryo points and deal ×4 damage to frozen zombies.</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>On hitting a Frozen zombie, the projectile can bounce once, and Coldslaw's attack speed is greatly increased for 3s. This effect can only trigger again 1.5s after it ends.</color>

original.name: 毁灭土豆雷
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>作为土豆条饭店的主厨，毁灭土豆雷手下管着一帮厨师，一向以雷厉风行、管理严格著称，但在成功的豆生背后，他也有自己的苦恼：脾气暴躁的他已经无法再做出美味的炸薯条了。</color>
original.info:
在毁灭性爆炸中四分五裂，爆出五个落地即成熟的土豆块。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1800</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>爆炸时，额外释放一次毁灭菇效果，然后向场上5个无植物的格子抛投土豆块。土豆块会在落地时生成一个立即出土的土豆雷</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>土豆雷+毁灭菇</color>

english.name: Crater-tot
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>As the head chef of a French fry restaurant, Crater-tot runs a tight kitchen and is known for his strict, no-nonsense management. But behind his successful spud career lies a personal struggle: his explosive temper means he can no longer make delicious fries.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Crater-tot causes a Doom-shroom explosion on its tile once armed, then spawns more Potato Mines across the lawn!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Cremator)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant. When it explodes, it also triggers a Doom-shroom effect, then throws potato chunks onto 5 empty tiles. Each chunk creates a fully armed Potato Mine as soon as it lands.</color>

german.name: Oje-Mine
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>As the head chef of a French fry restaurant, Crater-tot runs a tight kitchen and is known for his strict, no-nonsense management. But behind his successful spud career lies a personal struggle: his explosive temper means he can no longer make delicious fries.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Shatters in a devastating explosion, scattering five Potato Mines that instantly arm on landing.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Cremator)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant. When it explodes, it also triggers a Doom-shroom effect, then throws potato chunks onto 5 empty tiles. Each chunk creates a fully armed Potato Mine as soon as it lands.</color>

original.name: 寒冰南瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>他一直对自己的发型很满意，虽然他只是把屋檐下的冰锥掰下来装在自己头上了。</color>
original.info:
能封存寒冰菇的力量，以便择机释放。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>对啃咬者施加寒冷状态，赋予5点冻结值</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>能量不足3点时，阻止本格的寒冰菇效果触发，随后获得1点能量</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>点击会消耗1点充能，释放寒冰菇效果。充能高于1时，每5秒自动消耗充能释放寒冰菇效果</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>南瓜（底座）+寒冰菇</color>

english.name: Cryo Pumpkin
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>He has always been proud of his hairstyle, even though he merely snapped off an icicle from under a roof and placed it on his head.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Cryo Pumpkin stores the power of Ice-shrooms, allowing them to be released at the right moment.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=#0077b6>Cryo System: </color><color=#8B0000>Inflicts Chill to biters and adds 5 Cryo points.</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> When charge meter is below 3, prevents Ice-shroom effects on its tile and 1 tile in front from activating, then gains 1 charge.
<color=black>•</color> If charge meter is more than 1, automatically consumes 1 charge to release an Ice-shroom effect every 5s. Clicking can also trigger this effect.</color>

german.name: Cryo Pumpkin
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>He has always been proud of his hairstyle, even though he merely snapped off an icicle from under a roof and placed it on his head.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Cryo Pumpkin stores the power of Ice-shrooms, allowing them to be released at the right moment.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=#0077b6>Cryo System: </color><color=#8B0000>Inflicts Chill to biters and adds 5 Cryo points.</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> When charge meter is below 3, prevents Ice-shroom effects on its tile and 1 tile in front from activating, then gains 1 charge.
<color=black>•</color> If charge meter is more than 1, automatically consumes 1 charge to release an Ice-shroom effect every 5s. Clicking can also trigger this effect.</color>

original.name: 飓风三叶草
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“扇叶功率巨大，危险勿碰。”飓风三叶草这样警告那些想要触碰他的家伙，“以及，这是我的脸，不是风扇品牌商标。”</color>
original.info:
吹退接近的僵尸，对脚步不稳的僵尸效果显著。

<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每3秒，缓慢击退最近的3个僵尸。对空中单位效果翻倍，对被击飞的僵尸效果变为3倍，对载具和巨型僵尸的效果变为1/3</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>三叶草×2</color>

english.name: Cyclover
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"High fan power, do not touch." Cyclover warns anyone who tries to get close. "And also, that's my face, not a fan brand logo."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Cyclover blows back approaching zombies, especially effective against zombies in the air.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Every 3s, if there are ground zombies ahead, slowly pushes back up to 3 nearest zombies. Effect is doubled on flying zombies, tripled on zombies knocked into the air, and reduced to 1/3 against vehicles and giant zombies.</color>

german.name: Cyclover
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"High fan power, do not touch." Cyclover warns anyone who tries to get close. "And also, that's my face, not a fan brand logo."</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Cyclover blows back approaching zombies, especially effective against zombies in the air.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Every 3s, if there are ground zombies ahead, slowly pushes back up to 3 nearest zombies. Effect is doubled on flying zombies, tripled on zombies knocked into the air, and reduced to 1/3 against vehicles and giant zombies.</color>

original.name: 毁灭卷心菜投手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“我是黑夜中的猎手。”毁灭卷心菜投手这样定义自己。他的肤色确实能够在黑夜中完美隐藏，然而那对红红的眼睛却经常暴露行踪。但即便如此，毁灭卷心菜投手也不愿意买副墨镜遮挡一下，他说这是“死神的注视”……其实他是找不到架眼镜腿的耳朵在哪里。</color>
original.info:
投出高伤害的卷心菜，击中余烬状态时还会产生爆炸。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1800/15秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>子弹命中处于余烬状态的僵尸时，产生小范围1/3倍无衰减溅射</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>卷心菜投手+毁灭菇</color>

english.name: Damage-pult
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I am the hunter of the night," he declares. His dark skin blends perfectly into darkness, but his glowing red eyes often give him away. Still, Damage-pult refuses to wear sunglasses, calling it "the gaze of death"… though in truth, he just can't figure out how to take his contact off.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Damage-pult launches high-damage cabbages that trigger explosions on Irradiated targets.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>1800/15s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>When hitting Irradiated zombies, the projectile causes a small splash explosion dealing 1/3 damage without falloff.</color>

german.name: Waterloo-pult
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I am the hunter of the night," he declares. His dark skin blends perfectly into darkness, but his glowing red eyes often give him away. Still, Damage-pult refuses to wear sunglasses, calling it "the gaze of death"… though in truth, he just can't figure out how to take his contact off.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Launches high-damage cabbages that trigger explosions on Irradiated targets.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800/15s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>When hitting Irradiated zombies, the projectile causes a small splash explosion dealing 1/3 damage without falloff.</color>

original.name: 毁灭杨桃
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“星辰，赐予我毁灭的力量！”毁灭杨桃念诵着可怕的咒语，召唤流星摧毁一切他讨厌的事物。不过为什么这颗流星是黑色的？“大概是经过大气层时摩擦燃烧导致的。”</color>
original.info:
会将自身化作毁灭流星砸向地面。

<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>出场3秒后消失，召唤一个毁灭流星，坠落时造成1800范围伤害，分裂出180个伤害20的星星</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>杨桃+毁灭菇</color>

english.name: Death Star
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I could destroy almost the entire planet if I wanted to," boasts Death Star, "and they'd all blame it on the biggest star in the sky..."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Death Star transforms into a Doom Meteor and crashes into the ground.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Disappears after 3s and summons a Doom Meteor that deals 1800 area damage on impact and splits into 180 spore stars each dealing 20 damage.</color>

german.name: Todesstern
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I could destroy almost the entire planet if I wanted to," boasts Death Star, "and they'd all blame it on the biggest star in the sky..."</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Transforms himself into a Doom Meteor and crashes into the ground.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Disappears after 3s and summons a Doom Meteor that deals 1800 area damage on impact and splits into 180 spore stars each dealing 20 damage.</color>

original.name: 寒冰毁灭菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​“我将冰封世界，万籁俱寂”“极度的寒冷会碾碎你的体温系统，所以没关系，没有多少痛苦的。”寒冰毁灭菇一般不出现在战场，据说他的出现伴随着暴风雪，白光一闪后，连时间都会凝固。​</color>
original.info:
冰封世界的毁灭菇，伤害全场僵尸，并短暂冻结关卡时间。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1800（灰烬）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>对所有僵尸造成伤害并冻结5秒，同时冻结关卡，10秒内不会出现新僵尸</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>寒冰菇+毁灭菇</color>

english.name: Demise-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I will freeze the world, and silence will reign. The extreme cold will disrupt your body's temperature system, so it won't be very painful," Demise-shroom proclaims. He seldom appears in battle, but when he does, a blizzard follows in his wake. With a flash of white light, even time seems to freeze.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Demise-shroom can destroy zombies across the entire screen and freeze time.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Cremator)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Freezes surviving zombies for 5 seconds. Also freezes the level temporarily – no new zombies will appear within 10 seconds.</color></size>

german.name: Kryo-Unheilpilz
german.introduce: <size=32><color=black>„Ich werde die Welt einfrieren, und Stille wird herrschen. Die extreme Kälte wird euer Temperatursystem stören, also wird es nicht allzu schmerzhaft sein“, verkündet Kryo-Unheilpilz. Er erscheint selten im Kampf, doch wenn er es tut, folgt ein Schneesturm in seinem Gefolge. Mit einem weißen Lichtblitz scheint sogar die Zeit einzufrieren.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=32>Kryo-Unheilpilz kann alle Zombies auf dem gesamten Bildschirm zerstören und die Zeit einfrieren.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Einäscherung)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000> Friert das Level ein - innerhalb von 10 Sekunden werden keine neuen Zombies erscheinen.</color></size>

original.name: 蒜三叶草
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>蒜三叶草曾经在一家烧烤店打过零工，当时那家店生意火爆，直到招到了蒜三叶草之后就不一样了，“我还记得当时我将蒜蓉吹上天之后，客人们都高兴的身冒绿光出去了。</color>
original.info:
能赋予全场僵尸蒜值并使其换行的三叶草。

<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>使全场僵尸换行，蒜值低于5的僵尸增至5点蒜值，然后赋予1点蒜值</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>三叶草+大蒜</color>

english.name: Disguster
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Disguster used to have a simple life, working at a bustling barbecue joint where business was booming. "Ah, those were the days," it sighs. "Customers used to leave with a green glow of happiness after I blew away the overwhelming garlic. Now? Things just aren't the same."
english.info:
<size=36>Disguster can poison zombies across the entire field and force them to change lanes.

<color=#5E1675>Poison System: </color><color=#8B0000>Inflicts 5 Poison Points to every non-poisoned zombie in the screen and applies the Toxic Effect. Inflicts an additional 1 Poison Point and increases the time the debuff stays by 5 more seconds.</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Forces Zombies to change lanes. </color>

german.name: Knobblatt
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Disguster used to have a simple life, working at a bustling barbecue joint where business was booming. "Ah, those were the days," it sighs. "Customers used to leave with a green glow of happiness after I blew away the overwhelming garlic. Now? Things just aren't the same."
german.info:
<size=36>Disguster can poison zombies.

<color=#5E1675>Poison System: </color><color=#8B0000>Inflicts 5 Poison Points to every non-poisoned zombie in the screen and applies the Toxic Effect. Inflicts an additional 1 Poison Point and increases the time the debuff stays by 5 more seconds.</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Forces Zombies to change lanes. </color>

original.name: 毁灭仙人掌
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>毁灭仙人掌熟读《植物兵法》，因此她喜欢积攒力量并爆发而出，力求一击建功——这种方法不仅可以用来打僵尸，还能用来“袭击”铠甲鼠。</color>
original.info:
发射余烬尖刺贯穿僵尸，会随攻击进行而爆发性散射尖刺。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>子弹能穿透2次，伤害后施加余烬状态</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>每次攻击有1/20概率触发大招，每次未触发，概率依次提升至1/19、1/18……直至100%。触发大招后重置概率</color>
<color=#3D1400>大招：</color><color=red>向前方上下各45°的扇形区域持续散射90发毁灭尖刺，可同时对空对地</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>仙人掌+毁灭菇</color>

english.name: Doom Cactus
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Doom Cactus is a firm believer in the Art of War of Plants: bide your time, strike hard, and leave nothing standing. Whether it's zombies shambling through the battlefield or armored rats scurrying for cover, one well-placed explosion is all it takes to turn the tide.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Doom Cactus has a chance to spray doom thorns across the entire field with each attack!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Attacks inflict Irradiated and pierce twice.
<color=black>•</color> Each attack has a 0% starting chance of unleashing an Ultimate attack. If it fails, the chance is increased by 5% for the next attack.</color>
<color=black>Ultimate: </color><color=#8B0000>Shoots a large number of thorns forward (at most 90), which can hit airborne units.</color>

german.name: Untergangs-Kaktee
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Doom Cactus is a firm believer in the Art of War of Plants: bide your time, strike hard, and leave nothing standing. Whether it's zombies shambling through the battlefield or armored rats scurrying for cover, one well-placed explosion is all it takes to turn the tide.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Fires destructive thorns.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Each attack has a 0% starting chance of unleashing an Ultimate attack. If it fails, the chance is increased by 5% for the next attack.</color>
<color=black>Ultimate: </color><color=#8B0000>Shoots a large number of thorns forward, which can hit airborne units.</color>

original.name: 毁灭大嘴花
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>毁灭大嘴花曾是巨型大嘴花大胃王冠军的有力竞争者。“他把自己的蛋糕吃完了，还把我的炸成了灰烬。”巨型大嘴花说。“不过，他以毁坏赛方财物最终被罚下了场。”</color>
original.info:
吞食僵尸时在前方释放毁灭菇效果。其他植物要小心被“坑”。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>秒杀（吞食）</color>
<color=#3D1400>消化时间：</color><color=red>60秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>吞食成功时，在前方1格释放毁灭菇效果</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大嘴花+毁灭菇</color>

english.name: Doom Chomper
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>In the Chomper's Big Eater Championship, Doom Chomper was a force to be reckoned with—until he took things a little too far. "He didn't just eat his cake—he incinerated mine!" a fellow contestant recalled. Unsurprisingly, he was disqualified for excessive destruction.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Doom Chomper devours a zombie to produce a Doom explosion, it can destroy plants too!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>Insta-kill (Devour)</color>
<color=black>Digestion Time: </color><color=#8B0000>60s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Each time it successfully bites a zombie, a Doom-shroom explosion is released, causing a crater to appear in front of it (does not trigger explosion if in the rightmost column).</color>

german.name: Unheilsschnapper
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>In the Chomper's Big Eater Championship, Doom Chomper was a force to be reckoned with—until he took things a little too far. "He didn't just eat his cake—he incinerated mine!" a fellow contestant recalled. Unsurprisingly, he was disqualified for excessive destruction.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Devours a zombie to produce a Doom explosion.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>Insta-kill (Devour)</color>
<color=black>Digestion Time: </color><color=#8B0000>60s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Each time it successfully bites a zombie, a Doom-shroom explosion is released, causing a crater to appear in front of it (does not trigger explosion if in the rightmost column).</color>

original.name: 毁灭大蒜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>在某一届僵尸吃蒜挑战赛中，毁灭大蒜被作为压轴菜端上了餐桌。而那一届挑战赛的结果是，十位选手中有三位弃权，五位送医，剩下两位当场爆炸，最终因为没有任何选手胜出，毁灭大蒜成为了那一届僵尸吃蒜挑战赛的冠军。</color>
original.info:
能使啃咬者产生尸爆的大蒜。

<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>被啃咬时，对啃咬者施加余烬状态，并使其在死亡时造成半径1.5格爆炸，伤害300</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>被啃咬时，对该僵尸施加剧毒效果并赋予1点蒜值</color>

english.name: Doom Garlic
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>At one Zombie Garlic-Eating Championship, Doom Garlic was served as the final course. The result: three of the ten contestants withdrew, five were rushed to the hospital, and the remaining two exploded on the spot. With no remaining competitors, Doom Garlic himself was declared the champion of that year's event.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Doom Garlic causes the zombies that bite it to explode upon death.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Inflicts Irradiated debuff on zombies that bite it and curses them. Cursed zombies explode on death in a 1.5-tile radius for 300 damage.
<color=black>•</color> Inflicts Poison debuff and 1 Poison point on zombies that bite it.
<color=black>•</color> When Irradiated debuff and Poison debuff are active simultaneously on a zombie, the Poison duration becomes infinite.</color>

german.name: Unheilsknoblauch
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>At one Zombie Garlic-Eating Championship, Doom Garlic was served as the final course. The result: three of the ten contestants withdrew, five were rushed to the hospital, and the remaining two exploded on the spot. With no remaining competitors, Doom Garlic himself was declared the champion of that year's event.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Causes the zombies that bit it to explode upon death.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Inflicts Irradiated debuff on zombies that bite it and curses them. Cursed zombies explode on death in a 1.5-tile radius for 300 damage.
<color=black>•</color> Inflicts Poison debuff and 1 Poison point on zombies that bite it.
<color=black>•</color> When Irradiated debuff and Poison debuff are active simultaneously on a zombie, the Poison duration becomes infinite.</color>

original.name: 毁灭水草
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>由于长期熬夜研究聚变难题导致睡眠不足，毁灭水草的双眼布满了血丝。有很多同事建议他补足睡眠、治一治这双红眼，他却完全不想这样做。“那样的话，我拍出来的照片可就全是黑白的了……想想都可怕。”</color>
original.info:
蕴含毁灭菇力量的缠绕水草。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>秒杀（溺死）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>死亡时释放毁灭菇效果（不留坑洞）</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>缠绕水草（底座）+毁灭菇</color>

english.name: Doom Kelp
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Due to long nights spent researching fusion problems and chronic sleep deprivation, Doom Kelp's eyes are bloodshot. Many colleagues suggested he get more rest and treat his red eyes, but he refused completely. "If I did that… my face would just show as a puddle of pitch black in photos… just the thought of that is terrifying."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Doom Kelp explodes like a Doom-shroom on activation.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>Insta-kill (Drown) + 1800 (Cremator)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Triggers a craterless Doom-shroom effect upon death.</color>

german.name: Doom Kelp
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Due to long nights spent researching fusion problems and chronic sleep deprivation, Doom Kelp's eyes are bloodshot. Many colleagues suggested he get more rest and treat his red eyes, but he refused completely. "If I did that… my face would just show as a puddle of pitch black in photos… just the thought of that is terrifying."</color>

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>Insta-kill (Drown) + 1800 (Cremator)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Triggers a craterless Doom-shroom effect upon death.</color>

original.name: 毁灭豌豆射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>毁灭豌豆射手和毁灭胆小菇是很好的朋友，一个是急性子，一个是慢性子。两人在一起时却是最好的搭档“虽然我们性格不同，但是我们相辅相成。”</color>
original.info:
会逐渐提高伤害，是毁灭胆小菇的好搭档。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>子弹能穿透二类防具</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>每次攻击都会使伤害+1，最高+60</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>左边一格有毁灭胆小菇时，自身攻击间隔与其同步</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手+毁灭菇</color>

english.name: Doom Pea
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Doom Pea and Frenzy-shroom are great friends—one's a hothead, the other’s laid-back. But together, they're the perfect pair. "We may be opposites, but we bring out the best in each other."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Doom pea is a damage-scaling Peashooter and the perfect partner for Frenzy-shroom.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Attacks penetrate Type 2 armor. Damage increases by 1 each attack, up to 60. If a Frenzy-shroom is planted 1 tile behind it, Doom Pea gains Frenzy-shroom's attack speed and Frenzy-shroom gains Doom Pea's attack damage.</color>

german.name: Verderbse
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Doom Pea and Frenzy-shroom are great friends—one's a hothead, the other’s laid-back. But together, they're the perfect pair. "We may be opposites, but we bring out the best in each other."</color>
german.info:
<size=36>A damage-scaling Peashooter and the perfect partner for Frenzy-shroom.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Attacks penetrate Type 2 armor. Damage increases by 1 each attack, up to 60. If a Frenzy-shroom is planted 1 tile behind it, Doom Pea gains Frenzy-shroom's attack speed and Frenzy-shroom gains Doom Pea's attack damage.</color>

original.name: 毁灭花盆
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>毁灭花盆的最大秘密之一就是他的材质——到底是什么材质的花盆能够在爆炸中完好无损？“也不能说是完好无损。”他笑笑，“特殊的柔性材质，加上耐高温涂层，效果还不错，是吧？”</color>
original.info:
折损生命以阻止毁灭留坑，能协助大地自愈并从中受益。

<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮，载体，可种裸地</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>可以失去75韧性，再流失20%韧性的血量，以阻止弹坑在本格产生</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>在场时，弹坑修复时间降低至90秒，且修复时每1秒为本行血量最低的毁灭花盆回复其2%韧性的血量</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>花盆（底座）+毁灭菇</color>

english.name: Doom Pot
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>One of Doom Pot's biggest secrets is what it's made of: what kind of flowerpot can survive an atomic explosion completely intact? "Well, I wouldn't say completely intact." He chuckles. "Special flexible material plus a heat-resistant coating. Works pretty well, don't you think?"</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Doom Pot sacrifices its own health to prevent craters from appearing.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Can lose 75 max HP, then lose HP equal to 20% of its max HP, to prevent a crater from forming on its tile.
<color=black>•</color> While present, reduces crater recovery time to 90s. Craters heal the Doom Pot with the lowest HP in their lane by 2% max HP every second.</color>

german.name: Doom Pot
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>One of Doom Pot's biggest secrets is what it's made of: what kind of flowerpot can survive an atomic explosion completely intact? "Well, I wouldn't say completely intact." He chuckles. "Special flexible material plus a heat-resistant coating. Works pretty well, don't you think?"</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Doom Pot sacrifices its own health to prevent craters from appearing.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>

<color=black>•</color> While present, reduces crater recovery time to 90s. Craters heal the Doom Pot with the lowest HP in their lane by 2% max HP every second.</color>

original.name: 毁灭窝瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>毁灭窝瓜在草坪上沉默瓜言，经常黑着脸色地去做一些事情，然后留下一地的坑洞。对了，TA在窝瓜里面的外号是“胖子”。</color>
original.info:
蕴含毁灭菇力量的窝瓜，比较冲动好斗，容易“坑”到附近的植物。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1800（压扁）</color>
<color=#3D1400>索敌范围：</color><color=red>左侧2格~右侧3格</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>落地时，释放伤害与自身攻击力相同的毁灭菇效果</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>窝瓜+毁灭菇</color>

english.name: Doom Squash
english.introduce:
<align=left><size=36><color=black>Doom Squash rarely speaks to anyone on the lawn. It silently moves from place to place, leaving craters behind. Rumor has it that it was originally supposed to be deployed under "dire circumstances" but somehow escaped containment.

- Edited by cassidy</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Doom Squash unleashes a Doom-shroom explosion and crater at the crush site.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Squash) + 1800 (5×5, Cremator)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>2 tiles to the left; 3 tiles to the right</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Upon landing, triggers a Doom-shroom explosion that leaves a crater on the landing spot; destroying all plants on that tile.</color>

german.name: Matsch des Grauens
german.introduce:
<align=left><size=36><color=black>Doom Squash rarely speaks to anyone on the lawn. It silently moves from place to place, leaving craters behind. Rumor has it that it was originally supposed to be deployed under "dire circumstances" but somehow escaped containment.

- Edited by cassidy</color>
german.info:
<size=36>An extremely explosive Squash, and prone to causing collateral damage.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Squash) + 1800 (5×5, Cremator)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>2 tiles to the left; 3 tiles to the right</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Upon landing, triggers a Doom-shroom explosion that leaves a crater on the landing spot; destroying all plants on that tile.</color>

original.name: 毁灭坚果
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>毁灭坚果是蝙蝠侠的粉丝，他热衷于效仿偶像潜藏在黑夜中，鲜少与植物们交流，只在漫展里偶尔出没。一次他撞见了究极超时空玉米，给老人家吓了一跳：“毁灭菇什么时候长这么胖了？”</color>
original.info:
蕴藏核能的坚果，拥有防爆能力。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫非物理爆炸，阻止3×3范围的僵尸毁灭菇爆炸产生。5×5范围内有余烬状态的僵尸死亡时，回血100。死亡时释放毁灭菇效果</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>坚果+毁灭菇</color>

english.name: Doom-nut
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Doom-nut is a huge fan of Batman. He rarely speaks, preferring to lurk in shadows, and only shows up at the occasional Comic-cons. One time, he startled Cosmo-pult in a hallway. "When did Doom-shroom get... this bulky?" the old corn muttered.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Doom-nut is immune to all explosions, and explodes in a large area upon its own death. 

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Immune to non-physical explosions. 
<color=black>•</color> Prevents Doom-shroom Zombies in a 3×3 area from exploding. 
<color=black>•</color> Heals for 100 HP when a zombie with Irradiated debuff dies in a 5×5 area.
<color=black>•</color> Triggers Doom-shroom effect on death.</color>

german.name: Todesnuss
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Doom-nut is a huge fan of Batman. He rarely speaks, preferring to lurk in shadows, and only shows up at the occasional Comic-cons. One time, he startled McCornics in a hallway. "When did Doom-shroom get... this bulky?" the old corn muttered.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Wall-nut with nuclear potential. 

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Immune to non-physical explosions. 
<color=black>•</color> Prevents Doom-shroom Zombies in a 3×3 area from exploding. 
<color=black>•</color> Heals for 100 HP when a zombie with Irradiated debuff dies in a 5×5 area.
<color=black>•</color> Triggers Doom-shroom effect on death.</color>

original.name: 毁灭三线射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>三个脑袋让毁灭三线射手拥有了三倍的思考能力，这让他在核物理系的研究中取得了巨大的成就，而在学术之外他还喜欢思考其他的一些问题，例如为什么会有植物总想往自己身上塞辣椒。                                                                                     </color>
original.info:
向三行发射毁灭类子弹。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40×3/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>发射毁灭豌豆，能穿透二类防具</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>每第7轮攻击发射3倍伤害的大型毁灭菇子弹，能穿透二类防具，造成单体伤害后，再造成半径3格范围伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>三线射手+毁灭菇</color>

english.name: Doom-spreader
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Three heads give Doom-spreader triple the thinking power, allowing him to achieve great accomplishments in nuclear physics research. Outside of academia, he also enjoys pondering other questions — such as why certain plants always try to stuff Jalapeno onto him.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Doom-spreader fires Doom peas across three lanes.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40×3/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Doom peas penetrate type 2 armor.
<color=black>•</color> Every 7th attack fires three large Doom Shells dealing 3× damage. They can pierce type 2 armor, dealing single-target damage before exploding in a 3-tile radius.</color>

german.name: Doom-spreader
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Three heads give Doom-spreader triple the thinking power, allowing him to achieve great accomplishments in nuclear physics research. Outside of academia, he also enjoys pondering other questions — such as why certain plants always try to stuff Jalapeno onto him.</color>

<color=black>•</color> Every 7th attack fires three large Doom Shells dealing 3× damage. They can pierce type 2 armor, dealing single-target damage before exploding in a 3-tile radius.</color>

original.name: 毁灭向日葵
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>花园的游戏有的时候也需要一点运气。这个时候，毁灭向日葵就该下场了。“为什么，就因为我脸黑吗？”“不只是脸黑，你的运气真的不好。”</color>
original.info:
可以在周围种下毁灭菇孢子的向日葵，成长后遥感引爆。

<color=#3D1400>阳光产量：</color><color=red>25/50秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每50秒在周围3×3范围种植1颗毁灭菇孢子。孢子需要30秒成长，成长后若爆炸半径内有僵尸则会自爆，释放毁灭菇效果</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>向日葵+毁灭菇</color>

english.name: Doomflower
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Garden games sometimes come down to pure luck. That's when Doomflower steps up."Why always me?" "Because you're destined. Or doomed."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Doomflower plants Doom-spores around herself, which grow and detonate remotely.

<color=black>Sun Output: </color><color=#8B0000>25/25s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Every 50s, plants one Doom-spore randomly in a 3×3 area around herself.
<color=black>•</color> Doom-spores take 30s to grow and once mature, if a zombie enters their blast radius, they detonate like a Doom-shroom.</color>

german.name: Todessonne
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Garden games sometimes come down to pure luck. That's when Doomflower steps up."Why always me?" "Because you're destined. Or doomed."</color>
german.info:
<size=36>A Sunflower that plants Doom-spores around herself, which grow and detonate remotely.

<color=black>Sun Output: </color><color=#8B0000>25/25s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Every 50s, plants one Doom-spore randomly in a 3×3 area around herself.
<color=black>•</color> Doom-spores take 30s to grow and once mature, if a zombie enters their blast radius, they detonate like a Doom-shroom.</color>

original.name: 磁性毁灭菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>使用磁力约束核能，是磁性毁灭菇一直在研究的课题。这可是件困难的工作，时机一点都差不得，他已经报废好几个实验室了。不过，比起植物，似乎僵尸更希望他研究成功。</color>
original.info:
被磁力约束而稳定的毁灭菇，可以融合铁器变为对应形态。

<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>不会爆炸</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>毁灭菇+磁力菇</color>

english.name: Dormant-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Using magnetism to confine nuclear energy is a topic that Dormant-shroom has been researching for a long time. This is a difficult task, and timing is crucial; numerous laboratories of his are now in ruins. However, it seems that the zombies are more eager for him to succeed than the plants.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Dormant-shroom does not explode, but can be fused with metal to transform into a corresponding form.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Does not explode until further fusion.</color>

german.name: Damoklespilz
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Using magnetism to confine nuclear energy is a topic that Dormant-shroom has been researching for a long time. This is a difficult task, and timing is crucial; numerous laboratories of his are now in ruins. However, it seems that the zombies are more eager for him to succeed than the plants.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Dormant-shroom is stabilized by magnetic force and can be fused with metal to transform into a corresponding form.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Does not explode until further fusion.</color>

original.name: 超级樱桃射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​他现在超级暴躁，劝你最好别去招惹他，说不定他真会把卡喉咙里的樱桃射出来——看他脸憋的多红。</color>
original.info:
无惧樱桃爆炸。发射爆炸樱桃，产生小范围樱桃爆炸。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>300/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>免疫樱桃爆炸伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>发射爆炸樱桃，造成半径1格无衰减溅射</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>融合使用的樱桃炸弹卡牌冷却减少85%</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>樱桃射手+樱桃炸弹</color>

english.name: Explode-o-shooter
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Meet Explode-o-shooter, the ultimate plant killer. He's more irritable than ever—who would've thought the warm and friendly Cherryshooter would swallow another special cherry? Don't push your luck with him. That cherry stuck in his throat might just be his next shot—his face is already turning red!</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Explode-o-shooter shoots out cherries that explode in an area on impact!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>300/3s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Its projectiles will deal area explosion damage.
<color=black>•</color> Has immunity to cherry explosions.
<color=black>•</color> Reduces the Recharge of the last Cherry Bomb seed packet used for its fusion by 85%.</color></size>

german.name: Explod-o-Kanone
german.introduce: <size=34><color=black>Trefft Explod-o-Kanone, den ultimativen Pflanzenkiller. Er ist reizbarer als je zuvor—wer hätte gedacht, dass die warme und freundliche Kirschkanone noch eine spezielle Kirsche verschlingen würde? Versuche nicht, sein Glück zu überstrapazieren. Diese Kirsche, die ihm im Hals steckt, könnte seinen nächsten Schuss sein—sein Gesicht wird schon rot!</color></size>
german.info:
<size=34>Die Kirschen, die von Explod-o-Kanone abgefeuert werden, verursachen Explosionsschaden im Umkreis. Er ist außerdem gegen Kirsch-Explosionen immun.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>300/3 Sekunden</color></size>

original.name: 毁灭三叶草
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>猫瓜一开始只是嫌弃风扇的功率小了一点，于是进化了风扇的动力，可惜直到风扇的动力来到核聚变也没有达到她想要的效果，“散热效果很差，产生的热能全部被吹出来了。”这是僵王博士的评价。</color>
original.info:
持续释放羽流来攻击全场。

<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>存在的10秒内，每1秒对全场僵尸造成180灰烬伤害，可对空</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>三叶草+毁灭菇</color>

english.name: Fallout Blover
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Nyan Squash just wanted a stronger fan… but not even nuclear power can seem to meet her requirements. "This is a terrible model," Zomboss noted. "All that heat and waste product? Blasted straight out."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Fallout Blover deals ticks of damage to all zombies on the field for a limited time, even more if the zombie is Irradiated..

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Lasts for 10s before disappearing.
<color=black>•</color> Every second, deals 180 Cremator damage to all zombies on the lawn. Can target air.</color>

german.name: Apokalyptoblatt
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Nyan Squash just wanted a stronger fan… but not even nuclear power can seem to meet her requirements. "This is a terrible model," Zomboss noted. "All that heat and waste product? Blasted straight out."</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Blasts zombies with high-temp wind laced with ash and nuclear fallout.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Lasts for 10s before disappearing.
<color=black>•</color> Every second, deals 180 Cremator damage to all zombies on the lawn. Damage is doubled against zombies with the Irradiated debuff.</color>

original.name: 火焰猫尾草
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“不关橙猫猫事的哦。”火焰猫尾草热情似火，“你知道民间故事中的猫车吗？给我看这里哦！”顺带一提，火焰猫尾草使用的是红外线制导，也就是所谓的“热导弹”。</color>
original.info:
橙红色的猫尾草，对红温状态的僵尸特攻。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40×2/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>水生</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>全场索敌，优先对空</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>对红温的僵尸伤害×3</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>猫尾草（底座）+火爆辣椒</color>

english.name: Flame Cattail
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"When I was young, I thought I'd be a regular Cattail," Flame Cattail said, warming her tail with pride. "Turns out, I'm a blazing inferno of awesomeness!" Frost Cattail sighed from the corner, muttering, "Showoff."</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Flame Cattails attack zombies in any lane and deal higher damage to enflamed targets.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40×2/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Deals ×3 damage to Enflamed zombies.</color></size>

german.name: Flammen Katzenschwanz
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>„Als ich jung war, dachte ich, ich wäre ein ganz normaler Katzenschwanz“, sagte Flammen Katzenschwanz und wärmte stolz ihren Schwanz. „Stellt sich heraus, ich bin ein brennendes Inferno der Großartigkeit!“ Frost Katzenschwanz seufzte aus der Ecke und murmelte: „Angeber.“</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Flammen Katzenschwanz kann Zombies in jeder Reihe angreifen und hohen Schaden verursachen.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>40*2/1.5 Sekunden</color>
<color=#720026>Entflammter Schwächungszauber: </color><color=#8B0000>Verursacht dreimal so viel Schaden an Entflammter-Zombies.</color></size>

original.name: 火焰忧郁菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>火焰忧郁菇能喷出热蒸汽，这使得他成为了远近闻名的糕点烘焙师，他独家研发的辣味糕点也受到很多人的喜爱。</color>
original.info:
向周围喷射施加红温状态的烟雾。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40×4/1.9秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>攻击时，向自身周围半径1.5格范围喷射四次烟雾，每次都会施加红温状态</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大喷菇（底座）+忧郁菇或其卡片/肥料+火爆辣椒</color>

english.name: Flame Gloom-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Flame Gloom-shroom's ability to release hot steam has established him as a celebrated pastry baker. His signature spicy pastries are a favorite among many, cherished for their distinct flavors.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Flame Gloom-shroom releases high-damaging enflaming fumes around it.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40×4/1.9s (Piercing)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Inflicts the Enflamed debuff when attacking zombies.</color></size>

german.name: Glut-Stinkmorchel
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Die Fähigkeit von Glut-Stinkmorchel, heißen Dampf freizusetzen, hat ihn zu einem gefeierten Konditor gemacht. Seine charakteristischen scharfen Gebäckstücke sind bei vielen beliebt und werden für ihren einzigartigen Geschmack geschätzt.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Glut-Stinkmorchel setzt hochschädliche Glutfälle um sich herum frei.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>40*4/1.9 Sekunden</color>
<color=#720026>Entflammter Schwächungszauber: </color><color=#8B0000>Verursacht den Schwächungszauber Entflammter, wenn er Zombies angreift.</color></size>

original.name: 火焰高坚果
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>火焰高坚果很喜欢奥运，并执意推荐火炬树桩充当奥运火炬。虽然不推荐食用火焰高坚果，但如果非要尝尝的话就会发现火焰高坚果是辣的。</color>
original.info:
口感火辣的高坚果。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>8000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>高大</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>被啃咬时，对啃咬者造成20伤害并施加红温状态</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>受到火爆辣椒效果时回血3000</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>坚果（底座）+高坚果或其卡片/肥料+火爆辣椒</color>

english.name: Flame Tall-nut
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Flame Tall-nut is a huge fan of the Olympics and passionately insists that Torchwood be chosen as the Olympic torch. Cautious warning to the uninformed though: do not try to eat him. You may find yourself burning up from the spicy heat.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Flame Tall-nut is a tall wall that enflames zombies that bite it.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>8000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>When affected by the Jalapeno, heals 3000 Toughness. Inflicts Enflamed debuff and deals 20 damage to zombies that bite him.</color></size>

german.name: Scharf-Nuss
german.introduce: <size=30><color=black>Scharf-Nuss ist ein großer Fan der Olympischen Spiele und besteht leidenschaftlich darauf, dass Zunderholz als Olympische Fackel ausgewählt wird. Eine vorsichtige Warnung an Unwissende: Versuchen Sie nicht, ihn zu essen. Es könnte sein, dass Sie von der scharfen Hitze in Flammen aufgehen.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=30>Zombies werden entflammt, wenn sie den Scharf-Nuss beißen.

<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>8000</color>
<color=#720026>Entflammter Schwächungszauber: </color><color=#8B0000>Zombies, die Entflammter sind, sind 50% anfälliger für alle Angriffe.</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Wenn er von der Jalapeno getroffen wird, heilt er 1000 Ausdauer. Zombies, die ihn angreifen, verlieren außerdem 20 Lebenspunkte pro Biss.</color></size>

original.name: 火焰坚果
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“永远保持微笑。”这是火焰坚果作为饭店服务员的基本素养，即便看到融化了一半的寒冰坚果在那里嚷嚷着为什么没有防滑标志，也必须憋住。</color>
original.info:
口感火辣的坚果。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>被啃咬时对啃咬者造成20伤害并施加红温状态</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>坚果+火爆辣椒</color>

english.name: Flame Wall-nut
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Always wear a smile"—that’s rule number one for Flame Wall-nut, the ever-patient restaurant server. Even when half-melted Frost Wall-nut is slipping all over the floor yelling about the lack of a 'Wet Floor' sign, he just keeps smiling. And sizzling.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Flame Wall-nut scorches zombies that try taking a bite.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Deals 20 damage to biters and inflicts Enflamed debuff. Flame Wall-nuts can be upgraded to Flame Tall-nuts using a Fertilizer.</color>

german.name: Venuss
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Always wear a smile"—that’s rule number one for Flame Wall-nut, the ever-patient restaurant server. Even when half-melted Frost Wall-nut is slipping all over the floor yelling about the lack of a 'Wet Floor' sign, he just keeps smiling. And sizzling.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Spicy-flavored nut that scorches biters.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Deals 20 damage to biters and inflicts Enflamed debuff. Flame Wall-nuts can be upgraded to Flame Tall-nuts using a Fertilizer.</color>

original.name: 火焰大喷菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>作为餐馆的主厨，在铁板上舞出火龙是晚宴的必备节目。不过每次都有客人会被烫伤，听说为了补偿，火焰大喷菇又为他们表演了一次。</color>
original.info:
喷射高频火焰施加红温状态。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1×33/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>火焰伤害，攻击时施加红温状态</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大喷菇+火爆辣椒</color>

english.name: Flame-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>As the head chef of the restaurant, performing a fiery dragon dance on the teppan is a must-have show for every dinner. But every time, at least one guest ends up getting burned. Word has it that to make up for it, the Flame-shroom gave them an encore performance.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Flame-shroom spews fumes ahead that deals enflaming damage.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>1×33/1.5s (Piercing)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Deals fire damage and inflicts Enflamed debuff. Flame-shrooms can be upgraded to Flame Gloom-shrooms using a Fertilizer.</color>

german.name: Loderpilz
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>As the head chef of the restaurant, performing a fiery dragon dance on the teppan is a must-have show for every dinner. But every time, at least one guest ends up getting burned. Word has it that to make up for it, the Flame-shroom gave them an encore performance.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Flamethrower incarnated.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>33/1.5s (Piercing, deals frame damage of 1 33 times)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Deals fire damage and inflicts Enflamed debuff. Flame-shrooms can be upgraded to Flame Gloom-shrooms using a Fertilizer.</color>

original.name: 浮空大嘴花
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>抛弃了碍事的根茎后，大嘴花踏出了掠食者征服天空的第一步。居高临下的优势让他的食谱大大丰富，但同时也带来了意料之外的问题：吃掉的僵尸太多，让他的脸都变绿了。</color>
original.info:
飘在空中，吞食接近的地面或空中目标。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>秒杀（吞食）</color>
<color=#3D1400>消化时间：</color><color=red>40秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>飞行</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>能吞食飞行僵尸</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大嘴花+三叶草</color>

english.name: Flytrapper
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>After shedding its cumbersome roots, Flytrapper took its first step toward conquering the skies as a predator. The advantage of attacking from above greatly expanded its menu, but it also brought an unexpected problem: it ate so many zombies that its face turned green..</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Flytrapper hovers in the air and devours nearby ground or airborne targets.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000> Insta-kill (Devour)</color>
<color=black>Digestion Time: </color><color=#8B0000>40s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Can eat both land and flying zombies.</color>

german.name: Flytrapper
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>After shedding its cumbersome roots, Flytrapper took its first step toward conquering the skies as a predator. The advantage of attacking from above greatly expanded its menu, but it also brought an unexpected problem: it ate so many zombies that its face turned green..</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Flytrapper hovers in the air and devours nearby ground or airborne targets.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000> Insta-kill (Devour)</color>
<color=black>Digestion Time: </color><color=#8B0000>40s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Can eat both land and flying zombies.</color>

original.name: 橄榄机枪射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“犯规！出局！”橄榄机枪射手是球场上最严厉、最暴躁的裁判，是橄榄球规则的捍卫者。每场比赛从头到尾，他的嘴巴简直没停过，一直在努力把那些完全不懂橄榄球的球员赶出赛场。</color>
original.info:
坚硬如钢的机枪射手，能射出令红色橄榄球僵尸转头就跑的赤红子弹。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>80×4/2秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>铁植物</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>发射铁豌豆，造成击退，并附加目标二类防具当前血量的伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>每第12发子弹为红橄榄豌豆，命中红色橄榄球类僵尸后，使其转身快速逃离</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color>
<color=red>机枪射手（底座）+橄榄帽</color>

english.name: Football Gatling
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Foul play! You're out!" Football Gatling is the strictest and most hot-tempered referee on the field, upholding football rules. From start to finish, his mouth never stops, constantly trying to eject players who don't understand the game.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Football Gatling fires 4 buck peas at a time, and sometimes fires a red one which scares football players away!

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>3000</color>
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>80×4/2s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Metal plant. Counts as an Advanced Fusion.
<color=black>•</color> Projectiles knock back zombies and instantly break Type 2 armor (before damage reduction).
<color=black>•</color> Every 12th shot is a Football Pea that causes hit Red-colored Football Zombies to run away from your house.</color>

german.name: MG-Football
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Foul play! You're out!" Football Gatling is the strictest and most hot-tempered referee on the field, upholding football rules. From start to finish, his mouth never stops, constantly trying to eject players who don't understand the game.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Occasionally fires red shots that lure Football Zombies away.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>3000</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>80×4/2s</color>
