<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Metal plant. Counts as an Advanced Fusion.
<color=black>•</color> Projectiles knock back zombies and instantly break Type 2 armor (before damage reduction).
<color=black>•</color> Every 12th shot is a Football Pea that causes hit Red-colored Football Zombies to run away from your house.</color>

original.name: 橄榄高坚果
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​红彤彤的高坚果看起来更严肃了，一些不明真相的小植物甚至会被他的装扮吓到，其实了解橄榄高坚果的植物都知道，不苟言笑的外表下藏着的是他保护同伴的决心，而抢来的头盔无疑使他更加自信​​。</color>
original.info:
坚硬如钢的高坚果。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>16000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>高大</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>铁植物</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>高坚果（底座）+橄榄帽</color>

english.name: Football-nut
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Football-nut looked fierce, causing some small plants that didn't know the truth to feel scared by his appearance. However, the plants that understood Football-nut knew that beneath his serious exterior lay a strong determination to protect his companions. The stolen helmet undoubtedly boosted his confidence.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Football-nut is able to withstand a huge amount of damage!

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>16000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Metal plant. Can be fed metal objects to restore 500 Toughness.
<color=black>•</color> Tall plant.</color></size>

german.name: Rugby-Nuss
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Rugby-Nuss sah furchterregend aus, was einige kleine Pflanzen, die die Wahrheit nicht wussten, ängstlich machte. Doch die Pflanzen, die Rugby-Nuss verstanden, wussten, dass unter seiner ernsten Fassade eine starke Entschlossenheit lag, seine Gefährten zu beschützen. Der entwendete Helm steigerte zweifellos sein Selbstvertrauen.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Rugby-Nuss kann eine enorme Menge Schaden einstecken.

<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>16000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Kann mit Metallgegenständen gefüttert werden, um 500 PS wiederherzustellen.</color></size>

original.name: 大蒜坚果
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>大蒜坚果认同即使是僵尸也应该保持营养均衡的理念。他永远挡在僵尸和脑子的路上，并把僵尸引向绿色健康食品——卷心菜坚果。</color>
original.info:
兼具大蒜特点的坚果，口感毒辣，入口即发。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>被啃咬时，使啃咬者换行并施加剧毒效果，赋予1点蒜值</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>坚果+大蒜</color>

english.name: Foul-nut
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Foul-nut believes even zombies deserve a balanced diet. He'll always stand between them and your brains, gently nudging them toward healthier options like Cabbage-nut.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Foul-nut redirects and poisons zombies that bite while protecting the plants behind.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>When bitten, poisons attacker for 10s and gives them 1 Poison point.</color>

german.name: Nusslauch
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Foul-nut believes even zombies deserve a balanced diet. He'll always stand between them and your brains, gently nudging them toward healthier options like Cabbage-nut.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>A tough nut with garlic properties, poisonous and hits instantly.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>When bitten, poisons attacker for 10s and gives them 1 Poison point.</color>

original.name: 大蒜喷菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>鉴于丰厚的薪水，大蒜喷菇最近重新拾起了在面包房的工作。但他百思不得其解——为什么会有那么多人喜欢蒜味的面包？</color>
original.info:
蒜味的大喷菇，喷射可以赋予蒜值的烟雾。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>30/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>攻击赋予1点蒜值</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大喷菇+大蒜</color>

english.name: Foul-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>With a pale skin, a hairstyle that could rival a cathedral dome and a grin full of crooked teeth, Foul-shroom looks like it's auditioning for the villain in a fairytale. Ironically, he usually gets the role of a vampire.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Foul-shroom sprays poison gas at zombies!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>30/1.5s (Piercing)</color>
<color=#5E1675>Poison System: </color><color=#8B0000>Attack adds 1 Poison point to zombies.</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Zombies that bite it are forced to switch lanes.</color>

german.name: Faulpilz
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>With a pale skin, a hairstyle that could rival a cathedral dome and a grin full of crooked teeth, Foul-shroom looks like it's auditioning for the villain in a fairytale. Ironically, he usually gets the role of a vampire.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Sprays poison gas at zombies!

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5 Seconds</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Attack adds one Poison Point to zombies. It also has inherited garlic property.</color>

original.name: 毁灭胆小菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​同样是紧张，有的植物会把头埋在地上，有的植物却会因此而兴奋。毁灭胆小菇的肾上腺素在体内奔腾驰骋着，子弹也愈来愈快，最好不要再招惹他，说不定他马上要紧张到“爆”了。</color>
original.info:
会疯狂提升攻速，是毁灭豌豆射手的好搭档。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>每次攻击都会使攻击间隔缩短0.1秒。攻击间隔最低为0.2秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>害怕时蹲伏，重置攻击间隔。害怕时如果攻击间隔已缩短至0.2秒，则会自爆，并释放毁灭菇效果</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>右边一格有毁灭豌豆射手时，自身攻击力会与其同步</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>胆小菇+毁灭菇</color>

english.name: Frenzy-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>While some plants instinctively bury their heads when nervous, Frenzy-shroom thrives on excitement. His adrenaline spikes, causing his spores to fire at an increasing rate. It's wise to avoid provoking him again, or he might explode from all that pent-up energy.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Frenzy-shroom's attack speed increases as it attacks, but it will self destruct if zombies get too close!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5s (0.25s Minimum)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Each attack will shorten the attack interval by 0.1s, to a minimum of 0.25s. Hides and resets when zombies get near. Will explode when zombies get near while peak attack speed is reached.</color></size>

german.name: Rasereipilz
german.introduce: <size=30><color=black>Während einige Pflanzen instinktiv ihre Köpfe einziehen, wenn sie nervös sind, blüht Rasereipilz in Momenten der Aufregung richtig auf. Sein Adrenalin schießt in die Höhe, wodurch seine Sporen immer schneller feuern. Es ist klug, ihn nicht erneut zu provozieren, sonst explodiert er noch vor lauter angestauter Energie.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=30>Rasereipilz erhöht seine Angriffsrate, je länger er angreift.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20 / 1.5 Sekunden (0.5 Spitzen Angriffsgeschwindigkeit)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Jeder Angriff verkürzt das Angriffsintervall um 0,1 Sekunden, maximal 0.5 Sekunden. Wird zurückgesetzt, wenn sich Zombies nähern. Explodiert, wenn sich Zombies nähern, während die maximale Angriffsgeschwindigkeit erreicht ist.</color></size>

original.name: 寒冰猫尾草
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“我不是猫……我是……我是超威蓝猫！”寒冰猫尾草说，“你有猫冰吗？”寒冰猫尾草似乎很喜欢猫薄荷，也喜欢冰冰凉凉的东西。</color>
original.info:
冰蓝色的猫尾草，对寒冷状态的僵尸特攻。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40×2/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>水生</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>全场索敌，优先对空</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>对寒冷的僵尸伤害×2，对冻结的僵尸伤害×4</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>猫尾草（底座）+寒冰菇</color>

english.name: Frost Cattail
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I'm not just a cat... I'm... I'm a super blue cat!" declared Frost Cattail. "Do you have some cold catnip...?" His love for catnip shines through, and he has an undeniable fascination with all things cool.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Frost Cattail can attack any zombie in any lane and deal extra damage to chilled targets.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40×2/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Deals ×2 damage to chilled zombies. Deals ×4 damage to frozen zombies.</color></size>

german.name: Frost Katzenschwanz
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>„Ich bin nicht nur eine Katze... Ich bin... ich bin eine super blaue Katze!“ erklärte Frost Katzenschwanz. „Hast du etwas kaltes Katzengras...?“. Seine Liebe zu Katzengras ist offensichtlich, und er hat eine unbestreitbare Faszination für alles, was kühl ist.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Frost Katzenschwanz kann jeden Zombie in der Reihe angreifen und verlangsamen.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20*2/1.5 Sekunden (Langsam) </color>
<color=#0077b6>Kryo-System: </color><color=#8B0000>Jeder Treffer auf einen Zombie fügt 5 Kryo-Punkte hinzu. Zusätzlich konzentriert er seine Angriffe auf den betroffenen Zombie.</color></size>

original.name: 寒冰忧郁菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>寒冰忧郁菇的梦想是当一名物理学家，他整天沉迷于世界难题而不和任何植物接近。“为什么头上会长出好几串冰锥？”这是他最近研究的课题。他执意用“串”这个字。</color>
original.info:
向周围喷射施加寒冷状态的烟雾。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40×4/1.9秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>攻击时，向自身周围半径1.5格范围喷射四次烟雾，每次都会施加寒冷状态，赋予5点冻结值</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大喷菇（底座）+忧郁菇或其卡片/肥料+寒冰菇</color>

english.name: Frost Gloom-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Dreaming of a career as a physicist, the Frost Gloom-shroom dedicates his days to unraveling the complexities of the world, avoiding contact with other plants. "Why do I have multiple strings of icicles sprouting from my head?" he muses, the latest question occupying his thoughts. He's oddly adamant about calling them "strings."</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Frost Gloom-shroom releases chilling fumes around that can freeze zombies.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40×4/1.9s (Piercing)</color>
<color=#0077b6>Cryo System: </color><color=#8B0000>Each attack applies Chill and adds 5 Cryo points.</color></size>

german.name: Schnee-Stinkmorchel
german.introduce: <size=34><color=black>Der Schnee-Stinkmorchel träumt von einer Karriere als Physiker und widmet seine Tage der Entschlüsselung der Komplexitäten der Welt, während er den Kontakt zu anderen Pflanzen meidet. „Warum sprießen mehrere Eiszapfen aus meinem Kopf?“ fragt er sich, und diese Frage beschäftigt ihn gerade besonders. Merkwürdigerweise besteht er darauf, sie „Fäden“ zu nennen.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=34>Schnee-Stinkmorchel setzt kalte Dämpfe frei, die Zombies einfrieren können.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20*4/1.9 Sekunden (Durchdringend) </color>
<color=#0077b6>Kryo-System: </color><color=#8B0000>Jeder Angriff fügt 5 Kryo-Punkte hinzu.</color></size>

original.name: 寒冰高坚果
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​寒冰高坚果竖起高高的冰刺朝向僵尸。别人说他过于“冷酷”，或者是“沉默”。寒冰高坚果的表情毫无变化，他对抵御僵尸这件事有坚定的意志，不过在这件事上，更可能只是他脸冻僵了。​</color>
original.info:
口感冰凉的高坚果。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>8000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>高大</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>被啃咬时，对啃咬者施加寒冷状态并赋予10点冻结值</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>受到寒冰菇效果时回血1000</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>坚果（底座）+高坚果或其卡片/肥料+寒冰菇</color>

english.name: Frost Tall-nut
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Frost Tall-nut raised his icy spikes high, ready to confront the zombies. Others remarked on how "cold" and "silent" he seemed. Yet, his expression remained unchanged, resolute in his defense against the undead. The truth was his face had simply frozen in place.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Frost Tall-nuts are tall walls that slow down zombies that bite them.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>8000</color>
<color=#0077b6>Cryo System: </color><color=#8B0000>Zombies that bite it are chilled and accumulate 10 Cryo points.</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Tall plant. When affected by Ice-shrooms, heals 1000 Toughness.</color></size>

german.name: Frost-Nuss
german.introduce: <size=34><color=black>Frost-Nuss richtete ihre eisigen Stacheln hoch auf, bereit, sich den Zombies zu stellen. Andere bemerkten, wie „kalt“ und „still“ sie wirkte. Doch ihr Ausdruck blieb unverändert, entschlossen in der Verteidigung gegen die Untoten. Die Wahrheit war, dass ihr Gesicht einfach festgefroren war.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=34>Frost-Nuss ist eine schwere Barrierepflanze. Sie verlangsamt Zombies, die an ihr knabbern.

<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>8000</color>
<color=#0077b6>Kryo-System: </color><color=#8B0000>Zombies, die ihn beißen, werden verlangsamt und sammeln 10 Kryo-Punkte an.</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Wenn er von der Eispilz betroffen ist, heilt er 1000 Ausdauer.</color></size>

original.name: 寒冰坚果
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>寒冰坚果对自己老在路上滑倒的事情愤愤不平。“拖地的人总是忘记摆上‘小心地滑’的标志，”他抱怨道。不过，他确实没有注意到自己似乎矮了一截。</color>
original.info:
口感冰凉的坚果。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>被啃咬时对啃咬者施加寒冷状态，赋予10点冻结值</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>坚果+寒冰菇</color>

english.name: Frost Wall-nut
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Frost Wall-nut huffed as he hit the ground again. "Do the janitors ever remember to put up 'Caution: Slippery Floor' signs!?" he grumbled. But in his frustration, he failed to realize something very concerning—he was shrinking.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Zombies that bite Frost Wall-nut are slowed down.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Zombies that chew it will be slowed down and will accrue Cryo points. Frost Wall-nuts can be upgraded to Frost Tall-nuts using a Fertilizer.</color>

german.name: Eisnuss
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Frost Wall-nut huffed as he hit the ground again. "Do the janitors ever remember to put up 'Caution: Slippery Floor' signs!?" he grumbled. But in his frustration, he failed to realize something very concerning—he was shrinking.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Zombies that bite him are slowed down.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Zombies that chew it will be slowed down and will accrue Cryo points. Frost Wall-nuts can be upgraded to Frost Tall-nuts using a Fertilizer.</color>

original.name: 寒冰大喷菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​寒冰大喷菇在大喷菇里显得与众不同，在阿拉斯加极寒地带的留学经历使得他更高冷一些，虽然只是去学了几年发型设计，但他感到很自豪。​</color>
original.info:
喷射施加寒冷状态的烟雾。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>攻击施加寒冷状态，赋予5点冻结值</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大喷菇+寒冰菇</color>

english.name: Frost-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Frost-shroom stands out among the Fume-shrooms. His study abroad in the freezing Alaskan wilderness made him even cooler—literally. Though he only studied hair design for a few years, he's pretty proud of it.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Frost-shroom's fumes can pass through and freeze zombies.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1.5s (Piercing) </color>
<color=#0077b6>Cryo System: </color><color=#8B0000> Attacks inflict chill and add 5 Cryo points. Frost-shrooms can be upgraded to Frost Gloom-shrooms using a Fertilizer.</color></size>

german.name: Frostpilz
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Frostpilz sticht unter den Stinkpilzen hervor. Sein Auslandsstudium in der eisigen Wildnis Alaskas machte ihn noch cooler – im wahrsten Sinne des Wortes. Obwohl er dort nur ein paar Jahre Haarstyling studierte, ist er ziemlich stolz darauf.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Frostpilz’ Dämpfe können Zombies durchdringen und einfrieren.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5 Sekunden (Durchdringend) </color>
<color=#0077b6>Kryo-System: </color><color=#8B0000>Wird nach jedem Angriff 5 Kryo-Punkte hinzufügen.</color></size>

original.name: 寒冰大嘴花
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>作为在《北极怪物》系列中一炮而红的影星，寒冰大嘴花很快染上了挑剔的毛病，他只佩戴定制的复古风装扮，拒绝参演任何不在黄金时段播出的节目，食物也只吃各种冰淇淋制品。</color>
original.info:
十分挑食，只吞冻透的僵尸，下口时会根据冻度作出反响。

<color=#3D1400>消化时间：</color><color=red>40秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>只能吞食冻结状态的僵尸。成功吞食时释放仅冻结1秒的寒冰菇效果；失败时对3×3范围僵尸造成伤害，施加寒冷状态，赋予50冻结值</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大嘴花+寒冰菇</color>

english.name: Frostbiter
english.introduce: After becoming a breakout star in the Arctic Monster series, Frostbiter quickly became rather picky. He only wears custom vintage outfits, refuses to appear in any show that doesn't air during prime time, and eats nothing but various kinds of ice cream.
english.info:
<size=36>Frostbiter eats only frozen zombies.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40 / Insta-kill (Devour)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Can only swallow frozen zombies. Successfully swallowing a zombie releases an Ice-shroom effect that only freezes for 1 second.
<color=black>•</color> If unsuccessful, deals damage to zombies in a 3×3 area, inflicts Chilled, and applies 50 Cryo Points.</color>

german.name: Frostbiter
german.introduce: After becoming a breakout star in the Arctic Monster series, Frostbiter quickly became rather picky. He only wears custom vintage outfits, refuses to appear in any show that doesn't air during prime time, and eats nothing but various kinds of ice cream.
german.info:
<size=36>Frostbiter eats only frozen zombies.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40 / Insta-kill (Devour)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Can only swallow frozen zombies. Successfully swallowing a zombie releases an Ice-shroom effect that only freezes for 1 second.
<color=black>•</color> If unsuccessful, deals damage to zombies in a 3×3 area, inflicts Chilled, and applies 50 Cryo Points.</color>

original.name: 寒冰樱桃
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>植物们都说寒冰樱桃沉着冷静内向寡言。“我偶尔会跟樱桃们吐露心声”，寒冰樱桃说道，“他们称之为爆炸性新闻”。</color>
original.info:
冰制的樱桃模具，吸收植物的樱桃类子弹来生成樱桃炸弹卡片。

<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>吸收植物方粉樱桃/火焰樱桃/爆炸樱桃时，获得1/2/10点能量，每获得100点，生产1张樱桃炸弹卡片。死亡时释放樱桃炸弹效果并冻结范围内僵尸10秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>樱桃炸弹+寒冰菇</color>

english.name: Frozen Cherry
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The plants all say that Frozen Cherry is calm, introverted, and taciturn. "I occasionally confide in the other cherries," Frozen Cherry said, "they call it 'explosive news.'"</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Frozen Cherry absorbs cherry projectiles from plants to generate Cherry Bomb seed packets.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Absorbing cherries, ignited cherries, and explosive cherries grants 1, 2, and 10 energy points respectively. For every 100 energy points collected, a Cherry Bomb seed packet is generated. Upon death, unleashes a Cherry Bomb explosion and freezes all zombies in its range for 10 seconds.</color>

german.name: Tiefkühl-Kirsche
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The plants all say that Frozen Cherry is calm, introverted, and taciturn. "I occasionally confide in the other cherries," Frozen Cherry said, "they call it 'explosive news.'"</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Cherry mold made of ice, he absorbs cherry projectiles from plants to generate Cherry Bomb seed packets.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Absorbing cherries, ignited cherries, and explosive cherries grants 1, 2, and 10 energy points respectively. For every 100 energy points collected, a Cherry Bomb seed packet is generated. Upon death, unleashes a Cherry Bomb explosion and freezes all zombies in its range for 10 seconds.</color>

original.name: 三线大喷菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>凭借以自身为原型的游戏《捣蛋菇》的走红，三线大喷菇名利双收。“身体的与众不同是上帝给予的机遇，”在记者面前，他谦虚地说道，“我只是成功抓住了这份机遇，我能做出这款游戏也多亏了这两个额外的孢子脑袋。”</color>
original.info:
拥有三线射手射程的大喷菇。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40×3/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>位于边路时，本行的伤害翻倍</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大喷菇+三线射手</color>

english.name: Fume-spreader
english.introduce: Thanks to the success of Bad Fungi, the game based on him, Fume-spreader has gained both fame and fortune as an inventor and aviator. "Being different is an opportunity given to me by King Fungi," he humbly told reporters. "I simply seized that opportunity. I couldn't have made the game without these two extra spore heads. They make excellent propellers."
english.info:
<size=36>Fume-spreader fires fumes down 3 lanes.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40×3/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>When planted in an edge lane, its damage in its own lane is doubled.</color>

german.name: Fume-spreader
german.introduce: Thanks to the success of Bad Fungi, the game based on him, Fume-spreader has gained both fame and fortune as an inventor and aviator. "Being different is an opportunity given to me by King Fungi," he humbly told reporters. "I simply seized that opportunity. I couldn't have made the game without these two extra spore heads. They make excellent propellers."
german.info:
<size=36>Fume-spreader fires fumes down 3 lanes.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40×3/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>When planted in an edge lane, its damage in its own lane is doubled.</color>

original.name: 大喷菇南瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“我可以同时向前后两个方向攻击，”大喷菇南瓜这样说着，“我是双向大喷菇。不过我身前的僵尸好像没有其他植物说的那么多。”他似乎并没有注意到、他面对的方向和其他植物不太一样。</color>
original.info:
能像大喷菇一样攻击的南瓜……方向似乎不太对？

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20×3/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>索敌范围：</color><color=red>本格和上下方各3格</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>纵向喷射无限穿透的烟雾</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>南瓜（底座）+大喷菇</color>

english.name: Fuming Pumpkin
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I can attack in both forward and backward directions," says Fuming Pumpkin confidently. "I'm a bidirectional Fume-shroom." However, he doesn't appear to have noticed that he's facing a different direction from everyone else.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Fuming Pumpkin can attack like a Fume-shroom… though the direction seems a little off.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20×3/1.5s (Piercing)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000> Targets from his own tile, up to 3 tiles both above and below</color>

german.name: Stinkkürbis
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I can attack in both forward and backward directions," says Fumy Pumpkin confidently. "I'm a bidirectional Fume-shroom." However, he doesn't appear to have noticed that he's facing a different direction from everyone else.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Can attack like a Fume-shroom… though the direction seems a little off.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20×3/1.5s (Piercing)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000> Targets from his own tile, up to 3 tiles both above and below</color>

original.name: 蒜卷心菜投手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“手撕包菜清香爽口，绿色健康，制作简单。如果出锅之前再加几颗蒜，那会更加美味。”大蒜厨师解释道，多吃大蒜对治疗脱发也具有一定的作用。</color>
original.info:
蒜味的卷心菜投手，投出能弹跳的蒜卷心菜。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>子弹享受(20×目标蒜值)的伤害加成，造成伤害后赋予1点蒜值。子弹能弹射1次，命中蒜值不为0的僵尸不消耗弹射次数</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>卷心菜投手+大蒜</color>

english.name: Garbage-pult
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"The combination of cabbage and garlic is fresh, delicious, and healthy, and it's simple to make. Adding a few cloves of garlic before serving enhances the flavor," explains Chef Garlic. Eating garlic is also said to have some effect on preventing hair loss.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Garbage-pult launches stinky, poisonous cabbages at the zombies.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/3s</color>
<color=#5E1675>Poison System: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> See Clove-pult for details on the Poison System.
<color=black>•</color> Each time it hits a zombie with Poison Points greater than 0, it can bounce again. There is no limit to the amount of times it can bounce.
<color=black>•</color> Each hit deals an additional 5×(target Poison value) damage and then adds 1 Poison point.
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Launches a projectile that bounces once.</color>

german.name: Knoblauchpult
german.introduce: <size=30><color=black>„Die Kombination aus Kohl und Knoblauch ist frisch, lecker und gesund, und sie ist einfach zuzubereiten. Wenn man vor dem Servieren noch ein paar Nelken Knoblauch hinzufügt, verstärkt das den Geschmack“, erklärt Chef Knoblauch. Es wird auch gesagt, dass das Essen von Knoblauch eine Wirkung auf die Vorbeugung von Haarausfall hat.</color>
german.info:
<size=30>Knoblauchpult schießt ein Projektil, das einmal abprallt. Jedes Mal, wenn es einen Zombie mit Giftpunkten größer als 0 trifft, kann es erneut abprallen. Es gibt keine Begrenzung für die Anzahl der Abprallversuche, und jeder Treffer fügt 1 Giftpunkt hinzu.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>40/3 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Jeder Zombie-Treffer fügt 1 Giftpunkt hinzu. Siehe Gewürznelkepult für Informationen.</color>

original.name: 大蒜花盆
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>大蒜花盆早就想帮助盆中的植物来一次全方位的杀菌消毒了，尤其是前线和僵尸直接接触的那些植物们，但似乎只有大蒜类的植物愿意种在他的盆里。“有的植物宁可和僵尸接触，也不愿意沾染上我的蒜味。”大蒜花盆感叹道，“现在我只能用大蒜给大蒜消毒了，还要被他们说是蒜味相投。”</color>
original.info:
蒜味的花盆，降低本格蒜类植物受到的啃咬伤害。

<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>可种裸地，低矮，载体</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>本格的蒜类植物受到的啃咬伤害降低为10，并使啃咬者尽可能向最中间一行换行</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>花盆（底座）+大蒜</color>

english.name: Garlic Pot
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Garlic Pot has long wanted to help the plants in its pot get a thorough sterilization, especially those on the front lines in direct contact with zombies. However, it seems only garlic-type plants are willing to grow in its pot. "Some plants would rather face zombies than catch my garlic smell," Garlic Pot sighed. "Now I can only use garlic to disinfect garlic, and they just say it's a perfect match."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Garlic Pot reduces the biting damage taken by garlic-type plants on top, and has a garlic effect itself.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Forces zombies to move towards the middle row.
<color=black>•</color> Reduces the biting damage taken by garlic-type plants on top to 10.</color>

german.name: Knoblauchtopf
german.introduce: <size=30><color=black>Der Knoblauchtopf hat schon lange den Wunsch, den Pflanzen in seinem Topf eine gründliche Sterilisation zu ermöglichen, besonders denen an der Frontlinie, die direkt mit Zombies in Kontakt kommen. Allerdings scheinen nur Knoblauch-Pflanzen bereit zu sein, in seinem Topf zu wachsen. „Manche Pflanzen würden lieber Zombies gegenüberstehen, als meinen Knoblauchgeruch zu ertragen“, seufzte der Knoblauchtopf. „Jetzt kann ich nur noch Knoblauch mit Knoblauch desinfizieren, und sie sagen nur, dass es perfekt zusammenpasst.“</color>
german.info:
<size=30>Reduziert den Bissschaden, den Knoblauch-Pflanzen erleiden, und hat selbst einen Knoblauch-Effekt.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Zwingt die Zombies, sich in Richtung der mittleren Reihe zu bewegen.</color>

original.name: 蒜西瓜投手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>曾经没有几个家伙可以在蒜西瓜投手的面前装蒜，一般情况下不管是谁遇上蒜西瓜投手都要绕道而行，其实蒜西瓜投手的本意并不是这样的，他不祈求自己在和以前当厨师时一样受欢迎，至少他希望自己能结交一些喜欢大蒜素的朋友，而现在，大家终于不会再远离他了，他让朋友们都爱上了大蒜素。</color>
original.info:
蒜味的西瓜投手，投出西瓜群体赋予蒜值。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>100/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>子弹的直击享受(20×目标蒜值)的伤害加成，溅射享受(5×目标蒜值)的伤害加成，造成伤害后都会赋予1点蒜值</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>西瓜投手+大蒜</color>

english.name: Garlic-pult
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Few dare to put on airs in front of Garlic-pult. Most take a detour when they see him, though he doesn't intend to be intimidating. He no longer seeks the popularity he had as a chef, but he does hope to make friends who appreciate the benefits of allicin. Now, plants finally embrace his unique charm, garlic and all.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Garlic-pult launches large garlics that poison zombies.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>100/3s</color>
<color=#5E1675>Poison System: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> See Clove-pult for details on the Poison System.
<color=black>•</color> Direct hits deal an additional 20×(target Poison value) damage. Splashes deal an additional 5×(target Poison value) damage. Accumulates 1 Poison point for all zombies within the garlic melon's splash radius.</color>

german.name: Melonaknoblauchpult
german.introduce: <size=30><color=black>Nur wenige wagen es, sich in der Nähe von Melonaknoblauchpult groß aufzuspielen. Die meisten machen einen Umweg, wenn sie ihn sehen, obwohl er nicht einschüchternd wirken will. Er strebt nicht mehr nach der Popularität, die er einst als Koch hatte, aber er hofft auf Freunde, die die Vorteile von Allicin zu schätzen wissen. Jetzt erkennen die Pflanzen endlich seinen einzigartigen Charme – Knoblauch inklusive.</color>
german.info:
<size=30>Melonaknoblauchpult sammelt 1 Giftpunkt für alle Zombies innerhalb des Spritzradius des Knoblauchs. Jeder Giftpunkt erhöht den Schaden von Flächenangriffen um 5.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>80/3 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Jeder Treffer fügt dem Ziel 1 Giftpunkt zu; siehe Gewürznelkepult.</color>

original.name: 流光机枪射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>流光机枪射手在战场上大放光彩，常常能够斩获四倍的战功，虽然经常会因为过于耀眼而被敌方集火，但这丝毫不影响他英勇作战，光芒中的伤口是勇士的勋章。</color>
original.info:
发射四束高频激光，持续推进战线。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>10</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>每0.5秒，获得（光照等级）点光能，存储上限1000点。每道激光在攻击或输送时，均会消耗（1+当前光能×10%）点光能</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>能锁定本行前方的流光中继射手（不可紧邻），每0.1秒消耗4次光能输送一次，为目标补充4×自身攻击力10%的光能，每点消耗的光能使补充量增加1倍</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>可同时对四只僵尸发射激光，每0.2秒攻击一次，单次伤害会增加（消耗光能）倍</color>
<color=#3D1400>④</color><color=red>手动点击会重新锁定目标</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手×4+路灯花</color>

english.name: Gatling Beam
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Gatling Beam shines brilliantly on the battlefield, often earning four times the credit. Though its glow makes it an easy target, it never backs down. Wounds within the light are a warrior's badge of honor.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Garling Beam fires four times the amount of beams Beamshooter does!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>10×4/0.2s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Gains Lumos energy equal to Lumos level every 0.5s, up to 1000. Each laser beam consumes (1 + current energy × 10%) energy when attacking or transferring.
<color=black>•</color> Can lock onto a Split Beam in front in the same lane (not directly adjacent). Transfers energy every 0.1s, restoring energy equal to 40% of its attack. Each point of energy spent doubles the amount transferred.
<color=black>•</color> Consumes energy every 0.2s to attack 4 zombies at once, increasing damage by the amount of energy spent.
<color=black>•</color> Click on it will reset its target.</color>

german.name: Gatling Beam
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Gatling Beam shines brilliantly on the battlefield, often earning four times the credit. Though its glow makes it an easy target, it never backs down. Wounds within the light are a warrior's badge of honor.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Fires four high-frequency lasers.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>10×4/0.2s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Gains Lumos energy equal to Lumos level every 0.5s, up to 1000. Each laser beam consumes (1 + current energy × 10%) energy when attacking or transferring.
<color=black>•</color> Can lock onto a Split Beam in front in the same lane (not directly adjacent). Transfers energy every 0.1s, restoring energy equal to 40% of its attack. Each point of energy spent doubles the amount transferred.
<color=black>•</color> Consumes energy every 0.2s to attack 4 zombies at once, increasing damage by the amount of energy spent.
<color=black>•</color> Click on it will reset its target.</color>

original.name: 火辣机枪射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>苦恼于越来越多的伤者，这位擅长高温消毒的豌豆医生打算带上自己的新发明——火辣加特林，直接去给伤痛的源头“消消毒”。</color>
original.info:
发射火辣豌豆的机枪射手。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>30×4/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>攻击施加红温状态</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手×4+火爆辣椒</color>

english.name: Gatling Blaze
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Tired of treating endless burn victims, this pea doctor now takes his proud invention of pyrotherapy to cure the problem at its source.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Gatling Blaze fires 4 Blaze Peas at once.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>30×4/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000> Attacks inflict Enflamed debuff.</color>

german.name: MG-Flamme
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Tired of treating endless burn victims, this pea doctor now takes his proud invention of pyrotherapy to cure the problem at its source.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Fires 4 Blaze Peas at once.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>30×4/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000> Attacks inflict Enflamed debuff.</color>

original.name: 樱桃机枪射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​樱桃机枪射手的枪管一直都是红温的，他对外的解释是：预热枪管可以快速发射子弹。大家都深信不疑，直到他们发现樱桃机枪射手吃特制樱桃的时候也不取下枪管…​</color>
original.info:
发射粉樱桃子弹的机枪射手。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40×4/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手×4+樱桃炸弹</color>

english.name: Gatling Cherry
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Gatling Cherry's barrel was always red hot. He assured everyone that it was preheated to ensure faster firing. Everyone bought the story—until they caught him eating special cherries without even removing the barrel.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Gatling Cherry fires 4 double damage cherries at once!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40×4/1.5s</color></size>

german.name: MG-Kirsche
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Das Rohr der MG-Kirsche war immer glühend heiß. Er versicherte allen, dass es vorgeheizt sei, um schneller feuern zu können. Alle glaubten ihm – bis sie ihn dabei erwischten, wie er Spezialkirschen aß, ohne das Rohr überhaupt zu entfernen.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>MG-Kirsche ist Kirschkanones letzte Form!

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>60*4/1.5 Sekunden</color></size>

original.name: 毁灭菇机枪射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“毁灭机枪是危险的，不可靠近的，是世界上禁忌的力量。”虽然植物这边流传的故事非常的可怕，但其实毁灭机枪却没有像故事里的一样，反而他是植物中最和蔼的，不过被炸成灰的僵尸很不同意。</color>
original.info:
每轮发射四发毁灭菇子弹。

<color=#3D1400>使用条件：</color><color=red>旅行模式</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手×4+毁灭菇</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>300×4/1.5秒，1800</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>发射毁灭菇子弹。每第16发子弹变为6倍伤害的大型子弹，且发射后休息4.5秒（3倍攻击间隔）</color>
<color=#3D1400>毁灭菇子弹：</color><color=red>能穿透二类防具。大型毁灭菇子弹造成单体伤害后，再造成半径3格范围伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条1：</color><color=red>枕戈待旦：不会休息，解锁亚种毁灭机枪胆小菇</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条2：</color><color=red>核能威慑：每第4发子弹改为大毁灭菇子弹</color>

english.name: Gatling Doom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Gatling Doom is dangerous and should not be approached. It is a forbidden force in the world." Despite the frightening tales circulating among the plants, Gatling Doom is not as it seems. In fact, it is one of the friendliest plants. However, the zombies turned to ashes would disagree.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Gatling Doom is destruction incarnate. Fires rounds of destruction to decimate those unlucky enough to face its wrath.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode</color>
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>300×4/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Fires Doom Shells that ignore Type 2 armor in rounds of 4. Fires an Ultimate Doom Shell that deals 1800 damage once every 4 rounds of bullets and then rests for 4.5s after the Ultimate Doom Shell is shot. Ultimate Doom Shells deal splash damage over a large area after dealing the initial single-target damage.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
</color><color=#8B0000>1. No more rest after firing an Ultimate Doom Shell | Gatling Frenzy-shroom Subspecies Unlocked | Effects also apply to SP variants
2. Now fires an Ultimate Doom Shell every round instead of every 4th round | Effects also apply to SP variants</color></size>

german.name: MG-Unheil
german.introduce: <size=30><color=black>„MG-Unheil ist unfassbar gefährlich und sollte von allen gemieden werden. Es ist eine verbotene Kraft in dieser Welt.“ Trotz der beängstigenden Geschichten, die unter den Pflanzen kursieren, ist MG-Unheil ganz anders als erwartet. Tatsächlich gehört es zu den freundlichsten Pflanzen. Die zu Asche verwandelten Zombies würden jedoch widersprechen.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=30>Verkörpert die Zerstörung. Feuert Runden des Unheils auf jeden, der unglücklich genug ist, seinen Zorn zu spüren.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>300*4/1.5 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Feuert eine Kugel des Untergangs ab, die einmal alle 4 Runden 1800 Schaden verursacht. Jedes Geschoss verursacht Schaden in einem großen Bereich.</color>
<color=black>Odyssee Verbesserung:
</color><color=#8B0000>1. Keine Pause mehr zwischen den Angriffen
2. Kann jetzt jede Runde vernichtende Kugeln abfeuern</color></size>

original.name: 魅惑机枪射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>魅惑机枪射手是僵友俱乐部的名植，“我的眼睛没有任何问题，我能知道哪些僵尸是可以被感化的。”他还严厉批评过魅惑窝瓜的激进派，“他太暴力了，我们应该友好点。”他俩现在已经吵得热火朝天，以至于现在保守派和激进派只剩下他俩了，除了最正常的那位。</color>
original.info:
发射魅惑豌豆的机枪射手。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>30×4/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>杀死僵尸时，召唤一个植物方的魅惑豌豆射手僵尸</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手×4+魅惑菇</color>

english.name: Gatling Hypno
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Gatling Hypno is a star in the Zombuddies Club. "There's nothing wrong with my eyes. I know which zombies can be redeemed." He harshly criticizes the radical Hypno Squash: "He's too violent, we should be friendlier with our potential collaborators." Their debate is now so intense that only the two of them remain in the club, besides the one who started it all.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Gatling Hypno fires 4 hypno peas at a time!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>30×4/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Summons a Hypnotized Hypno Pea Zombie upon kill.</color>

german.name: MG-Hypno
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Gatling Hypno is a star in the Zombuddies Club. "There's nothing wrong with my eyes. I know which zombies can be redeemed." He harshly criticizes the radical Hypno Squash: "He's too violent, we should be friendlier with our potential collaborators." Their debate is now so intense that only the two of them remain in the club, besides the one who started it all.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Gatling Pea that fires Hypno Peas.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>30×4/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Summons a Hypnotized Hypno Pea Zombie upon kill.</color>

original.name: 机枪射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>机枪射手宣布要去参军的时候，他的父母出于担心一致反对：“亲爱的儿子，这太危险了！”但机枪豌豆毫不动摇。“生活本就危险。”他这样回答，眼里闪现出钢铁般的信念。​</color>
original.info:
一次发射四颗豌豆。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20×4/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手×4</color>

english.name: Gatling Pea
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Gatling Pea, the big brother of the Pea family, stands tall with his gun barrel, the very foundation of everyone's safety. His back is like a monument on the battlefield, admired by all. Yet, he smiles modestly, knowing that his daily life is actually managed by his younger brother, Peashooter. "I can't live without him," he admits quietly.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Gatling Pea shoots four peas at a time.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20×4/1.5s</color></size>

german.name: MG-Erbse
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Die Eltern von MG-Erbse waren nicht glücklich, als er zur Armee wollte. 'Schatz, das ist zu gefährlich!', beschworen sie ihn. Er jedoch gab nicht nach. 'Leben ist gefährlich', sagte er mit stahlharter Überzeugung.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>MG-Erbsen verschießen vier Erbsen auf einmal.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20*4/1.5 Sekunden</color></size>

original.name: 机枪小喷菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“我们要去参军啦！”三只小喷菇激动地说。他们的身高达不到要求，甚至连小号的钢盔都很难找。但是这些困难无法阻挡机枪小喷菇的脚步，他们团结一致，决心成为军队中最优秀的三人小组。</color>
original.info:
一次发射四颗小豌豆。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20×4/2.25秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮，可密植</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>小喷菇（底座）+豌豆射手×4</color>

english.name: Gatling Pea-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"We're off to join the army!" the three little mushrooms shouted with joy. Although their heights didn't meet the requirements and locating small helmets was a struggle, these challenges couldn't hold back the Gatling Pea-shrooms. United as one, they set their sights on becoming the top trio in the army.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Gatling Pea-shroom fires 4 small peas at once, with the added benefit of being able to be stacked!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20×4/2.25s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).</color></size>

german.name: MG-Erbsenpilz
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>„Wir treten der Armee bei!“ riefen die drei kleinen Pilze fröhlich. Obwohl ihre Größen nicht den Anforderungen entsprachen und das Finden kleiner Helme eine Herausforderung war, konnten diese Schwierigkeiten die MG-Erbsenpilze nicht aufhalten. Vereint als Trio setzten sie sich zum Ziel, das Top-Trio in der Armee zu werden.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>MG-Erbsenpilz kann bis zu dreimal gestapelt werden, um 12 kleine Erbsen auf einmal abzufeuern!

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20*4/1.5 Sekunden</color></size>

original.name: 蒜毒机枪射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>蒜毒机枪射手身上有浓烈的大蒜气味，很多植物都因此认为他平时并不注重生活，而事实却恰恰相反，他的生活充满了自律——不论是规律的作息、定期的锻练，还是每小时一次的枪管清洁工作。</color>
original.info:
发射蒜豌豆的机枪射手。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>30×4/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>子弹命中时赋予1蒜值。如果目标处于中毒状态，在其位置生成一个毒瘴</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手×4+大蒜</color>

english.name: Gatling Poison
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>At the neighborhood potluck, renowned linguist Gatling Poison proudly served a "traditional recipe" of 'pois' and 'poisson'. It tasted excellent, except everybody got food poisoning afterwards. To this day he still insists the 'poison' was part of the 'Gift'.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Gatling Poison fires four poison peas at once.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>30×4/1.5s</color>
<color=#5E1675>Poison System: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Projectiles add 1 Poison value to zombies on hit.
<color=black>•</color> If the zombie hit is already in a Poisoned state, creates a Toxic Cloud at the zombie's feet.</color>

german.name: MG-Knoblauch
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>At the neighborhood potluck, renowned linguist Gatling Poison proudly served a "traditional recipe" of 'pois' and 'poisson'. It tasted excellent, except everybody got food poisoning afterwards. To this day he still insists the 'poison' was part of the 'Gift'.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Fires four garlic peas at once.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>30×4/1.5s</color>
<color=#5E1675>Poison System: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Projectiles add 1 Poison value to zombies on hit.
<color=black>•</color> If the zombie hit is already in a Poisoned state, creates a Toxic Cloud at the zombie's feet.</color>

original.name: 寒冰机枪射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>他的手是冷的，他的脸是冷的，他的心是冷的，他的血是冷的。。。这家伙冻上了吧？“我并不会被冻上，因为机枪的枪管还是很烫的。”寒冰机枪瑟瑟发抖地向担心自己的植物们解释道。</color>
original.info:
发射寒冰豌豆的机枪射手。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20×4/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手×4+寒冰菇</color>

english.name: Gatling Snow
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"His hands are cold, his face is cold, his heart is cold, and even his blood is cold… Is he frozen?" someone wondered aloud. Gatling Snow shivered, reassuring the concerned plants, "I'm not frozen! The barrel of my machine gun is still burning hot!"</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Gatling Snow shoots four snow peas at a time.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20×4/1.5s</color>
<color=#0077b6>Cryo System: </color><color=#8B0000>Each attack adds 10 Cryo points.</color></size>

german.name: MG-Schnee
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>„Seine Hände sind kalt, sein Gesicht ist kalt, sein Herz ist kalt, und sogar sein Blut ist kalt… Ist er eingefroren?“, fragte sich jemand laut. MG-Schnee schüttelte sich und beruhigte die besorgten Pflanzen: „Ich bin nicht eingefroren! Der Lauf meines Maschinengewehrs ist immer noch brennend heiß!“</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>MG-Schnee schießt vier gefrorene Erbsen gleichzeitig ab.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20*4/1.5 Sekunden</color></size>

original.name: 巨型坚果
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>我在战场上所向披靡，伙伴们都在看我伟岸的身姿！”巨型坚果骄傲地说，“在被坚果不倒翁俱乐部开除一年后，我终于找到了适合自己的工作”</color>
original.info:
巨型坚果保龄球！向前滚动，伤害沿途的僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>600/0.02秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>坚果×2</color>

english.name: Giant Wall-nut
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I am invincible on the battlefield, and my partners can't take their eyes off my majestic figure!" the Giant Wall-nut boasted. "One year after getting kicked out of the Wall-nut Tumbler Club, I finally found a job that truly suits me."</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Giant Wall-nut rolls forward, knocking down all zombies in its path.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>600/0.02s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Rolls down the lane, killing all the zombies on its path.</color></size>

german.name: Riesen-Nuss
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>„Ich bin auf dem Schlachtfeld unbesiegbar, und meine Partner können ihren Blick nicht von meiner majestätischen Erscheinung abwenden!“, prahlte die Riesen-Nuss. „Ein Jahr nach dem Rauswurf aus dem Wall-Nuss-Tumbler-Club habe ich endlich einen Job gefunden, der wirklich zu mir passt.“</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Die Riesen-Nuss rollt nach vorne und wirft alle Zombies um, die ihr begegnen.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Rollt die Gasse hinunter und tötet alle Zombies auf seinem Weg.</color></size>

original.name: 超级大喷菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>冰霜武装他的身躯，岁月洗去他的稚气，他的眼神比熏黑的枪管更致命，所有的敌人在他的目光中只能倒映出不屑。他是死神，是终结者，被他盯上的目标最好晚上让家里少做一份饭。</color>
original.info:
发射爆炸冰锥。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20×4/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>攻击能穿透2次，施加寒冷状态，赋予5点冻结值，造成半径1格、50%伤害的无衰减溅射，溅射会伤害直击目标。直击对冻结僵尸伤害×4</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大喷菇+寒冰菇+毁灭菇</color>

english.name: Glacier-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Frost has wrapped around his body, stripping away the innocence of his youth. His eyes, colder and deadlier than any gun's barrel, now only show disdain for his enemies. He's become the reaper, the end of the line. Anyone caught in his frosty sights would do well to leave one less meal prepared at home.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Glacier-shroom can fire chilly doomspikes that pierce and deal damage in an area.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20×4/3s</color>
<color=#0077b6>Cryo System: </color><color=#8B0000>Add 5 Cryo points to zombies each hit. Deals ×4 damage to frozen zombies.</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Pierces 2 times. Splashes for 10 damage without falloff within a range of 1 tile.</color></size>

german.name: Unheilbergpilz
german.introduce: <size=31><color=black>Der Frost hat seinen Körper umhüllt und die Unschuld seiner Jugend genommen. Seine Augen, kälter und tödlicher als der Lauf einer Waffe, zeigen jetzt nur noch Verachtung für seine Feinde. Er ist zum Sensenmann geworden, dem Ende der Linie. Jeder, der in seinen frostigen Blick gerät, sollte gut daran tun, zu Hause eine Mahlzeit weniger vorzubereiten.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=31>Unheilbergpilz kann explosive Eiskegel abfeuern.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20*4/3 Sekunden</color>
<color=#0077b6>Kryo-System: </color><color=#8B0000>Fügt den Zombies bei jedem Treffer 10 Kryo-Punkte zu. Verursacht den 4-fachen Schaden an gefrorenen Zombies.</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Durchbohrt 3 Feinde. Verursacht 10 Schaden im Bereich des Feindkontakts.</color></size>

original.name: 忧郁菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“我喜欢喷射大量烟雾。”忧郁蘑菇说，“我知道许多人不喜欢这样，他们说这又粗鲁啦烟雾又很臭啦之类的，我只想说，你们想不想自己的脑袋被僵尸吃掉。”</color>
original.info:
向周围喷射可以穿透的烟雾。
<color=#800080>需要种植在大喷菇上</color>

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20×4/1.9秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>攻击时，向自身周围半径1.5格范围喷射四次烟雾</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大喷菇（底座）+忧郁菇或其卡片/肥料</color>

english.name: Gloom-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I've always enjoyed releasing heavy fumes," says Gloom-shroom. "I know a lot of people aren't cool with that. They say it's rude or that it smells bad. All I can say is, would you rather have your brain eaten by zombies?"</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Gloom-shrooms fire heavy fumes in an area around them.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20×4/1.9s (Piercing)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Can only be placed on existing Fume-shrooms.</color></size>

german.name: Stinkmorchel
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>'Ich lasse gern mal ein bisschen Dampf ab', sagt Stinkmorchel. 'Viele finden das ja nicht so toll. Sie finden es unfein oder mögen den Geruch nicht. Ich kann dazu nur sagen: Hättet ihr es lieber, dass Zombies euer Gehirn fressen?!'</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Stinkmorcheln stoßen giftige Dämpfe um sich herum aus.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20*4/1.9 Sekunden</color></size>

original.name: 流光三叶草
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“银烛秋光冷画屏，轻罗小扇扑流萤。”这是流光三叶草最喜欢的一句诗，从小就对萤火虫充满了兴趣的她常在夜晚的水边吹起微风，欣赏荧光从风中缓缓升起，又闪动着慢慢落回昏暗的草丛，如此美景也只有僵尸才会不解风情了。</color>
original.info:
明亮的三叶草，可以暂时为全场提供光照等级。

<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>拥有三叶草的特点。为全场提供1级光照，持续30秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>三叶草+路灯花</color>

english.name: Glowver
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"The silver candle illuminates the cold autumn canvas, while the light silk fan dances gracefully with the fireflies." This is Glowver's beloved poem. His fascination with fireflies began in childhood, and he often enjoys the cool breeze by the water at night, admiring how their fluorescence rises gently from the wind, twinkling before softly falling back into the dark grass. Only zombies would overlook such exquisite beauty.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Glowver dispels fog and increases the Lumos level of Lumos plants present.

<color=#99582a>Lumos System: </color><color=#8B0000>Gives 1 Lumos Level for Lumos plants in the entire field for 30 seconds.</color></size>

german.name: Leuchtfächer
german.introduce: <size=32><color=black>„Die silberne Kerze erleuchtet die kalte Herbstleinwand, während der leichte Seidenfächer anmutig mit den Glühwürmchen tanzt.“ Dies ist das geliebte Gedicht von Leuchtfächer. Seine Faszination für Glühwürmchen begann in seiner Kindheit, und oft genießt er die kühle Brise am Wasser bei Nacht, bewundernd, wie ihre Fluoreszenz sanft aus dem Wind emporsteigt, bevor sie leise wieder in das dunkle Gras fällt. Nur Zombies würden eine so exquisite Schönheit übersehen.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=32>DispVertreibt Nebel und erhöht die Leuchtkraft-Stufe der Leuchtkraft-Pflanzen in der Nähe.

<color=#99582a>Leuchtkraft-System: </color><color=#8B0000>Gibt 1 Leuchtkraft-Stufe für Leuchtkraft-Pflanzen auf dem gesamten Feld für 30 Sekunden.</color></size>

original.name: 魅惑小蘑菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​“在我小的时候，我一直以为僵尸是童话里才有的怪物。”魅惑小蘑菇慢悠悠地解释说，“你们不应该困惑，我只是把僵尸们变回了童话里应有的样子。”</color>
original.info:
小小的魅惑菇，僵尸啃咬时会被魅惑并变小。

<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮，可密植</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>被啃咬时魅惑该僵尸并使其缩小（体型和血量变为0.7倍），然后自身消失</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>小喷菇（底座）+魅惑菇</color>

english.name: Gnome-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"As a kid, I believed zombies were nothing more than fairy tale monsters," Gnome-shroom said softly. "Now, don't get it twisted—I'm just restoring them to the fairy tale form they were always supposed to have."</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Gnome-shroom shrinks a zombie and makes it fight for you!

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant. Makes a zombie smaller (cuts Toughness to 70%) and fight for you.</color></size>

german.name: Mini-Hypnopilz
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>„Als Kind glaubte ich, Zombies wären nichts weiter als Märchenmonster“, sagte Mini-Hypnopilz leise. „Jetzt, missversteht mich nicht – ich stelle sie einfach in die Märchenform zurück, die sie immer haben sollten.“</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Mini-Hypnopilz verkleinert einen Zombie und lässt ihn für dich kämpfen!

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Macht einen Zombie kleiner (halbiert die Gesundheit) und kämpft für dich.</color></size>

original.name: 吸金磁
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>吸金磁在经历过数钱的工作之后，她发现自己的吸能强的可怕，于是转职成了战斗人员，“说实在的，这可比数钱的工作爽多了，”吸金磁如是说到，“毕竟钱可不会绕着被你赚，但子弹会。”虽说如此，但其他的植物可被他坑惨了。</color>
original.info:
定期激活，促使邻行的植物攻击，并将邻行的子弹吸引至本行获得金钱。

<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>不参与磁力系统。每轮激活3秒，休息2秒。激活时使邻行的植物攻击，并将其中的平射子弹吸引至本行，每吸引1个，获得25金钱（每轮最多500）</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>磁力菇+金盏花</color>

english.name: Gold Magnet
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>After working countless hours at an accountant firm, the Gold Magnet realized its terrifying attracting potential and switched careers to become a fighter. 'Honestly, this is way more fun than counting money,' it remarks. 'After all, money doesn't grow on trees, but they do somehow from crops.' That said, its plant companions often end up suffering from its antics.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Gold Magnet forces plants to fire, attracts projectiles and makes you money for it!

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Forces straight-shooting plants in adjacent lanes to fire, attracts straight-shooting projectiles from adjacent lanes and produces 25 coins for every projectile attracted.</color>

german.name: Goldmagnet
german.introduce: <size=34><color=black>Nachdem er unzählige Stunden in einer Buchhalterfirma gearbeitet hatte, erkannte der Goldmagnet sein erschreckendes Anziehungspotenzial und wechselte den Beruf, um Kämpfer zu werden. Ehrlich gesagt, macht das viel mehr Spaß als Geld zu zählen“, bemerkt er. Schließlich wächst Geld nicht auf Bäumen, aber die wachsen ja irgendwie aus Pflanzen. Allerdings leiden seine Pflanzengefährten oft unter seinen Streichen.</color>
german.info:
<size=34>Zieht Geschosse an!

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Zieht geradlinig schießende Geschosse von benachbarten Bahnen an und erzeugt 25 Münzen für jedes angezogene Geschoss.</color>

original.name: 金向日葵
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>在奖杯基座上站岗使她感到厌烦，是时候加入战场（并晒出健康肤色）了！</color>
original.info:
飞快生产阳光并储存的向日葵，大招取出阳光。

<color=#3D1400>阳光产量：</color><color=red>50/10秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>生产的阳光会储存起来，每株最多储存1万。超过上限的阳光会存储在最新的金向日葵内</color>
<color=#3D1400>大招：</color><color=red>消耗1000金钱，冷却0秒。使全场金向日葵释放储存的阳光</color>

english.name: Golden Sunflower
english.introduce: Standing guard over a trophy had been so last season. Now? She was ready to shine—and not just under the sun. "Look, I love a good tan, but let's be real... I was made for the fight!"
english.info:
<size=36>Golden Sunflower stores sun in a personal piggy bank at a fast rate, its ultimate gives all that sun to you!

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Every 10 seconds, 50 Sun is accumulated, up to 10,000.
<color=black>•</color> The Sun limit in the level is adjusted to 50,000.
<color=black>•</color> The excess will be stored in the available Golden Sunflowers.
<color=black>Ultimate: </color><color=#8B0000>Costs 1000 Coins; makes all Golden Sunflowers release their stored Sun.</color>
english.cost: <size=36>Upgrade Cost: </color><color=#8B0000>3000 Coins; each existing Golden Sunflower will double the cost</color>

german.name: Gold-Sonnenblume
german.introduce: Standing guard over a trophy had been so last season. Now? She was ready to shine—and not just under the sun. "Look, I love a good tan, but let's be real... I was made for the fight!"
german.info:
<size=36>Generates Sun faster... faster!

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Every 10 seconds, 50 Sun is accumulated, up to 10,000.
<color=black>•</color> The Sun limit in the level is adjusted to 50,000.
<color=black>•</color> The excess will be stored in the available Golden Sunflowers.
<color=black>Ultimate: </color><color=#8B0000>Costs 1000 Coins; makes all Golden Sunflowers release their stored Sun.</color>
german.cost: <size=36>Upgrade Cost: </color><color=#8B0000>3000 Coins; each existing Golden Sunflower will double the cost</color>

original.name: 金坚果
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>僵尸总是忍不住要把金坚果的壳咬开，看看里面到底是什么。这不是什么魔法，而是僵尸有一种传言，认为他是一块金箔包裹的巧克力球。</color>
original.info:
韧性更高的金质坚果，大招可以提高自身韧性并回血。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>8000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>由银坚果升级而来时，免费释放一次大招</color>
<color=#3D1400>大招：</color><color=red>消耗1000金钱，冷却5秒。增加1000韧性，然后回复1倍韧性血量</color>

english.name: Golden-nut
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Zombies just can't resist biting into Golden-nut's shell to see what's inside. It's not magic; there's simply a rumor among zombies that he's a chocolate truffle wrapped in gold foil.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Golden-nut is made of gold, with even higher toughness and can use its Ultimate to boost its max HP and restore health.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>8000</color>
<color=black>Ultimate: </color><color=#8B0000>Costs 1000 Coins, Cooldown: 5s; Increases max Toughness by 1000 and restores health equal to its full Toughness.</color>
english.cost: <size=36>Upgrade Cost: </color><color=#8B0000>1000 Coins, 1 instance of Ultimate included</color>

german.name: Golden-nut
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Zombies just can't resist biting into Golden-nut's shell to see what's inside. It's not magic; there's simply a rumor among zombies that he's a chocolate truffle wrapped in gold foil.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Wall-nut made of gold, with even higher toughness; can use Ultimate to boost max HP and restore health.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>8000</color>
<color=black>Ultimate: </color><color=#8B0000>Costs 1000 Coins, Cooldown: 5s; Increases max Robustheit by 1000 and restores health equal to its full Robustheit.</color>
german.cost: <size=36>Upgrade Cost: </color><color=#8B0000>1000 Coins, 1 instance of Ultimate included</color>

original.name: 西瓜窝窝投手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>窝瓜很重，但是太软。西瓜也很重，可惜太脆。但是现在我们两个问题都不用担心了——啊，也许两个问题都得担心。</color>
original.info:
投出的子弹会像窝瓜一样重压僵尸，然后像西瓜一样破碎，造成溅射。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>120（压扁）/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>子弹落地时造成范围压扁伤害，稍后破碎，造成衰减溅射伤害，溅射模式与西瓜相同</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>西瓜投手+窝瓜</color>

english.name: Gourd-pult
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Squash is heavy, but too soft. Melons are heavy too, but too fragile. Now those problems are solved. Or possibly combined.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Gourd-pults projectiles crush zombies like a Squash, then shatter like a Melon, dealing splash damage.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>120 (Squash)/3s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Projectiles deal area crush damage on landing, then break shortly after, dealing splash damage with fall-off similar to Melon-pult.</color>

german.name: Matschlonapult
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Squash is heavy, but too soft. Melons are heavy too, but too fragile. Now those problems are solved. Or possibly combined.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Projectiles crush zombies like a Squash, then shatter like a Melon, dealing splash damage.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>120 (Squash)/3s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Projectiles deal area crush damage on landing, then break shortly after, dealing splash damage with fall-off similar to Melon-pult.</color>

original.name: 水草大蘑菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>水草大蘑菇对艺术有着独到的见解，他认为极致的混乱才是美的最高境界。就像他那一头卷发，从来没有打理过，反而生长出了自己的风格。正因如此，他缺席了所有的河底僵尸清理任务。</color>
original.info:
伸出水草触手连续抽打前方僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>30×3/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>对前方4.5格范围内所有的僵尸连续攻击三次，每次伤害后都会赋予1点水草值并追加效果：
第一次：额外赋予1点水草值
第二次：附加5×水草值的伤害
第三次：造成击退</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>缠绕水草（底座）+大喷菇</color>

english.name: Grapple Kelp
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Grapple Kelp has a unique sense of art, believing that absolute chaos is the highest form of beauty. His untamed curls have never been groomed, instead growing into a style of their own. Because of this, he has been absent from every underwater zombie cleanup mission.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Grapple Kelp deals high damage to zombies with tangle value and deals knockback!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>30×3/3s (Piercing)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Attacks all zombies within 4.5 tiles in front three times. Each hit applies 1 Tangle Stack and triggers these effects:
<color=black>-</color> 1st hit: +1 extra stack;
<color=black>-</color> 2nd hit: Deals additional damage equal to 5×(current stacks on the zombie);
<color=black>-</color> 3rd hit: knockback.</color>

german.name: Mief-Tang
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Grapple Kelp has a unique sense of art, believing that absolute chaos is the highest form of beauty. His untamed curls have never been groomed, instead growing into a style of their own. Because of this, he has been absent from every underwater zombie cleanup mission.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Extends tendrils to repeatedly strike enemies in front.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>30×3/3s (Piercing)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Attacks all zombies within 4.5 tiles in front three times. Each hit applies 1 Tangle Stack and triggers these effects:
<color=black>-</color> 1st hit: +1 extra stack;
<color=black>-</color> 2nd hit: Deals additional damage equal to 5×(current stacks on the zombie);
<color=black>-</color> 3rd hit: knockback.</color>

original.name: 胆大菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​“我有勇气我都不怕～管他春秋冬夏～”胆大菇不再胆小了，见到僵尸也不会缩起来。“曾经我很害怕，但是大喷菇前辈说，如果有僵尸靠近你，拿你的孢子喷他就好了，缩头解决不了问题。</color>
original.info:
喷射近程的烟雾或发射远程的孢子。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>30/1.5秒（烟雾）
30×2/1.5秒（孢子）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>烟雾射程4.5格，无限穿透</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>射程内没有目标则改为发射孢子</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>胆小菇+大喷菇</color>

english.name: Gutsy-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Courage fills me, no fear remains~ Whether it's spring, fall, winter, or summer~" Gutsy-shroom no longer shrinks in the face of zombies. "I used to tremble, but Senior Fume-shroom told me, 'If a zombie gets near, spray your spores. Hiding won't solve anything.'"</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Gutsy-shroom can switch between a double spore shot or a quick short range fume based on its situation!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>30×2/1.5s (Long range); 30/1.5s (Short range, piercing)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Shoots 2 spores at once. When zombies get within 4 tiles in range, sprays piercing fumes instead.</color></size>

german.name: Mutpilz
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>„Mut erfüllt mich, keine Angst bleibt~ Ob Frühling, Herbst, Winter oder Sommer~“ Mutpilz schrumpft nicht mehr vor Zombies. „Früher zitterte ich, aber der alte Stinkpilz sagte zu mir: ‚Wenn ein Zombie näherkommt, sprüh deine Sporen. Verstecken löst nichts.‘“</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Mutpilz ist bereit, sich den Zombies zu stellen, nah oder fern!

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20*2/1.5 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Wenn sich Zombies bis auf 3 Felder nähern, versprühen sie stattdessen stechenden Rauch.</color></size>

original.name: 寒冰小蘑菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​“身体虽然变小，能力还是一样的好！”每次出场的时候，寒冰小蘑菇都会摆出他标志性的poker face，然后开始讲冷笑话，所以现在你知道为什么他也可以把僵尸冻起来了吧。​</color>
original.info:
用小小的身躯冻结超小范围的敌人。

<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮，可密植</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>冻结接触的僵尸4秒，并施加10秒寒冷状态</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>小喷菇（底座）+寒冰菇</color>

english.name: Hail-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Smaller in size, same big abilities!" Hail-shroom's signature poker face never cracks as he delivers his jokes, and that might just be why zombies freeze on the spot.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Hail-shroom can temporarily freeze zombies they come into contact with.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant. Freezes zombies that eat it in place.</color></size>

german.name: Mini-Eispilz
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>„Kleiner in der Größe, gleich große Fähigkeiten!“ Mini-Eispilz’ legendäre Poker-Miene verzieht sich nie, selbst wenn er seine Witze bringt – vielleicht ist das der Grund, warum die Zombies augenblicklich einfrieren.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Mini-Eispilz kann Zombies, die mit ihm in Kontakt kommen, vorübergehend einfrieren.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Friert Zombies, die ihn fressen, an Ort und Stelle ein.</color></size>

original.name: 火焰地刺王
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>火焰地刺王前不久去了墨西哥，他被墨西哥人的热情同化了，同时喜欢上了塔可。现在他高涨的热情全部用在和寒冰地刺王的塔可博物馆投资事业中了，但寒冰地刺王貌似不太支持他。</color>
original.info:
触感火辣的地刺王。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>450</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40×2/1秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>攻击施加红温状态</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>地刺（底座）+地刺王或其卡片/肥料+火爆辣椒</color>

english.name: Hearthrock
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Not long ago, Hearthrock traveled to Mexico and was swept away by the vibrant enthusiasm of the locals, quickly falling in love with tacos. Now, he's pouring all his energy into a taco museum alongside Icerock, though Icerock doesn't seem to share his enthusiasm.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Hearthrock can enflame and damage zombies that step on it and can withstand multiple crushes!

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>450</color>
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40×2/1s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Inherits traits from Spikerock. Applies the Enflamed Debuff when attacking zombies.</color></size>

german.name: Stachelinferno
german.introduce: <size=32><color=black>Vor nicht allzu langer Zeit reiste Stachelinferno nach Mexiko und ließ sich von der lebhaften Begeisterung der Einheimischen mitreißen, schnell verliebt in Tacos. Jetzt steckt er all seine Energie in ein Taco-Museum zusammen mit Stachelkristall, auch wenn Stachelkristall seine Begeisterung nicht ganz zu teilen scheint.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=32>Entflammt Zombies, die darauf treten, und durchbohrt zudem Fahrzeuge.

<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>450</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>40*2/1 Sekunden</color>
<color=#720026>Entflammter Schwächungszauber: </color><color=#8B0000>Wendet den Entflammter-Schwächungszauber an, wenn er Zombies angreift.</color></size>

original.name: 海螺胆小菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>海螺胆小菇是优秀的灯塔，引导船只的方向，成为无数船只返航的最大帮手，而且非常谦虚清廉，从不接受多余的感谢。当然，这是船长之间的说法，对海螺胆小菇自己来说，靠近的船只实在是太可怕了、每次都能吓得他缩起来。</color>
original.info:
水生的胆小菇，投食海蘑菇后才会鼓起勇气攻击一段时间。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20/0.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>水生，低矮（蹲伏状态）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>默认处于蹲伏状态</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>对其使用海蘑菇卡牌后，10秒内正常攻击，随后再度蹲伏</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>海蘑菇（底座）+胆小菇</color>

english.name: Hermit-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Hermit-shroom drifts like a hidden reef, timid, still, but dangerous to the unwary. When the surrounding water shifts, he rouses and ferociously defends himself, then settles back beneath the waves as if nothing happened.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Hermit-shroom stays scared until you use a Sea-shroom on him, then he attacks for a while before becoming scared again..

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20/0.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Hides himself by default. Using a Sea-shroom seed packet on him makes him attack for 10s, after which he cowers again. Is short when hiding.</color>

german.name: Einsiedlerpilz
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Hermit-shroom drifts like a hidden reef, timid, still, but dangerous to the unwary. When the surrounding water shifts, he rouses and ferociously defends himself, then settles back beneath the waves as if nothing happened.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Too shy to attack until he sees a Sea-shroom dive.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20/0.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Hides himself by default. Using a Sea-shroom seed packet on him makes him attack for 10s, after which he cowers again. Is short when hiding.</color>

original.name: 火焰花盆
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>作为一名园艺爱好者，火焰花盆最喜欢做的事情就是在自己头上栽培各式各样的植物，这个爱好一直持续到了他去火焰大喷菇的餐馆吃了一次饭。</color>
original.info:
借助火势激发上方火伴战意。

<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮，载体，可种裸地</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每0.2秒限一次，受到火爆辣椒效果时，为上方火系投手、射手等植物回血20并提供持续5秒的50%攻速加成，该加成可叠加</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>花盆（底座）+火爆辣椒</color>

english.name: Hot Pot
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Hot Pot loves growing plants on his head. There's only one problem: everything he grows comes out spicy. Tomatoes taste like chili peppers, peas make your mouth burn, and even the most innocent-looking sunflowers come with a serious kick. He insists they're only mildly hot. Nobody has had the courage to tell him otherwise.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Hot Pot uses flames to ignite the fighting spirit of fire plants above it.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant. Once every 0.2s, when affected by a Jalapeno effect, restores 20 HP to fire-type catapults, shooters, etc. above it and grants them a 50% bonus Attack Speed for 5s. This bonus can stack.</color>

german.name: Hot Pot
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Hot Pot loves growing plants on his head. There's only one problem: everything he grows comes out spicy. Tomatoes taste like chili peppers, peas make your mouth burn, and even the most innocent-looking sunflowers come with a serious kick. He insists they're only mildly hot. Nobody has had the courage to tell him otherwise.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Hot Pot uses flames to ignite the fighting spirit of fire plants above it.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant. Once every 0.2s, when affected by a Jalapeno effect, restores 20 HP to fire-type catapults, shooters, etc. above it and grants them a 50% bonus Attack Speed for 5s. This bonus can stack.</color>

original.name: 火炬土豆雷
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>他原本只想做一个普普通通的地雷，直到一枚燃烧弹被扔到了它的引信上。现在的他虽然对无法隐蔽颇为不满，但是作为炊事班的掌上明珠，也算是因祸得福了。</color>
original.info:
能点燃小豌豆和土豆豌豆，并从中生成焰光土豆雷。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1800</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>影响经过的特定子弹</color>
<color=#A86A44>·小豌豆：</color><color=red>点燃，伤害+20</color>
<color=#A86A44>·滚地坚果：</color><color=red>伤害×2，重置穿透次数</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>每影响超过100个子弹，在前方生成一个不能用于融合的焰光土豆雷
*影响土豆豌豆会计为8发</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>死亡时产生土豆雷爆炸</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>土豆雷+火炬树桩</color>

english.name: Hot Potato
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Hot Potato only wanted to be an ordinary landmine, until an incendiary shell landed on his fuse. Though he's unhappy about no longer being able to stay hidden, becoming the darling of the mess hall has turned out to be a blessing in disguise.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Hot Potato ignites Small Peas and Potato Peas, creating Roasted Potatoes from them.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>1800</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant. Affects certain projectiles that pass through it:
	Small Peas, Potato Peas: Ignited, +20 damage
	Rolling Wall-nuts: Damage ×2 and piercing count reset
<color=black>•</color> For every 100+ projectiles affected, a Roasted Potato is spawned in front (Potato Peas count as 8 projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Triggers a Potato Mine explosion upon death.</color>

german.name: Hot Potato
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Hot Potato only wanted to be an ordinary landmine, until an incendiary shell landed on his fuse. Though he's unhappy about no longer being able to stay hidden, becoming the darling of the mess hall has turned out to be a blessing in disguise.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Hot Potato ignites Small Peas and Potato Peas, creating Roasted Potatoes from them.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>1800</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant. Affects certain projectiles that pass through it:
	Small Peas, Potato Peas: Ignited, +20 damage
	Rolling Wall-nuts: Damage ×2 and piercing count reset
<color=black>•</color> For every 100+ projectiles affected, a Roasted Potato is spawned in front (Potato Peas count as 8 projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Triggers a Potato Mine explosion upon death.</color>

original.name: 大嘴胆小菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>大嘴胆小菇非常在意自己的口腔卫生，因为她害怕躲起来的时候会被自己的口臭折磨。另外，她一直在纠结一个问题：自己清理头部到底是用洗发水，还是口腔清新剂？</color>
original.info:
害怕时吞下周围僵尸，并在威胁解除后吐出尸块来攻击。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>害怕时，对3×3范围内最多3只僵尸造成吞食。不论成功与否，该效果进入40秒冷却，期间发射无限穿透的滚地尸块</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>胆小菇+大嘴花</color>

english.name: Hungry-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Hungry-shroom is very concerned about her oral hygiene because she's afraid she'll be tormented by her own bad breath whenever she hides. She's also been agonizing over one question: when cleaning her head, should she use shampoo or mouthwash?</color>
english.info:
<size=36>When scared, Hungry-shroom swallows nearby Zombies and spits out chunks of corpses to attack once the threat has passed.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>When scared, swallows up to 3 Zombies within a 3×3 area. This effect then enters a 40s CD, during which it fires ground-rolling chunks of corpses with infinite pierce.</color>

german.name: Hungry-shroom
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Hungry-shroom is very concerned about her oral hygiene because she's afraid she'll be tormented by her own bad breath whenever she hides. She's also been agonizing over one question: when cleaning her head, should she use shampoo or mouthwash?</color>
german.info:
<size=36>When scared, Hungry-shroom swallows nearby Zombies and spits out chunks of corpses to attack once the threat has passed.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>When scared, swallows up to 3 Zombies within a 3×3 area. This effect then enters a 40s CD, during which it fires ground-rolling chunks of corpses with infinite pierce.</color>

original.name: 魅惑大蒜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>魅惑大蒜和大蒜家族格格不入，因为他很受大家欢迎。家族成员们对他又喜爱又嫉妒，但魅惑大蒜并不在意这些，他只想用帽子遮住眼睛、在闲暇时刻好好地睡上一觉。</color>
original.info:
头顶魅惑菌盖的大蒜。

<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>使接触的魅惑僵尸换行。被啃咬时魅惑该僵尸并使其换行，然后自身变回大蒜</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大蒜+魅惑菇</color>

english.name: Hypno Garlic
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Hypno Garlic doesn't quite fit in with the rest of the garlic family — he's far too popular for that. Loved and envied by his kin, he pays them no mind. All he wants is to pull his hat low over his eyes and enjoy a peaceful nap whenever he can.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Hypno Garlic can move hypnotized zombies to other lanes.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Causes hypnotized zombies that touch him to switch lanes.
<color=black>•</color> When bitten, hypnotizes the attacker, forces it to switch lanes, then reverts to a regular Garlic.</color>

german.name: Hyplauch
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Hypno Garlic doesn't quite fit in with the rest of the garlic family — he's far too popular for that. Loved and envied by his kin, he pays them no mind. All he wants is to pull his hat low over his eyes and enjoy a peaceful nap whenever he can.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Garlic with a shroomy hypno-cap mushroom on its head.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Causes hypnotized zombies that touch him to switch lanes.
<color=black>•</color> When bitten, hypnotizes the attacker, forces it to switch lanes, then reverts to a regular Garlic.</color>

original.name: 魅惑西瓜投手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>魅惑西瓜投手喜欢交友、绘画，以及调酒，她是一家酒吧的明星调酒师，调制的魅惑西瓜汁加冰比传统鸡尾酒更受欢迎。她的一些疯狂的客人甚至会为了喝到魅惑西瓜汁而假扮僵尸。</color>
original.info:
充满魅力的西瓜投手，投出可以魅惑成群僵尸的魅惑瓜。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>120/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>子弹的直击和溅射均有25%概率魅惑血量低于50%的僵尸</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>被啃咬时魅惑该僵尸，然后变为西瓜投手</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>魅惑菇+西瓜投手</color>

english.name: Hypno Melon
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Hypno Melon loves making friends, painting, and mixing drinks.
