She's the star bartender at a bar, and her iced hypno melon juice is even more popular than classic cocktails. Some of her more eccentric fans have even dressed up as zombies just to get a taste.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Hypno Melon lobs melons capable of hypnotizing hordes of zombies.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>120/3s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Both direct hits and splash damage have a 25% chance to hypnotize zombies with less than 50% max HP.
<color=black>•</color> When bitten, hypnotizes the attacker, then reverts to a Melon-pult.</color>

german.name: Hypnolopult
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Hypno Melon loves making friends, painting, and mixing drinks. She's the star bartender at a bar, and her iced hypno melon juice is even more popular than classic cocktails. Some of her more eccentric fans have even dressed up as zombies just to get a taste.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Lobs hypno melons capable of hypnotizing hordes of zombies.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>120/3s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Both direct hits and splash damage have a 25% chance to hypnotize zombies with less than 50% max HP.
<color=black>•</color> When bitten, hypnotizes the attacker, then reverts to a Melon-pult.</color>

original.name: 魅惑土豆雷
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>魅惑土豆雷不喜欢操之过急。它相信每个僵尸都应该有第二次机会——最好是在爆炸前。这自相矛盾吗？这和它拒绝分享的五点个人哲学并不矛盾。</color>
original.info:
魅力爆炸的土豆雷。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1800</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>魅惑爆炸范围内的僵尸，如果不能魅惑，则如常造成伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>魅惑菇+土豆雷</color>

english.name: Hypno Mine
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Hypno Mine isn't one for rushing. It believes every zombie deserves a second chance — preferably before it explodes. Contradictory? Maybe. But it's perfectly in line with its five personal principles, which it refuses to share.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Hypno Mine hypnotizes all zombies caught in the explosion radius.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>1800</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Hypnotizes the zombies exploded, deals 1800 damage instead if the zombie cannot be hypnotized.</color>

german.name: Hypnomine
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Hypno Mine isn't one for rushing. It believes every zombie deserves a second chance — preferably before it explodes. Contradictory? Maybe. But it's perfectly in line with its five personal principles, which it refuses to share.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Potato Mine with an explosive charm.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Hypnotizes the zombies exploded, deals 1800 damage instead if the zombie cannot be hypnotized.</color>

original.name: 魅惑豌豆射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“仅仅让僵尸们成为我们的盟友是不够的。我们需要给它们配备一些额外的火力，让他们在这个过程中看起来更像我们！”魅惑豌豆射手用一种充满诱惑力的语气说道。</color>
original.info:
发射魅惑豌豆，子弹击杀僵尸后会召唤魅惑豌豆射手僵尸为己方作战。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>30/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>杀死僵尸时，召唤一个植物方的魅惑豌豆射手僵尸</color>
<color=#3D1400>魅惑豌豆射手僵尸：</color><color=red>韧性270。每1.5秒发射一个伤害20的魅惑豌豆</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手+魅惑菇</color>

english.name: Hypno Pea
english.introduce:
<align=left><size=36><color=black>"Simply making Zombies into our allies isn't enough. We need to equip them with a little extra firepower, and have them look more like us in the process!" Hypno Pea says in an alluring tone.

-Written by Mr. Etc.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Hypno pea shoots hypno peas that turn killed zombies into friendly Hypno Pea Zombies.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>30/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Summons a Hypnotized Hypno Pea Zombie upon killing a zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Abilities do not work in water lanes.
<color=black>•</color> Hypno Pea Zombie: 270 HP, fires a 20-damage Hypno Pea every 1.5s.</color>

german.name: Hypno-Erbse
german.introduce:
<align=left><size=36><color=black>"Simply making Zombies into our allies isn't enough. We need to equip them with a little extra firepower, and have them look more like us in the process!" Hypno Pea says in an alluring tone.

-Written by Mr. Etc.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Shoots hypno peas that turn killed zombies into friendly Hypno Pea Zombies.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>30/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Summons a Hypnotized Hypno Pea Zombie upon killing a zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Abilities do not work in water lanes.
<color=black>•</color> Hypno Pea Zombie: 270 HP, fires a 20-damage Hypno Pea every 1.5s.</color>

original.name: 魅惑辣椒
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“我可是很温柔的，”魅惑辣椒整理了一下自己的帽子，“能够帮僵尸找到藏在心底的脆弱，引导他们卸下不需要的伪装、成为我们坦荡的朋友。”至于熊熊燃烧的火焰，那只是魅惑元素的焰色反应，不会伤害到脆弱的僵尸朋友。</color>
original.info:
用热辣的魅力炸翻僵尸，令其变心。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1800（灰烬）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>魅惑本行血量低于(0.5×本次伤害)的僵尸，如果不能魅惑，则仍旧造成伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>火爆辣椒+魅惑菇</color>

english.name: Hypno Pepper
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I'm actually very harmless," said Hypno Pepper, adjusting his hat. "I help zombies find their hidden fragility, guiding them to drop their pretense and become open, honest friends." As for the blazing flames? "That's just the hypnotium doing its magic. It doesn't really hurt the fragile zombies."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Hypno Pepper explodes, hypnotizing zombies it hits if they are at a low enough health.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Hypnotizes all zombies with less than 900 HP in its lane. Deals 1800 Cremator damage to all other zombies in its lane.</color>

german.name: Jalahypño
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I'm actually very harmless," said Hypno Pepper, adjusting his hat. "I help zombies find their hidden fragility, guiding them to drop their pretense and become open, honest friends." As for the blazing flames? "That's just the hypnotium doing its magic. It doesn't really hurt the fragile zombies."</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Explodes with fiery charm, causing zombies to switch sides.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Hypnotizes all zombies with less than 900 HP in its lane. Deals 1800 Cremator damage to all other zombies in its lane.</color>

original.name: 魅惑花盆
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>魅惑花盆很受欢迎。无论植物、僵尸、还是调皮的小甲虫，都是她的好朋友。她平时在一家蘑菇培育基地工作，业余时间则是僵友俱乐部的高级会员，每逢节假日还会和大家分享她亲手制作的漂亮的彩虹土。</color>
original.info:
花盆中的魅力能够滋养魅惑僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>载体，可种裸地，低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>为经过的魅惑僵尸永久提供33%减伤。每0.04秒为本格魅惑僵尸回复1点血量</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>被啃咬时魅惑该僵尸并变回花盆</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>花盆（底座）+魅惑菇</color>

english.name: Hypno Pot
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Hypno Pot is well-liked by everyone. Plants, zombies, even mischievous little beetles are all her friends. She works at a mushroom nursery, and in her free time she's a proud member of the Zombuddies Club, often sharing her handmade rainbow clay during holidays.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Hypno Pot grants healing and damage reduction to hypnotized zombies on its tile.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Grants hypnotized zombies on its tile 33% permanent Damage Reduction and heals 1 HP every 0.04s. When bitten, hypnotizes the attacker and reverts back to a Flower Pot.</color>

german.name: Hypnotopf
german.introduce: <color=#3D1400>Hypno Pot is well-liked by everyone. Plants, zombies, even mischievous little beetles are all her friends. She works at a mushroom nursery, and in her free time she's a proud member of the Zombuddies Club, often sharing her handmade rainbow clay during holidays.</color>
german.info:
The charm within the pot nurtures hypnotized zombies.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Grants hypnotized zombies on its tile 33% Damage Reduction and heals 1 HP every 0.04s. When bitten, hypnotizes the attacker and reverts back to a Flower Pot.</color>

original.name: 魅惑双发射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>魅惑双发射手语速很快，大多数句子都在别人开口之前就说完了。“现实就是个循环！我以前开过这枪，两次！”</color>
original.info:
发射魅惑豌豆的双发射手。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>30×2/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>杀死僵尸时，召唤一个植物方的魅惑豌豆射手僵尸</color>
<color=#3D1400>增生豆荚：</color><color=red>出场15秒后手动点击，即可升级为魅惑裂荚射手</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手×2+魅惑菇</color>

english.name: Hypno Repeater
english.introduce:
<align=left><size=36><color=black>Hypno Repeater talks fast and finishes most sentences before anyone else starts speaking. "Reality's a loop! I've fired this shot before, twice!"

-Written by Ocean Soul</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Hypno Repeater shoots double the amount of hypno peas compared to its predecessor.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>30×2/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Summons a Hypnotized Hypno Pea Zombie upon kill.
<color=black>•</color> Tap to auto-fuse with a free Peashooter 15s after planting.</color>

german.name: Hyplinator
german.introduce:
<align=left><size=36><color=black>Hypno Repeater talks fast and finishes most sentences before anyone else starts speaking. "Reality's a loop! I've fired this shot before, twice!"

-Written by Ocean Soul</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Repeater that fires Hypno Peas.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>30×2/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Summons a Hypnotized Hypno Pea Zombie upon kill.
<color=black>•</color> Tap to auto-fuse with a free Peashooter 15s after planting.</color>

original.name: 魅惑窝瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“我现在终于发现僵尸确实是我们的好朋友。”魅惑窝瓜说，他迅速加入了僵友俱乐部。并且，用自己极为激进的、表达友好的方法，让其他成员都变成了保守派。</color>
original.info:
用魅力压倒敌人的窝瓜。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1800（压扁）</color>
<color=#3D1400>索敌范围：</color><color=red>左侧0.5格~右侧1格</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>魅惑碾压范围内的僵尸，如果不能魅惑，则如常造成伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>窝瓜+魅惑菇</color>

english.name: Hypno Squash
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I've finally realized zombies really are our friends,"said Hypno Squash, who quickly joined the Zombuddies Club. The only problem: his extremely radical way of showing friendship turned all the other members into conservative ones.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Hypno Squash hypnotizes any zombies caught it its wake.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>0.5 tiles to the left; 1 tile to the right</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Hypnotizes the zombies he crushes, deals 1800 damage instead if the zombie cannot be hypnotized.</color>

german.name: Hypnoquetscher
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I've finally realized zombies really are our friends,"said Hypno Squash, who quickly joined the Zombuddies Club. The only problem: his extremely radical way of showing friendship turned all the other members into conservative ones.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Squash that overwhelms zombies with charm.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>0.5 tiles to the left; 1 tile to the right</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Hypnotizes the zombies he crushes, deals 1800 damage instead if the zombie cannot be hypnotized.</color>

original.name: 魅惑火炬树桩
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>作为泳池歌舞会的新星，魅惑火炬树桩刚一出道就俘获了包括僵尸和豌豆在内的大批粉丝，如火般的热情和乐于助人的品格是她的标签。但是就像大多数公众人物一样，魅惑火炬树桩也饱受流言困扰，整容和使用过量腻子粉的传言一直伴随着她。</color>
original.info:
充满魅力的火炬树桩，能从焰光中映出机枪射手僵尸作战。

<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>每影响超过60发子弹，召唤一个植物方的机枪射手僵尸
*魅惑豌豆会被计为4发</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>影响经过的特定子弹。不会影响由僵尸发射的子弹</color>
<color=#A86A44>·魅惑豌豆：</color><color=red>点燃，伤害+30</color>
<color=#A86A44>·豌豆：</color><color=red>点燃，伤害+20</color>
<color=#A86A44>·寒冰豌豆：</color><color=red>变为豌豆</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>被啃咬时魅惑该僵尸，然后变为火炬树桩</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>火炬树桩+魅惑菇</color>

english.name: Hypnowood
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>As a rising star of the poolside variety scene, Hypnowood quickly gained a huge following of zombies and plants alike. Her fiery charm and helpful nature became her trademark. But like many public figures, she is plagued by rumors: plastic surgery and excessive use of cosmetics have always followed her.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Hypnowood can summon hypnotized Gatling Pea Zombies to fight for you after igniting enough projectiles.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Summons a hypnotized Gatling Pea Zombie for every 60 projectiles ignited (not counting projectiles from hypnotized zombies).
<color=black>•</color> Hypno Peas count as 4 projectiles.
<color=black>•</color> When bitten, hypnotizes the attacker, and reverts to Torchwood.
<color=black>•</color> Affects the following projectiles:
<color=black>-</color> Peas: Ignited for +20 damage;
<color=black>-</color> Hypno Peas: Ignited for +30 damage;
<color=black>-</color> Snow Peas: Reverts to Peas.</color>

german.name: Hypnofeuer
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>As a rising star of the poolside variety scene, Hypnowood quickly gained a huge following of zombies and plants alike. Her fiery charm and helpful nature became her trademark. But like many public figures, she is plagued by rumors: plastic surgery and excessive use of cosmetics have always followed her.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Summons Gatling Pea Zombies from its flames.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Summons a hypnotized Gatling Pea Zombie for every 60 projectiles ignited.
<color=black>•</color> Hypno Peas count as 4 projectiles.
<color=black>•</color> When bitten, hypnotizes the attacker, and reverts to Torchwood.
<color=black>•</color> Affects the following projectiles:
<color=black>-</color> Peas: Ignited for +20 damage;
<color=black>-</color> Hypno Peas: Ignited for +30 damage;
<color=black>-</color> Snow Peas: Reverts to Peas.</color>

original.name: 寒冰仙人掌
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“高处不胜寒呐！”寒冰仙人掌总是会如此感慨，这让其他植物都感到很奇怪。但其实也不难理解，毕竟当你带着满脸的冰霜从云端回到地面时，你也会发出如此感慨的。</color>
original.info:
发射寒冰尖刺，对空军和冻结单位效果更佳。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>子弹施加寒冷状态，赋予10冻结值，对冻结单位伤害×4</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>对空时，子弹能穿透2次，且伤害×4</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>仙人掌+寒冰菇</color>

english.name: Ice Cactus
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"It really is cold up here!" Ice Cactus often sighs this way, leaving other plants rather confused. But it is not hard to understand. After all, if you returned from the clouds with your face covered in frost, you would probably say the same thing.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Ice Cactus fires icy spikes that are especially effective against airborne and frozen targets.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5s</color>
<color=#0077b6>Cryo System: </color><color=#8B0000>Attacks inflict Chill, add 10 Cryo points and deal ×4 damage to frozen zombies.</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Against airborne targets, projectiles pierce twice and deal ×4 damage.</color>

german.name: Ice Cactus
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"It really is cold up here!" Ice Cactus often sighs this way, leaving other plants rather confused. But it is not hard to understand. After all, if you returned from the clouds with your face covered in frost, you would probably say the same thing.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Ice Cactus fires icy spikes that are especially effective against airborne and frozen targets.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5s</color>
<color=#0077b6>Cryo System: </color><color=#8B0000>Attacks inflict Chill, add 10 Cryo points and deal ×4 damage to frozen zombies.</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Against airborne targets, projectiles pierce twice and deal ×4 damage.</color>

original.name: 寒冰土豆雷
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“我是战场上最重要的主角，”寒冰土豆地雷这样想，“而主角总是最后关头才登场。”在动手之前，他甚至会把自己埋进阴凉的土壤中充分地休息，当然，要注意把自己完美的发型留在外面、不要弄脏了。</color>
original.info:
浓缩了寒冰的力量，只需溅到一点，就能不断膨化爆炸。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1800</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>出土和爆炸时，释放一次冰爆：对3×3范围僵尸施加4秒冻结状态，造成1/3倍攻击力的伤害，并在周围8个格子内有僵尸的格子再次释放范围仅一格的微型冰爆</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>土豆雷+寒冰菇</color>

english.name: Ice Mine
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I am the true star of the battlefield," Ice Mine thinks. "And a star always makes his entrance at the very last moment." Before the grand review, he even buries himself in cool soil to rest, but not without making sure his perfect hairstyle stays untouched above ground.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Ice Mine releases a wave of ice when arming that can chain from zombie to zombie if they are close enough, it also does this on death!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>1800</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>On arming and detonation, triggers an ice blast that freezes zombies in a 3×3 area for 4s, dealing 1/3 damage, and triggers secondary smaller ice blasts in adjacent tiles containing zombies.</color>

german.name: Eismine
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I am the true star of the battlefield," Ice Mine thinks. "And a star always makes his entrance at the very last moment." Before the grand review, he even buries himself in cool soil to rest, but not without making sure his perfect hairstyle stays untouched above ground.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Releases condensed icy gas that triggers chain ice explosions from even the smallest contact.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>On arming and detonation, triggers an ice blast that freezes zombies in a 3×3 area for 4s, dealing 1/3 damage, and triggers secondary smaller ice blasts in adjacent tiles containing zombies.</color>

original.name: 寒冰花盆
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>每年夏天都是寒冰花盆最活跃的时候。“嘻嘻，热吗？要不要到我这里来凉快一下。”寒冰花盆说，“不过要小心，别在冰面上摔倒了。还有，来避暑的西瓜也要小心，变成冰镇西瓜后别被人拿去吃了哦。”</color>
original.info:
用于冷凝的花盆，可以将焰光汇聚而成的植物变为实体。

<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>可种裸地，低矮，载体</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每10秒，使本格一个特定焰光植物变为对应的基础植物</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>花盆（底座）+寒冰菇</color>

english.name: Ice Pot
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Summer is when Ice Pot is most active. "Heehee, feeling hot? Want to come cool off here?" he says. "Just be careful not to slip on the ice. And if you're a watermelon seeking shade, watch out! Once you turn into a chilled watermelon, someone might just eat you!"</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Ice Pot can turn roasted plants into their originals, taking the 'Roast' out of 'Roasted'.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Every 10s, transforms a specific Roasted plant on its tile into its base form usable for fusion.</color>

german.name: Eistopf
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Summer is when Ice Pot is most active. "Heehee, feeling hot? Want to come cool off here?" he says. "Just be careful not to slip on the ice. And if you're a watermelon seeking shade, watch out! Once you turn into a chilled watermelon, someone might just eat you!"</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Can materialize plants forged in fire.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Every 10s, transforms a specific Roasted plant on its tile into its base form usable for fusion.</color>

original.name: 寒冰地刺王
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>从阿拉斯加回来之后，寒冰地刺王很兴奋，他迫不及待想要把僵尸们冻得又冷又硬，“冰”在同时戳爆这些僵尸的脚底板儿。他执意要大家用“冰”这个字。他的皮肤上还残留着从阿拉斯加带回来的冷冽，眼中闪烁着未融化的雪光。</color>
original.info:
触感冰凉的地刺王。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>450</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40×2/1秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>攻击施加寒冷状态，赋予5点冻结值</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>地刺（底座）+地刺王或其卡片/肥料+寒冰菇</color>

english.name: Icerock
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>After his return from Alaska, Icerock couldn't contain his excitement. Eager to freeze the zombies solid, he relished the thought of "ice" bursting beneath their feet. He made it a point that everyone use the term "ice." His skin still carried the chill from his Arctic adventure, and his eyes shimmered with the brilliance of unmelting snow.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Icerock can withstand multiple tires and chills zombies that step on it!

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>450</color>
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40×2/1s</color>
<color=#0077b6>Cryo System: </color><color=#8B0000>Attacks inflict Chill and add 5 Cryo points.</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Inherits traits from Spikerock.</color></size>

german.name: Stachelkristall
german.introduce: <size=32><color=black>Nach seiner Rückkehr aus Alaska konnte Stachelkristall seine Aufregung kaum verbergen. Eifrig darauf bedacht, die Zombies einzufrieren, freute er sich über den Gedanken, dass „Eis“ unter ihren Füßen zerbricht. Er bestand darauf, dass jeder den Begriff „Eis“ verwendet. Seine Haut trug noch die Kälte seines arktischen Abenteuers, und seine Augen schimmerten mit dem Glanz von ungeschmolzenem Schnee.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=32>Kann Reifen durchbohren und Zombies einfrieren.

<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>450</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20*2/1 Sekunden (Langsam) </color>
<color=#0077b6>Kryo-System: </color><color=#8B0000>Fügt 5 Kryo-Punkte pro Angriff hinzu.</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Kann Reifen durchstechen, was Fahrzeuge sofort tötet.</color></size>

original.name: 寒冰地刺
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>寒冰地刺参加了第一届PVZ冰球赛，在获得胜利后，雪橇车僵尸表示需要重判，“我可什么都没干，”寒冰地刺耸了耸尖刺，“至于我头上的弹簧……那是我的赛前保护措施。”</color>
original.info:
触感冰凉的地刺。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40/1秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>攻击施加寒冷状态，赋予10点冻结值</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>地刺+寒冰菇</color>

english.name: Iceweed
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Breaking news from the first Plants vs. Zombies Hockey Tournament! Iceweed skated to victory, leaving the Bobsled Zombies scrambling. But now, they're calling foul! "I did nothing wrong," Iceweed insists, adjusting their icy spikes. "And these springs? Just a little pre-game safety gear."
english.info:
<size=36>Iceweed can slow down zombies that walk on it.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Iceweeds can be upgraded to Icerocks using a Fertilizer.</color>
<color=#0077b6>Cryo System: </color><color=#8B0000>Each hit inflicts Chill and adds 10 Cryo points.</color>

german.name: Frostkraut
german.info:
<size=36>Frostweed can slow down zombies that walk on it.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1 Second</color>
<color=#0077b6>Kryo-System: </color><color=#8B0000>Each hit adds 10 Cryo Points.</color>

original.name: 寒冰小喷菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​寒冰小喷菇并不是特意去学习了制冷技术，只是有一次去爬山的时候没带被子，小喷菇们在山头冻了一晚上，头上都结霜了。后来倒是寒冰射手看中了这天赐的容颜，分了些寒冰子弹给他们。​</color>
original.info:
发射施加寒冷状态的小冰锥。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20/2.25秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮，可密植</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>攻击能穿透2次，施加寒冷状态，赋予5点冻结值。对冻结或免疫0级寒冷状态的僵尸伤害×4</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>小喷菇（底座）+豌豆射手+寒冰菇</color>

english.name: Icicle-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The Icicle-shrooms didn't set out to master refrigeration technology. During a hiking trip, they forgot their quilts and spent an entire night frozen atop a mountain, frost forming on their heads. Later, Snow Pea, captivated by their frosty appearance, gifted them some icicles to complement their new look.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Icicle-shroom fires icicles that slow down and pierce enemies.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5s</color>
<color=#0077b6>Cryo System: </color><color=#8B0000>Inflicts chill and adds 5 Cryo points for every icicle hit. Pierce 2 times. Deals ×4 damage to frozen and chill-immune zombies.</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).</color></size>

german.name: Eiszapfenpilz
german.introduce: <size=33><color=black>Die Eiszapfenpilze hatten nie vor, die Kühltechnologie zu meistern. Während einer Wanderung vergaßen sie ihre Decken und verbrachten eine ganze Nacht eingefroren auf einem Berggipfel, wobei Frost ihre Köpfe bedeckte. Später schenkte die Hagelzuckererbse ihnen, fasziniert von ihrem frostigen Aussehen, ein paar Eiszapfen, um ihren neuen Look zu ergänzen.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=33>Eiszapfenpilz schießt Eiszapfen, die Gegner verlangsamen.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5 Sekunden</color>
<color=#0077b6>Kryo-System: </color><color=#8B0000>Fügt 5 Kryo-Punkte für jeden getroffenen Eiszapfen hinzu. 3 Mal durchbohren. Jeder Eiszapfen fügt einem gefrorenen Zombie 4-mal mehr Schaden zu.</color></size>

original.name: 寒冰窝瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>为了克服自己冲动易怒的性格，窝瓜给自己放冰箱里冻了三天三夜。他现在总是把气氛降到冰点，植物们都不想说话“激怒”他。至于僵尸嘛……“不许说窝有冰！”</color>
original.info:
蕴含冻结力量的窝瓜。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1800（压扁）</color>
<color=#3D1400>索敌范围：</color><color=red>左侧0.5格~右侧1格</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>落地后对3×3范围内的僵尸造成600伤害并冻结4秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>窝瓜+寒冰菇</color>

english.name: Icy Squash
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>To tame its hot temper, Icy Squash locked itself in the freezer for three days and nights. Now it keeps the mood ice-cold — so cold that the other plants don't dare say a word to 'set it off.' As for zombies… let's just say, no one's allowed to 'break the ice' with it.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Icy Squash can freeze zombies near the crush site!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Squash) + 600 (3×3)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>0.5 tiles to the left; 1 tile to the right</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Upon landing deals additional 600 damage to zombies in a 3×3 area and freezes them for 4s.</color>

german.name: Matscheis
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>To tame its hot temper, Icy Squash locked itself in the freezer for three days and nights. Now it keeps the mood ice-cold — so cold that the other plants don't dare say a word to 'set it off.' As for zombies… let's just say, no one's allowed to 'break the ice' with it.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Squash imbued with freezing power.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Squash) + 600 (3×3)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>0.5 tiles to the left; 1 tile to the right</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Upon landing deals additional 600 damage to zombies in a 3×3 area and freezes them for 4s.</color>

original.name: 流明坚果
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“路灯有时会坏掉，这是很正常的。每当这个时候，我作为备用路灯的重要性就体现出来了，不过大家好像都很担忧我。”流明坚果说道。但他不知道，其他人担忧的不是他的亮度，而是他可能会把路灯框撑坏。</color>
original.info:
提供光照并阻挡僵尸，光照强时利用光能治疗自身。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>光照范围：</color><color=red>3×3,1级</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每15秒回复150×(本格光照等级-1)的血量</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>坚果+路灯花</color>

english.name: Illumi-nut
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Streetlights sometimes malfunction, and that’s normal. This is when my role as a backup streetlight becomes important, though everyone seems worried about me," said Illumi-nut. He didn't know that others worry not about his brightness, but that he might break the streetlight frame.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Illumi-nut gives off lumos levels and can heal its hard shell periodically.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=#99582a>Lumos System: </color><color=#8B0000>Provides 1 Lumos Level in a 3×3 area. Restores 150 Toughness per Lumos Level every 15s.</color></size>

german.name: Nuss-terne
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Streetlights sometimes malfunction, and that’s normal. This is when my role as a backup streetlight becomes important, though everyone seems worried about me," said Illumi-nut. He didn't know that others worry not about his brightness, but that he might break the streetlight frame.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Wall-nut with Plantern properties; heals himself with Lumos level.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=#99582a>Lumos System: </color><color=#8B0000>Provides 1 Lumos Level in a 3×3 area. Restores 150 Robustheit per Lumos Level every 15s.</color></size>

original.name: 铁桶窝瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>铁桶窝瓜用铁皮武装自己，更大的重量和更高的硬度足够让僵尸吃尽苦头。当然铁皮也并非万能，比如遮挡不了脸上的痘痘，虽然铁桶窝瓜坚称这些是固定铁皮的柳钉。</color>
original.info:
坚硬如铁、重若千钧的窝瓜。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1000</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>3240（压扁）</color>
<color=#3D1400>索敌范围：</color><color=red>左侧0.5格~右侧1格</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>受到的樱桃爆炸伤害减半</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>可以消耗铁器回血500</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>窝瓜（底座）+铁桶</color>

english.name: Iron Squash
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Iron Squash armored up in cold steel, harder, heavier and packs more harm. Just don't mention the "rivets" on his face. He insists they're structural... not acne.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Iron Squash deals extra crushing damage!

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>1000</color>
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>3240 (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>0.5 tiles to the left; 1 tile to the right</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Metal plant. Can be fed corresponding metal objects to restore 500 Toughness. Receives half the damage from explosive cherries.</color>

german.name: Metallmatsch
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Iron Squash armored up in cold steel, harder, heavier and packs more harm. Just don't mention the "rivets" on his face. He insists they're structural... not acne.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>A metal-plated Squash with terrifying weight.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>1000</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>3240 (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>0.5 tiles to the left; 1 tile to the right</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Metal plant. Can be fed corresponding metal objects to restore 500 Robustheit. Receives half the damage from explosive cherries.</color>

original.name: 铁桶杨桃
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>面对植物们的询问，铁桶杨桃总是回答他脸上的那一抹红色是胎记。“其实他是被我的叶子擦的”磁力三叶草说。后来他赔了磁力三叶草一桶红色油漆。</color>
original.info:
坚硬如铁的杨桃，发射对二类防具特攻的铁星星。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>2000</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>80×5/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>发射铁星星，造成伤害时，附加目标二类防具当前血量的伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>受到的爆炸樱桃伤害减半</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>可以消耗铁器回血500</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>磁性杨桃（底座）+铁桶</color>

english.name: Iron Star
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>People often use the headshots of Iron Star and Starmorph to hype up their relationship, which greatly troubles both of them. In fact, Iron Star just wants to be himself - a star with a heart of stone that is hard to rust.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Iron Star fires stars lined with a metallic coating to deal extra damage!

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>2000</color>
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>80×5/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Metal plant. Breaks Type 2 armor instantly (before damage reduction). You can use metal objects on it to heal it by 500.</color></size>

german.name: Sternenstahl
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Menschen verwenden oft die Kopfaufnahmen von Sternenstahl und Sternenlocke, um ihre Beziehung zu hypen, was beide sehr belastet. Tatsächlich möchte Sternenstahl einfach er selbst sein – ein Stern mit einem Herzen aus Stein, das schwer zu rosten ist.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Schießt Sterne ab, die mit einer metallischen Beschichtung versehen sind.

<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>2000</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>40*5/1.5 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Wird bei Kontakt zurückgeschlagen. Verursacht immensen Schaden an Eisenzombies und zerbricht Eisentüren.</color></size>

original.name: 流明南瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>流明南瓜声称自己经常能看到幽灵，但是事实上幽灵真的存在吗？——谁知道呢，说不定是他又被人拉去参加万圣节活动了。</color>
original.info:
提供光照并保护植物，光照强时利用光能治疗自身。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>光照范围：</color><color=red>3×3,1级</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每15秒回复150×(本格光照等级-1)的血量</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>南瓜（底座）+路灯花</color>

english.name: Jack O' Plantern
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Jack O' Plantern insists that he frequently encounters ghosts, but do they truly exist? Who can say for certain? Perhaps he was simply dragged into another round of Halloween festivities by someone eager for a good scare.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Jack O' Plantern dispels fog and gives lumos levels in an area while defending the plant inside!

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=#99582a>Lumos System: </color><color=#8B0000>Provides 1 Lumos Level in a 3×3 area. Restores 150 Toughness per Lumos Level every 15s.</color></size>

german.name: Kürbislaterne
german.introduce: <size=34><color=black>Kürbislaterne besteht darauf, dass er häufig Geistern begegnet, aber existieren diese wirklich? Wer kann es mit Sicherheit sagen? Vielleicht wurde er einfach von jemandem, der auf einen guten Schreck aus war, erneut in die Halloween-Feierlichkeiten hineingezogen.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=34>Vertreibt in einem kleinen Bereich den Nebel und erhöht die Leuchtkraft-Stufe der Leuchtkraft-Pflanzen darin.

<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=#99582a>Leuchtkraft-System: </color><color=#8B0000>Gibt 1 Leuchtkraft-Stufe in einem 3x3 Raster. Stellt alle 15 Sekunden 150 Ausdauer pro Leuchtkraft-Stufe wieder her.</color></size>

original.name: 大嘴窝瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“好饿好饿好饿，窝真的好饿。”大嘴窝瓜一边嚷一遍扑向前面的僵尸，无论有多少都填不满他的胃。看呐，巨人僵尸来了，他终于能吃饱……哦，好像有点撑了。 </color>
original.info:
贪吃的窝瓜，大快朵颐时会留在场上继续搜寻食物。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1800（压扁）</color>
<color=#3D1400>索敌范围：</color><color=red>右侧一格</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>攻击时，能吞食一只僵尸，对不能被吞食的僵尸仍旧造成伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>吞食成功时，可以在当前位置重返战场</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>窝瓜+大嘴花</color>

english.name: Jawbreaker
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"So hungry, so hungry, so hungry! I'm starving!" Jawbreaker shouts as he lunges at zombies ahead. No matter how much he eats, it's never enough. Oh look - a Gargantuar! Finally, a proper meal… Wait, that might've been too much.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Jawbreaker will respawn and continue to crush zombie if it has a zombie to devour.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>1 tile to the right</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> On landing, attempts to devour one zombie caught underneath. Still deals damage to zombies that are not eaten.
<color=black>•</color> On a successful devour, returns to the field on the same tile, otherwise he disappears.</color>

german.name: Kieferbrecher
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"So hungry, so hungry, so hungry! I'm starving!" Jawbreaker shouts as he lunges at zombies ahead. No matter how much he eats, it's never enough. Oh look - a Gargantuar! Finally, a proper meal… Wait, that might've been too much.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Gluttonous Squash that keeps squashing when fed.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>1 tile to the right</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> On landing, attempts to devour one zombie caught underneath. Still deals damage to zombies that are not eaten.
<color=black>•</color> On a successful devour, returns to the field on the same tile, otherwise he disappears.</color>

original.name: 水母魅惑菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“水母？还是蘑菇？猜错了的话，要帮我干活哦。”水母魅惑菇很喜欢和没脑子的僵尸玩这种游戏，迄今为止她还没有输过。最接近正确答案的是听说了这件事的Z教授：“海里有一种僧帽水母，这个，或许可以称为菌盖水母？”</color>
original.info:
水生的魅惑菇，滤食海蘑菇后，召唤鸭子救生圈僵尸为己方作战。

<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>水生</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>被啃咬时魅惑该僵尸并消失</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>对其使用海蘑菇卡牌后，在原地生成一个魅惑鸭子救生圈僵尸</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>海蘑菇（底座）+魅惑菇</color>

english.name: Jelly-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Am I a Jellyfish? Or a Mushroom? Guess wrong, and you'll have to work for me." The Jelly-shroom loves playing these games with brainless zombies and has never lost. The closest to the right answer was Professor Cherryz, who answered "I know Box Jellies are not true Jellies… Are you one of those?"</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Jelly-shroom summons browncoats in the water after using a Sea-shroom on it.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Summons a hypnotized Ducky Tube Zombie (browncoat) that fights for you after consuming a Sea-shroom.
<color=black>•</color> When bitten, hypnotizes the attacker, then disappears.</color>

german.name: Hypnoqualle
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Am I a Jellyfish? Or a Mushroom? Guess wrong, and you'll have to work for me." The Jelly-shroom loves playing these games with brainless zombies and has never lost. The closest to the right answer was Professor Cherryz, who answered "I know Box Jellies are not true Jellies… Are you one of those?"</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Summons grunt zombies to fight for you after consuming a Sea-shroom.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Summons a hypnotized Ducky Tube Zombie (browncoat) that fights for you after consuming a Sea-shroom.
<color=black>•</color> When bitten, hypnotizes the attacker, then disappears.</color>

original.name: 缠绕水雷
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“前方的船只注意绕行，这里有礁石！”缠绕水雷担任河道上的安全员，用红灯指示船只远离危险。这项工作他做的不错，毕竟他出现在哪里，哪里就有危险。</color>
original.info:
会爆炸的缠绕水草。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>秒杀（溺死）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>水生，低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>秒杀接近的第一个僵尸，并对半径1.5格内的僵尸造成600伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>缠绕水草（底座）+土豆雷</color>

english.name: Kelp Mine
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Beware, ships — reefs ahead!" Kelp Mine serves as the river's safety officer, signaling danger with a red light. He does a solid job, since wherever he appears, danger is never far behind.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Tangle Mine explodes in an area after drowning a zombie.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>Insta-kill (Drown)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Insta-kills the first approaching zombie and deals 600 damage to zombies in a 3×3 area.</color>

german.name: Wassermine
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Beware, ships — reefs ahead!" Kelp Mine serves as the river's safety officer, signaling danger with a red light. He does a solid job, since wherever he appears, danger is never far behind.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Tangle Kelp that's as explosive as Potato Mine.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>Insta-kill (Drown)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Insta-kills the first approaching zombie and deals 600 damage to zombies in a 3×3 area.</color>

original.name: 三线水草射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>三线水草射手喜欢游泳和晒太阳，“许多植物都害怕我的眼睛，”在海边闲逛的三线水草射手小声说道，“但他们不知道那是为了防晒要买三副墨镜。”</color>
original.info:
向三行发射水草子弹的缠绕水草，子弹能赋予水草值。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>30×3/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>拥有缠绕水草的特点。攻击赋予1点水草值</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>缠绕水草（底座）+三线射手</color>

english.name: Kelp-spreader
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Kelp-spreader basked in the sun, his eyes scanning the horizon. "Many plants are scared of my gaze," he chuckled. "But they'd understand if they had to wear three pairs of sunglasses for protection like I do!"</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Can fire kelps that slow down aquatic zombies across multiple lanes.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20×3/1.5s + Insta-kill (Drown)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Each attack adds 1 Tangle value.</color>
<color=#006400>Tangled Debuff: </color><color=#8B0000>Slows targets and stackable with Chill. Zombies affected receive more and more additional percentage damage from kelps based on the zombie's Tangle Value, until they're insta-killed when the Tangle Value is full (30).</color></size>

german.name: Tangwerfer
german.introduce: <size=31><color=black>Tangwerfer sonnte sich, seine Augen scannen den Horizont. „Viele Pflanzen haben Angst vor meinem Blick“, lachte er. „Aber sie würden es verstehen, wenn sie wie ich drei Paar Sonnenbrillen zum Schutz tragen müssten!“</color></size>
german.info:
<size=31>Tangwerfer kann Kelp abfeuern, die Zombies verlangsamen.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20*3/1.5 Verlangsamt + Stapelbar mit Gefrieren  </color>
<color=black>Verhedderter Schwächungszauber: </color><color=#8B0000>Jeder Kelp verursacht zusätzlichen prozentualen Schaden, der von den Verhedderte-Punkten des Zombies abhängt. Der Zombie wird sofort getötet, wenn der Verhedderte-Punkt voll ist.</color></size>

original.name: 磁性玉米投手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“老人家也要学会与时俱进，”磁性玉米投手说，“磁力这种新力量可真是让我大开眼界。”当然也有一点小小的麻烦，总让邻居以为自己是收废品的老人家。</color>
original.info:
可以利用磁性融合铁器的玉米投手。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>60/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>有25%概率投出伤害80的磁力黄油，使目标定身4秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>玉米投手+磁力菇</color>

english.name: Kernel Morph
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"The elderly also need to learn to keep up with the times," the Kernel Morph said, "This new force of magnetism has truly opened my eyes." Of course, there is a small problem; it always makes the neighbors think he's a scrap collector.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Kernel Morph can fuse with metal objects and changes into the corresponding form based on the type of object.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>60/3s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Has a 25% chance to throw a magnetic butter with 80 damage, and stuns the target for 4s. Can fuse with Bucket and Chrono Core.</color>

german.name: Kornamorph
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"The elderly also need to learn to keep up with the times," the Kernel Morph said, "This new force of magnetism has truly opened my eyes." Of course, there is a small problem; it always makes the neighbors think he's a scrap collector.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>The Kernel Morph can fuse with metal objects and changes into the corresponding form based on the type.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>60/3s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Has a 25% chance to throw a magnetic butter with 80 damage, and stuns the target for 4s. Can fuse with Bucket and Chrono Core.</color>

original.name: 三线玉米炮手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>三线玉米炮手在黄油工厂上班、负责分拣黄油和玉米粒。他的工作效率很高，但每次分拣到最后都会十分头疼，因为他只能分拣三的倍数，当只剩下一粒玉米粒时，他总是不知道该如何装货。</color>
original.info:
向三行快速投出子弹，未投出黄油时也会不断增加投射量。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20×3/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>每轮在本格及上下两格各攻击一次，攻击享受边路补偿</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>每轮有25%概率投出40伤害的黄油。如果本轮未投出黄油，使此后每轮攻击次数+1（额外子弹随机分配），投出黄油后重置次数</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>玉米投手+三线射手</color>

english.name: Kernel Tri-pult
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Kernel Tri-pult works at a butter factory, sorting butter and corn kernels. His work efficiency is impressive, but every time he reaches the final batch, he gets a headache — he can only sort in multiples of three. When only one kernel remains, he never knows how to package it.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Rapidly fires projectiles across three lanes, continuously increasing projectile count when butter is not thrown.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20×3/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Each attack cycle targets his own lane and the two lanes above and below. Attacks benefit from edge lane compensation.
<color=black>•</color> Each cycle has a 25% chance to throw butter dealing 40 damage. If butter is not thrown this cycle, the next cycle gain 1 additional projectile (the extra projectiles are randomly distributed). Throwing butter resets the bonus.</color>

german.name: Kernel Tri-pult
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Kernel Tri-pult works at a butter factory, sorting butter and corn kernels. His work efficiency is impressive, but every time he reaches the final batch, he gets a headache — he can only sort in multiples of three. When only one kernel remains, he never knows how to package it.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Rapidly fires projectiles across three lanes, continuously increasing projectile count when butter is not thrown.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20×3/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Each attack cycle targets his own lane and the two lanes above and below. Attacks benefit from edge lane compensation.
<color=black>•</color> Each cycle has a 25% chance to throw butter dealing 40 damage. If butter is not thrown this cycle, the next cycle gain 1 additional projectile (the extra projectiles are randomly distributed). Throwing butter resets the bonus.</color>

original.name: 火爆卷心菜投手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>由于对辣椒的使用出神入化，“川川香”饭馆的生意一直十分火爆，而老板火爆卷心菜投手自己也像辣椒一样，刚猛热烈、激情四射。吃他做的菜只有一点需要注意：吃饱了一定要赶紧离开，否则他会再送你一份。</color>
original.info:
投出火辣的卷心菜，命中时还会爆裂出大量小型卷心菜。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>60/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>子弹命中后，向3×3范围每格分裂出一个伤害为原本1/3倍的小子弹，均会在施加红温效果后造成伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>卷心菜投手+火爆辣椒</color>

english.name: Kimchi-pult
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Thanks to his mastery of chili sauce, his Korean restaurant is always booming. Its owner, Kimchi-pult, is just as fiery, bold, passionate, and intense. There's only one thing to remember when eating his food: once you're full, leave quickly… or he'll serve you another round.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Kimchi-pult hurls cabbages that explode into smaller cabbage pieces on impact.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>60/3s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>On hit, projectile splits into smaller projectiles across a 3×3 area (1/3 damage each), all applying Enflamed debuff before dealing damage.</color>

german.name: Kimchipult
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Thanks to his mastery of chili sauce, his Korean restaurant is always booming. Its owner, Kimchi-pult, is just as fiery, bold, passionate, and intense. There's only one thing to remember when eating his food: once you're full, leave quickly… or he'll serve you another round.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Hurls spicy-hot cabbages that explode into smaller cabbages on impact.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>60/3s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>On hit, projectile splits into smaller projectiles across a 3×3 area (1/3 damage each), all applying Enflamed debuff before dealing damage.</color>

original.name: 海蘑菇地雷
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>海蘑菇地雷蛰伏已久，阳光和水分让他获得了堪比樱桃的力量。“土豆爆炸!”他这么大叫着，只为了吓僵尸一跳。</color>
original.info:
可以长大两次的土豆雷。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>900</color>
<color=#3D1400>范围：</color><color=red>半径0.74格（限1行）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>默认处于出土状态</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>出场30秒后长大，伤害×2。再过30秒后再次长大，伤害范围提升至半径1.5格</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>土豆雷（底座）+海蘑菇</color>

english.name: Land-mine
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>After lying in wait for a long time, Land-mine has drawn sufficient strength from sunlight and moisture, gaining power comparable to a Cherry Bomb. "Spudow!" he shouted, but the zombies were only surprised.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Land Mine can grow twice, increasing its damage and range with each growth.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>900 (Initial)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Starts in an armed state. Grows 30s after appearance, doubling its damage.
<color=black>•</color> After another 30s, grows again and increases explosion radius to 1.5 tiles across lanes.</color>

german.name: Landmine
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>After lying in wait for a long time, Land-mine has drawn sufficient strength from sunlight and moisture, gaining power comparable to a Cherry Bomb. "Spudow!" he shouted, but the zombies were only surprised.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Can grow twice.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>900 (Initial)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Starts in an armed state. Grows 30s after appearance, doubling its damage.
<color=black>•</color> After another 30s, grows again and increases explosion radius to 1.5 tiles across lanes.</color>

original.name: 卷心菜窝窝投手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“智能机器人真好用，我按照自己的模样订做了一个，极大提升了我的投掷效率。”卷心菜窝窝投手兴奋地说，“哦，要开始战斗了。”说完，他跳到一个更大的自己的投篓中，随后便听到对方说：“智能机器人真好用，我按照……”</color>
original.info:
投出可以投出卷心菜窝窝投手的卷心菜窝窝投手。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>60（压扁）/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>投出卷心菜窝窝投手子弹，落地后可投出2个小型子弹，小型子弹落地后可再投出2个更小型子弹
子弹每次落地时造成范围伤害，每次体型缩小后伤害减半</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>卷心菜投手+窝瓜</color>

english.name: Lettuce-pult
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Smart robots are so handy! I customized one to my exact specifications, and it's massively boosted my throwing efficiency!" Lettuce-pult exclaimed excitedly. "Oh, the battle is about to begin." With that, he leaped into a larger version of himself. Moments later, he heard the opponent say, "Smart robots are so handy! I customized one to..."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Lettuce-pult can launch tinier versions of itself, unmasking its layers to attack more zombies.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>60/3s (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Lobs a mini Lettuce-pult that deals AOE crushing damage upon landing, then lobs 2 smaller Lettuce-pults that deal 50% of the original damage before disappearing. The smaller Lettuce-pults lob 2 even smaller Lettuce-pults that deal 25% of the original damage and disappear immediately before disappearing itself.</color>

german.name: Quetschkohlapult
german.introduce: <color=#3D1400>"Smart robots are so handy! I customized one to my exact specifications, and it's massively boosted my throwing efficiency!" Lettuce-pult exclaimed excitedly. "Oh, the battle is about to begin." With that, he leaped into a larger version of himself. Moments later, he heard the opponent say, "Smart robots are so handy! I customized one to..."</color>
german.info:
Lettuce-pult can launch tinier versions of itself, unmasking its layers to attack more zombies.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>60/3s (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Lobs a mini Lettuce-pult that deals AOE crushing damage upon landing, then lobs 2 smaller Lettuce-pults that deal 50% of the original damage before disappearing. The smaller Lettuce-pults lob 2 even smaller Lettuce-pults that deal 25% of the original damage and disappear immediately before disappearing itself.</color>

original.name: 流光仙人掌
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>沙漠里的历练让我光耀无比，流光仙人掌吹嘘道，然而他每天都不会忘记加灯油。</color>
original.info:
喜光的仙人掌，光照越强，伤害和穿透能力越高。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>30/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>发射光刺，优先对空。根据光照等级获得增强，1级：子弹能穿透2次；2级：改为发射激光，无限穿透，优先对空；3级：激光伤害翻倍。攻击飞行僵尸时攻击次数×2，激光伤害×3</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>仙人掌+路灯花</color>

english.name: Lumos Cactus
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"My adventures in the desert have made me remarkably brilliant," Lumos Cactus boasted, but he never forgot to replenish his lamp oil each day to ensure he continued to shine.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Lumos Cactus fires piercing spikes or lasers, depending on the Lumos level.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>30/1.5s</color>
<color=#99582a>Lumos System: </color><color=#8B0000>Gets the following buffs depending on the Lumos Level:
<color=black>•</color> Level 1 = Pierce 2 Times
<color=black>•</color> Level 2 = Infinite Pierce Laser, Air Damage ×3
<color=black>•</color> Level 3 = Base Laser Damage → 40</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Shoots 2 times at once when attacking flying zombies.</color></size>

german.name: Lichtkaktee
german.introduce: <size=34><color=black>„Meine Abenteuer in der Wüste haben mich bemerkenswert brillant gemacht“, prahlte Lichtkaktee, doch er vergaß nie, jeden Tag sein Lampenöl aufzufüllen, um sicherzustellen, dass er weiter strahlte.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=34>Feuert durchdringende Stacheln und Laser ab, je nach Leuchtkraft-Stufe.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5 Sekunden, 20*2/1.5 Sekunden (Air)</color>
<color=#99582a>Leuchtkraft-System: </color><color=#8B0000>Erhält je nach Leuchtkraft-Stufe die folgenden Verstärkungen:
Stufe 1 = 3 Mal durchbohren
Stufe 2 = Unendliches Durchbohren
Stufe 3 = Laser-Luftschaden → 60</color></size>

original.name: 流光花盆
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>流光花盆总是发出温暖的荧光，因此也经常被当成小夜灯。如果凑近观察，你还会发现盆的边缘上刻着一行小字呢，上面写着“萤火虫栖息地，请勿打扰。”</color>
original.info:
可以当作小路灯的花盆，为本格提供光照等级。

<color=#3D1400>光照范围：</color><color=red>1×1,1级</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>可种裸地，低矮，载体</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>花盆（底座）+路灯花</color>

english.name: Lumos Pot
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The Lumos Pot always emits a warm glow, so it is often used as a nightlight. If you look closely, you will also find a small inscription on the edge of the pot that says, "Firefly habitat, please do not disturb."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Lumos Pot is a Flower Pot that can be used as a small Plantern, providing 1 Lumos level for its tile.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Dispels a small patch of fog, providing 1 Lumos level for its tile.</color>

german.name: Lichttopf
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The Lumos Pot always emits a warm glow, so it is often used as a nightlight. If you look closely, you will also find a small inscription on the edge of the pot that says, "Firefly habitat, please do not disturb."</color>
german.info:
<size=36>A Flower Pot that can be used as a small Plantern, providing 1 Lumos level for its tile.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Dispels a small patch of fog, providing 1 Lumos level for its tile.</color>

original.name: 光叶保护伞
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>透过迷雾，看破一切，她是伟大的先知，智慧的化身。神说要有光，“吾便遵神旨意，来至斯地，愿用这圣洁的光辉，救斯地之民于水火之中”。</color>
original.info:
会提供并存储光照的力量，用于抵挡子弹和伤害。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1000</color>
<color=#3D1400>能量上限：</color><color=red>2000</color>
<color=#3D1400>光照范围：</color><color=red>3×3,1级</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>出场时拥有2000点能量，每秒回复(25×光照等级)点能量。能量耗尽后，5秒内不能回复</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>可消耗能量抵挡伤害，比率为5:1</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>可消耗伤害值1倍的能量（能量不足时则消耗全部能量），抵挡半径1.5格内的僵尸方子弹</color>
<color=#3D1400>④</color><color=red>伞类击退：伤害40</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>叶子保护伞+路灯花</color>

english.name: Lumos Umbrella
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Beyond the fog, she watches, a prophet untouched by mortal blindness. When God willed light into existence, she stepped forth. "By decree of the Almighty, I have come to the land of Seth. The fire looms, but with this sacred light, I shall protect the lost from its grasp."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Lumos Umbrella can dispel fog and block bullets.

<color=black>Energy Limit: </color><color=#8B0000>2000</color>
<color=black>Shield & Light Range: </color><color=#8B0000>3×3</color>
<color=black>Special: <color=#99582a>Lumos System</color></color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Provides 1 Lumos Level and dispels fog like a Plantern.
<color=black>•</color> Consumes Energy to block projectiles. Each block consumes Energy based on the damage of the projectile (excluding basketballs). Tridents cannot be blocked.
<color=black>•</color> Restores (25 x Lumos Level) Energy every second, pausing to rest for 5 seconds when it is completely exhausted.
<color=black>•</color> Reduces Energy first to absorb damage, where 5 Energy = 1 Toughness.</color>

german.name: Lichtschirm
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Beyond the fog, she watches, a prophet untouched by mortal blindness. When God willed light into existence, she stepped forth. "By decree of the Almighty, I have come to the land of Seth. The fire looms, but with this sacred light, I shall protect the lost from its grasp."</color>
german.info:
<size=36>It can dispel fog and block bullets.

<color=black>Energy Limit: </color><color=#8B0000>2000</color>
<color=black>Shield & Light Range: </color><color=#8B0000>3×3</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: <color=#99582a>Lumos System</color></color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Provides 1 Lumos Level and dispels fog like a Plantern.
<color=black>•</color> Consumes Energy to block projectiles. Each block consumes Energy based on the damage of the projectile (excluding basketballs). Tridents cannot be blocked.
<color=black>•</color> Restores (25 x Lumos Level) Energy every second, pausing to rest for 5 seconds when it is completely exhausted.
<color=black>•</color> Reduces Energy first to absorb damage, where 5 Energy = 1 Robustheit.</color>

original.name: 磁力仙人掌
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>磁力仙人掌曾在空军学院进修过一段时间的通讯干扰。他经常向朋友们吹嘘那时的成绩优异。然而，他并没有意识到他的成绩全在于他的空军司令父亲。</color>
original.info:
善于打击金属防具的仙人掌，还能干扰飞艇的操控系统。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>发射磁力尖刺，优先对空，根据目标特性追加效果：
·持有可吸取防具：伤害×2
·铁气球、超时空气球防具：伤害×10，最低造成500伤害
·部分飞艇：一定次数后使其坠机（飞艇10次，迷你基洛夫3次，基洛夫飞艇20次）</color>
<color=#3D1400>坠机：</color><color=red>立即死亡，在坠落点造成1000范围伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>仙人掌+磁力菇</color>

english.name: Magnet Cactus
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Magnet Cactus spent some time studying communications jamming at the Air Force Academy, often bragging to his friends about his stellar grades. What he doesn't realize is that his success was mostly thanks to his father, a high-ranking Air Force commander pulling strings behind the scenes.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Magnet Cactus deals extra damage to metallic objects, even being able to crash zomppelins!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Deals double the damage to metallic armor.
<color=black>•</color> Deals 500 damage to Bucknut-copter Zombies.
<color=black>•</color> Dealing a certain amount of damage to Airships can cause it to crash, dealing 1000 damage to zombies near the crash site. Zomppelin = 10 Hits | Kirov Drone = 3 Hits | Kirov Zomppelin = 20 Hits</color></size>

german.name: Magnedorn
german.introduce: <size=30><color=black>Magnedorn verbrachte einige Zeit mit dem Studium von Kommunikationsstörungen an der Luftwaffenakademie und prahlte oft vor seinen Freunden mit seinen hervorragenden Noten. Was er nicht wusste, war, dass sein Erfolg hauptsächlich seinem Vater zu verdanken war, einem hochrangigen Luftwaffenkommandeur, der hinter den Kulissen die Fäden zog.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=30>Kann hohen Schaden an fliegenden Objekten verursachen.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Verursacht doppelt so viel Schaden an metallischer Rüstung. Wenn Luftschiffe eine bestimmte Menge an Schaden erleiden, können sie abstürzen und den Zombies in der Nähe der Absturzstelle 1000 Schaden zufügen.</color></size>

original.name: 寻宝土豆雷
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>地底下埋藏着珍宝，以及……僵尸？“所以我现在寻宝的花园是块墓地吗？！”寻宝土豆雷只需要寻宝就好了，而为了给寻宝添加乐趣的戴夫埋僵尸可麻烦多了。</color>
original.info:
忙于埋头寻找宝藏的土豆雷。

<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>每30秒寻宝1次，1%概率找到僵尸，10%概率找到随机植物卡牌，89%概率找到25阳光和100金钱</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>位于宝藏地块时，每20秒寻宝1次，33%概率找到随机植物卡牌，67%概率找到25阳光和100金钱</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>死亡或找到3张植物卡牌时自爆，释放土豆雷爆炸</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>土豆雷+金盏花</color>

english.name: Marigold Mine
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Beneath the ground lie treasures… and zombies? "So my treasure-hunting garden is actually a graveyard?!" Marigold Mine only wants to dig for treasures, but Dave buried zombies to make the hunt more exciting, which complicates things.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Marigold Mine can dig up treasures in the ground, it can dig up plants, sun, and even zombies!

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant. Digs up a treasure every 30s: 1% chance for a random zombie, 10% for a random seed packet, otherwise produces 25 Sun and 100 Coins.
<color=black>•</color> On Beach maps, Marigold Mines placed on Treasure Spots gain 50% faster production; seed packet chance rises to 33% while zombie chance drops to 0%.
<color=black>•</color> Disappears after finding 3 seed packets.
<color=black>•</color> On death or disappearance, triggers a Potato Mine explosion with 1800 damage.</color>

german.name: Goldmine
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Beneath the ground lie treasures… and zombies? "So my treasure-hunting garden is actually a graveyard?!" Marigold Mine only wants to dig for treasures, but Dave buried zombies to make the hunt more exciting, which complicates things.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Always busy digging for treasures.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant. Digs up a treasure every 30s: 1% chance for a random zombie, 10% for a random seed packet, otherwise produces 25 Sun and 100 Coins.
<color=black>•</color> On Beach maps, Marigold Mines placed on Treasure Spots gain 50% faster production; seed packet chance rises to 33% while zombie chance drops to 0%.
<color=black>•</color> Disappears after finding 3 seed packets.
<color=black>•</color> On death or disappearance, triggers a Potato Mine explosion with 1800 damage.</color>

original.name: 磁性西瓜投手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>磁性西瓜投手为电磁学研究院工作，曾经提出过一个猜想的磁极模型，认为磁极像西瓜籽嵌入西瓜一样分布在磁铁中。但是他的猜想并没有被重视，因为他只是研究院的西瓜供应商。</color>
original.info:
投出的西瓜能强力扣击僵尸的头戴防具，可以利用磁性融合铁器。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>120/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>对有一类防具的僵尸造成2倍伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>西瓜投手+磁力菇</color>

english.name: Melon Morph
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Melon Morph used to work at the Electromagnetics Research Institute and once proposed a conjectured model of magnetic poles, suggesting that magnetic poles are distributed like watermelon seeds embedded in a watermelon. However, his theory was ignored, because he was only the institute's watermelon supplier.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Melon Morph can merge with metallic objects to gain new properties!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>120/3s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000> Deals 2× damage to zombies with Type 1 Armor. Can fuse with Bucket and Chrono Core.</color>

german.name: Morphmelone
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Melon Morph used to work at the Electromagnetics Research Institute and once proposed a conjectured model of magnetic poles, suggesting that magnetic poles are distributed like watermelon seeds embedded in a watermelon. However, his theory was ignored, because he was only the institute's watermelon supplier.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Stepping stone for other Metal Melon fusions, also deals heavy damage to helmeted zombies.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>120/3s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000> Deals 2× damage to zombies with Type 1 Armor. Can fuse with Bucket and Chrono Core.</color>

original.name: 西瓜花盆
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>在瓜瓤上种植，这算不算无土栽培呢？</color>
original.info:
用西瓜碗充当的花盆。提升远程西瓜投手的溅射效果。

<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>可种裸地，低矮，载体</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>通过融合来生成时，额外返还150阳光</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>增强特定植物的溅射效果：
·多数西瓜投手和西瓜南瓜：溅射伤害提升至子弹伤害的2/3且不再衰减
·超时空西瓜投手：传送状态扩散目标+3
·究极冰神西瓜：传送状态扩散目标+1
·毁灭西瓜投手：子弹命中余烬坑洞时伤害范围扩大
</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>花盆（底座）+西瓜投手</color>

english.name: Melon Pot
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Frugal Melon Pot can't stand to see Melon-pult throw melons without a thought for cost, so after defeating the zombies, Melon Pot secretly collects the shattered melon fragments scattered on the ground. "This is called soilless cultivation," Melon Pot explained. "Not just any plant can be grown in the ground here; every inch of soil is precious."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Melon Pot enhances melon-type plants by removing their splash damage falloff!

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Returns an extra 150 Sun on fusion.
<color=black>•</color> Doubles the splash damage of most Melons above it, with no falloff; damage remains at 2/3 of base damage. Makes Chrono Melons spread Chronoshift to 3 more targets. Makes Maelonstrom spread Chronoshift to 1 more target. Increases Doom-pult's damage radius when hitting on a Irradiated Crater.</color>

german.name: Melonentopf
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Der sparsame Melonentopf kann es nicht ertragen, Melonapult dabei zuzusehen, wie es gedankenlos Melonen wirft. Nachdem die Zombies besiegt sind, sammelt Melonentopf heimlich die zerbrochenen Melonenfragmente, die auf dem Boden verstreut sind. „Das nennt man erdlose Kultivierung“, erklärte Melonentopf. „Nicht jede Pflanze kann hier im Boden wachsen; jeder Zentimeter Erde ist kostbar.“</color>
german.info: <size=36>Verdoppelt den Flächenschaden von Melonenpflanzen darüber, ohne Abfall; der Schaden bleibt bei 2/3 des Grundschadens.

original.name: 西瓜南瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“哈哈，猜猜我的眉毛在哪里？”西瓜南瓜笑着问观众，他是著名的屋顶魔术师，擅长各种魔术、包括让自己的眼睛消失一半。当然，他最得意的魔术还是大变西瓜，至今都没有人能看清他是如何把西瓜藏到投手的投篓里面的。</color>
original.info:
用西瓜皮充当的保护壳，会为本格投手的攻击附赠西瓜。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每当投手植物在本格攻击一次，协同弹射一发西瓜</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>南瓜（底座）+西瓜投手</color>

english.name: Melon Shell
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Ha ha! Guess where my eyebrows are!" Melon Pumpkin laughs at the audience. A famous rooftop magician, he excels at all kinds of tricks, including making half of his eyes disappear. Of course, his proudest illusion is the Great Melon Transformation. To this day, no one has ever seen how he hides a watermelon inside a Melon-pult's bucket.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Melon Shell throws bonus watermelons when protecting a catapult-type plant.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>80/?s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Each time the catapult plant inside attacks, it simultaneously launches an additional watermelon.</color>

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>80/?s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Each time the catapult plant inside attacks, it simultaneously launches an additional watermelon.</color>

original.name: 三线西瓜炮手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>三线西瓜炮手其实并不知道自己是否有籽，但他还是觉得自己是无籽的。“三倍体西瓜是无籽的。至少，书上是这么说的。”</color>
original.info:
向三行快速投出西瓜。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>80×3/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每轮在本格及上下两格各攻击一次，攻击享受边路补偿</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>西瓜投手+三线射手</color>

english.name: Melon Tri-pult
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Melon Tri-pult isn't actually sure whether he has seeds, but he still believes he's seedless. "Triploid watermelons are seedless. At least, that's what the book says."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Rapidly throws watermelons across three lanes.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>80×3/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Each attack cycle targets his own lane and the two lanes above and below. Attacks benefit from edge lane compensation.</color>

german.name: Melon Tri-pult
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Melon Tri-pult isn't actually sure whether he has seeds, but he still believes he's seedless. "Triploid watermelons are seedless. At least, that's what the book says."</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Rapidly throws watermelons across three lanes.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>80×3/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Each attack cycle targets his own lane and the two lanes above and below. Attacks benefit from edge lane compensation.</color>

original.name: 西瓜坚果
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>遇到僵尸来买瓜的时候，瓜摊老板水滴芦荟就把最大的西瓜——西瓜坚果卖出去。等到僵尸啃掉了牙，水滴芦荟就会介绍他们去旁边的诊所补牙——当然，这家诊所也属于水滴芦荟。</color>
original.info:
受到一定程度伤害后，获得短暂护盾保护并反击一发西瓜。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>8000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>存储最终受到伤害1.5倍的能量，伤害高于100/500/1000时，储存3/4.5/6倍。能量上限为4倍韧性</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>能量超过1000时，消耗所有能量，弹射出1个造成等量伤害的西瓜，获得等量的会在5秒内完全衰减的护盾</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>坚果+西瓜投手</color>

english.name: Melon-nut
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Whenever zombies come to buy watermelons, the melon stand owner Aloe Alba always sells them the biggest one—the Melon-nut. After the zombies crack their teeth on it, Aloe Alba refers them to a nearby dental clinic to get them fixed, and, naturally, that clinic also belongs to Aloe Alba.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Melon-nut grows a temporary shield and retaliates with a melon after taking a certain amount of damage.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>8000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> When taking damage, stores 1.5× the damage taken as Retaliation Charge. If the damage exceeds 100/500/1000, stores 3/4.5/6× the damage instead.
<color=black>•</color> Retaliation Meter is capped at 4×max HP.
<color=black>•</color> When the Retaliation Meter exceeds 1000, consumes all charges to launch a watermelon dealing the same amount of damage and gains a shield of equal value that fully decays over 5s.</color>

german.name: Melonuss
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Whenever zombies come to buy watermelons, the melon stand owner Aloe Alba always sells them the biggest one—the Melon-nut. After the zombies crack their teeth on it, Aloe Alba refers them to a nearby dental clinic to get them fixed, and, naturally, that clinic also belongs to Aloe Alba.</color>

<size=36>Grows a temporary shield and retaliates with a melon after taking a certain amount of damage.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>8000</color>
