<color=black>•</color> When the Retaliation Meter exceeds 1000, consumes all charges to launch a watermelon dealing the same amount of damage and gains a shield of equal value that fully decays over 5s.</color>

original.name: 铁桶西瓜投手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>为身体覆盖上钢铁的铁桶西瓜投手避免了被摆上水果摊的命运，但是他需要面对的苦恼依然不少，比如花大价钱为铁壳防锈，以及不停回答其他好奇投手的问题：“你的叶子也是铁的吗？铁叶子是不是能当西瓜刀？”</color>
original.info:
坚硬如铁的西瓜投手，投出沉甸甸的西瓜，强力扣击僵尸的头戴防具。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>2000</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>200/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>铁植物</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>对有一类防具的僵尸造成2倍伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>
磁性西瓜投手（底座）+铁桶</color>

english.name: Metal-pult
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Covering his body in iron saved the Metal-pult from ending up at the fruit stall, but he still faces many troubles, like spending heavily on rust-proofing and constantly answering other curious plants: "Are your leaves also made of iron? Can iron leaves be used as fruit knives?"</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Metal-pult lobs melons that deal a very large amount of damage.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>2000</color>
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>200/3s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Metal plant. Deals 2× damage to zombies with Type 1 Armor.</color>

german.name: Metallmelone
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Covering his body in iron saved the Metal-pult from ending up at the fruit stall, but he still faces many troubles, like spending heavily on rust-proofing and constantly answering other curious plants: "Are your leaves also made of iron? Can iron leaves be used as fruit knives?"</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Lumps heavy balls of pure iron at the zombies, dishing out heavy damage.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>2000</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>200/3s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Metal plant. Deals 2× damage to zombies with Type 1 Armor.</color>

original.name: 魅惑三叶草
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>植物们总是很好奇为什么魅惑三叶草总是把僵尸往回送，魅惑三叶草说：“既然三叶草总是把僵尸退向他们面朝的方向的反向，那我将魅惑僵尸也推向反向不是很正常吗？”但其实她只是方向感迷失罢了。</color>
original.info:
充满魅力的三叶草，往回牵引魅惑僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>以固定速度将全场的魅惑僵尸向左牵引，持续5秒，并对发生位移的僵尸造成其0.1倍韧性的伤害。不同的僵尸速度倍率不同（空中僵尸0.2倍，载具僵尸0.4倍，巨型僵尸0.6倍）</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>魅惑菇+三叶草</color>

english.name: Mind-blover
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Plants are always curious why Mind-blover pulls the zombies back. Mind-blover explains: "Since Blover always pushes zombies to the opposite direction they face, I believe it's only natural for me to do the same to hypnotized zombies."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Mind-blover can pull back hypnotized zombies!

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Pulls all hypnotized zombies back, lasting for 5s, but reduces their HP by 10% max Toughness (except for zombies in the leftmost column).</color>

german.name: Hypnorad
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Plants are always curious why Hypnoblover pulls the zombies back. Hypnoblover explains: "Since Blover always pushes zombies to the opposite direction they face, I believe it's only natural for me to do the same to hypnotized zombies."</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Can pull back hypnotized(charmed) zombies!

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Pulls all charmed zombies back.</color>

original.name: 土豆坚果
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“如你所见，我既是土豆、也是坚果。”土豆坚果把半边身子埋进地下，像土豆那样吸收大地的能量，但是坚果坚硬的外壳让他的热量积攒在体内难以挥发，“我很感谢那些僵尸，他们帮我释放了多余的热量……”</color>
original.info:
低矮的坚果，每次破损都会造成爆炸。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>血量首次低于某个损伤点（2/3倍韧性、1/3倍韧性）时，造成500伤害的土豆雷爆炸。死亡时释放土豆雷爆炸</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>坚果+土豆雷</color>

english.name: Mine-nut
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Once seen as small and weak, Mine-nut now stood tall and strong, boasting a pair of big eyes and firm flesh. Yet beneath that sturdy exterior, he felt fragile and feared shrinking back to his former size. The zombies quipped, "If you take another bite, you'll explode!"</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Mine-nut can explode while being eaten and again once it is broken.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Damage Phases: </color><color=#8B0000>1333/2666</color>
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>500/Phase Transition, 1800/Death</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant. Causes single-tiled explosions on damage phase transitions.</color></size>

german.name: Erdnuss
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Früher als klein und schwach angesehen, steht Erdnuss nun groß und stark da, prahlte mit einem Paar großer Augen und festem Fleisch. Doch unter diesem robusten Äußeren fühlte er sich zerbrechlich und fürchtete, wieder auf seine frühere Größe zu schrumpfen. Die Zombies scherzten: „Wenn du noch einen Bissen nimmst, explodierst du!“</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Erdnuss kann explodieren, während er gegessen wird und einmal, wenn er zerbrochen wird.

<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>500 / Explosion, 1800 / Über den Tod</color></size>

original.name: 海蘑菇群
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>繁衍与增殖，这是生命的本能。在一些偶然的条件下，海蘑菇会聚集在一起生长，抵御风浪，并抛出诱饵吸引捕食者、保证群落的安全。近些年，能促成海蘑菇集体生长的技术难关终于被攻克，这项新的技术立刻被应用在了水族馆中。</color>
original.info:
繁殖能力强大，海洋蘑菇生态系统中的重要一环。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20×2/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>水生，低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>出场时为2只，15秒后，变为3只（伤害变为20×3/1.5秒）</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>之后每15秒1次，尽可能对前方1格植物使用海蘑菇卡牌，否则生成1张海蘑菇卡牌</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>海蘑菇（底座）+小喷菇</color>

english.name: Minnow-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Reproduction and proliferation are life's instincts. Under certain conditions, Minnow-shrooms grow together, resisting waves, and swim in schools to confuse predators. In recent years, technology enabling compact breeding has finally been developed and immediately applied in aquariums.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Minnow-shroom constantly creates copies of itself, if one does not fit on the tile, it will be turned into a Sea-shroom for others to use!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20×2 (later ×3)/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Does not return Sun on fusion.
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Starts out as a school of 2.
<color=black>•</color> Grows into a school of 3 after 15s.
<color=black>•</color> Afterwards, feeds the plant directly in front with a Sea-shroom every 15s. If unsuccessful, drops a Sea-shroom seed packet.</color>

german.name: Elritzpilz
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Reproduction and proliferation are life's instincts. Under certain conditions, Minnow-shrooms grow together, resisting waves, and swim in schools to confuse predators. In recent years, technology enabling compact breeding has finally been developed and immediately applied in aquariums.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Highly reproductive; an important part of the ocean fungal ecosystem.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20×2 (later ×3)/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Does not return Sun on fusion.
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Starts out as a school of 2.
<color=black>•</color> Grows into a school of 3 after 15s.
<color=black>•</color> Afterwards, feeds the plant directly in front with a Sea-shroom every 15s. If unsuccessful, drops a Sea-shroom seed packet.</color>

original.name: 磁性大喷菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“我以前的任务是发酵面包，”磁性大喷菇介绍道，“但现在我负责收集铁器，用来造烤面包的炉子。”</color>
original.info:
喷射锈蚀金属的烟雾，拥有的磁性可以融合铁桶。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>对含铁的僵尸造成2倍伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大喷菇+磁力菇</color>

english.name: Morph-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>'I used to ferment bread,' Morph-shroom explained, 'but now I collect metal to build the bread ovens.'</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Putting an Iron Bucket on him might have interesting results.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Deals ×2 damage to Metal Zombies.</color>

german.name: Lockpilz
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>„Früher habe ich Brot fermentiert“, erklärte Lockpilz, „aber jetzt sammle ich Metall, um die Brotbacköfen zu bauen.“</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Ein Eisenkübel auf ihn zu setzen, könnte interessante Ergebnisse haben.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Verursacht doppelt so viel Schaden an Eisenzombies.</color>

original.name: 特种三线射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“你们两个已经轮流用了三分钟，该轮到我了！”特种三线射手的三个头从小就一直在争夺家中物品的使用权，从玻璃球，到漫画书，再到用豌豆雕刻的限量版特种兵徽章。</color>
original.info:
可在三种攻击模式之间切换，灵活分配火力。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20×6/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>拥有三种攻击模式，点击即可切换，索敌范围也会随之调整</color>
<color=#A86A44>普通射击模式：</color><color=red>向本行及邻行各发射2发子弹</color>
<color=#A86A44>火力覆盖模式：</color><color=red>向所有行各发射1发子弹</color>
<color=#A86A44>火力集中模式：</color><color=red>在本行发射6发子弹</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>处于火力覆盖模式时，如果地图行数少于6行，则损失的子弹伤害会均分给其他子弹</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>三线射手+豌豆射手</color>

english.name: Multipeater
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"You two have already taken turns for three whole minutes, now it's my turn!" The three heads of the Multipeater have been competing for shared items since childhood, from marbles, to comic books, to a limited-edition commando badge carved from peas.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Multipeater can switch between three attack modes, allowing flexible allocation of firepower.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20×6(or n)/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Has three attack modes that can be switched by tapping on it; targeting behavior changes accordingly:
<color=black>•</color> 1. Standard Mode: Fires 2 peas each into his own lane and the 2 adjacent lanes;
<color=black>•</color> 2. Spread Mode: Fires 1 peas each into every lane (if the map has fewer than 6 lanes, the damage from missing shots is evenly redistributed among the remaining shots);
<color=black>•</color> 3. Focus Mode: Fires 6 peas each into his own lane.</color>

german.name: Dupli-Triplinator
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"You two have already taken turns for three whole minutes, now it's my turn!" The three heads of the Multipeater have been competing for shared items since childhood, from marbles, to comic books, to a limited-edition commando badge carved from peas.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Can switch between three attack modes, allowing flexible allocation of firepower.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20×6(or n)/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Has three attack modes that can be switched by tapping on it; targeting behavior changes accordingly:
<color=black>•</color> 1. Standard Mode: Fires 2 peas each into his own lane and the 2 adjacent lanes;
<color=black>•</color> 2. Spread Mode: Fires 1 peas each into every lane (if the map has fewer than 6 lanes, the damage from missing shots is evenly redistributed among the remaining shots);
<color=black>•</color> 3. Focus Mode: Fires 6 peas each into his own lane.</color>

original.name: 土豆小喷菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>曾有植物请教土豆小喷菇的算数能力为什么这么优秀。“我也不想啊。”土豆小喷菇回答道，“每过一会儿清点一次家族人数，算数能力不好不行。”或者说，正是他们不会弄丢任何一个成员的精神，练就了这一本领。</color>
original.info:
能自我繁殖一次，且后代还能继续繁殖。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20/2.25秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮，可密植</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>射程2.5格。出场20秒后在本格繁殖一株土豆小喷菇，每株只能繁殖一次。死亡时造成300伤害的土豆雷爆炸</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>小喷菇（底座）+土豆雷</color>

english.name: Nugget-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Some plants asked: "Why is the top of Nugget-shroom red?", to which he replied, "Well, let me ask you first..."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Nugget-shroom can reproduce itself onto the same tile!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant. Spawns a new Nugget-shroom in the same tile after 20 Seconds. Each Nugget-shroom can only reproduce once. Upon death, it deals 300 damage to nearby zombies</color>

german.name: Nuggetpilz
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Some plants asked: "Why is the top of Nugget-shroom red?" Potato Sprout Mushroom then asked: "Well, let me ask you first..."</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Can reproduce itself!

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5 Seconds</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Spawns a new Nugget-shroom in the same tile after 20 Seconds. Each Nugget-shroom can only reproduce once. Upon death, it deals 300 damage to nearby zombies</color>

original.name: 坚果花盆
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>大家对坚果花盆的外貌议论纷纷，有人说他其实是被敲碎的坚果、有人说他原本是坏掉的不倒翁。但无论别人怎样猜测，坚果花盆都不会回答，那些无聊的过去，就让它沉没在熔岩中吧。“至少现在，我是一个花盆。”他和其他花盆聚在一起，这样说道。</color>
original.info:
隔热的防御型花盆。

<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>可种裸地，低矮，载体</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>为本格植物提供20%减伤</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>免疫熔岩地块的伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>熔岩地块：</color><color=red>每秒灼伤上方所有单位。对僵尸：造成50伤害。对植物：优先对花盆造成10伤害。如果没有花盆，则对本格植物造成50伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>花盆（底座）+坚果</color>

english.name: Nut Pot
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Everyone speculated about Nut Pot's appearance: some said he was a broken nut, others that he was a damaged daruma doll. Whatever others guessed, Nut Pot didn't answer. Those boring past events were buried by lava. "At least now, I am a Pot," he said.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Nut Pot gives the plant on its tile a damage reduction, and it's immune to lava!

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Reduces incoming damage to the plant on top by 20%.
<color=black>•</color> Immune to Lava tile damage and protects the plant on top.
<color=black>•</color> Lava tiles deal 50 damage per second to plants and zombies on them, prioritizing Flower Pots, dealing 10 damage to them instead.</color>

german.name: Topfnuss
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Everyone speculated about Nut Pot's appearance: some said he was a broken nut, others that he was a damaged daruma doll. Whatever others guessed, Nut Pot didn't answer. Those boring past events were buried by lava. "At least now, I am a Pot," he said.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Heat-insulated defensive Flower Pot.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Reduces incoming damage to the plant on top by 20%.
<color=black>•</color> Immune to Lava tile damage and protects the plant on top.
<color=black>•</color> Lava tiles deal 50 damage per second to plants and zombies on them, prioritizing Flower Pots, dealing 10 damage to them instead.</color>

original.name: 坚果南瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>对坚果南瓜来说，只要自己能制造良好的内部环境供小坚果成长就好。外界的喧嚣他并不在乎，甚至僵尸的啃咬他也不甚在意。他唯一介意的是在战斗中，会有其他植物挤占他的内部空间，这是他专门留给小坚果的。</color>
original.info:
坚硬的南瓜，内部会持续长出有用的坚果仁。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>8000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每50秒一次，壳内会长成一个坚果仁，为3×3范围内受伤的其他南瓜类植物回复共计1000血量，如果没有满足条件的植物，则生产1张坚果卡牌。一个坚果南瓜最多生产3张坚果卡牌</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>南瓜（底座）+坚果</color>

english.name: Nut Shell
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>For the Nut Shell, all that matters is creating a good internal environment for the smaller Nuts to grow. He ignores the outside noise and even zombie bites. The only thing he cares about is other plants crowding his internal space, a space he reserves specifically for the Mini-nuts.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Nut Shell grows Wall-nuts inside itself, which can either be used to heal other plants or be converted into a Wall-nut seed packet.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>8000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Spawns a Mini-nut every 50s. When the Mini-nut is fully grown, it is consumed to heal a nearby damaged Pumpkin-type plant for up to 1000 HP or to produce a Wall-nut seed packet if no such plant exists. A single Nut Shell can produce at most 3 Wall-nut seed packets.</color>

german.name: Kürbisnuss
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>For the Nut Shell, all that matters is creating a good internal environment for the smaller Nuts to grow. He ignores the outside noise and even zombie bites. The only thing he cares about is other plants crowding his internal space, a space he reserves specifically for the Mini-nuts.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Continuously grows helpful Mini-nuts inside.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>8000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Spawns a Mini-nut every 50s. When the Mini-nut is fully grown, it is consumed to heal a nearby damaged Pumpkin-type plant for up to 1000 HP or to produce a Wall-nut seed packet if no such plant exists. A single Nut Shell can produce at most 3 Wall-nut seed packets.</color>

original.name: 坚果小蘑菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>是坚果还是蘑菇？何必分得这么清，也许是个松茸呢。​</color>
original.info:
形似坚果的小蘑菇，但硬度只有坚果的一半。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>2000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮，可密植</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>小喷菇（底座）+坚果</color>

english.name: Nut-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Nut or mushroom? Why worry about labels? Nut-shroom isn't about to tell you it's actually a matsutake in disguise anyway.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Nut-shroom can be your stalwart defender despite its size.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>2000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).</color></size>

german.name: Nusspilz
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Nuss oder Pilz? Warum sich mit Bezeichnungen aufhalten? Nusspilz wird dir ohnehin nicht verraten, dass es sich eigentlich um einen getarnten Matsutake handelt.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Nusspilz kann trotz seiner Größe ein fester Verteidiger sein.

<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>2000</color></size>

original.name: 坚果火炬树桩
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“今天野餐为大家准备的是烤坚果。”谈到如此美味的食物，即便是坚果火炬树桩也忍不住露出了笑容。真是一场完美的野餐——除了缺少坚果的身影。虽然使用的是面制品，但如此逼真的模样还是让坚果感到不适。</color>
original.info:
炙烤着坚果的火炬树桩，可以生成焰光坚果。

<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每影响超过50个子弹，在前方生成一个不能用于融合的焰光坚果</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>火炬树桩+坚果</color>

english.name: Nutwood
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Today's menu features roasted nuts." Even Nutwood can't help but smile at the thought of having made such a treat. It's the perfect picnic snack, except that no actual Wall-nuts are around. The "roasted nuts" are bread replicas, so realistic that they make real Wall-nuts uneasy.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Nutwood summons a Roasted Wall-nut after igniting enough projectiles.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>For every 50 peas lit, a Roasted Wall-nut is spawned in front.</color>

german.name: Nussholz
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Today's menu features roasted nuts." Even Nutwood can't help but smile at the thought of having made such a treat. It's the perfect picnic snack, except that no actual Wall-nuts are around. The "roasted nuts" are bread replicas, so realistic that they make real Wall-nuts uneasy.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Capable of producing Roasted Wall-nuts.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>For every 50 peas lit, a Roasted Wall-nut is spawned in front.</color>

original.name: 卷心瓜投手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“拨开绿色的外表，我的内心种着玫瑰。”这句话的意思是不要随便走进一家陌生的理发店，这将会是一个脑洞大开的决定。</color>
original.info:
投出可以弹跳的卷心瓜。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>80/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>子弹能弹射1次</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>卷心菜投手+西瓜投手</color>

english.name: Overripe Melon
english.introduce:
<align=left><size=36><color=black>"Peel away the green exterior, and you'll find a heart of roses within." This phrase means don't randomly walk into an unfamiliar barber shop—it will be a mind-blowing decision.
Melon Pot: "After finishing a watermelon, wearing its rind on your head is something everyone did as a kid." Flower Pot remarks, "Honestly, it's kind of silly."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Overripe Melon fires melons that bounce once.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>80/3s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Projectiles bounce once.</color>

german.name: Gefüllte Melone
german.introduce:
<size=34><color=black>„Schäle die grüne Schale ab, und du findest ein Herz aus Rosen darin.“ Dieser Spruch bedeutet, dass man nicht einfach in einen unbekannten Friseurladen spazieren sollte – es könnte eine verblüffende Entscheidung sein.

Melonentopf: „Nachdem man eine Wassermelone gegessen hat, ist es etwas, was jeder als Kind getan hat, die Schale auf dem Kopf zu tragen.“ Blumentopf merkt an: „Ehrlich gesagt, es ist irgendwie albern.“</color>
german.info:
<size=34>Feuert Melonen ab, die einmal aufspringen.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>120/3 Sekunden</color>

original.name: 豌豆花盆
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>豌豆花盆是豌豆射手的超级粉丝。他把自己染成了绿色，用纸浆做了些树叶，甚至还把一个旧花瓶改造成了豌豆枪管！现在只差一个签名了。</color>
original.info:
豌豆家族的射击基座，会利用后坐力来迸发额外火力。

<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮，载体，可种裸地</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>本格的豌豆射手类植物每发射30发子弹，就使其立即发射5发子弹</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>花盆（底座）+豌豆射手</color>

english.name: Pea Pot
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Pea Pot is a devoted fan of the Peashooter. It dyed itself green, made leaf decorations out of paper pulp, and even modified an old vase into a pea cannon barrel. All that’s missing is an autograph.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Pea Pot makes certain Peashooter type plants on top shoot a burst 5 of their projectile once they've fired normally enough.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Peashooter-type plants on this tile trigger an extra rapid-fired 5 shots every time they fire 30 shots.</color>

german.name: Pea Pot
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Pea Pot is a devoted fan of the Peashooter. It dyed itself green, made leaf decorations out of paper pulp, and even modified an old vase into a pea cannon barrel. All that’s missing is an autograph.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Pea Pot makes certain Peashooter type plants on top shoot a burst 5 of their projectile once they've fired normally enough.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Peashooter-type plants on this tile trigger an extra rapid-fired 5 shots every time they fire 30 shots.</color>

original.name: 豌豆窝瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“我到底是该跳起来砸人，还是该老实当个射手？”这个问题困扰了豌豆窝瓜整个青春期。虽然他最后选择当一个传统一点的窝瓜，但每次落地时，身上那些绿色疙瘩还是会应激地喷射豌豆。</color>
original.info:
籽用窝瓜，砸击时爆出大量子弹。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1800（压扁）</color>
<color=#3D1400>索敌范围：</color><color=red>左侧0.5格~右侧1格</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>落地时，爆出3圈（共108颗）豌豆子弹</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>窝瓜+豌豆射手</color>

english.name: Pea Squash
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Should I jump up and smash zombies, or should I just be a proper shooter?" That question haunted Pea Squash throughout his entire adolescence. In the end, he chose the more traditional Squash lifestyle, but every time he hits the ground, those little green bumps on his body reflexively fire peas anyway.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Pea Squash bursts into a few rings of peas when it slams down.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>0.5 tiles to the left; 1 tile to the right</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>When it lands, releases 3 rings of pea projectiles (108 peas total).</color>

german.name: Matsch-Erbse
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Should I jump up and smash zombies, or should I just be a proper shooter?" That question haunted Pea Squash throughout his entire adolescence. In the end, he chose the more traditional Squash lifestyle, but every time he hits the ground, those little green bumps on his body reflexively fire peas anyway.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Bursts into a storm of peas when it slams down.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>0.5 tiles to the left; 1 tile to the right</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>When it lands, releases 3 rings of pea projectiles (108 peas total).</color>

original.name: 坚果射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​“不……不准说我长的丑，不然……等…等下喷你哦”坚果射手一直都在为自己“出众”的外貌所苦恼。不过他坚信植物的内在永远比外在重要。他虚心请教了保龄球坚果前辈，终于学会了…把子弹像保龄球一样滚出去的技巧。”</color>
original.info:
吐出可以穿透的滚地坚果。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>发射滚地坚果，无限穿透，但遇到上坡时消失</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手+坚果</color>

english.name: Pea-nut
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"No... don't call me ugly, or else... wait... I'll spray you." Pea-nut has always struggled with his "unique" appearance. But he firmly believes that what's inside a plant matters more than how it looks. Seeking guidance, he humbly asked senior Bowling Nut for advice and eventually mastered the technique of rolling nuts like bowling balls.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Pea-nut fires mini-nuts that can pierce an infinite number of zombies!

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5s (Piercing) </color>

german.name: Erbsen-Nuss
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>„Nein... nenn mich nicht hässlich, sonst... warte... ich spritz dich ab.“ Erbsen-Nuss hatte immer mit seinem „einzigartigen“ Aussehen zu kämpfen. Aber er ist fest davon überzeugt, dass das Innere einer Pflanze mehr zählt als ihr Aussehen. Auf der Suche nach Rat bat er demütig den erfahrenen Bowling-Nuss um Hilfe und meisterte schließlich die Technik, Nüsse wie Bowlingbälle zu rollen.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Erbsen-Nuss schießt Mini-Nüsse ab, die Zombies durchdringen können.

<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5 Sekunden (Durchdringend) </color>

original.name: 豌豆小喷菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​“小小的身体里蕴含着大大的能量”，任何轻视豌豆小喷菇的人都会被他的表现震惊。“其实我们都是从小喷菇来的，一天一点进步，坚持吃阳光早餐，你也可以像我这样。</color>
original.info:
发射小豌豆。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20/2.25秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮，可密植</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>小喷菇（底座）+豌豆射手</color>

english.name: Pea-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Don't let my size fool you; even a small body can contain a lot of energy," Pea-shroom cautions those who underestimate him. "We all began as tiny mushrooms, making progress a little at a time. With dedication to a sunny breakfast, you can become just like me."</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Pea-shroom shoots further than Puff-shroom.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20/2.25s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).</color></size>

german.name: Erbsenpilz
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>„Lass dich nicht von meiner Größe täuschen; auch ein kleiner Körper kann viel Energie enthalten“, warnt Erbsenpilz die, die ihn unterschätzen. „Wir alle haben als winzige Pilze angefangen und uns Schritt für Schritt verbessert. Mit einem sonnigen Frühstück kannst du genauso werden wie ich.“</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Erbsenpilz schießt weiter als der Pustepilz.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5 Sekunden</color></size>

original.name: 豌豆土豆雷
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​豌豆土豆雷没有眼睛，不过他有自己独特的感应僵尸的方法。“我感觉到了……”豌豆土豆雷缓缓地说，“僵尸正在靠近。越来越近了，越来越近了……”豌豆土豆雷不知道是自己心跳越来越快了，还是发射速度越来越快了。更快了，更快了……最终，“砰”的一声，豌豆土豆雷化为了一束土豆味的烟花​。</color>
original.info:
发射土豆豌豆的土豆雷，出土前就可以发射。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>30/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>出场时返还50阳光。死亡时爆出一圈（36颗）土豆豌豆</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>距离前方僵尸越近攻击间隔越短，最低0.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手+土豆雷</color>

english.name: Peatato Mine
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Peatato Mine may not have eyes, but he has his own special way of sensing zombies. "I feel it…" he murmured, "The zombies are getting closer… closer… closer…" Peatato Mine's heartbeat quickened, and so did his firing speed. Faster, faster… until, with a "bang," Peatato Mine exploded into a burst of potato-flavored fireworks.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Peatato Mine speeds up his attack rate when zombies get near, and can even fire before being armed!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>30/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Fusion returns 50 Sun.
<color=black>•</color> Attacks faster as zombies get closer, with a minimum attack interval of 0.5s. Upon exploding, deals 1800 damage to zombies in a small radius and releases 36 projectiles in all directions.</color></size>

german.name: Erbsen-Mine
german.introduce: <size=32><color=black>Erbsen-Mine hat vielleicht keine Augen, aber er hat seine eigene spezielle Art, Zombies zu spüren. „Ich fühle es…“ murmelte er, „Die Zombies kommen näher… näher… näher…“ Der Herzschlag von Erbsen-Mine beschleunigte sich, ebenso wie seine Feuerrate. Schneller, schneller… bis er mit einem „Bam!“ in einem Ausbruch von Kartoffel-Feuerwerk explodiert.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=32>Erbsen-Mine kann angreifen, bevor sie ausgebuddelt wird.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Greift schneller an, wenn die Zombies näher kommen. Setzt bei der Explosion 36 Projektile in alle Richtungen frei.</color></size>

original.name: 金盏菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>金盏菇是一位出色的倾听者。她喜欢与人交谈，喜欢听八卦、听故事，总之喜欢听别人说话。你可以在她的书《一分钱的思考》中读到她有多么热爱倾听。目前只有有声书版本。</color>
original.info:
生产少量金钱，长大后生产更多。

<color=#3D1400>金钱产量：</color><color=red>100(300)/25秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮，可密植</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每次生产100金钱。出场120秒后长大，每次生产的金钱提升至300</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>小喷菇（底座）+金盏花</color>

english.name: Penny-shroom
english.introduce:
<align=left><size=36><color=black>Penny Shroom is an amazing listener. She loves talking to others, listening to gossip, listening to other's stories, listening to others talk in general. You can read about how much she loves listening in her book, A Penny For Your Thoughts. Only audiobook format as of current.

- Written by Doot</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Penny-shroom produces a small amount of money, then produces more after growing up.

<color=black>Coin Production: </color><color=#8B0000>100→300/25s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant. Can be stacked.
<color=black>•</color> At first, produces 100 Coins each time. Grows up 120s after being planted, increasing its production to 300 each time.</color>

german.name: Penny-shroom
german.introduce:
<align=left><size=36><color=black>Penny Shroom is an amazing listener. She loves talking to others, listening to gossip, listening to other's stories, listening to others talk in general. You can read about how much she loves listening in her book, A Penny For Your Thoughts. Only audiobook format as of current.

- Written by Doot</color>

original.name: 魅惑大喷菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​炫彩大喷菇，堂堂登场！魅惑大喷菇只要喷射孢子就能让僵尸转向，有人说这是蘑菇家族特传的秘诀，有人说这是军方的新概念武器，而魅惑大喷菇只是淡淡一笑“只是魅惑菇每天帮我漱口罢了​​”。</color>
original.info:
充满魅力的大喷菇，喷射可以魅惑僵尸的烟雾。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>攻击有概率魅惑血量低于50%的僵尸，血量越低概率越高，最高为25%。被啃咬时魅惑该僵尸并变为大喷菇</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>魅惑菇+大喷菇</color>

english.name: Perfume-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The colorful Perfume-shroom makes a grand debut! With a blast of perfume, it can turn zombies around in an instant. Some claim it's a secret technique passed down by the mushroom family, while others believe it's a cutting-edge military weapon. Perfume-shroom just smiles and says, "It's all thanks to Hypno-shroom helping me rinse my mouth everyday."</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Perfume-shroom sprays fumes that can hypnotize zombies.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1.5s (Piercing) </color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Chance to hypnotize zombies with less than 50% Toughness. The lower the zombie's HP, the higher the chance, up to 25%.
<color=black>•</color> Hypnotization chance increases by 5% for each spore color from Trippy-shroom that hits the zombie.
<color=black>•</color> When bitten, hypnotizes the attacker, then reverts to a Fume-shroom.</color></size>

german.name: Parfümpilz
german.introduce: <size=32><color=black>Der bunte Parfümpilz feiert seinen großen Auftritt! Mit einem Duftstoß kann er Zombies im Handumdrehen umdrehen. Einige behaupten, es sei eine geheime Technik, die von der Pilzfamilie überliefert wurde, während andere glauben, es sei eine hochmoderne militärische Waffe. Parfümpilz lächelt nur und sagt: „Das verdanke ich Hypnopilz, der mir jeden Tag hilft, meinen Mund auszuspülen.“</color></size>
german.info:
<size=32>Parfümpilz versprüht Dämpfe, die Zombies betören können.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5 Sekunden (Durchdringend) </color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Chance, Zombies mit <50% Lebenspunkten zu verzaubern. Hypnotisiert den Zombie, der ihn frisst.</color></size>

original.name: 浴火三线射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>没人知道灼烧是否真的会为植物带来新生，那只是一个传说，奔向传说的植物都已化作灰烬，直到他成为的新的传说。 “我也不知道浴火几次才能成功，但为了他们，我必须成功。”</color>
original.info:
凤凰涅槃，浴火重生。

<color=#3D1400>使用条件：</color><color=red>旅行模式</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>灰烬三线射手+火爆辣椒</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>160×3/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>发射浴火豌豆，能穿透2次，伤害后施加红温状态</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>出场和死亡时在全场每行释放火爆辣椒效果</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条1：</color><color=red>怒火攻心：火焰豌豆类会施加红温状态，红温增伤幅度+100%</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条2：</color><color=red>百步穿杨：浴火豌豆能无限穿透，且附带等量红温爆炸伤害。解锁亚种飞火三线射手</color>

english.name: Phoenix Threepeater
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>No one knows if fire truly brings rebirth to plants—it's just a legend. Those who chased it turned to ash, until he became the new legend. "I don't know how many times I must endure the flames to succeed, but for them, I have to."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>From fire reborn!

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode</color>
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>160×3/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Ignites the whole lawn upon entry.
<color=black>•</color> Projectiles inflict the Enflamed debuff and pierce 2 times.
<color=black>•</color> Its damage is quadrupled after passing through an Infernal Squashwood.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
<color=#8B0000>1. Enflamed damage bonus 50% → 150%, and regular ignited projectiles can now inflict the debuff
2. Phoenix peas can now pierce infinitely and cause Enflamed explosions | Phoenix Drone Subspecies Unlocked</color>

german.name: Phönix Triplinator
german.introduce: <size=32><color=black></color>
german.info:
<size=36>Aus Asche wiedergeboren!

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>160x3/1.5 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Fackelt beim Betreten den gesamten Rasen ab, Projektile fügen den Schwächungszauber 'Entflammter' zu, durchdringt dreimal mit verdoppeltem Schaden nach dem Passieren von Gequetschtes Infernoholz.</color>
<color=black>Odyssee Verbesserung:
<color=#8B0000>1. Entflammter Schadensmultiplikator → 150%, und entzündete Erbsen können nun den Debuff
2 verursachen. Geschosse können jetzt unendlich durchschlagen</color>

original.name: 蒜毒豌豆射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>作为一名特色鲜明的大厨，蒜毒豌豆射手力求让每位顾客都能体验到他的拿手菜——蒜香豌豆。僵尸们闻到那股独特的蒜味时，总会被勾起关于蒜的往日种种：童年、亲人、故乡，当然，还有眼泪和鼻涕。</color>
original.info:
发射蒜豌豆，使中毒的僵尸释放体内毒素，形成一片毒瘴。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>30/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>子弹命中时赋予1蒜值。如果目标处于中毒状态，在其位置生成一个毒瘴</color>
<color=#3D1400>毒瘴：</color><color=red>每行最多存在一个。半径0.74格，持续6秒。每1秒，赋予范围内的僵尸1点蒜值，造成本行所有蒜毒射手类植物一轮发射子弹量20倍的伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手+大蒜</color>

english.name: Poison Pea
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Despite the name, Poison Pea is a chef with a strong signature style. He insists every customer try its specialty, fried peas with garlic powder. The smell alone brings zombies flooding with memories: childhood, family, home… and plenty of tears.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Poison Pea shoots peas that can create poison clouds if that hit a poison zombie!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>30/1.5s</color>
<color=#5E1675>Poison System: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Projectiles add 1 Poison value to zombies on hit.
<color=black>•</color> If the zombie hit is already in a Poisoned state, creates a Toxic Cloud at the zombie's feet that lasts for 6s, applying 1 Poison value and dealing damage equal to 20× the total projectiles fired in one volley by all Poison-system straight-shooting plants in this lane per second to all zombies caught within. There can be up to 1 active Toxic Cloud per lane.</color>

german.name: Herb-senkanone
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Despite the name, Poison Pea is a chef with a strong signature style. He insists every customer try its specialty, fried peas with garlic powder. The smell alone brings zombies flooding with memories: childhood, family, home… and plenty of tears.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Fires garlic peas that cause poisoned zombies to release toxins, forming a toxic cloud.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>30/1.5s</color>
<color=#5E1675>Poison System: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Projectiles add 1 Poison value to zombies on hit.
<color=black>•</color> If the zombie hit is already in a Poisoned state, creates a Toxic Cloud at the zombie's feet that lasts for 6s, applying 1 Poison value and dealing damage equal to 20× the total projectiles fired in one volley by all Poison-system straight-shooting plants in this lane per second to all zombies caught within. There can be up to 1 active Toxic Cloud per lane.</color>

original.name: 蒜毒双发射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“战斗！战斗！攻击！攻击！”蒜毒双发射手的生活充满激情和专注，他从来不会被其他的小事困扰，无论是僵尸、吸血鬼、还是卖美白化妆品的推销员，都别想轻易靠近他。</color>
original.info:
发射蒜豌豆的双发射手。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>30×2/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>子弹命中时赋予1蒜值。如果目标处于中毒状态，在其位置生成一个毒瘴</color>
<color=#3D1400>增生豆荚：</color><color=red>出场15秒后手动点击，即可升级为蒜毒裂荚射手</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手×2+大蒜</color>

english.name: Poison Repeater
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Fight! Fight! Attack! Attack!" Poison Repeater lives with passion and poison. Nothing distracts it, not zombies, not vampires, not even pushy salesmen.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Poison Repeater fires two poison peas at once.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>30×2/1.5s</color>
<color=#5E1675>Poison System: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Projectiles add 1 Poison value to zombies on hit.
<color=black>•</color> If the zombie hit is already in a Poisoned state, creates a Toxic Cloud at the zombie's feet.</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000> Tap to auto-fuse with a free Peashooter 15s after planting.

german.name: Knobinator
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Fight! Fight! Attack! Attack!" Poison Repeater lives with passion and poison. Nothing distracts it, not zombies, not vampires, not even pushy salesmen.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Fires two garlic peas at once.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>30×2/1.5s</color>
<color=#5E1675>Poison System: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Projectiles add 1 Poison value to zombies on hit.
<color=black>•</color> If the zombie hit is already in a Poisoned state, creates a Toxic Cloud at the zombie's feet.</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000> Tap to auto-fuse with a free Peashooter 15s after planting.

original.name: 土豆窝瓜块茎
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>长在藤上的窝瓜你见过，那长在地里的窝瓜你见过吗？对了，你可不要嘲笑他的个子低，如果让他听到了，他会让你变得比他还要矮的。</color>
original.info:
会长成可以压扁僵尸的土豆窝瓜，留在原地的块茎则可继续生长。

<color=#3D1400>索敌范围：</color><color=red>左侧0.5格~右侧1格</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>默认处于出土状态。索敌范围内有僵尸时，在原地生成一个土豆窝瓜，然后入土15秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>土豆窝瓜：</color><color=red>效果和伤害同窝瓜，但索敌范围更大</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>窝瓜+土豆雷</color>

english.name: Potato Masher
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>You've seen Squashes growing on vines, but have you ever seen one sprouting from the ground itself? Don't be fooled, as Potato Masher is simply mashed potatoes shaped like a Squash. But don't you dare laugh at how short he is. If he hears you, he'll make you even shorter than he is.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Potato Masher produces Potato Mashes that can squash zombies when they approach.

<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>0.5 tiles to the left; 1 tile to the right</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Starts out armed by default. Generates a Potato Mash on the spot when a zombie enters his targeting range, then burrows underground for 15s to arm again.
<color=black>•</color> Potato Mash has the same effect and damage as Squash, but with a larger targeting range.</color>

german.name: Sprungmine
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>You've seen Squashes growing on vines, but have you ever seen one sprouting from the ground itself? Don't be fooled, as Potato Masher is simply mashed potatoes shaped like a Squash. But don't you dare laugh at how short he is. If he hears you, he'll make you even shorter than he is.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Produces Potato Mashes that can squash zombies.

<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>0.5 tiles to the left; 1 tile to the right</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Starts out armed by default. Generates a Potato Mash on the spot when a zombie enters his targeting range, then burrows underground for 15s to arm again.
<color=black>•</color> Potato Mash has the same effect and damage as Squash, but with a larger targeting range.</color>

original.name: 小蘑菇南瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>小蘑菇南瓜三兄弟是非常受喜爱的乖孩子，不吵不闹、也从不闹矛盾，他们唯一的爱好就是拼好头顶的南瓜拼图，可惜一直没能成功。</color>
original.info:
防御性的小蘑菇圈，圈上的小蘑菇数量越多，防护越周全。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>每3秒回血50</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>出场时，血量为1/4倍韧性</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>血量高于1/3倍韧性时，拥有50%减伤</color>
<color=#3D1400>④</color><color=red>血量高于2/3倍韧性时， 为壳内的植物承伤</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>南瓜（底座）+小喷菇</color>

english.name: Puff-kin
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The three Puff-shroom Pumpkin brothers are well-loved, well-behaved kids: quiet, orderly, and never quarrelsome. Their only hobby is trying to piece together the pumpkin puzzle on top of their heads, though unfortunately, they have never quite succeeded.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Puff-kin starts out very weak, but has constant healing and gains extra abilities as it gains health!

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Restores 50 HP every 3s. Starts out at 1/4 max HP.
<color=black>•</color> At 1/3 max HP or more, gains a 50% incoming damage reduction.
<color=black>•</color> At 2/3 max HP or more, absorbs damage for the plant inside.</color>

german.name: Pustekürbis
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The three Puff-shroom Pumpkin brothers are well-loved, well-behaved kids: quiet, orderly, and never quarrelsome. Their only hobby is trying to piece together the pumpkin puzzle on top of their heads, though unfortunately, they have never quite succeeded.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>The more Puff-shrooms in the Puff-kin, the stronger the protection!

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Restores 50 HP every 3s. Starts out at 1/4 max HP.
<color=black>•</color> At 1/3 max HP or more, gains a 50% incoming damage reduction.
<color=black>•</color> At 2/3 max HP or more, absorbs damage for the plant inside.</color>

original.name: 土豆南瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>土豆南瓜曾是一家薯条店的老板，但口碑持续下滑导致他不得不来到了花园。“半份薯条，减量不减价，是不是挺划算的？”他正推销着新品，不过客人好像对他的“半份”更有兴趣。</color>
original.info:
低矮的南瓜，每次破损都会造成爆炸。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>血量首次低于某个损伤点（2/3倍韧性、1/3倍韧性）时和死亡时，释放500伤害的土豆雷爆炸</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>南瓜（底座）+土豆雷</color>

english.name: Pumpkin Mine
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Once a chip shop owner, Pumpkin Mine had a simple business model: cut the fries in half but keep the price the same. The customers disagreed. Now in the Garden, he's offering a different kind of deal—one that ends with a bang. Yet, for some reason, people still bring up his old menu.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Pumpkin Mine is a shorter Pumpkin.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles). However, non-"short" plants inside it will be hit. Triggers small explosions on damage phase transitions, causing 500 damage to nearby zombies. On death, explodes like a Potato Mine and deals 1800 damage.</color>

german.name: Kartoffelkürbis
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Once a chip shop owner, Pumpkin Mine had a simple business model: cut the fries in half but keep the price the same. The customers disagreed. Now in the Garden, he's offering a different kind of deal—one that ends with a bang. Yet, for some reason, people still bring up his old menu.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>A shorter Pumpkin.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles). However, non-"short" plants inside it will be hit. Each time it is damaged, a small explosion will occur, causing 500 points of damage to zombies.</color>

original.name: 豌豆南瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>听说僵尸开来了“坦克”？那咱就亮出活的机枪堡垒——豌豆南瓜！至于弹药从哪来？咳，设计师忘了装弹仓……但问题不大！让同住的射手们“匀一点”子弹就好啦！</color>
original.info:
豌豆家族的射击掩体，根据内部射手的射击习惯来辅助发射子弹。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>壳内有豌豆射手类植物时，按照其射击模式（子弹数量、伤害及类型）进行射击，攻击间隔是壳内植物的2倍，最短为3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>该射击视为是由壳内的植物进行</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>南瓜（底座）+豌豆射手</color>

english.name: Pumpkin Pod
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Heard that some zombies brought a "tank"? Then show them the living machine-gun fortress — Pumpkin Pod! As for ammo… well, the designer forgot to include any! But no problem! Let the peashooters inside "share" some ammo!</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Pumpkin Pod copies the attack of a Pea-type plant inside it periodically.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>?</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>If a Pea-family plant is inside, it copies the attack of that plant, matching that plant's projectile count, damage, and type and shoots at 50% the attack rate, with a min. attack CD of 3s and a max. of 6s. These shots are considered to be fired by the internal plant.</color>

german.name: Kürbse
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Heard that some zombies brought a "tank"? Then show them the living machine-gun fortress — Pumpkin Pod! As for ammo… well, the designer forgot to include any! But no problem! Let the peashooters inside "share" some ammo!</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Copies the behavior of the Pea-shooting plant inside it.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>?</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>If a Pea-family plant is inside, it copies the attack of that plant, matching that plant's projectile count, damage, and type and shoots at 50% the attack rate, with a min. attack CD of 3s and a max. of 6s. These shots are considered to be fired by the internal plant.</color>

original.name: 火爆南瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>火爆南瓜是饭店的优秀员工，他平时负责当服务员，节日会为客人表演魔术，如果后厨出了些意外，他还会临时顶替煤气灶的工作。</color>
original.info:
能存储火爆辣椒的力量，点击会全部释放，爆发强大威力。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>拥有20点啃咬反伤，反伤后施加红温状态</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>受到火爆辣椒效果时，获得10%伤害的热能。本行有红温的僵尸死亡时，获得60热能</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>热能至多100万。每30点使啃咬反伤+1。若热能不小于1800，点击或死亡时会消耗全部热能，释放等伤害的火爆辣椒效果</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>南瓜（底座）+火爆辣椒</color>

english.name: Pyro Pumpkin
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Pyro Pumpkin is an excellent restaurant employee. He usually works as a waiter, performs magic tricks during festivals, and when something goes wrong in the kitchen, he can temporarily substitute as a gas stove.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Pyro Pumpkin stores thermal power; clicking releases it all for a powerful burst down the lane.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> When bitten, deals 20 damage to the attacker and applies Enflamed.
<color=black>•</color> Gains thermal energy equal to 10% of damage when affected by Jalapeno effects. Gains 60 thermal energy when an Enflamed zombie in its lane dies.
<color=black>•</color> Max thermal energy: 1M. Every 30 points of energy increase bite reflection damage by +1. If thermal energy ≥ 1800, clicking or death consumes all energy to release a Jalapeno effect with damage equal to stored energy.</color>

german.name: Pyro Pumpkin
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Pyro Pumpkin is an excellent restaurant employee. He usually works as a waiter, performs magic tricks during festivals, and when something goes wrong in the kitchen, he can temporarily substitute as a gas stove.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Pyro Pumpkin stores thermal power; clicking releases it all for a powerful burst down the lane.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> When bitten, deals 20 damage to the attacker and applies Enflamed.
<color=black>•</color> Gains thermal energy equal to 10% of damage when affected by Jalapeno effects. Gains 60 thermal energy when an Enflamed zombie in its lane dies.
<color=black>•</color> Max thermal energy: 1M. Every 30 points of energy increase bite reflection damage by +1. If thermal energy ≥ 1800, clicking or death consumes all energy to release a Jalapeno effect with damage equal to stored energy.</color>

original.name: 流光大灯菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“我见到的所有植物都戴着墨镜，”流光大灯菇愤愤说道，“简直不可理喻，这种行为太做作了！”最终，流光大灯菇将其归因于一种莫名兴起的潮流，而植物们认为裸眼接触一个超大功率的激光发射器有害视力是显而易见的事……</color>
original.info:
发射无限穿透的激光，威力随距离衰减，随光照增强。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>10/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>射程整行，无限穿透</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>每级光照增加0.5倍伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>根据与目标之间的距离，伤害增加1.6×(5-两者列数差)倍。3级及以上光照时，改为增加0.8×(10-两者列数差)倍</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大喷菇+路灯花</color>

english.name: Ray-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Every plant I see is wearing sunglasses," Ray-shroom grumbles. "It's ridiculous, so pretentious!" In the end, Ray-shroom chalks it up to some inexplicable trend, while the other plants agree that staring directly at an ultra-high-power laser emitter is obviously bad for your eyesight…</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Ray-shroom fires a piercing laser ray, its damage falls off with distance but increases with Lumos.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>10/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Fires across the entire lane with unlimited pierce.
<color=black>•</color> Each Lumos level increases damage by 0.5×.
<color=black>•</color> Damage increases by 1.6×(5 - column distance to the target). At Lumos level 3 or higher, this instead becomes 0.8×(10 - column distance).</color>

german.name: Muffellampe
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Every plant I see is wearing sunglasses," Ray-shroom grumbles. "It's ridiculous, so pretentious!" In the end, Ray-shroom chalks it up to some inexplicable trend, while the other plants agree that staring directly at an ultra-high-power laser emitter is obviously bad for your eyesight…</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Fires a piercing laser ray. Damage falls off with distance and increases with Lumos.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>10/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Fires across the entire lane with unlimited pierce.
<color=black>•</color> Each Lumos level increases damage by 0.5×.
<color=black>•</color> Damage increases by 1.6×(5 - column distance to the target). At Lumos level 3 or higher, this instead becomes 0.8×(10 - column distance).</color>

original.name: 流光双发射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>一周一次的泳池灯火联欢会是流光双发射手重要的社交活动，每次出门前，他都会仔细地戴好特制的灯框帽子，帽沿下的树叶不仅能让他看起来更帅气，也能给他的萤火虫朋友提供一个狂欢后休息的落脚点。</color>
original.info:
发射两束高频激光，持续推进战线。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>10</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>每0.5秒，获得（光照等级）点光能，存储上限1000点。每道激光在攻击或输送时，均会消耗（1+当前光能×10%）点光能</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>能锁定本行前方的流光中继射手（不可紧邻），每0.1秒输送一次，为目标补充2×自身攻击力10%的光能，每点消耗的光能使补充量增加1倍</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>可同时对两只僵尸发射激光，每0.2秒攻击一次，单次伤害会增加（消耗光能）倍</color>
<color=#3D1400>④</color><color=red>手动点击会重新锁定目标</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手×2+路灯花</color>

english.name: Rebeamer
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The weekly Pool Light Festival is an important social event for Rebeamer. Before heading out, it carefully adjusts its lamp hat, the leaves under the brim not only make it look stylish, but also give its firefly friends a place to rest after the party.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Fires double the amount of beams Beamshooter does!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>10×2/0.2s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Gains Lumos energy equal to Lumos level every 0.5s, up to 1000. Each laser beam consumes (1 + current energy × 10%) energy when attacking or transferring.
<color=black>•</color> Can lock onto a Split Beam in front in the same lane (not directly adjacent). Transfers energy every 0.1s, restoring energy equal to 20% of its attack. Each point of energy spent doubles the amount transferred.
<color=black>•</color> Consumes energy every 0.2s to attack 2 zombies at once, increasing damage by the amount of energy spent.
<color=black>•</color> Click on it will reset its target.</color>

german.name: Rebeamer
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The weekly Pool Light Festival is an important social event for Rebeamer. Before heading out, it carefully adjusts its lamp hat, the leaves under the brim not only make it look stylish, but also give its firefly friends a place to rest after the party.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Fires two high-frequency lasers.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>10×2/0.2s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Gains Lumos energy equal to Lumos level every 0.5s, up to 1000. Each laser beam consumes (1 + current energy × 10%) energy when attacking or transferring.
<color=black>•</color> Can lock onto a Split Beam in front in the same lane (not directly adjacent). Transfers energy every 0.1s, restoring energy equal to 20% of its attack. Each point of energy spent doubles the amount transferred.
<color=black>•</color> Consumes energy every 0.2s to attack 2 zombies at once, increasing damage by the amount of energy spent.
<color=black>•</color> Click on it will reset its target.</color>

original.name: 双发小喷菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​“关于我是谁，双发会给出答案”头顶双发叶子的小喷菇闪亮登场啦，双倍子弹，双倍快乐哦。喜欢成群结队的她们会欢快地把火力倾泻到战场上 ，即使她们还小。</color>
original.info:
一次发射两颗小豌豆。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20×2/2.25秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮，可密植</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>小喷菇（底座）+豌豆射手×2</color>

english.name: Repeat-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Who am I? The double-shot holds the answer!" exclaims the little Repeat-shroom, proudly flaunting the twin leaves atop its head. With double the firing rate and double the cheer, these spirited beings thrive in groups, eagerly pouring their firepower onto the battlefield, showcasing that size doesn't define their strength.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Repeat-shroom can fire two small peas from afar.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20×2/2.25s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).</color></size>

german.name: Doppel-Erbspilz
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>„Wer bin ich? Der Doppelschuss hält die Antwort bereit!“, ruft der kleine Doppel-Erbspilz und präsentiert stolz die beiden Blätter auf seinem Kopf. Mit doppelter Feuerrate und doppelter Freude blühen diese lebhaften Wesen in Gruppen auf und ergießen ihre Erbsenkraft auf das Schlachtfeld – ein Beweis, dass Stärke nicht von der Größe abhängt.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Doppel-Erbspilz kann zwei kleine Erbsen gleichzeitig schießen.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20*2/1.5 Sekunden</color></size>

original.name: 双发射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​与他阳光开朗的兄弟不同，双发射手总是漫不经心地生活，然后全神贯注地战斗，他偷偷学会了双发的技巧，却把这个秘密雪藏不让豌豆知道。“我希望他能一直快乐的生活，不用去学会这些战斗的技巧。</color>
original.info:
一次发射两颗豌豆。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20×2/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>增生豆荚：</color><color=red>特定的双发射手出场15秒后，手动点击即可升级为对应的裂荚射手</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手×2</color>

english.name: Repeater
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Unlike his bright and cheerful brother, Repeater leads a carefree life—until it's time to fight. He secretly mastered the art of double shooting but kept it hidden from Peashooter. "I just want him to live happily, without ever needing to learn these battle skills."</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Repeater fires two peas at a time.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20×2/1.5s</color></size>

german.name: Duplinator
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Der Duplinator ist cool. Er stammt von der Straße. Er lässt sich von niemandem provozieren, ob Pflanze oder Zombie, und er hält sich andere mit Erbsen vom Leib. Insgeheim sehnt er sich jedoch nach Liebe.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Duplinatoren verschießen zwei Erbsen auf einmal.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20*2/1.5 Sekunden</color></size>

original.name: 焰光土豆雷
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>刚从薯条炸锅里被捞出来，焰光土豆雷忍不住大声嚷嚷：“是哪个粗心的家伙不加工就把我扔进去的？”他是如此的恼怒，第一个撞到他的家伙可要倒霉了。</color>
original.info:
焰光映出的土豆雷，与土豆雷没有太多区别。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1800</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>无法融合</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>可以借助寒冰花盆转换为立即出土的土豆雷</color>

english.name: Roasted Potato
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Freshly pulled from an oven, Roasted Potato couldn't help but shout, "Which careless fool tossed me in there without preparing me first?" He's so furious that the first thing to bump into him is going to regret it.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>A fiery reflection of a Potato Mine, with little difference from the original.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>1800</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000> Short plant. Cannot be fused. Can be transformed into an armed Potato Mine using an Ice Pot.</color>

german.name: Roasted Potato
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Freshly pulled from an oven, Roasted Potato couldn't help but shout, "Which careless fool tossed me in there without preparing me first?" He's so furious that the first thing to bump into him is going to regret it.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>A fiery reflection of a Potato Mine, with little difference from the original.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>1800</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000> Short plant. Cannot be fused. Can be transformed into an armed Potato Mine using an Ice Pot.</color>

original.name: 焰光南瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“万圣节快乐！”焰光南瓜快乐地喊着，把一包包糖果分给淘气的小植物们。对了，等到分完糖果，可千万不要忘记来看他举办的南瓜灯会，据说他会亲自扮演南瓜灯！</color>
original.info:
焰光汇聚而成的南瓜，与南瓜没有太多区别。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>无法融合</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>可以借助寒冰花盆转换为南瓜</color>

english.name: Roasted Pumpkin
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Happy Halloween!" calls Roasted Pumpkin, handing out bags of candy to mischievous little plants. And when the candy's gone, don't forget to come see his stage play—he might just play the Headless Horseman himself!</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Roasted Pumpkin is just a Pumpkin physically, but a bright yellow visually.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Cannot be used for fusions.
<color=black>•</color> Can be converted to a regular Pumpkin using an Ice Pot.</color>

german.name: Roasted Pumpkin
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Happy Halloween!" calls Roasted Pumpkin, handing out bags of candy to mischievous little plants. And when the candy's gone, don't forget to come see his stage play—he might just play the Headless Horseman himself!</color>
german.info:
<size=36>A Pumpkin formed in intense temperatures, but not much different.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Cannot be used for fusions.
<color=black>•</color> Can be converted to a regular Pumpkin using an Ice Pot.</color>

original.name: 焰光地刺
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>总有人分不清火炬生产的地刺和普通地刺的区别，但火炬地刺本身很清楚：这再明显不过了，我让他们所走的道路成为了一条更加阳光明亮的康庄大道。</color>
original.info:
焰光映出的地刺，与地刺没有太多区别。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20/1秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>无法融合</color>

english.name: Roasted Spikeweed
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>After the test of fire, he's still the same old Spikeweed, just wiser, shinier, and ready to give the zombies a warmer welcome!</color>
english.info:
<size=36>A hot Spikeweed? What's the difference between him and the cooler Spikeweed?

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>300</color>
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Cannot be used in fusions.</color>

german.name: Golden Stachelkraut
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>总有人分不清火炬生产的地刺和普通地刺的区别，但火炬地刺本身很清楚：这再明显不过了，我让他们所走的道路成为了一条更加阳光明亮的康庄大道。</color>
german.info:
<size=36>火焰地刺？他也许跟地刺没有太多区别。

<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>300</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>？</color>
<color=black>

original.name: 焰光窝瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>焰光窝瓜总是一个接一个从窝炬里跳出来。“炼瓜炉里太热了，把我身体都要烤化了！”几个金色的焰光窝瓜一起喊道。</color>
original.info:
焰光汇聚而成的窝瓜，与窝瓜没有太多区别。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1800（压扁）</color>
<color=#3D1400>索敌范围：</color><color=red>左侧0.5格~右侧1格</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>无法融合</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>可以借助寒冰花盆转换为窝瓜</color>

english.name: Roasted Squash
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Roasted Squashes jump out from the Squash Torchwood one by one, "It's getting hot in there; our entire body is melting!" they declared.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Roasted Squash is a Squash summoned by Squashwood, works the same as the original.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>0.5 tiles to the left; 1 tile to the right</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Cannot be used for fusions.
<color=black>•</color> Can be converted to a regular Squash using an Ice Pot.</color></size>

german.name: Golden Matschkürbis
german.introduce: <size=30><color=black>火焰窝瓜总是一个接一个从窝炬里跳出来。"炼瓜炉里太热了，把我身体都要烤化了！"几个金色的火焰窝瓜一起喊道。</color></size>
german.info:
<size=30>他只是一个金色的窝瓜。

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800</color></size>

original.name: 焰光坚果
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“光芒，赐予我温暖，赐予我力量。”焰光坚果微笑着，散发出精致的光辉以及……孜然的味道。他刚从烧烤派对上回来，酥脆的外壳让大家对他充满了食欲，包括僵尸。</color>
original.info:
焰光汇聚而成的坚果，与坚果没有太多区别。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>无法融合</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>可以借助寒冰花盆转换为坚果</color>

english.name: Roasted Wall-nut
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Light, grant me warmth, grant me strength." Roasted Wall-nut smiles, radiating a delicate glow… and the scent of cumin. Fresh from a barbecue party, his crispy shell draws hungry eyes from everyone, zombies included.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Roasted Wall-nut is formed in intense temperatures, but not different at all from the original.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Cannot be used for fusions.
<color=black>•</color> Can be converted to a regular Wall-nut using an Ice Pot.</color>

german.name: Roasted Wall-nut
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Light, grant me warmth, grant me strength." Roasted Wall-nut smiles, radiating a delicate glow… and the scent of cumin. Fresh from a barbecue party, his crispy shell draws hungry eyes from everyone, zombies included.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>A Wall-nut formed in intense temperatures, but not much different.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Cannot be used for fusions.
<color=black>•</color> Can be converted to a regular Wall-nut using an Ice Pot.</color>

original.name: 铁桶大喷菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“我又被开除了！”之前还是磁力大喷菇的铁桶大喷菇哭诉道，“我不就是不小心把拿到的铁器做成了烧水壶嘛！”</color>
original.info:
坚硬如铁的大喷菇，喷射有效锈蚀一类防具的烟雾。可以融合橄榄帽。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>2000</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>50/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>铁植物。对有一类防具的僵尸造成3倍伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>磁性大喷菇（底座）+铁桶</color>

english.name: Rust-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>'I got canned again!' cries Rust-shroom, who was Morph-shroom just a moment ago. 'All I did was accidentally make a coffee maker instead of an oven!'</color>
english.info:
<size=36>There could be another twist if you give him a Football Helmet?

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>2000</color>
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>50/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Deals ×3 damage to Type 1 armors.</color>

german.name: Rostpilz
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>„Ich wurde schon wieder eingedost!“, ruft Rostpilz, der gerade eben noch Lockpilz war, „Alles, was ich getan habe, war, versehentlich eine Kaffeemaschine anstelle eines Ofens zu bauen!“</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Es könnte eine weitere Wendung geben, wenn du ihm einen Rugby-Helm gibst?

<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>2000</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1.5 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Verursacht dreimal mehr Schaden an Rüstungen.</color>

original.name: 仙人掌大喷菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“这里的迷雾太浓，我快要喘不过气来了。”仙人掌大喷菇嚷嚷着，拉伸身体、把头顶的呼吸孔伸到迷雾上方，这才好受一点，“终于舒服了，但是不能再升高了，不然就要缺氧啦。”</color>
original.info:
喷射烟雾来打击低空敌人，伸长菌盖后更能专注对空。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>射程4.5格，无限穿透，能穿透二类防具</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>点击可以切换作战模式
·低空模式：可同时对空对地
·高空模式：伤害×4，只对空</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大喷菇+仙人掌</color>

english.name: Saguaro-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"The fog is too thick! I can't breathe!" Saguaro-shroom exclaims, stretching his body to raise his breathing pores above the fog. "That's better… though I can't go any higher, or the air will soon be out of oxygen!"</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Saguraro-shroom fires stronger fumes on the ground, and can be clicked on to target aerial zombies instead.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1.5s (Piercing)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Click to switch between different attack modes:
<color=black>-</color> Low Altitude: hits both ground and air;
<color=black>-</color> High Altitude: ×4 damage, anti-air only.</color>

german.name: Stinktus
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"The fog is too thick! I can't breathe!" Saguaro-shroom exclaims, stretching his body to raise his breathing pores above the fog. "That's better… though I can't go any higher, or the air will soon be out of oxygen!"</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Fires heavy fume to strike low-flying enemies. Can extend to focus on aerial targets.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1.5s (Piercing)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Click to switch between different attack modes:
<color=black>-</color> Low Altitude: hits both ground and air;
<color=black>-</color> High Altitude: ×4 damage, anti-air only.</color>

original.name: 超级投手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“在我小的时候，长辈们总问我想当一个投什么的投手。”超级投手说，“他们都认为玉米，西瓜，卷心菜不可兼得，但我并不认为。虽然我那时还是小孩子，但我还是全都要。”</color>
original.info:
投出会分裂的超级蔬果卷，有概率连射。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>140/5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>有42%概率连射，连射可连射。子弹命中时分裂为1个玉米瓜（25%概率为黄油瓜）和1个卷心瓜</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>卷心菜投手+玉米投手+西瓜投手</color>

english.name: Salad-pult
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"When I was little, everyone asked what kind of Pult I wanted to be," says Salad-pult. "They thought you couldn't have it all. But I decided I wanted everything—even back then."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Salad-pult can catapult mixed projectiles in rapid succession.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>140/5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>42% chance of rapid-firing. Projectiles split into a mix of corn on the cobs (1/4 chance for buttered corn) and Overripe Melons upon hitting zombies.</color>

german.name: Salatpult
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>„Als ich klein war, fragte jeder, was für ein Pult ich sein wollte“, sagt Salatpult. „Sie dachten, man könne nicht alles haben. Aber ich entschied, ich wollte alles – schon damals.“</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Kann gemischte Projektile in schneller Folge katapultieren.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>140/5 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>42% Chance auf Schnellfeuer. Projektile zerfallen beim Auftreffen auf Zombies in eine Mischung aus Maiskörnern (1/4 Chance auf Butter) und Kohlköpfen.</color>

original.name: 胆小花盆
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>学校里，胆小花盆缩成一团、不敢和人交流，因为他种出来的蘑菇比其他同学的都要少，过于害怕的他并没有注意到，同学们都在羡慕他的蘑菇是最美味的。</color>
original.info:
根据上方植物的身价为其吹嘘造势。

<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>可种裸地，低矮，载体</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>为上方植物提供(0.04×该植物阳光价值)%的攻击力加成，上限为20%</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>上方的胆小菇类植物获得的加成为2×(基础加成+10%)</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>3×3范围内有僵尸时会害怕</color>
<color=#3D1400>④</color><color=red>提供的加成还受自身状态影响。生成时和处于害怕状态时，加成效率为0%。加成效率每秒恢复30%</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>花盆（底座）+胆小菇</color>

english.name: Scaredy Pot
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>At school, Scaredy Flower Pot always curls up and avoids interacting with others. Because the mushrooms he grows are fewer than those of his classmates, he believes he is inferior. What his fear prevents him from noticing is that his classmates are actually envious - the mushrooms he grows are the most delicious of all.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Scaredy Pot gives damage boosts based on the value of the plant placed on top, but loses it all when zombies approach it.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Grants the plant placed on top an attack damage bonus equal to [0.04 × (that plant's Sun cost)]%, up to 20%.
<color=black>•</color> If the plant on top is a Scaredy-type mushroom, the attack bonus becomes 2×(base bonus + 10%), up to 60%.
<color=black>•</color> Becomes frightened when zombies are present within a 3×3 area and stops providing attack bonus while frightened. After leaving the frightened state, the attack bonus gradually recovers over 3s.</color>

german.name: Furchttöpfchen
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>At school, Scaredy Flower Pot always curls up and avoids interacting with others. Because the mushrooms he grows are fewer than those of his classmates, he believes he is inferior. What his fear prevents him from noticing is that his classmates are actually envious - the mushrooms he grows are the most delicious of all.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Give boosts based on the value of the plant placed on top.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Grants the plant placed on top an attack damage bonus equal to [0.04 × (that plant's Sun cost)]%, up to 20%.
<color=black>•</color> If the plant on top is a Scaredy-type mushroom, the attack bonus becomes 2×(base bonus + 10%), up to 60%.
<color=black>•</color> Becomes frightened when zombies are present within a 3×3 area and stops providing attack bonus while frightened. After leaving the frightened state, the attack bonus gradually recovers over 3s.</color>

original.name: 壮胆南瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“相信我，里面非常安全。”壮胆南瓜会温柔地哄着胆小菇，内置留声机和童话故事册可以让他们不再担心尸群。</color>
original.info:
善于鼓励胆小植物的南瓜。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>2000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>本格的胆小菇类植物和胆小花盆不会害怕（毁灭胆小菇和毁灭机枪胆小菇不会自爆）</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>南瓜（底座）+胆小菇</color>

english.name: Scareless Pumpkin
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Trust me, it's very safe inside." Scareless Pumpkin gently reassures Scaredy-shroom, as the built-in phonograph and fairy tale books help them no longer worry about the zombie horde.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Scaredy plants inside the Scareless Pumpkin will no longer be afraid.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>2000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Scaredy plants inside the pumpkin will not be afraid (Frenzy-shroom and Gatling Frenzy-shroom will not self-destruct).</color>

german.name: Furchtloser Kürbis
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Trust me, it's very safe inside." Scareless Pumpkin gently reassures Scaredy-shroom, as the built-in phonograph and fairy tale books help them no longer worry about the zombie horde.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>A pumpkin with the color of the Scaredy-shroom. Scaredy plants inside the pumpkin will not be afraid.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>2000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Scaredy plants inside the pumpkin will not be afraid (Frenzy-shroom and Gatling Frenzy-shroom will not self-destruct).</color>

original.name: 焦黑三线射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>焦黑三线豌豆很不满“为什么反而受益的是辣椒呢？”焦黑三线豌豆三兄弟嘴里冒着烟“明明你们融合辣椒都会使火焰燃烧的更旺。”焦黑三线豌豆们向着火炬树桩抱怨“你不会想吃焦黑的豌豆的，相信我。“</color>
original.info:
倍增了火爆辣椒的效果，但自身被烧焦的三线射手。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40×3/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>出场时在本行和邻行释放火爆辣椒效果</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>受到肥料效果时，变回三线射手</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>三线射手+火爆辣椒</color>

english.name: Scorched Threepeater
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Why does Jalapeno always get all the credit?" Scorched Threepeater exclaimed, smoke escaping from his mouth. "If they only realized that fusing with Jalapeno burns your peas." He turned to Torchwood with a serious look. "Trust me, you wouldn't want to munch on charred peas!"</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Scorched Threepeater is the byproduct of burning multiple lanes, could use some fertilizer.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40×3/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Produces a line of flames that deal 1800 (Cremator) damage in three lanes when planted or fused. Can be turned back to a regular Threepeater with a Fertilizer.</color></size>

german.name: Verkohlter Triplinator
german.introduce: <size=34><color=black>„Warum bekommt Jalapeño immer die ganze Anerkennung?“, rief der Verkohlte Triplinator aus, Rauch entweichend aus seinem Mund. „Wenn sie nur wüssten, dass die Fusion mit Jalapeño deine Erbsen verbrennt.“ Er wandte sich mit ernstem Blick an Zunderholz. „Glaub mir, verkohlte Erbsen will niemand essen!“</color></size>
german.info:
<size=34>Ein Triplinator, der nicht fusionieren kann, weil er verkohlt ist.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20*3/1.5 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Erzeugt eine Flammenlinie, die 1800 (Einäscherung) Schaden in drei Bahnen verursacht, wenn sie gepflanzt oder fusioniert wird.</color></size>

original.name: 火焰地刺
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>辣其实是一种痛觉。火焰地刺让僵尸们切身体会了这一点。</color>
original.info:
触感火辣的地刺。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40/1秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>攻击会施加红温状态</color>
