<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>地刺+火爆辣椒</color>

english.name: Scorchweed
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Studies reveal that spiciness is actually a type of pain," Scorchweed announced, rattling the red thorns on his head. "I intend to let the unbelieving zombies experience this reality for themselves."</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Scorchweed pops tires and enflames zombies that step on them.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Attacks inflict Enflamed Debuff. Scorchweeds can be upgraded to Hearthrocks using a Fertilizer.</color>
<color=#720026>Enflamed Debuff: </color><color=#8B0000> Damage taken increases by 50%; zombies with this debuff explode on death, spreading it further.</color></size>

german.name: Brandkraut
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>„Studien zeigen, dass Schärfe eigentlich eine Art von Schmerz ist“, verkündete Brandkraut und klapperte mit den roten Dornen auf seinem Kopf. „Ich beabsichtige, den unglaubigen Zombies diese Realität selbst erleben zu lassen.“</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Brandkraut lässt Reifen platzen und entzündet Zombies, die darauf treten.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20, Inflicts the Entflammter Debuff</color>
<color=#720026>Entflammter Schwächungszauber: </color><color=#8B0000>Der erlittene Schaden erhöht sich um 50%; Zombies mit diesem Schwächungszauber explodieren beim Tod und verbreiten ihn weiter.</color></size>

original.name: 火爆树桩
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>高温和辣总是相得益彰，火爆树桩并不了解这些，但长期以来的烧烤摊工作确实为他添加了一分与众不同的热度。</color>
original.info:
爆燃的火炬树桩，点燃能力较强。

<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>影响经过的特定子弹</color>
<color=#A86A44>·豌豆及黄色火焰豌豆、土豆豌豆：</color><color=red>点燃，伤害+30</color>
<color=#A86A44>·寒冰豌豆：</color><color=red>变为豌豆</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>死亡时释放火爆辣椒效果</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>火炬树桩+火爆辣椒</color>

english.name: Scorchwood
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>High temperatures and spiciness always go hand in hand. Scorchwood may not grasp this concept, but his years of working at the barbecue stall have certainly infused him with a distinctive heat.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Projectiles ignited by the Scorchwood has greatly increased power.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Explodes like a Jalapeno upon death.
<color=black>•</color> Ignites projectiles for the following effects:
-Peas, Potatoes and Low-tier Ignited Peas: +30 damage
-Snow Peas: Turn into regular peas.</color></size>

german.name: Glutholz
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Heiße Temperaturen und Schärfe sind immer eine gute Kombination. Glutholz mag dieses Konzept vielleicht nicht ganz verstehen, aber seine Jahre am Grillstand haben ihm definitiv eine unverwechselbare Hitze verliehen.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Glutholz entzündet Projektile, wodurch ihre Kraft stark erhöht wird.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Verbessert den Schaden je nach Art des Geschosses. Entzündet die Lane beim Tod.
Erbsen: 60, Kirschen: 120, Böcke: 320, Sonnenlicht: 400, Dreifach-Erbse: 45</color></size>

original.name: 海蘑菇花盆
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“每天都待在潮湿的环境里，我迟早要发霉长蘑菇！”感受着潮湿的空气，海蘑菇花盆经常像这样抱怨道，哪怕她自己本身就是一个蘑菇。</color>
original.info:
汲取周围水源，以此增强岸上水草的活力。

<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮，载体，可种裸地</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>3×3范围有水路格子时，进入湿润状态：为3×3范围的陆生水草融合植物提供50%速度加成，究极系列则仅提供25%，该加成不可叠加</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>花盆（底座）+海蘑菇</color>

english.name: Sea Pot
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I'm surrounded by moisture every day. I'm going to grow mold and mushroom on myself sooner or later!" Sea Pot often complains like this while feeling the damp air, despite being a mushroom herself.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Sea Pot draws from nearby water sources to invigorate aquatic plants on land.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant. When there is a water tile within a 3×3 area, becomes Moist, granting aquatic plant fusions on land within the 3×3 area a 50% attack speed bonus. Odyssey plants only receive a 25% speed bonus. This bonus does not stack.</color>

german.name: Sea Pot
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I'm surrounded by moisture every day. I'm going to grow mold and mushroom on myself sooner or later!" Sea Pot often complains like this while feeling the damp air, despite being a mushroom herself.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Sea Pot draws from nearby water sources to invigorate aquatic plants on land.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant. When there is a water tile within a 3×3 area, becomes Moist, granting aquatic plant fusions on land within the 3×3 area a 50% attack speed bonus. Odyssey plants only receive a 25% speed bonus. This bonus does not stack.</color>

original.name: 杨桃海蘑菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“我的名字听起来很像动物，但其实不是。”杨桃海蘑菇说，“这只是我的艺名。我是能吐出各种形状孢子的魔法师。”他很讨厌潜水僵尸，因为潜水僵尸会发现他只是头顶着星形水枪的海蘑菇。</color>
original.info:
水生的杨桃，长大后变为两连发。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20×5/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>水生，低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>出场60秒后长大，攻击发射的星星数量翻倍</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>海蘑菇（底座）+杨桃</color>

english.name: Sea Star
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Though my name resembles that of an animal, it's just a stage name," Sea Star explained. "I'm a magician who can expel spores of various shapes." He harbors a deep dislike for diving zombies, worried they'll uncover the truth: he's simply a sea-shroom with a star-shaped water gun perched on his head.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Sea Star shoots twice as many projectiles when grown!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20×5 → 20×5×2/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special:</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>Growth Time: </color><color=#8B0000>60s</color></size>

german.name: Meerstern
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>„Obwohl mein Name an ein Tier erinnert, ist es nur ein Künstlername“, erklärte Meerstern. „Ich bin ein Magier, der Sporen in verschiedenen Formen versprühen kann.“ Er hegt eine tiefe Abneigung gegen tauchende Zombies, aus Angst, sie könnten das Geheimnis entdecken: Er ist einfach ein Meerpilz mit einer sternförmigen Wasserpistole auf dem Kopf.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Greift zweimal an, wenn er vollständig gewachsen ist.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20*5 → 20*5*2 / 1.5 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Zeit für Wachstum: </color><color=#8B0000>60 Sekunden</color></size>

original.name: 海蘑菇水雷
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>一进入泳池，海蘑菇水雷就像个水宝宝那样吸收水份，他相信这可以让自己的爆炸威力倍增。虽然事实确实如此，但他依然无法理解这其中的原理，就像他无法理解为什么泳池永远不会被僵尸填满一样。</color>
original.info:
可以长大两次的水生土豆雷。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>900</color>
<color=#3D1400>范围：</color><color=red>半径0.74格（限1行）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>水生，低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>默认处于出土状态</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>出场30秒后长大，伤害×2。再过30秒后再次长大，伤害范围提升至半径1.5格</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>海蘑菇（底座）+土豆雷</color>

english.name: Sea-mine
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The moment he enters the pool, Sea-mine absorbs water like a little water baby, convinced this will greatly amplify his explosive power. While this does turn out to be true, he still cannot understand how it all works, just as he cannot understand why the pool is never completely filled with dead zombies either.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Sea-mine can grow twice, increasing its damage and range with each growth.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>900 (Initial)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Starts in an armed state. Grows 30s after appearance, doubling its damage.
<color=black>•</color> After another 30s, grows again and increases explosion radius to 1.5 tiles across lanes.</color>

german.name: Sea-mine
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The moment he enters the pool, Sea-mine absorbs water like a little water baby, convinced this will greatly amplify his explosive power. While this does turn out to be true, he still cannot understand how it all works, just as he cannot understand why the pool is never completely filled with dead zombies either.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Aquatic and can grow twice.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>900 (Initial)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Starts in an armed state. Grows 30s after appearance, doubling its damage.
<color=black>•</color> After another 30s, grows again and increases explosion radius to 1.5 tiles across lanes.</color>

original.name: 海蘑菇坚果
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>海蘑菇坚果喜欢和水宝宝待在一起，看着它们吸水长大，圆滚滚的身体透射着七彩的虹光，倒影在童真的双眸中。“时光就像溪边飞过的蓝蝴蝶，一旦错过，就再也见不到了”</color>
original.info:
水生的坚果，吸水变大变高，最后随着水流向前滚去，碾压沿途的僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>2000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>水生</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>出场10秒、20秒后各长大一次，血量和韧性均+2000</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>出场30秒后，变为保龄球向前滚动，伤害为600/0.02秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>海蘑菇（底座）+坚果</color>

english.name: Sea-nut
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Sea-nut loves spending time with the Water Beads, watching them soak up water and grow, its round body shimmering with rainbow light, reflected in innocent eyes. "Time is like a blue butterfly fluttering past the stream~ Once it's gone, you'll never see it again~"</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Sea-nut grows larger and larger after being fused, eventually rolling down the lane and destroying all zombies in its wake..

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>2000 (initial), 6000 (max)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Grows at 10s and 20s after planting, increasing HP and Toughness by 2000 each time. At 30s after planting, turns into a bowling nut rolling forward, dealing 600 damage every 0.02s on contact.</color>

german.name: Flussnuss
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Sea-nut loves spending time with the Water Beads, watching them soak up water and grow, its round body shimmering with rainbow light, reflected in innocent eyes. "Time is like a blue butterfly fluttering past the stream~ Once it's gone, you'll never see it again~"</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Grows bigger by absorbing water, then rolls forward to crush zombies.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>2000 (initial), 6000 (max)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Grows at 10s and 20s after planting, increasing HP and durability by 2000 each time. At 30s after planting, turns into a bowling nut rolling forward, dealing 600 damage every 0.02s on contact.</color>

original.name: 海蘑菇南瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>海蘑菇南瓜曾经是世界河流联欢会的大明星、海蘑菇群的骄傲，现在却再也不能浮在水面上。一切的变化都来自那场堪称噩梦的万圣节晚会，他戴上南瓜头套、贡献了一段完美的表演，却发现自己再也摘不下这沉重的南瓜了。</color>
original.info:
能用海蘑菇的菌丝修补自身的南瓜。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>对其使用海蘑菇卡牌后，回复1/3倍韧性的血量</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>南瓜（底座）+海蘑菇</color>

english.name: Sea-shell
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Once a star performer at the World Marine Life Festival and the pride of the Sea-shroom colony, Sea-shell can no longer float on water. Everything changed after that dreadful Halloween party. He wore a pumpkin head for the perfect performance, only to find he could never take it off again.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Sea-shell can regenerate some of its health at the cost of a Sea-shroom.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Land plant. Can be fed Sea-shroom seed packets to heal by 1/3 max HP.</color>

german.name: Meereskürbis
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Once a star performer at the World Marine Life Festival and the pride of the Sea-shroom colony, Sea-shell can no longer float on water. Everything changed after that dreadful Halloween party. He wore a pumpkin head for the perfect performance, only to find he could never take it off again.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Regenerates itself using Sea-shroom seed packets.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Land plant. Can be fed Sea-shroom seed packets to heal by 1/3 max HP.</color>

original.name: 海鲨大喷菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“我来自宽广的海洋，”海鲨大喷菇骄傲地说，“看我这身鲨鱼拟态，可以吓退各种天敌，只有在海洋中才能进化出来。”他很喜欢和海蘑菇讲述自己过去的经历，但总是刻意隐去自己离开大海的原因：鲨鱼拟态经常会引来真正的鲨鱼。</color>
original.info:
爱吃海蘑菇的水生大喷菇，假借海妖菇的威势来吓退敌人。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>水生</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>对其使用海蘑菇卡牌后，10秒内，其射程提升至整行</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>击退3秒内曾被海妖菇击退的僵尸</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>海蘑菇（底座）+大喷菇</color>

english.name: Shark-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>'I come from the vast ocean,' Shark-shroom boasts. "With this shark mimicry, I can scare off any predator. It's an evolution only possible in the deep sea." He loves telling tales of his past to Sea-shrooms, but never reveals why he left the ocean: the disguise often attracts real sharks.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Shark-shroom 'feeds' on Sea-shrooms, boosting its range, it can also buff Kraken-shroom!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Using a Sea-shroom seed packet on him extends his range to the full lane for 10s.
<color=black>•</color> Knocks back zombies knocked back by Kraken-shroom within the last 3s.</color>

german.name: Haipilz
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I come from the vast ocean," Shark-shroom boasts. "With this shark mimicry, I can scare off any predator. It's an evolution only possible in the deep sea." He loves telling tales of his past to Sea-shrooms, but never reveals why he left the ocean: the disguise often attracts real sharks.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>A cannibalistic Fume-shroom that "feeds" on Sea-shrooms, borrowing the menace of Kraken-shroom to drive away enemies.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Using a Sea-shroom seed packet on him extends his range to the full lane for 10s.
<color=black>•</color> Knocks back zombies knocked back by Kraken-shroom within the last 3s.</color>

original.name: 寒冰胆小菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​寒冰胆小菇自认为不同于其他胆小菇，他可没有因为害怕缩起来过，平时的活动也是正常和大家参加。不过这都是因为他害怕起来的时候会把身边的空气变得极冷，所以大家都不敢吓他​</color>
original.info:
发射施加寒冷状态的寒冰孢子。害怕时短暂冻结附近的僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>害怕时冻结3×3范围内的僵尸。攻击施加寒冷状态，赋予10点冻结值。对冻结的僵尸伤害x4</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>胆小菇+寒冰菇</color>

english.name: Shivery-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Shivery-shroom believes he stands apart from other scaredy-shrooms. Unlike them, he never shrinks in fear and joins in all activities without hesitation. However, that's only because when he gets scared, the air around him plummets in temperature, leaving everyone too afraid to startle him.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Shivery-shroom fires freezing spores, and freezes zombies when they get near!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1.5s</color>
<color=#0077b6>Cryo System: </color><color=#8B0000>Attacks inflict chill, add 10 Cryo points and deal ×4 damage to frozen zombies.</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Freeze nearby zombies when they get near.</color></size>

german.name: Zitterpilz
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Zitterpilz glaubt, dass er sich von den anderen Angsthasenpilzen unterscheidet. Anders als sie schrumpft er nie vor Angst und nimmt ohne zu zögern an allen Aktivitäten teil. Doch das liegt nur daran, dass die Luft um ihn herum bei Angst rapide abkühlt, was alle anderen davon abhält, ihn zu erschrecken.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Zitterpilz schießt gefrierende Sporen ab.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5 Sekunden</color>
<color=#0077b6>Kryo-System: </color><color=#8B0000>10 Kryo-Punkte pro Angriff.</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Friere Zombies in der Nähe ein, wenn sie sich nähern.</color></size>

original.name: 银卷心菜投手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>除了银亮亮的外表，银卷心菜投手还有一颗银子般的心。银卷心菜投手梦想成为一名教师，并且已经想好了招牌：那就是“银菜师教”。</color>
original.info:
投出银卷心菜。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>60/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>可消耗1000金钱，升级为金卷心菜投手</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>金盏花+卷心菜投手</color>

english.name: Silver Cabbage
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Besides a shiny silver exterior, Silver Cabbage also has a heart of silver. Silver Cabbage dreams of becoming a teacher and already has a catchphrase in mind: "Silver Cabbage Instructor, at your service."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Silver Cabbage launches slightly more powerful silver cabbages at zombies.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>60/3s</color>

german.name: Silberkohl
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Neben einer glänzenden silbernen Oberfläche hat der Silberkohl auch ein Herz aus Silber. Der Silberkohl träumt davon, Lehrer zu werden, und hat sich bereits einen Slogan überlegt: „Silberkohl-Instructor, zu Ihren Diensten.“</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Schießt silberne Kohlköpfe ab, um Zombies anzugreifen.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>80/3 Sekunden</color>

original.name: 银毁灭菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>银毁灭菇将毁灭转为生财之道，并且积累了可观的财富。不过他总是爱好奢华，你看，他在赚到第一桶金之后当场就把金子用来买新皮肤了。</color>
original.info:
绝对稳定的银质毁灭菇。

<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>不会爆炸</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>可消耗6000金钱，升级为金毁灭菇</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>毁灭菇+金盏花</color>

english.name: Silver Doom-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Silver Doom-shroom turned destruction into a money-making venture — and a lucrative one at that. Of course, he spent his first fortune immediately... on a fancy new skin.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Silver Doom-shroom does not explode, he's waiting for his payment.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Does not explode.</color>

german.name: Silber-Unheilspilz
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Silver Doom-shroom turned destruction into a money-making venture — and a lucrative one at that. Of course, he spent his first fortune immediately... on a fancy new skin.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>A Doom-shroom that swapped bang for bling.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Does not explode.</color>

original.name: 银蒜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>银做的大蒜还有蒜味吗，应该没有吧，植物们都没有被他熏走，不过僵尸们也是这么想的，不过他们尝过之后就后悔了！</color>
original.info:
耐啃咬的银质大蒜。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>600</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>可消耗1000金钱，升级为金蒜</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大蒜+金盏花</color>

english.name: Silver Garlic
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Does a garlic made of silver still smell like garlic? Probably not, but neither the plants nor the zombies were eager to test it. However, zombies soon regretted their curiosity after a taste!</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Possibly an even more pungent garlic? Maybe.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>600</color>

german.name: Silberknoblauch
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Riecht ein Knoblauch aus Silber immer noch nach Knoblauch? Wahrscheinlich nicht, aber weder die Pflanzen noch die Zombies waren scharf darauf, es zu testen. Doch die Zombies bereuten ihre Neugier bald nach dem ersten Bissen!</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Möglicherweise ein noch stärkerer Knoblauch? Vielleicht.

<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>600</color>

original.name: 银魅惑菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>银魅惑菇话术高超，见识广博，光辉诱人，本来已经近乎完美了，只可惜她比魅惑菇缺少了艳丽的色彩，因而她忌讳“失色”以及一切类似的表述，后来推而广之，“大惊”也讳，“洗白”也讳，连“素”“暗”“褪”都讳了。</color>
original.info:
魅惑僵尸后，掉落银币。

<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>魅惑啃咬者后，掉落100金钱</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>可消耗1000金钱，升级为金魅惑菇</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>魅惑菇+金盏花</color>

english.name: Silver Hypno-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Silver Hypno-shroom has a silver tongue, a wealth of knowledge, and a radiant allure. She's nearly perfect, if only she weren't missing the vivid colors of her ordinary counterpart. As a result, she can't stand the phrase "lose one's luster" or anything resembling it. Eventually, even "petrified" and "whitewash" became taboo, along with words like "plain," "dim," and "fade."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Silver Hypno-shroom turns Zombies against each other and causes them to drop silver coins.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Drops 100 Coins after hypnotizing a zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Costs 1000 Coins to be upgraded to a Golden Hypno-shroom.</color>

german.name: Silver Hypno-shroom
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Silver Hypno-shroom has a silver tongue, a wealth of knowledge, and a radiant allure. She's nearly perfect, if only she weren't missing the vivid colors of her ordinary counterpart. As a result, she can't stand the phrase "lose one's luster" or anything resembling it. Eventually, even "petrified" and "whitewash" became taboo, along with words like "plain," "dim," and "fade."</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Silver Hypno-shroom turns Zombies against each other and causes them to drop silver coins.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Drops 100 Coins after hypnotizing a zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Costs 1000 Coins to be upgraded to a Golden Hypno-shroom.</color>

original.name: 银寒冰菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>无情，冷酷，这是银寒冰菇身上的标签，哪怕其他寒冰菇都认为他过于冷血。但银寒冰菇并不在意，他正是靠着冷酷才挣到了自己的身家，不够冷酷的家伙是无法在冷链运输行业立足的。</color>
original.info:
覆盖着银霜的寒冰菇。

<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>造成的冻结时间比普通寒冰菇多1秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>可消耗3000金钱，升级为金寒冰菇</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>寒冰菇+金盏花</color>

english.name: Silver Ice-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Ruthless. Cold-blooded. Those are the labels people stick on Silver Ice-shroom, even other Ice-shrooms think he's too icy. Silver Ice-shroom doesn't care. His success comes from being cold-hearted; anyone who isn't ruthless enough simply can't survive in the cold-chain logistics business.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Silver Ice-shroom freezes for a little longer.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Freezes for 1 second longer than a normal Ice-shroom.</color>

german.name: Silber-Eispilz
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Ruthless. Cold-blooded. Those are the labels people stick on Silver Ice-shroom, even other Ice-shrooms think he's too icy. Silver Ice-shroom doesn't care. His success comes from being cold-hearted; anyone who isn't ruthless enough simply can't survive in the cold-chain logistics business.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>An Ice-shroom coated in silver frost.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Freezes for 1 second longer than a normal Ice-shroom.</color>

original.name: 银玉米投手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“把银币扔给僵尸，为什么呀，为什么？虽然僵尸只是游戏数据，但我们总要给他些临终关怀吧？”银玉米投手之前是电影院引座员，发现自己是天生是说道理的料后便带着他的黄油和玉米粒踏入演讲圈。</color>
original.info:
投出银玉米粒或含有钱币的银黄油。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>有25%的概率投出银黄油，造成60伤害、获得25金钱并使目标定身4秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>可消耗2000金钱，升级为金玉米投手</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>玉米投手+金盏花</color>

english.name: Silver Kernel
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Why throw silver coins at zombies? Why, why? Even if zombies are just game data, we still ought to show them some final respects." Silver Kernel was once an usher in a theater, but after discovering his knack for lecturing, he entered the world of public speaking, bringing along his butter and corn kernels.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Silver Kernel fires silver kernels and silver butter to attack zombies, with a chance to earn some extra Coins.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/3s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Has a 1/4 chance to throw a silver money bag, dealing 60 damage, immobilizing the zombie for 4 Seconds, and dropping 25 Coins.</color>

german.name: Silberkorn
german.introduce: <size=30><color=black>„Warum silberne Münzen auf Zombies werfen? Warum, warum? Auch wenn Zombies nur Spieldaten sind, sollten wir ihnen trotzdem einen letzten Respekt erweisen.“ Silberkorn war einst ein Platzanweiser im Theater, aber nachdem er sein Talent für das Vortragen entdeckte, trat er in die Welt des öffentlichen Sprechens ein und brachte sein Butter und seine Kornkörner mit.</color>
german.info:
<size=30>Schießt silberne Körner und silberne Geldsäcke ab, um Zombies anzugreifen, mit einer Chance, Münzen zu verdienen.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>40/3 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Hat eine 1/4 Chance, einen silbernen Geldsack zu werfen, der 60 Schaden verursacht, den Zombie für 4 Sekunden bewegungsunfähig macht und 25 Münzen fallen lässt.</color>

original.name: 银西瓜投手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>银西瓜投手有时觉得自己是最值钱的西瓜，直到想起更有含金量的金西瓜投手。“银瓜是瓜，雕花、黄瓤、蒜味、金子做的瓜也是瓜，反正都是瓜，像这样瓜际圈越来越大……”，玉米瓜投手替银西瓜投手苦笑起来，“……不也挺好嘛。”</color>
original.info:
投出银西瓜。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>100/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>可消耗3000金钱，升级为金西瓜投手</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>金盏花+西瓜投手</color>

english.name: Silver Melon
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Silver Melon sometimes considers itself the most valuable melon—until it remembers the more prestigious Golden Melon. "A melon is a melon, whether it's silver, gilded, or made with garlic or gold," Silver Melon chuckles. "We all have our place in the soil."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Silver Melon launches slightly better silver melons to attack zombies.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>100/3s</color>

german.name: Silbermelone
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Die Silbermelone hält sich manchmal für die wertvollste Melone – bis sie an die prestigeträchtigere Goldmelone denkt. „Eine Melone ist eine Melone, egal ob sie silbern, vergoldet oder mit Knoblauch oder Gold gemacht ist“, lacht die Silbermelone. „Wir alle haben unseren Platz im Boden.“</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Schießt silberne Melonen ab, um Zombies anzugreifen.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>160/3 Sekunden</color>

original.name: 银花盆
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“很多人总是说金啊、银啊，好像我们存在等级制度，其实这只是名字而已，”银盆说，“金盏花是银色的，他也照样叫金盏花。”如果不是他的眼睛一直看着屋顶边缘的咖啡豆，他的话可能还有点说服力。</color>
original.info:
生产金钱的花盆。

<color=#3D1400>金钱产量：</color><color=red>25/25秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>可种裸地，低矮，载体</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>可消耗2000金钱，升级为金花盆。场上每有一株金载体植物，该消耗翻倍</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>花盆（底座）+金盏花</color>

english.name: Silver Pot
english.introduce: "People are always saying 'gold this, silver that,' as if we have a hierarchy," Silver Pot said. "Marigold is silver, yet it's still called a Marigold." His words might have been more convincing if his gaze weren't fixed on the coffee bean by the roof's edge.
english.info:
<size=36>Silver Pot generates extra silver for you while barely taking up any space!

<color=black>Coin Output: </color><color=#8B0000>25/25s</color>

german.name: Silbertopf
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>„Die Leute sagen immer ‚Gold dies, Silber das‘, als ob wir eine Hierarchie hätten“, sagte der Silbertopf. „Ringelblume ist silbern, und wird trotzdem ‚Gold‘ genannt.“ Seine Worte wären vielleicht überzeugender gewesen, wenn sein Blick nicht auf die Kaffeebohne am Rand des Daches gerichtet gewesen wäre.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Erzeugt zusätzliche Münzen für dich.

<color=black>Coin Output: </color><color=#8B0000>25/25 Sekunden</color>

original.name: 银向日葵
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>银向日葵带着从她阿酿那传下来的银饰技法，在花园售卖银器，甚至还有自己专属的文创工坊。正所谓“一脉相承阿酿技，八方共赏雅韵流”。</color>
original.info:
更快生产阳光的向日葵。

<color=#3D1400>阳光产量：</color><color=red>25/15秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>可消耗3000金钱，升级为金向日葵。场上每有一株金向日葵，该消耗翻倍</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>向日葵+金盏花</color>

english.name: Silver Sunflower
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Who says sunflowers only bask in the sun? Silver Sunflower has a knack for more than just growing—she's a master silversmith! With techniques passed down from her brewer, she forges dazzling silverware and jewelry, each piece shimmering with history. As they say, "A brewer's legacy lives on, and elegance never goes unnoticed."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Silver Sunflower generates Sun faster.

<color=black>Sun Output: </color><color=#8B0000>25/15s</color>

german.name: Silber-Sonnenblume
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Who says sunflowers only bask in the sun? Silver Sunflower has a knack for more than just growing—she's a master silversmith! With techniques passed down from her brewer, she forges dazzling silverware and jewelry, each piece shimmering with history. As they say, "A brewer's legacy lives on, and elegance never goes unnoticed."</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Generates Sun faster.

<color=black>Sun Output: </color><color=#8B0000>25/15s</color>

original.name: 银保护伞
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>银伞总是担心有人会趁他不在家时去偷他的钱，所以决定时时刻刻带着自己的钱财，哪怕对抗僵尸也不例外。他觉得这样就安全了，但其实会有新的风险。“这是我掉的钱，你们不能捡！”他悲愤地喊，可惜没人听他的。</color>
original.info:
弹走投掷物时获得金钱。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>弹走投掷物时获得25金钱</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>伞类击退：伤害40</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>可消耗1000金钱，升级为金保护伞</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>叶子保护伞+金盏花</color>

english.name: Silver Umbrella
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Silver Umbrella is always anxious about someone stealing his money when he's away, so he carries his fortune with him everywhere—even into battle against zombies. He thinks this keeps his wealth safe, but it only adds new risks. "That's my money; you can't take it!" he complains, though no one ever listens.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Silver Umbrella generates extra money for you when it deflects basketballs.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>1000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Drops 25 Coins each time it activates and knocks back approaching zombies, dealing 40 damage, at the cost of Toughness. For specific self damage amounts, see Umbrella Husk.</color>

german.name: Silberschirm
german.introduce: <size=34><color=black>Der Silberschirm ist immer besorgt, dass jemand sein Geld stiehlt, wenn er nicht da ist, also trägt er sein Vermögen überall mit sich – sogar in den Kampf gegen Zombies. Er denkt, das hält sein Vermögen sicher, aber es bringt nur neue Risiken mit sich. „Das ist mein Geld; du kannst es nicht nehmen!“, beklagt er sich, obwohl ihm nie jemand zuhört.</color>
german.info:
<size=34>Erzeugt zusätzliche Münzen für dich, wenn er Basketballs abwehrt.

<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>1000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Lässt bei jeder Aktivierung 25 Münzen fallen, wirft herannahende Zombies zurück und verliert jedes Mal Ausdauer. Siehe Schirmhülle.</color>

original.name: 银坚果
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“我是贵重物品，”银坚果说，“不要随意使用。”从保龄球馆辞职后，他开始考虑牵头组织“金银保护协会”，但一直没有进展，因为他把所有的钱都花在了保养自己的银漆上面。</color>
original.info:
韧性更高的银质坚果。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>6000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>可消耗1000金钱，升级为金坚果</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>坚果+金盏花</color>

english.name: Silver-nut
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I'm a valuable item," says Silver-nut, "Handle me with care." After quitting his job at the bowling alley, he thought about starting the "Nonferrous Metal Protection Association," but nothing came of it, as he'd spent all his money keeping his silver paint in perfect condition.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Silver Wall-nut is made of silver, and comes with higher Toughness.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>6000</color>

german.name: Silber-Nuss
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I'm a valuable item," says Silver-nut, "Handle me with care." After quitting his job at the bowling alley, he thought about starting the "Nonferrous Metal Protection Association," but nothing came of it, as he'd spent all his money keeping his silver paint in perfect condition.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Wall-nut made of silver, with higher toughness.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>6000</color>

original.name: 西瓜小投手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>西瓜小投手们很喜欢分享，他们想要和僵尸们分享西瓜，但他们的力气太小，于是就把西瓜切成小块向僵尸们扔过去，不过僵尸们似乎不太擅长接住这些西瓜块……</color>
original.info:
小小的西瓜投手，投出不会溅射但对缩小的僵尸威力加倍的西瓜片。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>80/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮，可密植</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>子弹不会溅射，对缩小的僵尸造成的伤害×2</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color>
<color=red>小喷菇（底座）+西瓜投手</color>

english.name: Slice-pult
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Slice-pults love to share, even with zombies. They chop their melons into small slices and toss them over. Strangely, zombies are terrible at catching them…</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Slice-pult trades its splash damage for a smaller size, and its projectiles are twice as effective against shrunken zombies!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>80/3s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Melon slices no longer do splash damage but deal double the damage to shrunken zombies.</color>

german.name: Melonen-Zwille
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Slice-pults love to share, even with zombies. They chop their melons into small slices and toss them over. Strangely, zombies are terrible at catching them…</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Melon slices lose the ability to do splash but are now twice effective against shrunken zombies.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>80/3s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Melon slices no longer do splash damage but deal double the damage to shrunken zombies.</color>

original.name: 寒冰射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​冷酷的寒冰射手一般不会对别的植物露出表情，有人评价他的内心比射出来的冰豆还冷。寒冰射手也不想这样啊，但是每次他开口，暴露出来的子弹就会把身边的氛围降到冰点。​</color>
original.info:
发射施加寒冷状态的寒冰豌豆。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>攻击施加寒冷状态，赋予10点冻结值。对冻结的僵尸伤害x4</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手+寒冰菇</color>

english.name: Snow Pea
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The cold-blooded Snow Pea rarely displays his emotions to other plants. Some say his heart is even colder than the snow peas he fires. Snow Pea doesn't want to come off that way, but every time he opens his mouth, the bullets he launches plunge the atmosphere around him to freezing temperatures.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Snow Peas shoot snow peas that damage and slow the enemy.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5s</color>
<color=#0077b6>Cryo System: </color><color=#8B0000>Each snow pea inflicts chill and adds 10 Cryo points. Deals ×4 damage to frozen zombies.</color></size>

german.name: Hagelzuckererbse
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Die Leute sagen ihr immer, wie 'cool' sie sei. Sie sagen, sie solle einen 'kühlen Kopf' bewahren. Hagelzuckererbse verdreht nur die Augen. Gibt es keine originellen Sprüche mehr?</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Hagelzuckererbsen verschießen gefrorene Erbsen, die den Feind schädigen und aufhalten.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5 Sekunden</color>
<color=#0077b6>Kryo-System: </color><color=#8B0000>Jedes Geschoss fügt 10 Kryo-Punkte hinzu.</color></size>

original.name: 寒冰双发射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“你是怎么变成这样的？”有人这样问寒冰双发射手“其实我是双发射手，我只是在冬天睡觉时忘了盖被子”。</color>
original.info:
发射寒冰豌豆的双发射手。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20×2/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>增生豆荚：</color><color=red>出场15秒后手动点击，即可升级为寒冰裂荚射手</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手×2+寒冰菇</color>

english.name: Snow Repeater
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Whatever happened to you?" a curious plant asked Snow Repeater. He chuckled softly and said, "I'm still a Repeater at heart. I just forgot to snuggle under a blanket during winter nights."</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Snow Repeater shoots two snow peas in quick succession.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20×2/1.5s</color>
<color=#0077b6>Cryo System: </color><color=#8B0000>Each attack adds 10 Cryo points.</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Tap to auto-fuse with a free Peashooter 15s after planting.</color></size>

german.name: Schneiduplinator
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>„Was ist dir nur passiert?“, fragte eine neugierige Pflanze Schneiduplinator. Er schmunzelte leise und sagte: „Ich bin immer noch ein Duplinator im Herzen. Ich habe nur vergessen, mich in kalten Winternächten unter eine Decke zu kuscheln.“</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Schießt zwei gefrorene Erbsen nacheinander ab.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20*2/1.5 Sekunden</color></size>

original.name: 寒冰三线射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>相比其他同类，寒冰三线射手的三个头可以各自独立伸到更远的地方，这得益于他们的出生时间相差很大。他们用头顶的冰锥数量区分大小：老大两颗冰锥、因为是凌晨两点出生，老二一颗冰锥、因为是下午一点出生，老三三颗冰锥、代表他是老三。</color>
original.info:
向场上任意三行发射寒冰豌豆。

<color=#3D1400>索敌范围：</color><color=red>全场地表</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20×3/1秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>会向僵尸最靠左的至多三行，各发射一发寒冰豌豆，施加寒冷状态，赋予10冻结值，对冻结的僵尸造成4倍伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>三线射手+寒冰菇</color>

english.name: Snow Threepeater
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Unlike other plants of their kind, the three heads of Snow Threepeater can each stretch farther on their own, thanks to the large gaps between their birth times. They distinguish their ages by the number of icicles on their heads: the eldest has two icicles, having been born at 2 a.m.; the second has one icicle, having been born at 1 p.m.; and the youngest has three icicles, because he's the third-born.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Snow Threepeater fires Snow Peas at any three rows on the field.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20×3/1s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Fires one Ice Pea at each of up to 3 rows with the leftmost zombies; attacks inflict Chill, 10 Cryo Points and deal ×4 damage to frozen zombies.</color>

german.name: Snow Threepeater
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Unlike other plants of their kind, the three heads of Snow Threepeater can each stretch farther on their own, thanks to the large gaps between their birth times. They distinguish their ages by the number of icicles on their heads: the eldest has two icicles, having been born at 2 a.m.; the second has one icicle, having been born at 1 p.m.; and the youngest has three icicles, because he's the third-born.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Snow Threepeater fires Snow Peas at any three rows on the field.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20×3/1s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Fires one Ice Pea at each of up to 3 rows with the leftmost zombies; attacks inflict Chill, 10 Cryo Points and deal ×4 damage to frozen zombies.</color>

original.name: 阳光三叶草
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>阳光三叶草总挂着软乎乎的笑，常念叨：“万里无云，沐着带阳光味的春风，多惬意呀！”可惜僵尸不懂这份美好——她吹的可不是温柔春风，是实打实的阳光子弹。</color>
original.info:
能吹出大量阳光子弹的三叶草。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>10×72</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>旋转叶片，按螺旋线发射两圈共72个阳光子弹，命中时掉落5阳光</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>向日葵+三叶草</color>

english.name: Solar Blover
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Solar Blover always wears a gentle smile, often saying, "Clear skies and a spring breeze filled with sunshine - how pleasant!" Sadly, zombies don't understand this beauty. What she blows out isn't a soft spring wind, it's pure solar wind.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Solar Blover shoots out many sun shots while active, dropping sun when hitting zombies.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>10×72</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Spins its leaves and fires two spirals totaling 72 Sun Shots. Each shot drops 5 Sun upon hitting a target and can be buffed by Infernowood to deal 40 damage and drop 15 Sun instead.</color>

german.name: Sonnenwind
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Solar Blover always wears a gentle smile, often saying, "Clear skies and a spring breeze filled with sunshine - how pleasant!" Sadly, zombies don't understand this beauty. What she blows out isn't a soft spring wind, it's pure solar wind.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Capable of blowing out a large number of Sun shots.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>10×72</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Spins its leaves and fires two spirals totaling 72 Sun Shots. Each shot drops 5 Sun upon hitting a target and can be buffed by Infernowood to deal 40 damage and drop 15 Sun instead.</color>

original.name: 阳光炸弹
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​“所以…很明显…我们是光之美少女对吧。”兴奋的向日葵俩姐妹正在努力按压自己兴奋的心情“这个世界在等着我们救赎呢”“来吧，把光芒洒向这片大地吧，我就要忍不住啦！” 激情再也压制不住，她们异口同声地喊出了“光！”</color>
original.info:
释放炸到僵尸时产生阳光的樱桃爆炸。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1800（灰烬）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每伤害一个僵尸，获得25阳光</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>向日葵+樱桃炸弹</color>

english.name: Solar Bomb
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"So… it's obvious… we are Pretty Cures, aren't we?" The two Sunflower sisters tried to suppress their excitement. "The world needs us to save it!" Their passion bubbled over as they shouted together, "Flash!"</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Solar Bomb can produce extra Sun after exploding zombies!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Cremator)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Produces 25 Sun for each zombie killed in the explosion.</color></size>

german.name: Solarbombe
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>„Also… es ist offensichtlich… wir sind Pretty Cure, oder?“ Die beiden Sonnenblume-Schwestern versuchten, ihre Aufregung zu unterdrücken. „Die Welt braucht uns, um sie zu retten!“ Ihre Leidenschaft kochte über, als sie gemeinsam riefen: „Licht! Erleuchte dieses Land!“</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Solarbombe kann Sonne produzieren, nachdem sie Zombies getötet hat.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Einäscherung)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Erzeugt 25 Sonnen für jeden Zombie, der bei der Explosion getötet wird.</color></size>

original.name: 阳光大嘴花
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​大家都想知道阳光大嘴花是怎么把吃下去的僵尸转化成阳光的，可一问到这件事时他总是支支吾吾。直到有一天向日葵发现自己的叶绿素存量莫名大幅减少了，大家才明白过来：阳光大嘴花不是把僵尸转化成了阳光。​</color>
original.info:
消化完成时能获得阳光的大嘴花。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>秒杀（吞食）</color>
<color=#3D1400>消化时间：</color><color=red>40秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>消化完成时获得100阳光</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大嘴花+向日葵</color>

english.name: Solar Chomper
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Everyone was curious about how Solar Chomper transformed the zombies it devoured into sunlight, but it always hesitated to share its secret. One day, Sunflower discovered that her Plant Food content had significantly diminished, revealing the truth: it wasn't actually turning zombies into sunlight.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Solar Chomper can produce Sun after swallowing zombies.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>Insta-kill (Devour)</color>
<color=black>Digestion Time: </color><color=#8B0000>40s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Produces 100 Sun after swallowing a zombie.</color></size>

german.name: Solar-Schnapper
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Alle waren neugierig, wie Solar-Schnapper die Zombies, die er verschlang, in Sonnenlicht verwandelte, aber er zögerte immer, sein Geheimnis zu teilen. Eines Tages entdeckte Sonnenblume, dass ihr Chlorophyllgehalt deutlich gesenkt war, was die Wahrheit offenbarte: Er verwandelte Zombies nicht wirklich in Sonnenlicht.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Solar-Schnapper kann Sonne produzieren, nachdem er Zombies verschlungen hat.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000> Sofortiges Töten</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Erzeugt 100 Sonne nach dem Verschlucken von Zombies.</color></size>

original.name: 阳光辣椒
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>到底为什么很多植物对她有疏离感呢？她百思不得其解：“我可以生产阳光，我还可以攻击僵尸！”她认为自己比火爆辣椒更阳光，但是植物们觉得她比火爆辣椒更火爆。</color>
original.info:
燃烧其他植物以增强自身威力，炸到僵尸或植物时都会产生阳光。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1800（灰烬）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>会对本行的所有植物造成伤害，但有1/3概率保留植物1点血量</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>每伤害一个植物，获得50阳光，并使自身对僵尸的伤害增加500</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>每伤害一个僵尸，获得25阳光</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>向日葵+火爆辣椒</color>

english.name: Solar Flare
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Why do so many plants feel distant from her? She can't figure it out: "I can both defend you and bring you sunshine!" She believes she's brighter and sunnier than Jalapeno, but other plants think she's more destructive.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Solar Flare can convert both zombies AND plants into sun!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Cremator)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Returns 25 Sun for every zombie hit.
<color=black>•</color> Also deals 1800 damage to all plants in her lane. Each affected plant drops 50 Sun and boosts Solar Flare's damage by 500. If a plant would be destroyed, it has a 1/3 chance to survive with 1 HP remaining.</color>

german.name: Sonnenbrand
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Why do so many plants feel distant from her? She can't figure it out: "I can both defend you and bring you sunshine!" She believes she's brighter and sunnier than Jalapeno, but other plants think she's more destructive.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Burns other plants to enhance her power.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Cremator)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Returns 25 Sun for every zombie hit.
<color=black>•</color> Also deals 1800 damage to all plants in her lane. Each affected plant drops 50 Sun and boosts Solar Flare's damage by 500. If a plant would be destroyed, it has a 1/3 chance to survive with 1 HP remaining.</color>

original.name: 阳光土豆雷
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​平时阳光开朗，但接触后会暴露地雷系的本质。</color>
original.info:
生产阳光的土豆雷，爆炸时额外获得阳光。

<color=#3D1400>阳光产量：</color><color=red>25/15秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1800</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>出场时返还25阳光，死亡时获得50阳光</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>土豆雷+向日葵</color>

english.name: Solar Mine
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Stop at red lights, slow down at yellow lights, and obey traffic rules!" Solar Mine frequently warns zombies. But to the zombies, all they see is the disgusting green hue before them. He clutches his green leaves and pouts, wishing for more sunshine. "After all, sunshine is what fuels us all!"</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Solar Mine produces Sun at a fast rate until it explodes into a final burst.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>1800</color>
<color=black>Sun Output: </color><color=#8B0000>25/15s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Fusion returns 25 Sun.
<color=black>•</color> Drops 50 Sun on explosion.</color></size>

german.name: Solar-Mine
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>„Stoppe an roten Ampeln, bremse bei gelben Ampeln und befolge die Verkehrsregeln!“ Solar-Mine warnt Zombies häufig. Aber für die Zombies ist alles, was sie sehen, der ekelhaft grüne Farbton vor ihnen. Er klammert sich an seine grünen Blätter, schmollt und wünscht sich mehr Sonnenschein. „Schließlich ist Sonnenschein das, was uns alle antreibt!“</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Solar-Mine produziert Sonne bis und nach seiner Explosion.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800</color>
<color=black>Sonnenproduktion: </color><color=#8B0000>25/15 Sekunden</color></size>

original.name: 阳光花盆
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“你们觉得花盆这个词是什么意思？”阳光花盆发问，“是用来种花的盆呢？还是本身就是花的盆？不管你们怎么想，毫无疑问——我是一个花盆。”</color>
original.info:
生产少量阳光的花盆。

<color=#3D1400>阳光产量：</color><color=red>15/25秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>可种裸地，低矮，载体</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>花盆（底座）+向日葵</color>

english.name: Solar Pot
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"What do you guys think 'flower pot' means, huh?" Solar Pot snapped. "Is it a pot for growing flowers? Or is it a pot that is a flower? Either way, let's get one thing straight—I am a flowerpot. End of discussion."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Solar Pot generates a little extra Sun for you while taking up barely any space!

<color=black>Sun Output: </color><color=#8B0000>15/25s</color>

german.name: Solar-Topf
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"What do you guys think 'flower pot' means, huh?" Solar Pot snapped. "Is it a pot for growing flowers? Or is it a pot that is a flower? Either way, let's get one thing straight—I am a flowerpot. End of discussion."</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Generates extra Sun for you.

<color=black>Sun Output: </color><color=#8B0000>15/25s</color>

original.name: 阳光窝瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>阳光窝瓜最喜欢的事就是用叶子摸一摸头上的花瓣，然后得意地向其他窝瓜炫耀：“这就是用了阳光生发水的效果，看我柔顺的头发。”好在其他窝瓜都面貌严肃、不会取笑他，所以他至今都不知道自己长的是地中海发型。</color>
original.info:
自信、阳光的窝瓜，离场后，可以通过消耗阳光重返战场。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1800（压扁）</color>
<color=#3D1400>索敌范围：</color><color=red>左侧0.5格~右侧1格</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>离场时（被铲除的情况除外），可以消耗50阳光并在当前位置重返战场</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>每重返战场一次，之后需要消耗的阳光增加25</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>重返战场失败时，返还50阳光</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>窝瓜+向日葵</color>

english.name: Solar Squash
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Solar Squash's favorite thing to do is gently pat the petals on his head with his leaf, then boast proudly to other Squashes: "This is what Sun-powered shampoo does. Just look how smooth my hair is." Luckily for him, the other Squashes are all very serious and never tease him, so he still doesn't know he's sporting a classic receding hairline.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Solar Squash can consume Sun to remain on the lawn after squashing.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>0.5 tiles to the left; 1 tile to the right</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Upon landing or dying, consumes 50 + 25 * (Number of previous revivals) Sun to remain on the tile of the landing spot/revive. If this fails, 50 Sun is refunded.</color>

german.name: Sonnenmatsch
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Solar Squash's favorite thing to do is gently pat the petals on his head with his leaf, then boast proudly to other Squashes: "This is what Sun-powered shampoo does. Just look how smooth my hair is." Luckily for him, the other Squashes are all very serious and never tease him, so he still doesn't know he's sporting a classic receding hairline.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Can consume Sun to remain on the lawn after squashing.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>0.5 tiles to the left; 1 tile to the right</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Upon landing or dying, consumes 50 + 25 * (Number of previous revivals) Sun to remain on the tile of the landing spot/revive. If this fails, 50 Sun is refunded.</color>

original.name: 阳光坚果
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​阳光坚果总是以天使自居，但他不知道的是植物们经常在他背后讨论“要是他再加几条黑线简直和蜜蜂一模一样。”</color>
original.info:
能生产阳光的坚果，每次破损都会额外获得阳光。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>阳光产量：</color><color=red>25/15秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>血量首次低于某个损伤点（2/3倍韧性、1/3倍韧性）时，获得25阳光。死亡时获得50阳光</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>坚果+向日葵</color>

english.name: Solar-nut
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Solar-nut always sees himself as an angel, blissfully unaware that the other plants often talk behind his back. "You know, if he adds a few black lines, he'd look exactly like a bee!"</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Solar-nut produces Sun while protecting your plants, and produces a little burst when cracking.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Damage Phases: </color><color=#8B0000>1333/2666</color>
<color=black>Sun Output: </color><color=#8B0000>25/15s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Produces 25 Sun on damage phase transitions. Drops 50 Sun on death.</color>

german.name: Solar-Nuss
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Solar-Nuss sieht sich immer als Engel, ohne zu wissen, dass die anderen Pflanzen oft hinter seinem Rücken reden. „Weißt du, wenn er ein paar schwarze Linien hinzufügt, würde er genau wie eine Biene aussehen!“</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Solar-Nuss produziert Sonne und schützt deine Pflanzen.

<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Sonnenproduktion: </color><color=#8B0000>25/15 Sekunden</color>

original.name: 阳光卷心菜投手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>有的人问为什么阳光卷心菜扔的小阳光扔出屋顶右侧就不见了？阳光卷心菜只是笑笑：“不然你以为前院的阳光都是哪里来的？”</color>
original.info:
投出能弹射、能产光的阳光卷心菜。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>50/5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>通过融合来生成时，返还100阳光</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>子弹能弹射1次，当前每有200阳光额外弹射一次，最多5次。命中或落地时产生5阳光</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>向日葵+卷心菜投手</color>

english.name: Solar-pult
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Some people ask why Solar-pult's little Suns disappear when thrown over the roof's right side. Solar-pult just smiles: "Where do you think the front yard's Suns comes from?"</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Launches solar cabbages to attack zombies and generate sun.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>50/5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Returns 100 Sun upon fusion. Each shot bounces once after hitting a zombie. For every 200 Sun, it can bounce one more time; each bounce drops 5 Sun.</color></color>

german.name: Solarpult
german.introduce: <size=32><color=black>Manche Leute fragen sich, warum die kleinen Sonnen von Solarpult verschwinden, wenn sie über die rechte Seite des Daches geworfen werden. Solarpult lächelt nur: „Wo denkst du, kommt die Sonne im Vorgarten her?“</color>
german.info:
<size=32>Solarpult schleudert Solar-Kohlköpfe, um Zombies anzugreifen, und kann auch Sonne erzeugen.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>50/5 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Gibt bei der Verschmelzung 100 Sonne zurück. Jeder Schuss prallt einmal ab, nachdem er einen Zombie getroffen hat. Für jeweils 200 Sonnen kann er ein weiteres Mal abprallen; wenn er einen Zombie oder den Boden trifft, fällt er 5 Sonnen.</color></color>

original.name: 豌豆向日葵
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​“其实背后的向日葵是我妹妹”豌豆向日葵对大家说 “我们从出生就在一起了，她喜欢产阳光，然后我就可以代表阳光消灭你” 不过大家都知道阳光开朗的豌豆哥哥是个不折不扣的妹控，毕竟所有想靠近他妹妹的僵尸都被阳光砸死了。”</color>
original.info:
能生产阳光，并发射命中时获得阳光的子弹。

<color=#3D1400>阳光产量：</color><color=red>25/25秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>30/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每第3发子弹，在命中目标时掉落5阳光</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>向日葵+豌豆射手</color>

english.name: Solar-shooter
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Actually, the Sunflower behind me is my sister," Solar-shooter explained to everyone. "We've been inseparable since birth. She loves producing Sun, and I destroy zombies on her behalf." But everyone knows the truth: the cheerful Pea brother is a total siscon. After all, every zombie that gets near his sister mysteriously ends up vaporized by sunlight.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Solar-shooter can fire Sun shots that occasionally produce Sun.

<color=black>Sun Output: </color><color=#8B0000>25/25s</color>
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>30/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Every third shot drops 5 Sun when hitting targets.</size>

german.name: Erbsen-Sonnenblume
german.introduce: <size=34><color=black>"Eigentlich ist die Sonnenblume hinter mir meine Schwester", erklärte Erbsenkanone allen. "Wir sind seit der Geburt unzertrennlich. Sie liebt es, Sonne zu produzieren, und ich zerstöre Zombies in ihrem Auftrag." Aber jeder weiß die Wahrheit: Der fröhliche Erbsenbruder ist ein totaler Siscon. Immerhin wird jeder Zombie, der sich seiner Schwester nähert, auf mysteriöse Weise von Sonnenlicht verdampft.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=34>Erbsen-Sonnenblume kann Sonnenkugeln abfeuern, die Sonne erzeugen.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>100/5 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Kugeln lassen beim Auftreffen auf Zombies 5 Sonne fallen.</size>

original.name: 阳光杨桃
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“我是阳桃，不是杨桃！不要把我们弄混了！”阳桃一直致力于向大家解释自己和杨桃不一样，但是他粗枝大叶的朋友们并不在意这些小节，唯一支持他的是僵尸，因为阳桃比杨桃硌牙多了。</color>
original.info:
消耗阳光发射高伤害的星星。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>100×5</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>每次攻击消耗25阳光</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>不会索敌，需要手动点击攻击</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>本格有杨桃南瓜时，自动每0.35秒攻击一次</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>杨桃+向日葵</color>

english.name: Solarfruit
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I'm Solarfruit, not Sunny Five-fingers! Don't mix us up!" Solarfruit always tries to explain that he's different from Sunny Five-fingers, but his plant friends don't care. The only supporters he has are the zombies, since they think fingers are definitely more annoying to gnaw on than fruits.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Solarfruit can be click on to turn some of your sun into 5 stars!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>100×5</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Click on a Solarfruit to spend 25 Sun and make it shoot 5 100-damage Stars in 5 directions.
<color=black>•</color> Uses Sun and shoots automatically every 0.35s if placed in a Starry Pumpkin.</color>

german.name: Sonnenstern
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I'm Solarfruit, not Sunny Five-fingers! Don't mix us up!" Solarfruit always tries to explain that he's different from Sunny Five-fingers, but his plant friends don't care. The only supporters he has are the zombies, since they think fingers are definitely more annoying to gnaw on than fruits.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Uses Sun to shoot high-damage stars.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>100×5</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Click on a Solarfruit to spend 25 Sun and make it shoot 5 100-damage Stars in 5 directions.
<color=black>•</color> Uses Sun and shoots automatically every 0.35s if placed in a Starry Pumpkin.</color>

original.name: 阳光地刺
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>阳光地刺紧紧地贴在地上，这是她对大地母亲热爱的体现，那地面下嗡嗡震动的声音，是大地爵士乐最美的节拍——哦，还有僵尸们集体踩过地面的震动，那是最让人讨厌的杂音。</color>
original.info:
能在攻击时生产阳光的地刺。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20/1秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>攻击时掉落5阳光</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>地刺+向日葵</color>

english.name: Solarweed
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Solarweed clings tightly to the ground, a reflection of her love for Mother Earth. The buzzing vibrations underground are the finest rhythm of Earth's jazz, though the stomping of zombies passing over is her most hated noise.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Solarweed generates sun when it pokes a zombie.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Drops 5 sun on each attack.</color>

german.name: Solarweed
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Solarweed clings tightly to the ground, a reflection of her love for Mother Earth. The buzzing vibrations underground are the finest rhythm of Earth's jazz, though the stomping of zombies passing over is her most hated noise.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Solarweed generates sun when it pokes a zombie.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Drops 5 sun on each attack.</color>

original.name: 毁灭大喷菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>厌世害俗的毁灭大喷菇非常讨厌看见僵尸，因为这会拖累他的下班时间。他准备的子弹不多，却足够致命。“没什么事不要喊我，真的是，子弹要用的话就自己发射吧”虽然如此，高效工作的他仍然被大家所敬畏。</color>
original.info:
装填完成后，手动点击，对整行喷射毁灭烟雾。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1800</color>
<color=#3D1400>装填时间：</color><color=red>30秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>手动点击，攻击本行前方的非飞行僵尸</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大喷菇+毁灭菇</color>

english.name: Soot-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Soot-shroom, the misanthropic workaholic, can't stand the sight of zombies—too much of a distraction. He's got a small stash of bullets, but they're more than lethal enough. "Don't bother me unless it's urgent. If you want them dead, just shoot them yourself." Still, his sharp efficiency keeps everyone looking up to him.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Soot-shroom sends a high damaging fume across the entire lane on click.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>1800/30s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Click manually to attack all zombies in the row in front.</color></size>

german.name: Rußpilz
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Rußpilz, der misanthropische Workaholic, kann den Anblick von Zombies nicht ertragen – viel zu ablenkend. Er hat eine kleine Munition vorrätig, aber die ist mehr als tödlich genug. „Stört mich nicht, es sei denn, es ist dringend. Wenn ihr sie tot haben wollt, schießt selbst.“ Trotzdem sorgt seine scharfe Effizienz dafür, dass alle zu ihm aufsehen.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Rußpilz kann die meisten Zombies vor sich zerstören.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800/60 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Klicken Sie manuell, um alle Zombies in einer Reihe anzugreifen.</color></size>

original.name: 杨桃树桩
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>大学毕业后，杨桃树桩回到了山区做支教，“从接受教育的那一刻，我就明白知识就是要‘星火’相传的！”知识的火焰点燃了学生们的热情，也点燃了僵尸。</color>
original.info:
专用于点燃星星类子弹的火炬树桩。

<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>点燃经过的星星子弹（尖刺星星和玩偶匣星星除外），伤害+20并失去原有特点。点燃的星星子弹溅射方式类似火焰豌豆</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>杨桃+火炬树桩</color>

english.name: Sparkwood
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>After graduating from university, Sparkwood returned to the mountainous region to teach. "From the moment I received an education, I understood that knowledge is meant to be passed on like a 'spark'!" The flame of knowledge ignited the students' enthusiasm and also the zombies.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Sparkwood ignites star projectiles.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Ignites passing star-shaped projectiles (except thorn stars and jack-in-the-box stars), adding 20 damage and removing their other traits. Ignited stars do splash damage in a similar way to ignited peas.</color>

german.name: Funkelholz
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>After graduating from university, Sparkwood returned to the mountainous region to teach. "From the moment I received an education, I understood that knowledge is meant to be passed on like a 'spark'!" The flame of knowledge ignited the students' enthusiasm and also the zombies.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>A Torchwood shaped like a Starfruit, ignites star projectiles.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Ignites passing star-shaped projectiles (except thorn stars and jack-in-the-box stars), adding 20 damage and removing their other traits. Ignited stars do splash damage in a similar way to ignited peas.</color>

original.name: 豌豆胆小菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>豌豆胆小菇在马戏团学了一手快抛豌豆的绝活，谁也不知道他最多能以这种速度抛多少个豌豆。他很乐意向僵尸们展示展示，但他们靠得太近时可不行，这会暴露他的魔术技巧的。</color>
original.info:
疯狂地提升攻速和伤害，但害怕时会前功尽弃。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>每次攻击获得5%攻速加成，最多因此提升150%。害怕时重置该加成</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>每5%攻速加成使伤害+1</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>胆小菇+豌豆射手</color>

english.name: Speedy-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Speedy-shroom learned a remarkable rapid-fire pea tossing trick from the circus. No one knows just how many peas he can throw at that speed. He'd love to show it off to the zombies, but not when they get too close — that would reveal how the trick works.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Speedy-shroom rapidly increases its attack speed and damage while firing, but loses everything when frightened.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Gains 5% attack speed and +1 damage after every attack, up to +150% attack speed and +30 damage. This bonus is reset when frightened.</color>

german.name: Speedy-shroom
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Speedy-shroom learned a remarkable rapid-fire pea tossing trick from the circus. No one knows just how many peas he can throw at that speed. He'd love to show it off to the zombies, but not when they get too close — that would reveal how the trick works.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Speedy-shroom rapidly increases its attack speed and damage while firing, but loses everything when frightened.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Gains 5% attack speed and +1 damage after every attack, up to +150% attack speed and +30 damage. This bonus is reset when frightened.</color>

original.name: 黑曜石辣椒菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>外表冰冷，内心炽热，这是其他植物对黑曜石辣椒菇的评价。“别看我表面平静，真正爆发时的能量，绝对超乎你的想象。”黑曜石辣椒菇低语道。</color>
original.info:
为全场植物承伤，离场时释放火爆辣椒效果和寒冰菇效果。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>32000</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1800（灰烬）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>为全场植物承伤</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>每1秒，流失韧性20％的血量</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>死亡时，依次释放火爆辣椒效果（不受减伤影响）和寒冰菇效果</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>火爆辣椒+寒冰菇</color>

english.name: Spicicle
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Cold on the outside, fiery on the inside. This is how other plants describe Spicicle. "Don't be fooled by my calm appearance, my explosive energy is beyond your imagination," murmurs Spicicle. Oh, by the way, he's also quite skilled at making ice-cream.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Spicicle can take damage on the behalf of any plant on the lawn, and explodes in a burning cold explosion on death!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>1800</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>32000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Loses 20% Toughness every 3 seconds. While present, absorbs damage for all plants. Upon death, triggers Jalapeno in his row (ignores damage reduction) and fullscreen Ice-shroom.</color>

german.name: Hielopeño
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Cold on the outside, fiery on the inside. This is how other plants describe Frostburnt Jalapeno. "Don’t be fooled by my calm appearance, my explosive energy is beyond your imagination," murmurs Frostburnt Jalapeno. Oh, by the way, he's also quite skilled at making ice-cream.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Has both the properties of Ice-shroom and Jalapeno!

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800</color>
<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>32000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Loses 20% health every 3 seconds. While present, absorbs damage for all plants. Upon death, triggers Jalapeno in his row and fullscreen Ice-shroom.</color>

original.name: 火爆水草
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“常言道‘热情如火’，火爆水草对此可是深有体会，他那燃烧的激情连水都无法浇灭！可惜他旁边的僵尸只能感受到热情的‘烧烤’，却听不到水草的‘热情’发言，因为他们已经在这股烈焰中化为灰烬了！”</color>
original.info:
蕴含火爆辣椒力量的缠绕水草。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>秒杀（溺死）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>死亡时释放火爆辣椒效果</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>缠绕水草（底座）+火爆辣椒</color>

english.name: Spicy Kelp
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Passion is like fire," and Spicy Kelp knows this saying all too well. No amount of water can quench their fervent flames! Too bad, the nearby zombies can only feel the heat of the "grilling". Look at them, they have already turned to ashes in this relentless fire!</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Spicy Kelp will burn the entire row of zombies upon contact.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>Insta-kill (Drown) + 1800 (Cremator)</color></size>

german.name: Scharfertang
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>„Leidenschaft ist wie Feuer“, und Scharfertang kennt dieses Sprichwort nur zu gut. Kein Wasser kann die brennenden Flammen zähmen! Schade, dass die Zombies in der Nähe nur die Hitze des „Grillens“ spüren können. Sieh sie dir an, sie sind schon zu Asche geworden in diesem unerbittlichen Feuer!</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Scharfertang verbrennt die gesamte Reihe von Zombies bei Kontakt.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000> Sofortiges Töten + 1800 (Einäscherung)</color></size>

original.name: 火爆窝瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“我不像我的兄弟那样急不可耐”火爆窝瓜不紧不慢的说道，“他总是想着做事要快点快点再快点，但是真正致胜的法宝在于伺机而动。”</color>
original.info:
蕴含火爆辣椒力量的窝瓜，比较冲动好斗。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1800（压扁）</color>
<color=#3D1400>索敌范围：</color><color=red>左侧2格~右侧3格</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>落地时，释放伤害与自身攻击力相同的火爆辣椒效果</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>窝瓜+火爆辣椒</color>

english.name: Spicy Squash
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I'm not as impatient as my brother," Spicy Squash stated calmly. "He rushes through everything, but I've learned that true success comes from patience and careful observation. Sometimes, it's best to wait and let the fire simmer."</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Spicy Squash can burn a whole row of zombies upon crushing a zombie.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000> 1800 (Single tile, Squash) + 1800 (Lane, Cremator)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>2 tiles to the left; 3 tiles to the right</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Releases Jalapeno effect when crushing zombies.</color></size>

german.name: Scharfmatschkürbis
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>„Ich bin nicht so ungeduldig wie mein Bruder“, erklärte Scharfmatschkürbis ruhig. „Er stürzt sich kopfüber in alles, aber ich habe gelernt, dass wahrer Erfolg aus Geduld und genauer Beobachtung entsteht. Manchmal ist es das Beste, zu warten und das Feuer langsam köcheln zu lassen.“</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Scharfmatschkürbis kann eine ganze Reihe von Zombies verbrennen.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000> 1800 (Einzelfliese) + 1800 (Fahrspur + Einäscherung)</color></size>

original.name: 火爆杨桃
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>火爆杨桃沉默地瞪着眼，其他杨桃都对他敬而远之：“他看起来太可怕了。” 但火爆杨桃并不在意，他正专注于设计一场极致的艺术。他坚信，当自己绽放的那一刻，所有人都将为之侧目。</color>
original.info:
易燃易爆炸的杨桃，释放火爆星星。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>100×25</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>融合时不会释放火爆辣椒效果。出场1秒后自爆。死亡时释放火爆辣椒效果，爆出25个火爆星星</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>火爆辣椒+杨桃</color>

english.name: Spicy Starfruit
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Spicy Starfruit silently glares, while the other starfruits keep their distance: "He looks too scary." But Spicy Starfruit doesn't care; he is focused on creating an ultimate piece of art. He firmly believes that when he finally blooms, everyone will take notice.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Spicy Starfruit explodes and releases high-damage spicy stars.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>100 × 25</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Does not trigger the Jalapeno effect Immediately when fused. Explodes instead 1 second after fusion, releasing Jalapeno effect and exploding into 25 spicy stars.</color>

german.name: Weißer Zwerg
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Spicy Starfruit silently glares, while the other starfruits keep their distance: "He looks too scary." But Spicy Starfruit doesn't care; he is focused on creating an ultimate piece of art. He firmly believes that when he finally blooms, everyone will take notice.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Explodes and releases high-damage spicy stars.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>100 × 25</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Does not trigger the Jalapeno effect Immediately when fused. Explodes instead 1 second after fusion, releasing Jalapeno effect and exploding into 25 spicy stars.</color>

original.name: 地刺花盆
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>所有和地刺花盆相处过的植物都抱怨他太过热情又分不清界限，只有玄钢地刺坚果不在意这点，原因很简单，只有地刺花盆会愿意给锋利的玄钢刺外壳除锈。</color>
original.info:
拥有地刺特点的花盆，能增强地刺坚果类植物的防御。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20/1秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>可种裸地，低矮，载体</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>为地刺坚果和玄钢地刺坚果提供50%减伤</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>上方植物为玄钢地刺坚果时，自身免疫碾压，且触发扎胎后不会消失</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>花盆（底座）+地刺</color>

english.name: Spike Pot
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Every plant that's spent time with Spike Pot complains that he's far too enthusiastic and has no sense of personal boundaries. Only Obsidian Spike-nut doesn't mind, and the reason is simple: Spike Pot is the only one willing to help de-rust Obsidian Spike-nut's razor-sharp shell.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Spike Pot has Spikeweed traits and enhances the defenses of Spike-nut plants.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant. Inherits traits from Spikeweed (ignored by biting zombies and pops tires).
<color=black>•</color> Grants 50% damage reduction to Spike-nut and Obsidian Spike-nut on him.
<color=black>•</color> Becomes anti-crush if the plant above is an Obsidian Spike-nut.</color>

german.name: Stacheltopf
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Every plant that's spent time with Spike Pot complains that he's far too enthusiastic and has no sense of personal boundaries. Only Obsidian Spike-nut doesn't mind, and the reason is simple: Spike Pot is the only one willing to help de-rust Obsidian Spike-nut's razor-sharp shell.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Has Spikeweed traits and enhances the defenses of Spike-nut plants.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant. Inherits traits from Spikeweed (ignored by biting zombies and pops tires).
<color=black>•</color> Grants 50% damage reduction to Spike-nut and Obsidian Spike-nut on him.
<color=black>•</color> Becomes anti-crush if the plant above is an Obsidian Spike-nut.</color>

original.name: 缠绕水刺
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>缠绕水刺总是自卑，因为他是不起眼的一族里最不起眼的小家伙，还有一半身躯藏在水面下。其他地刺常常开导他：“没关系的，至少人们对你的关注度比地刺坚果高。”</color>
original.info:
攻击时可以赋予水草值的水生地刺。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20/1秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>水生</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>攻击赋予1点水草值。攻击载具时受伤10</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>缠绕水草（底座）+地刺</color>

english.name: Spike-kelp
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Spike-Kelp always felt like the runt of the spikeweed family—small, unnoticeable, and half-submerged. The others tried to cheer him up: "Hey, at least you're still more popular than that prickly old Spike-nut."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Spike-kelp applies Tangle Value to zombies that swin over it.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Attacks add 1 Tangle Value. Takes 10 damage every time he attacks a vehicle.</color>

german.name: Stacheltang
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Spike-Kelp always felt like the runt of the spikeweed family—small, unnoticeable, and half-submerged. The others tried to cheer him up: "Hey, at least you're still more popular than that prickly old Spike-nut."</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Spikeweed but aquatic and tangly.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Attacks add 1 Tangle Value. Takes 10 damage every time he attacks a vehicle.</color>

original.name: 地刺坚果
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>地刺坚果总是在怒视前方，“我这是在提醒他们，我并不好吃。”但僵尸们根本不把他放在眼里，毕竟他平时就不被人重视。</color>
original.info:
长满尖刺的坚果，被啃咬时造成反伤，对车辆特攻。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>拥有50点啃咬反伤。能抵抗车辆碾压，扎破轮胎时受伤500</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>坚果+地刺</color>

english.name: Spike-nut
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Spike-nut is always glaring, always frowning. "I need them to know I'm not a snack," he insists. The zombies, however, just laugh—because when has a Wall-nut ever been scary? Then they take a bite. Then they learn. The hard way.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Spike-nut punctures the tires of approaching Zombonis, and will still be standing afterwards!

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Reflects 50 damage back to zombies biting it.
<color=black>•</color> Punctures incoming tires in exchange for 500 Toughness. It cannot protect against submarines or being stomped by Gargantuars.</color>

german.name: Stachelnuss
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Spike-nut is always glaring, always frowning. "I need them to know I'm not a snack," he insists. The zombies, however, just laugh—because when has a Wall-nut ever been scary? Then they take a bite. Then they learn. The hard way.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Spike-nut punctures the tires of approaching Zombonis!!

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Reflects 50 damage back to zombies biting it.
