<color=black>•</color> Punctures incoming tires in exchange for 500 Robustheit. It cannot protect against submarines or being stomped by Gargantuars.</color>

original.name: 地刺王
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>地刺王刚刚从欧洲旅行回来;在玩的尽兴同时也结识了很多有趣的人。这增长了他的见识，他从来不知道，他们建造了这么大的博物馆有如此多的艺术创作，这对他而言太神奇了。</color>
original.info:
更强韧的地刺，能扎破多个轮胎。
<color=#800080>需要种植在地刺上</color>

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>450</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20×2/1秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>拥有地刺的特点，扎破轮胎或被巨人砸击时受伤50，被机械巨人碾压受伤150</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>地刺（底座）+地刺王或其卡片/肥料</color>

english.name: Spikerock
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Spikerock just got back from a trip to Europe. He had a great time, met some wonderful people, really broadened his horizons. He never knew they made museums so big, or put so many paintings in them. That was a big surprise for him.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Spikerocks pop multiple tires and hurt any zombies that step on them.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20×2/1s</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>450</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Can only be placed on existing Spikeweeds. Can puncture tires, but deducts 50 Toughness. Loses 50 Toughness when slammed on by Gargantuars and loses 150 when stomped on by Mecha Gargs.</color></size>

german.name: Stachelstein
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Stachelstein ist gerade von einer Europareise zurückgekehrt. Es war phantastisch, er lernte viele nette Leute kennen und erweiterte seinen Horizont enorm. Nie hätte er gedacht, dass es so große Museen mit so vielen Gemälden darin gibt. Das war eine Riesenüberraschung für ihn.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Stachelsteine zerstechen mehrere Reifen und verletzen Zombies, die drauftreten.

<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>450</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Kann Reifen durchstechen, zieht aber 50 Ausdauer ab.</color></size>

original.name: 地刺南瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>地刺南瓜不太愿意与其他植物交流，一部分原因是他的嘴在地下不方便张开，另一部分原因是他总被问及他的身子为什么在土里，以及他为何要保留这种独特的发型。而这两个问题有着同一个答案：从天而降的仙人掌窝瓜。</color>
original.info:
坚硬的外壳能强韧地刺类植物并为其抵御攻击。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>能抵抗碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>不会阻挡僵尸</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>能代替本格地刺类植物和地刺坚果承受碾压；且能通过受到500伤害，使其扎胎后不会消失</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>南瓜（底座）+地刺</color>

english.name: Spiky Pumpkin
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>piky Pumpkin isn't very fond of talking to other plants. Partly because it's difficult to open his mouth when it's underground, and partly because he's always being asked why his body is buried in the soil and why he keeps that peculiar hairstyle. Both questions have the same answer: Cactus Squash falling from the sky.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Spiky Pumpkin strengthens Spikeweeds and shields them from attacks.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Low plant. Anti-crush. Does not block zombies.
<color=black>•</color> Can take crushing attacks in place of Spikeweeds and Spike-nuts on the same tile. Can also take 500 damage to prevent them from disappearing after popping a tire.</color>

german.name: Spiky Pumpkin
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>piky Pumpkin isn't very fond of talking to other plants. Partly because it's difficult to open his mouth when it's underground, and partly because he's always being asked why his body is buried in the soil and why he keeps that peculiar hairstyle. Both questions have the same answer: Cactus Squash falling from the sky.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Spiky Pumpkin strengthens Spikeweeds and shields them from attacks.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Low plant. Anti-crush. Does not block zombies.
<color=black>•</color> Can take crushing attacks in place of Spikeweeds and Spike-nuts on the same tile. Can also take 500 damage to prevent them from disappearing after popping a tire.</color>

original.name: 海窝瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>海窝瓜是海滩景区的救生员，大家都惊叹于他如此沉重的身躯却能自由地在水面上游弋。对于自己的游泳能力，海窝瓜也一直讳莫如深，只是说：“这可不是能轻松做到的。”事实上他能浮起来全靠头顶提供升力的气球帽子，而这款帽子的生产商家早在十年前就倒闭了。</color>
original.info:
水生的窝瓜。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1800（压扁）</color>
<color=#3D1400>索敌范围：</color><color=red>左侧0.5格~右侧1格</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>海蘑菇（底座）+窝瓜</color>

english.name: Splash
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Splash works as a lifeguard at a seaside resort. Everyone is amazed that such a heavy body can still glide effortlessly across the water. When asked about it, he always replies, "That's not something easy to do." In truth, he floats thanks to a buoyant balloon hat, whose manufacturer Hopcap went bankrupt ten years ago.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Splash crushes zombies in the water.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>0.5 tiles to the left; 1 tile to the right</color>

german.name: Platschkürbis
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Splash works as a lifeguard at a seaside resort. Everyone is amazed that such a heavy body can still glide effortlessly across the water. When asked about it, he always replies, "That's not something easy to do." In truth, he floats thanks to a buoyant balloon hat, whose manufacturer Hopcap went bankrupt ten years ago.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Aquatic squash.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>1800 (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>0.5 tiles to the left; 1 tile to the right</color>

original.name: 流光中继射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“该轮到我戴帽子了。”“但帽子的系带是系在我下巴上的。”流光中继射手的两个头总是处在争论中，哪怕泳池灯火联欢会也无法影响，唯一能让他们停止争抢帽子的事情就是争抢眉毛。</color>
original.info:
接受左侧的激光供给，发射高频激光。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>10</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>右侧的头颅拥有流光豌豆射手的特点</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>左侧的头颅能接收本行流光射手类植物（不可紧邻）的光能</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手×3+路灯花</color>

english.name: Split Beam
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"It's my turn to wear the hat." "But the strap is under my chin."The two heads of the Lumen Relay Shooter argue constantly. Even the Pool Light Festival can't distract them - the only thing that stops the argument is when they start fighting over the eyebrows instead.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Split Beam receives beam energy from the left uses that energy to increase to power of its own beam.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>10/0.2s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> The right head functions like a Beamshooter.
<color=black>•</color> The left head can receive Lumos energy from beamshooter-family plants in the same lane (not in directly adjacent tile).
<color=black>•</color> Click on it will reset its target.</color>

german.name: Split Beam
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"It's my turn to wear the hat." "But the strap is under my chin."The two heads of the Lumen Relay Shooter argue constantly. Even the Pool Light Festival can't distract them - the only thing that stops the argument is when they start fighting over the eyebrows instead.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Receives laser energy from the left and fires high-frequency lasers.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>10/0.2s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> The right head functions like a Beamshooter.
<color=black>•</color> The left head can receive Lumos energy from beamshooter-family plants in the same lane (not in directly adjacent tile).
<color=black>•</color> Click on it will reset its target.</color>

original.name: 火辣裂荚射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“混蛋！我们的支援在哪里？左边的机枪射手往右挪一挪！”火辣裂荚射手的脾气非常臭，他总是因为战场上的一些小事大发雷霆，甚至不惜把更有活力的那个头对准自己后方的战友——幸好，他暂时还没有愤怒到向自己的战友射击。</color>
original.info:
发射火辣豌豆的裂荚射手。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>30×3/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>攻击施加红温状态</color>
<color=#3D1400>增生豆荚：</color><color=red>出场15秒后手动点击，即可升级为火辣机枪射手</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手×3+火爆辣椒</color>

english.name: Split Blaze
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Damn it! Where's our support? Machine gunner on the left, move right!" Hot-tempered and easily enraged, this shooter often yells at teammates, though luckily, he hasn't started firing at them yet.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Split Blaze fires Blaze Peas both forwards and backwards.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>30×3/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Attacks inflict Enflamed debuff.
<color=black>•</color> Tap to auto-fuse with a free Peashooter 15s after planting.</color>

german.name: Knallflamme
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Damn it! Where's our support? Machine gunner on the left, move right!" Hot-tempered and easily enraged, this shooter often yells at teammates, though luckily, he hasn't started firing at them yet.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Fires Blaze Peas in triple bursts.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>30×3/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Attacks inflict Enflamed debuff.
<color=black>•</color> Tap to auto-fuse with a free Peashooter 15s after planting.</color>

original.name: 樱桃裂荚射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>樱桃裂荚射手从战壕里爬出来说：“是谁？谁扔的炸弹？”“不好意思，兄弟，看你把枪口朝着我们，我还以为你是僵尸呢。”超级樱桃射手不好意思地说。</color>
original.info:
发射粉樱桃子弹的裂荚射手。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40×3/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>子弹触碰到左侧屏幕边缘会反弹</color>
<color=#3D1400>增生豆荚：</color><color=red>出场15秒后手动点击，即可升级为樱桃机枪射手</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手×3+樱桃炸弹</color>

english.name: Split Cherry
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Cherryshooter crawled out of the trench, bewildered. "Who threw that bomb?" he demanded. "Sorry, brother," Split Cherry replied sheepishly, "I saw you pointing your gun at us and thought you were a zombie."</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Split Cherry shoots cherries forward and backwards.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40×3/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Tap to auto-fuse with a free Peashooter 15s after planting.</color></size>

german.name: Knallkirsche
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Kirschkanone kroch aus dem Graben, verwirrt. „Wer hat diese Bombe geworfen?“, fragte er. „Tut mir leid, Bruder“, antwortete Knallkirsche schüchtern, „ich habe dich mit der Waffe auf uns zeigen sehen und dachte, du wärst ein Zombie.“</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Knallkirsche schießt Kirschen nach vorne und hinten.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>60*3/1.5 Sekunden</color></size>

original.name: 魅惑裂荚射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“我感觉有点晕！”“其实还好吧。”“不，我都晕头转向了。”“但你的头是在后面。”“这只是比喻而已。”“我也只是按照字面意思来看而已。”“这俩兄弟又吵架了，”魅惑豌豆射手说道，“这大概是他们俩吵的第3682次架。”</color>
original.info:
发射魅惑豌豆的裂荚射手。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>30×3/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>杀死僵尸时，召唤一个植物方的魅惑豌豆射手僵尸</color>
<color=#3D1400>增生豆荚：</color><color=red>出场15秒后手动点击，即可升级为魅惑机枪射手</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手×3+魅惑菇</color>

english.name: Split Hypno
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I feel dizzy!" "Actually it's not that bad." "No, I'm totally disoriented." "But your head's in the back." "That's just a figure of speech." "And I'm being literal." "These two brothers are arguing again," says Hypno Pea, "probably their 3,682nd time."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Split Hypno shoots hypno peas both forwards and backwards.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>30×3/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Summons a Hypnotized Hypno Pea Zombie upon kill.
<color=black>•</color> Tap to auto-fuse with a free Peashooter 15s after planting.</color>

german.name: Knallhypno
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I feel dizzy!" "Actually it's not that bad." "No, I'm totally disoriented." "But your head's in the back." "That's just a figure of speech." "And I'm being literal." "These two brothers are arguing again," says Hypno Pea, "probably their 3,682nd time."</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Split Pea that fires Hypno Peas.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>30×3/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Summons a Hypnotized Hypno Pea Zombie upon kill.
<color=black>•</color> Tap to auto-fuse with a free Peashooter 15s after planting.</color>

original.name: 裂荚射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>裂荚射手是豌豆里的双子兄弟，经常为了子弹应当向前还是向后射击争论不休。不过现在来看，他们貌似是通过子弹的反弹解决了这个问题。</color>
original.info:
向前发射一颗豌豆，向后发射两颗会回弹的豌豆。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20×3/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>子弹触碰到左侧屏幕边缘会反弹</color>
<color=#3D1400>增生豆荚：</color><color=red>特定的裂荚射手出场15秒后，手动点击即可升级为对应的机枪射手</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手×3</color>

english.name: Split Pea
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The Split Pea brothers always argued over the best direction to fire—forward or backward. But now they've found a clever solution: just let the peas rebound. Problem solved!</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Split Peas shoot peas forward and backwards.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20×3/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special:</color><color=#8B0000> Peas shot backwards will rebound upon reaching the edge of the screen.</color></size>

german.name: Knallerbse
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Die Brüder Knallerbse stritten sich immer über die beste Schussrichtung - vorwärts oder rückwärts. Aber jetzt haben sie eine clevere Lösung gefunden: Sie lassen die Erbsen einfach abprallen. Problem gelöst!</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Knallerbsen verschießen Erbsen nach vorn und hinten.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20*3/1.5 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Rückwärts geschossene Erbsen hüpfen und bewegen sich vorwärts.</color></size>

original.name: 裂荚小喷菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>前面的头说：“轮到我用眉毛了！”后面的头说：那只好一人一半了。虽然出生就差两分钟，可眉毛争夺战的硝烟永难停息。</color>
original.info:
向前发射一颗小豌豆，向后发射两颗会回弹的小豌豆。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20×3/2.25秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮，可密植</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>子弹触碰到左侧屏幕边缘会反弹</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>小喷菇（底座）+豌豆射手×3</color>

english.name: Split Pea-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The front head declares, 'My turn to use the eyebrow!' The back head replies, 'Guess we'll have to split it.' Born just two minutes apart, their eternal battle over the eyebrow shows no signs of stopping.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Split Pea-shroom shoots small peas both forward and backward.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20×3/2.25s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant. Backward peas rebound if no zombie is hit.</color>

german.name: Knallerbsenpilz
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Der vordere Kopf erklärt: „Ich bin dran mit dem Augenbrauen-Einsatz!“ Der hintere Kopf antwortet: „Dann müssen wir sie wohl teilen.“ Gerade mal zwei Minuten auseinander geboren, zeigt ihr ewiger Kampf um die Augenbraue keine Anzeichen des Aufhörens.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Schießt Erbsen sowohl nach vorne als auch nach hinten.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20x3/1.5 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Erbsen prallen nach hinten ab, wenn kein Zombie getroffen wird.</color>

original.name: 蒜毒裂荚射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>发射能够反弹的子弹，是每一个裂荚射手在新时代必须要学会的技术，但蒜毒裂荚射手却是个例外，他只需要把蒜毒豌豆向身后的屋内发射，之后自然会有人因为无法忍受气味而替他把豌豆丢回来。</color>
original.info:
发射蒜豌豆的裂荚射手。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>30×3/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>子弹命中时赋予1蒜值。如果目标处于中毒状态，在其位置生成一个毒瘴</color>
<color=#3D1400>增生豆荚：</color><color=red>出场15秒后手动点击，即可升级为蒜毒机枪射手</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手×3+大蒜</color>

english.name: Split Poison
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Bouncing shots are a must-have skill for modern Split Peas, but Split Poison did not bother to learn it. Nor does he had to. He can simply fire garlic peas into the house behind it, and sooner or later someone will throw them right back.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Split Poison fires poison peas both forwards and backwards.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>30×3/1.5s</color>
<color=#5E1675>Poison System: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Projectiles add 1 Poison value to zombies on hit.
<color=black>•</color> If the zombie hit is already in a Poisoned state, creates a Toxic Cloud at the zombie's feet.</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000> Tap to auto-fuse with a free Peashooter 15s after planting.

german.name: Knallknoblauch
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Bouncing shots are a must-have skill for modern Split Peas, but Split Poison did not bother to learn it. Nor does he had to. He can simply fire garlic peas into the house behind it, and sooner or later someone will throw them right back.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Fires garlic peas both forwards and backwards.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>30×3/1.5s</color>
<color=#5E1675>Poison System: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Projectiles add 1 Poison value to zombies on hit.
<color=black>•</color> If the zombie hit is already in a Poisoned state, creates a Toxic Cloud at the zombie's feet.</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000> Tap to auto-fuse with a free Peashooter 15s after planting.

original.name: 寒冰裂荚射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“别看他外表这么冰冷，说不定他还有不为人知的另一面呢？”只有矿工僵尸对此嗤之以鼻：“别瞎猜了，这家伙的另一面也是冷的！”</color>
original.info:
发射寒冰豌豆的裂荚射手。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20×3/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>子弹触碰到左侧屏幕边缘会反弹</color>
<color=#3D1400>增生豆荚：</color><color=red>出场15秒后手动点击，即可升级为寒冰机枪射手</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手×3+寒冰菇</color>

english.name: Split Snow
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Don't let his icy facade mislead you; there could be a hidden warmth," someone suggested. But Digger Zombie sneered, "Don't make foolish assumptions. This guy has nothing but cold sides!"</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Split Snow shoots snow peas forwards and backwards.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20×3/1.5s</color>
<color=#0077b6>Cryo System: </color><color=#8B0000>Each attack adds 10 Cryo points.</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Tap to auto-fuse with a free Peashooter 15s after planting.</color></size>

german.name: Knallschnee
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>„Lass dich nicht von seiner eisigen Fassade täuschen; vielleicht verbirgt sich eine versteckte Wärme“, schlug jemand vor. Aber Buddel-Zombie grinste spöttisch: „Macht keine dummen Annahmen. Dieser Kerl hat nur kalte Seiten!“</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Knallschnee schießt gefrorene Erbsen nach vorne und hinten.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20*3/1.5 Sekunden</color></size>

original.name: 西瓜弹弹菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“屏息，凝神，一击必杀！”西瓜弹弹菇富有耐心，总是等到最合适的时机才出手。如果你问他是怎么沉得住气的，他总会提及模仿者老师。</color>
original.info:
瓜藤盘绕的大蘑菇，蓄力后弹射西瓜。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>120/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>射程4.5格。不攻击时蓄力至少4.5秒，发射时使子弹伤害增至（1+蓄力时间×0.5）倍，蓄力上限30秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大喷菇+西瓜投手</color>

english.name: Spring Melon
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Holding your breath, focusing, and striking with precision!" Spring Melon is very patient, always waiting for the perfect moment to make a move. If you ask him how he manages to stay calm, he will always mention his mentor, Imitater.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Spring Melon charges its attack when no zombies are near, then uses that energy to launch a powerful melon when they get close!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>120/4s</color>
<color=black>Range:</color><color=#8B0000> 4 tiles ahead</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Charges when not attacking for at least 4.5s to increase damage to (1 + charge time × 0.5) times the base damage. Maximum charge time: 30s.</color>

german.name: Sprungmelone
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Holding your breath, focusing, and striking with precision!" Spring Melon is very patient, always waiting for the perfect moment to make a move. If you ask him how he manages to stay calm, he will always mention his mentor, Imitater.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>A big shroom with coiling vines that lob watermelons after charging.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>120/4s</color>
<color=black>Range:</color><color=#8B0000> 4 tiles ahead</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Charges when not attacking for at least 4.5s to increase damage to (1 + charge time × 0.5) times the base damage. Maximum charge time: 30s.</color>

original.name: 西瓜地刺
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>和他那位慵懒的表兄不同，西瓜地刺对待他心理健康治疗的工作可是十分勤快。虽然迄今为止，他唯一开过的处方就是“去玩会蹦床吧”。</color>
original.info:
向上弹开接近的僵尸，击飞时令僵尸头晕目眩。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>80/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>攻击时，将僵尸原地向上击飞短暂时间，对巨型僵尸效果变为1/3，直接将小鬼僵尸击出场外。无法击飞领袖僵尸和载具</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>地刺+西瓜投手</color>

english.name: Springweed
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Unlike his lazy cousin, Springweed is very diligent in his work as a mental health therapist. So far, the only prescription he has ever written is: "Go jump on a trampoline for a while."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Springweed launches nearby zombies upward and disorients them.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>80/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Launches zombies upward for a short time when attacking. Effect is reduced to 1/3 against giant zombies. Instantly kills Imps. Cannot launch boss zombies or vehicles.</color>

german.name: Springweed
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Unlike his lazy cousin, Springweed is very diligent in his work as a mental health therapist. So far, the only prescription he has ever written is: "Go jump on a trampoline for a while."</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Springweed launches nearby zombies upward and disorients them.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>80/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Launches zombies upward for a short time when attacking. Effect is reduced to 1/3 against giant zombies. Instantly kills Imps. Cannot launch boss zombies or vehicles.</color>

original.name: 卷心菜小投手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>人们都说迷你的卷心菜有神奇的魔法，可以把僵尸都变小！而弹跳一下就是触发魔法的秘诀。但只有玉米小投手清楚，里面包了块小黄油，不过因为卷心菜太厚了没爆出来而已。不然为什么要弹跳一下才能把僵尸变小？</color>
original.info:
小小的卷心菜投手，投出能传递缩小状态的小卷心菜。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮，可密植</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>子弹能弹射2次。如果子弹命中被缩小的僵尸，该子弹获得使僵尸缩小的能力</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color>
<color=red>小喷菇（底座）+卷心菜投手</color>

english.name: Sprout-pult
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>People say Sprout-pult holds the magical power to shrink zombies. And the secret, they claim, is in the bounce. But only Baby Corn knows the real reason: there's a tiny pat of butter hidden inside. The cabbage leaves are just too thick for it to pop out… so of course it needs to bounce first to shrink a zombie.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Sprout-pult can pass the shrunken effect of a zombie to other zombies by using its bouncing sprouts.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/3s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Shots bounce twice. If a shot hits a shrunken zombie, it gains the ability to shrink the next zombies hit.</color>

german.name: Salat-Zwille
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>People say Sprout-pult holds the magical power to shrink zombies. And the secret, they claim, is in the bounce. But only Baby Corn knows the real reason: there's a tiny pat of butter hidden inside. The cabbage leaves are just too thick for it to pop out… so of course it needs to bounce first to shrink a zombie.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Lobs sprouts capable of passing on the shrinking effect.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>40/3s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Shots bounce twice. If a shot hits a shrunken zombie, it gains the ability to shrink the next zombies hit.</color>

original.name: 土豆胆小菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>为什么土豆胆小菇打着打着就自爆了？他的解释很感人：“我的每一次攻击，都是在燃烧我的生命！”但事实却是——他只是个很怕麻烦的魔术师，在打了几次后就不想打了，会用一份土豆烟花，上演一出大变活“菌”。</color>
original.info:
会在定时引信熄灭前，燃烧生命发射高伤害的孢子。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>60/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>出场后的20秒内，攻击时会受到75伤害，以造成10倍伤害。死亡时造成600伤害的土豆雷爆炸</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>胆小菇+土豆雷</color>

english.name: Spuddy-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Why does Spuddy-shroom explode after a few attacks? His explanation is quite touching: "Every attack I make is burning my life!" But the truth is—he's just a magician who doesn't want to do much work. After a few attacks, he decides to use a potato firework to perform a grand "fungus" transformation.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Spuddy-shroom consumes his own Toughness to fire high-damage spores!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>600/3s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Each attack costs 75 Toughness. If kept alive for 20 seconds after being planted, his red light will turn off with attack power reduced by 90%, but attacks will no longer cost Toughness. Upon death, it deals 600 damage to nearby zombies.</color>

german.name: Angsthasenmine
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Why does Spuddy-shroom explode after a few attacks? His explanation is quite touching: "Every attack I make is burning my life!" But the truth is—he’s just a magician who doesn’t want to do much work. After a few attacks, he decides to use a potato firework to perform a grand "fungus" transformation.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Consumes HP to fire high-damage spores!

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>600/3 Seconds</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Each attack costs 75 HP. If kept alive for 20 seconds after being planted, his red light will turn off with attack power reduced by 90%, but attacks will no longer cost health. Upon death, it deals 600 damage to nearby zombies.</color>

original.name: 窝瓜坚果
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>窝瓜坚果被人拽着蒂从儿童乐园里拖出来、丢到了草坪上。因为他是个残次品弹力球，浑身疙瘩让孩子们很不喜欢。窝瓜坚果非常不满，他不停地在草坪上蹦跳，大喊着：“我要玩个够！我要玩个够！”</color>
original.info:
学着窝瓜上蹿下跳的坚果。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>160（压扁）/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>有僵尸接近时，持续在本格弹跳，落地时造成小范围伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>跳起时不会阻挡僵尸</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>坚果+窝瓜</color>

english.name: Squash-nut
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Dragged from a kids' playground by his stem and dumped on the lawn, Squash-nut was rejected for being a deformed rubber ball. Now, furious and bumpy, he bounces wildly, yelling: "I'm gonna play all I want! ALL I WANT!"</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Squash-nut jumps and crushes zombies who try and eat it.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>160/1.5s (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Bounces in his tile when a zombie gets close, dealing splash damage on each landing. Does not block zombies while airborne.</color>

german.name: Matschnuss
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Dragged from a kids' playground by his stem and dumped on the lawn, Squash-nut was rejected for being a deformed rubber ball. Now, furious and bumpy, he bounces wildly, yelling: "I'm gonna play all I want! ALL I WANT!"</color>
german.info:
<size=36>A bouncy nut who's all tantrum and impact.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>160/1.5s (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Bounces in his tile when a zombie gets close, dealing splash damage on each landing. Does not block zombies while airborne.</color>

original.name: 三线窝瓜射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“他有三个头，底座也不是叶子，他不像一株正常的豌豆！”有许多植物害怕三线窝瓜射手奇怪的样子。但三线窝瓜射手并不在意，他的生活非常充实，攻击僵尸、看书、下棋，以及赢得每一届泳池打水漂比赛的冠军。</color>
original.info:
向三行发射弹跳窝瓜子弹。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40×3/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>子弹命中后开始弹跳，落地时造成40伤害的超小范围溅射</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>三线射手+窝瓜</color>

english.name: Squash-spreader
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"He has three heads, and his base isn't even a leaf! He looks nothing like a regular pea!" Many plants cower at the sight of Squash-spreader's peculiar appearance. Yet, Squash-spreader remains unfazed. He thrives in his vibrant life, battling zombies, reading voraciously, playing chess, and winning every pool skipping contest.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Squash-spreader can fire small bouncing squashes across multiple lanes.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40×3/3s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Every time a mini-squash hits the ground, it inflicts 40 points of damage to nearby zombies.</color></size>

german.name: Matschkürbiswerfer
german.introduce: <size=32><color=black>„Er hat drei Köpfe, und seine Basis ist nicht einmal ein Blatt! Er sieht überhaupt nicht wie eine normale Erbse aus!“ Viele Pflanzen ducken sich vor dem seltsamen Aussehen des Matschkürbiswerfers. Doch der Matschkürbiswerfer bleibt unbeeindruckt. Er gedeiht in seinem lebendigen Leben, kämpft gegen Zombies, liest unermüdlich, spielt Schach und gewinnt jedes Pool-Hüpfen.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=32>Matschkürbiswerfer kann kleine, springende Matschkürbisse abfeuern.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>40*3/3 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Jedes Mal, wenn ein Mini-Squash den Boden trifft, fügt er den Zombies in der Nähe 40 Punkte Schaden zu.</color></size>

original.name: 窝瓜地刺
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“嗯？嗯。”这是窝瓜地刺的口头禅，少言寡语的他常常令人感到捉摸不透。每当茶余饭后，窝瓜地刺的来历总会成为植物们的首选话题。据说在一个平常的下午，窝瓜跳起来正准备压扁前边的僵尸，但他没有注意到僵尸脚下的地刺。</color>
original.info:
可以击退的地刺，同时发射一个弹跳窝瓜子弹。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>攻击造成击退并发射一个弹跳窝瓜子弹，伤害40</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>地刺+窝瓜</color>

english.name: Squashweed
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Huh? Yeah." This catchphrase belongs to Squashweed, who rarely speaks and often leaves others feeling uncertain. After dinner, the topic of thorns always becomes a favorite among the plants. It's said that on an ordinary afternoon, as Squash prepared to crush a nearby zombie, he overlooked the thorns lurking beneath its feet.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Squashweed knocks zombies back every time it attacks!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Each attack will knock back zombies and fire 1 bouncing mini-squash.</color></size>

german.name: Stachlmatschkürbis
german.introduce: <size=32><color=black>„Hä? Ja.“ Dieser Spruch gehört zu Stachlmatschkürbis, der selten spricht und oft bei anderen Verwirrung hinterlässt. Nach dem Abendessen wird das Thema Dornen immer zu einem Favoriten unter den Pflanzen. Es wird gesagt, dass Stachlmatschkürbis an einem gewöhnlichen Nachmittag, als er dabei war, einen nahegelegenen Zombie zu zerquetschen, die Dornen unter dessen Füßen übersah.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=32>Stachlmatschkürbis schleudert Zombies bei jedem Angriff zurück.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Jeder Angriff schleudert Zombies zurück und feuert 1 springende Mini-Matschkürbis ab.</color></size>

original.name: 窝瓜火炬树桩
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>窝瓜火炬树桩又点燃了一颗豌豆。这一回，豌豆把周围全照亮了。一个窝瓜出现在焰光里，是那么温和，那么慈爱。</color>
original.info:
炙烤着窝瓜的火炬树桩，可以生成焰光窝瓜。

<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每影响超过50个子弹，在前方生成一个不能用于融合的焰光窝瓜</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>火炬树桩+窝瓜</color>

english.name: Squashwood
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"It's way too hot! Too hot!" Squash yelled, trapped in the flames of Torchwood. "Who put me here? I should be squashing zombies, not being the punchline at a barbecue party!" The heat was overwhelming, and as he reached his breaking point, he ignited, bursting forth from the torch to rejoin the battle against the zombies.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Squashwood produces a Roasted Squash in front for each 60 peas that pass through it.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>For every 60 peas lit, a Roasted Squash is spawned in front.</color></size>

german.name: Gequetschtes Zunderholz
german.introduce: <size=34><color=black>„Es ist viel zu heiß! Viel zu heiß!“, schrie der Matschkürbis, gefangen in den Flammen von Zunderholz. „Wer hat mich hierher gesetzt? Ich sollte Zombies zerquetschen, nicht die Pointe bei einer Grillparty sein!“ Die Hitze war überwältigend, und als er seinen Siedepunkt erreichte, entzündete er sich und brach aus der Fackel hervor, um erneut in den Kampf gegen die Zombies einzutreten.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=34>Er produziert einen Matschkürbis vorne, nachdem 60 Erbsen durch ihn hindurchgeflogen sind.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Jedes Mal, wenn 60 Erbsen angezündet werden, wird ein Matschkürbis davor gepflanzt.</color></size>

original.name: 杨桃坚果
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>杨桃坚果住在坚硬的石头下面，平时懒洋洋的也不愿意动，僵尸来咬他、他也不愿意挪脚。能让他动起来的事情只有两件，一是好朋友约他去抓水母，二是好朋友约他去捉弄邻居。</color>
original.info:
形似杨桃的坚果，受到攻击就会发射星星。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20×5</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>不会主动索敌。受击时向五个方向发射星星</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>坚果+杨桃</color>

english.name: Star-nut
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Star-nut lives under a rock and rarely moves. It's not because he's lazy, but because he's got standards. He'll only act if invited by a certain square friend to jellyfishing… or to prank a cephalopodic neighbor.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Star-nut releases 5 stars for each bit of damage it takes.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Fires five 20-damage stars in all directions when damaged.</color>

german.name: Sternnuss
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Star-nut lives under a rock and rarely moves. It's not because he's lazy, but because he's got standards. He'll only act if invited by a certain square friend to jellyfishing… or to prank a cephalopodic neighbor.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>A reactive defender that counters with little stars.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Fires five 20-damage stars in all directions when damaged.</color>

original.name: 杨桃大蘑菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>杨桃大蘑菇的星星菌盖在击中僵尸时发射星星子弹，很大程度上提高了子弹的利用率。“其实如果优化掉向后发射的那颗子弹，利用率还能进一步提高。”他的一位战友一边躲避飞回来的子弹一边评价道。</color>
original.info:
发射会穿透的星星菌盖，接触敌人时分裂为五发星星子弹。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20×5/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>星星菌盖没有伤害，能穿透2次，每次接触目标时，向5个方向各分裂出一个伤害20的星星子弹</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大喷菇+杨桃</color>

english.name: Starburst-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>When Starburst-shroom's star-shaped cap hits a zombie, it releases star projectiles, greatly improving projectile efficiency. "Actually, if the backward-fired star were optimized as well, the efficiency could be even higher." One of his comrades commented while dodging the returning projectile.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Starburst-shroom fires piercing star caps that deal no damage on their own, but split into five stars on contact.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>0 + 20×5×(0-3)/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>The Star cap itself deals no damage and can pierce twice. Each time it contacts a zombie, it releases 1 star projectile in each of 5 directions, each dealing 20 damage.</color>

german.name: Starburstpilz
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>When Starburst-shroom's star-shaped cap hits a zombie, it releases star projectiles, greatly improving projectile efficiency. "Actually, if the backward-fired star were optimized as well, the efficiency could be even higher." One of his comrades commented while dodging the returning projectile.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Fires piercing star caps that split into five stars on contact.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>0 + 20×5×(0-3)/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>The Star cap itself deals no damage and can pierce twice. Each time it contacts a zombie, it releases 1 star projectile in each of 5 directions, each dealing 20 damage.</color>

original.name: 土豆大喷菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>在收到土豆地雷的商业合作邀请后，土豆大喷菇辞掉了面包房的工作。“加入土豆爆炸行业是我做过最棒的决定，”土豆大喷菇说道，“从嘴里直接喷出淀粉的生产效率可比面包发酵高多了！”</color>
original.info:
喷射的烟雾带有土豆味，时而还会在僵尸身上砰然炸开。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>30/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每15秒一次，攻击会改为在命中的每个僵尸的位置释放一次土豆雷爆炸，伤害为自身攻击力的10倍</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大喷菇+土豆雷</color>

english.name: Starch-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>After accepting a brand partnership offer from Potato Mine, Starch-shroom quit his bakery job. "Joining the explosive-making industry was the best decision I've ever made," says Starch-shroom. "Spraying starch straight from your mouth is way more efficient than fermenting bread!"</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Starch-shroom sprays potato onto zombies ahead, and sometimes causes each zombie in range to explode!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>30/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Every 10th attack, triggers a Potato Mine explosion that deals 300 damage at the position of each zombie hit.</color>

german.name: Stinkmine
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>After accepting a brand partnership offer from Potato Mine, Starch-shroom quit his bakery job. "Joining the explosive-making industry was the best decision I've ever made," says Starch-shroom. "Spraying starch straight from your mouth is way more efficient than fermenting bread!"</color>
german.info:
<size=36>The fume he sprays carries a strong potato scent, sometimes even explosive!

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>30/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Every 10th attack, triggers a Potato Mine explosion that deals 300 damage at the position of each zombie hit.</color>

original.name: 大蒜杨桃
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>大蒜杨桃每天只做三件事：熬夜打游戏，用蒜汁洗澡，用三倍糖的蒜味奶茶代替一日三餐。他的邻居们早就放弃了劝他规律作息，也几乎没人想和这个满身蒜味的家伙说话，反正他自己是快乐的，对他来说，这就足够了。</color>
original.info:
蒜味的杨桃。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>30×5/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>子弹享受(5×目标蒜值)的伤害加成，造成伤害后赋予1点蒜值</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>杨桃+大蒜</color>

english.name: Starlic
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Starlic does three things every day: stays up all night playing video games, bathes in garlic juice, and replaces all three meals with garlic-flavored milk tea loaded with triple sugar. His neighbors gave up trying to convince him to keep a regular schedule long ago, and hardly anyone wants to talk to the guy who smells like garlic all over. But he's happy, and that's all that matters to him.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Starlic fires poisonous stars.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>30×5/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Poison stars gain a damage bonus of (5× the target's current Poison point), then inflict 1 Poison point onto the target after dealing damage.</color>

german.name: Starlic
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Starlic does three things every day: stays up all night playing video games, bathes in garlic juice, and replaces all three meals with garlic-flavored milk tea loaded with triple sugar. His neighbors gave up trying to convince him to keep a regular schedule long ago, and hardly anyone wants to talk to the guy who smells like garlic all over. But he's happy, and that's all that matters to him.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Starlic fires poisonous stars.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>30×5/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Poison stars gain a damage bonus of (5× the target's current Poison point), then inflict 1 Poison point onto the target after dealing damage.</color>

original.name: 磁性杨桃
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>磁性杨桃一直有个梦想，那就是把天上的星星给吸下来，所以他每天晚上都在仰望星空。</color>
original.info:
可以利用磁性融合铁器，并获得对应的输出能力。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40×5/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>发射磁力星星，对铁器防具造成2倍伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>可以融合的铁器：</color><color=red>铁桶、玩偶匣、矿工镐</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>杨桃+磁力菇</color>

english.name: Starmorph
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Starmorph harbors a lifelong dream: to suck the stars from the sky. He spends every night staring at the starry heavens, imagining the day when his dream becomes reality.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Starmorph can fuse with some iron materials from zombies to acquire their properties.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40×5/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Metal plant. Deals double damage to iron zombies. Can fuse with Bucket, Pickaxe and Jack-in-the-Box.</color></size>

german.name: Sternenlocke
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Sternenlocke hegt einen Lebenstraum: die Sterne vom Himmel zu saugen. Jede Nacht starrt er in den sternklaren Himmel und stellt sich den Tag vor, an dem sein Traum Wirklichkeit wird.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Kann mit Eisenmaterialien von Zombies fusionieren, um deren Eigenschaften zu absorbieren.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20*5/1.5 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Verursacht doppelten Schaden an Eisenzombies.</color></size>

original.name: 杨桃南瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>看他鼻子就知道，他是杨桃一系的“星标好友”。</color>
original.info:
五叶草和阳光杨桃的好搭档。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>壳内的五叶草植物同时吸附的子弹数量上限×4：
·杨桃五叶草：20→80
·究极五叶草：60→240</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>壳内的阳光杨桃可以正常索敌攻击</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>南瓜（底座）+杨桃</color>

english.name: Starry Pumpkin
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>People often wonder how many languages Starry Pumpkin must know to communicate effortlessly with all the plants. Starry Pumpkin smiles and says, "Actually, I only speak Starfruit's language, since he's the only one I work closely with."</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Starry Pumpkin empowers only a couple of Starfruit fusions.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Quadruples the attraction limits of Starblover plants (Starblover to 80, and Pulsar to 240).
<color=black>•</color> Allows Solarfruit to use Sun to shoot automatically.</color></size>

german.name: Sternenkürbis
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Die Leute fragen sich oft, wie viele Sprachen der Sternenkürbis sprechen muss, um mühelos mit allen Pflanzen zu kommunizieren. Der Sternenkürbis lächelt und sagt: "Eigentlich spreche ich nur die Sprache der Sternenfrucht, da er der Einzige ist, mit dem ich eng zusammenarbeite."</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Hilft dem Sternenwehblatt, mehr Sterne zu behalten.

<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Erhöht die Speichergrenze von Sternenwehblatt auf 60.</color></size>

original.name: 杨桃窝瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“老鹰抓小鸡的诀窍其实很好把握。"杨桃窝瓜给新来的朋友们讲解着自己的技巧，"只要让朋友们躲在身后，等老鹰靠近就一起跳起来躲避就行了。”这种技巧很快便得到了朋友们的认同，但现在他们遇到了一个新的问题——谁来扮演老鹰。</color>
original.info:
像五指山一样坠落，压扁成群僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>900（压扁）×5</color>
<color=#3D1400>索敌范围：</color><color=red>左侧0.5格~右侧1格</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>在中心、左上、左下、右上、右下分别落地，各造成小范围伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>窝瓜+杨桃</color>

english.name: Starry Squash
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"The trick to playing tag is actually quite simple." Starry Squash explained his technique to his new friends. "Just let your friends hide behind you, then when the chaser gets close, jump together and dodge." The technique was quickly accepted by everyone, but they soon faced a new problem: who would play the chaser?</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Starry Squash falls like the Five Finger Mountain, crushing groups of zombies.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>900×5 (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>0.5 tiles to the left; 1 tile to the right</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Lands simultaneously at center, upper-left, upper-right, farther-left, and farther-right positions, each dealing smaller area damage (area can overlap).</color>

german.name: Starry Squash
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"The trick to playing tag is actually quite simple." Starry Squash explained his technique to his new friends. "Just let your friends hide behind you, then when the chaser gets close, jump together and dodge." The technique was quickly accepted by everyone, but they soon faced a new problem: who would play the chaser?</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Starry Squash falls like the Five Finger Mountain, crushing groups of zombies.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>900×5 (Squash)</color>
<color=black>Detection Range: </color><color=#8B0000>0.5 tiles to the left; 1 tile to the right</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Lands simultaneously at center, upper-left, upper-right, farther-left, and farther-right positions, each dealing smaller area damage (area can overlap).</color>

original.name: 杨桃胆小菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“远处的家伙，不管你们是谁，除了马戏团的人，都不要过来！”杨桃胆小菇瑟瑟发抖，“我，我可是很强大的！”他一刻不停地攻击着，以为这样就能吓退那些不怀好意的家伙，却并没有注意到自己的子弹根本没有打向正前方。</color>
original.info:
形似杨桃的胆小菇，快速发射星星，但这只是虚张声势。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20×5/0.75秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>攻击方式与杨桃相同，但只在攻击范围内没有僵尸时持续攻击，有僵尸则会害怕</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>胆小菇+杨桃</color>

english.name: Starry-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Guys in the distance, no matter who you are, except for the circus people, don't come over!" The Starry-shroom, trembled, "I, I am very powerful!" He kept attacking, thinking that this would scare off those with ill intentions, but he didn't notice that his bullets weren't even hitting straight ahead.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Starry-shroom shoots stars faster and in 5 directions, but also gets frightened easily.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20×5/0.75s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Keeps shooting stars in 5 directions like Starfruit, but becomes afraid and stops if there is a zombie in its range.</color>

german.name: Starrpilz
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Guys in the distance, no matter who you are, except for the circus people, don't come over!" The Starry-shroom, trembled, "I, I am very powerful!" He kept attacking, thinking that this would scare off those with ill intentions, but he didn't notice that his bullets weren't even hitting straight ahead.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Starry-shroom shoots stars faster and in 5 directions, but also gets frightened more often.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20×5/0.75s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Keeps shooting stars in 5 directions like Starfruit, but becomes afraid and stops if there is a zombie in its range.</color>

original.name: 杨桃豌豆射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>杨桃豌豆射手非常骄傲，他认为自己是闪闪发光的，就像天上的星星那样。虽然朋友们告诉他，他并没有能穿透迷雾或黑夜的光芒，但这丝毫不影响星星豌豆射手每天保持着好心情，并承担了城市里一个礼堂穹顶的星空风格装修。</color>
original.info:
发射杨桃豌豆，在命中前散播多次星星。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>子弹每0.5秒一次（首次0.2秒），向周围分裂出5个星星子弹，最多分裂5次</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>豌豆射手+杨桃</color>

english.name: Starshooter
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Starshooter is very proud of itself and believes it shines like a star in the sky. Although others tell it that it does not actually emit light capable of piercing fog or darkness, this does not affect its good mood, and it even helps decorate a city hall ceiling with a starry sky design.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Starshooter fires star peas that split into multiple stars before impact.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Projectiles split into 5 star projectiles in all directions every 0.5s (first at 0.2s), up to 5 times.</color>

german.name: Starshooter
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Starshooter is very proud of itself and believes it shines like a star in the sky. Although others tell it that it does not actually emit light capable of piercing fog or darkness, this does not affect its good mood, and it even helps decorate a city hall ceiling with a starry sky design.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Starshooter fires star peas that split into multiple stars before impact.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Projectiles split into 5 star projectiles in all directions every 0.5s (first at 0.2s), up to 5 times.</color>

original.name: 仙人掌杨桃
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>仙人掌杨桃是个奇怪的家伙。植物们都这样说，他明明躺在地上、却只攻击空中的僵尸，难道不能攻击地上的僵尸吗？对此，仙人掌杨桃并不去争论，因此获得了脾气好的美誉。但其实，他只是不想暴露自己视力不好、躺下来只能看到天上的事实。</color>
original.info:
防空特化的杨桃，对空中威胁发射追踪的仙人掌星星。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20×5/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>发射仙人掌星星，全场索敌只对空</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>仙人掌+杨桃</color>

english.name: Starthorn
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Starthorn has always been a bit of an oddity. The plants joke, "He's always on the ground but only fights the flying zombies. Why doesn't he go after the ground ones?" Starthorn, ever patient, says nothing, quietly protecting his secret: his poor vision only allows him to see the sky when he lies down.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Starthorn shoots 5 homing cactus stars, but only at zombies in the sky.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20×5/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Thorny stars track flying zombies across the board.</color></size>

german.name: Sternstachel
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Sternstachel war schon immer ein wenig eine Seltenheit. Die Pflanzen machen Witze: „Er ist immer am Boden, greift aber nur die fliegenden Zombies an. Warum geht er nicht nach den Zombies am Boden?“. Sternstachel, stets geduldig, sagt nichts und bewahrt ruhig sein Geheimnis: Seine schlechte Sehkraft lässt ihn nur den Himmel sehen, wenn er sich hinlegt.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Kann nur Zombies in der Luft angreifen.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20*5/1.5 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Stachelige Sterne verfolgen fliegende Zombies über das Spielfeld.</color></size>

original.name: 蒜毒三线射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“真臭！我讨厌你们！”蒜毒三线射手的第三个头哭喊道。僵尸们误以为他哭是因为那令人作呕的气味。实际上，他哭是因为彼此的音乐品味不同。“我们连鼻孔都没有。”第一个头平静地解释道。</color>
original.info:
向三行发射蒜豌豆，使中毒的僵尸释放体内毒素，形成一片毒瘴。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>30×3/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>子弹命中时赋予1蒜值。如果目标处于中毒状态，在其位置生成一个毒瘴</color>
<color=#3D1400>毒瘴：</color><color=red>每行最多存在一个。半径0.74格，持续6秒。每1秒，赋予范围内的僵尸1点蒜值，造成本行所有蒜毒类射手植物一轮发射子弹量20倍的伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>三线射手+大蒜</color>

english.name: Stench-spreader
english.introduce:
<align=left><size=36><color=black>"Ugh, your taste stinks! I hate you two!" cries the third head. Zombies think he's crying from his fellows' smell, but actually, it's just because of their terrible taste in music. "We don't even have noses," the first head explains.

-Written by silver fool</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Stench-spreader shoots peas in 3 lanes that can create gas clouds if they hit a poisoned zombie!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>30×3/1.5s</color>
<color=#5E1675>Poison System: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Projectiles add 1 Poison value to zombies on hit.
<color=black>•</color> If the zombie hit is already in a Poisoned state, creates a Toxic Cloud at the zombie's feet that lasts for 6s, applying 1 Poison value and dealing damage equal to 20× the total projectiles fired in one volley by all Poison-system straight-shooting plants in this lane per second to all zombies caught within. There can be up to 1 active Toxic Cloud per lane.</color>

german.name: Tripli-Stinker
german.introduce:
<align=left><size=36><color=black>"Ugh, your taste stinks! I hate you two!" cries the third head. Zombies think he's crying from his fellows' smell, but actually, it's just because of their terrible taste in music. "We don't even have noses," the first head explains.

-Written by silver fool</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Shoots Poison peas; makes poisoned zombies release toxic clouds on hit.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>30×3/1.5s</color>
<color=#5E1675>Poison System: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Projectiles add 1 Poison value to zombies on hit.
<color=black>•</color> If the zombie hit is already in a Poisoned state, creates a Toxic Cloud at the zombie's feet that lasts for 6s, applying 1 Poison value and dealing damage equal to 20× the total projectiles fired in one volley by all Poison-system straight-shooting plants in this lane per second to all zombies caught within. There can be up to 1 active Toxic Cloud per lane.</color>

original.name: 蒜毒树桩
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>大蒜的清香沁人心脾，火焰的炙烤又将这味道升华到了另一重境界。蒜毒树桩深吸一口气，沉醉于这美妙的气息，也为其他植物无法领会这份美好而感到遗憾。</color>
original.info:
熏烤经过的豌豆，使其毒性变得浓郁。

<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>影响经过的特定子弹</color>
<color=#A86A44>·豌豆：</color><color=red>伤害+10，变为蒜豌豆</color>
<color=#A86A44>·蒜豌豆：</color><color=red>伤害×2，变为毒蒜豌豆（直击赋予1蒜值、施加剧毒效果并生成毒障，会造成类似火焰豌豆的溅射）</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>火炬树桩+大蒜</color>

english.name: Stenchwood
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The fresh aroma of garlic is soothing, while the blaze of fire elevates it to another level entirely. Stenchwood takes a deep breath, lost in this intoxicating scent, and feels regret that other plants cannot appreciate such beauty.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Stenchwood converts peas into poison peas and enchances the power of already existing poison peas!

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Affects specific projectiles that pass through:
<color=black>-</color> Peas: +10 Damage, becomes Poison Pea;
<color=black>-</color> Poison Peas: Damage ×2, becomes Venom Peas that also deal Splash damage.</color>

german.name: Zunderstank
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The fresh aroma of garlic is soothing, while the blaze of fire elevates it to another level entirely. Stenchwood takes a deep breath, lost in this intoxicating scent, and feels regret that other plants cannot appreciate such beauty.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Cauterizes passing peas, greatly enhancing their toxicity.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Affects specific projectiles that pass through:
<color=black>-</color> Peas: +10 Damage, becomes Poison Pea;
<color=black>-</color> Poison Peas: Damage ×2, becomes Venom Peas that also deal Splash damage.</color>

original.name: 大蒜南瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>经历多次更新迭代，大蒜南瓜作为最终成品正式投入实战。相比普通大蒜，他优化了不够坚硬、喜欢占用多余的空间和无法抵挡子弹的缺点。至于那个气味上的缺点……考验战士们吃苦耐劳精神的时候到了！</color>
original.info:
兼具大蒜特点的南瓜。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>被啃咬时，使啃咬者换行并施加剧毒效果，赋予1点蒜值</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>南瓜（底座）+大蒜</color>

english.name: Stinky Pumpkin
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>After countless revisions, Stinky Pumpkin is finally combat-ready. Compared to regular Garlic, it fixes issues like weak defense, space efficiency and inability to protect plants from projectiles. As for that smell… well, time to test everyone's endurance.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Stinky Pumpkin poisons and redirects biters to protect the plant inside.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000> Zombies that bite him will be poisoned for 10s, forced to change lanes and accumulate 1 Poison point.</color>

german.name: Muffelkürbis
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>After countless revisions, Stinky Pumpkin is finally combat-ready. Compared to regular Garlic, it fixes issues like weak defense, space efficiency and inability to protect plants from projectiles. As for that smell… well, time to test everyone's endurance.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Pumpkin with Garlic traits.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000> Zombies that bite him will be poisoned for 10s, forced to change lanes and accumulate 1 Poison point.</color>

original.name: 窝瓜水草
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>窝瓜水草是植物中名副其实的哲学家。窝瓜水草平常不是念叨“究竟我是窝还是窝是我”，就是思考“草从哪里来，到哪里去”，从来不注意个人卫生，以至于别的植物看到他的蓬头乱发就躲得远远的。</color>
original.info:
形似窝瓜的缠绕水草，可以将总计三只僵尸拖入水下。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>秒杀（溺死）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>拥有缠绕水草的特点，可以秒杀3次。拖下水时造成超小范围伤害600</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>缠绕水草（底座）+窝瓜</color>

english.name: Strangle Kelp
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Strangle Kelp stands out as a true philosopher among plants. It often ponders profound questions like, "Where does the grass come from, and where does it go?" However, its disregard for personal hygiene and unkempt hair make other plants shy away, preferring to keep their distance.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Strangle Kelp can drag three zombies into the water before disappearing.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>Insta-kill (Drown) ×3</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Drags 3 zombies into the water (CD: 1s). Each drag also deals 600 damage to nearby zombies.</color></size>

german.name: Matschtang
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Matschkürbistang hebt sich als wahrer Philosoph unter den Pflanzen hervor. Oft stellt es sich tiefgründige Fragen wie: „Woher kommt das Gras und wohin geht es?“ Doch seine Missachtung der persönlichen Hygiene und sein ungepflegtes Haar lassen andere Pflanzen zurückweichen, die lieber Abstand halten.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Matschkürbistang kann drei Zombies ins Wasser ziehen.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000> Sofortiges Töten*3</color></size>

original.name: 胆小坚果
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>坚果胆小原先和其他胆小菇一样胆小，直到坚果胆小在电视上看到了远房表亲“蘑菇力”，面对僵尸从不胆怯的样子，于是决定向“蘑菇力”学习，给自己取外号“蘑菇立”，并且日夜练习胆量，只为在面对僵尸时不再害怕。</color>
original.info:
瘦成杆的坚果，虽然胆小，被逼急了也会奋起反抗。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>3×3范围内有僵尸时会害怕。害怕时蹲伏，拥有50%减伤</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>害怕10秒后，起身击退附近的僵尸，并同时对目标及其一类、二类防具造成20伤害，且5秒内不会害怕</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>坚果+胆小菇</color>

english.name: Sturdy-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Sturdy-shroom was originally shy like other Scaredy-shrooms, until seeing distant relatives with "Mushroom Power" on TV — unafraid of zombies. He decided to learn from them, nicknamed himself "Mushroom Lee," and trained day and night to face zombies without fear.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Sturdy-shroom can knock back zombies after being scared for too long!

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000> After cowering for 10s, immediately stands up and knocks back nearby zombies, dealing 20 damage to the zombie's body, its Type 1 armor and Type 2 armor simultaneously. For the next 5s, he will not hide himself again. While cowering, takes 50% reduced damage.</color>

german.name: Angsthaselnuss
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Sturdy-shroom was originally shy like other Scaredy-shrooms, until seeing distant relatives with "Mushroom Power" on TV — unafraid of zombies. He decided to learn from them, nicknamed himself "Mushroom Lee," and trained day and night to face zombies without fear.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Very slim defender, but will fight back when cornered.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000> After cowering for 10s, immediately stands up and knocks back nearby zombies, dealing 20 damage to the zombie's body, its Type 1 armor and Type 2 armor simultaneously. For the next 5s, he will not hide himself again. While cowering, takes 50% reduced damage.</color>

original.name: 火瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>植物们总觉得红皮西瓜自带年味，噼里啪啦好不热闹。对此西瓜却解释道：“我没有往西瓜里放鞭炮，只是心急吃不了热西瓜，密封食物在加热的时候会爆炸！”</color>
original.info:
投出施加红温状态的火焰西瓜。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>120/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>直击和溅射都施加红温状态</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>西瓜投手+火爆辣椒</color>

english.name: Summer Melon
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The plants always feel that red-rinded watermelons carry the festive vibe of New Year, crackling and popping with excitement. But Summer Melon explains, 'I didn't put firecrackers in the melon! It's just that sealed food explodes when heated—and you can't rush eating a hot watermelon!'</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Summer Melon lobs blazingly hot melons!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>120/3s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Inflicts the Enflamed debuff.</color>

german.name: Sommermelone
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Die Pflanzen fühlen immer, dass Wassermelonen mit roter Schale die festliche Stimmung des Neujahrs tragen, knisternd und mit Aufregung. Aber die Wassermelone erklärt: „Ich habe keine Feuerwerkskörper in die Melone gepackt! Es ist nur so, dass versiegelte Lebensmittel explodieren, wenn sie erhitzt werden – und man kann eine heiße Wassermelone nicht eilig essen!“</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Wirft glühend heiße Melonen!

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>160/3 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Verursacht den Schwächungszauber Entflammter.</color>

original.name: 阳光菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​阳光菇总是悄悄地生长在阴暗的角落，但是却会默默地积攒阳光。“我知道我很弱小”阳光菇说“但是我的阳光是必不可少的，我是一切光辉之路的起点。” 没有人敢否定她的观点，黑夜有她，并且不止有她。​</color>
original.info:
生产少量阳光，长大后生产更多。

<color=#3D1400>阳光产量：</color><color=red>15/25秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮，可密植</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>出场120秒后长大，生产的阳光变为25</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>小喷菇（底座）+向日葵</color>

english.name: Sun-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Sun-shroom hates sun. He hates it so much that when it builds up in his system, he spits it out as fast as he can. He just won't abide it. To him, sun is crass.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Sun-shrooms give small sun at first and normal sun later.

<color=black>Sun Output: </color><color=#8B0000>15→25/25s
<color=black>Growth Time: </color><color=#8B0000>120s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).</color></size>

german.name: Sonnenpilz
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Der Sonnenpilz hasst die Sonne. Er hasst sie so sehr, dass er sie sofort ausspuckt, sobald sich Sonnen in ihm bilden. Er kann sie einfach nicht ausstehen. Er findet sie nur ätzend.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Sonnenpilze geben dir zuerst kleine, später normale Sonnen.

<color=black>Sonnenproduktion: </color><color=#8B0000>15 (25) / 25 Sekunden
<color=black>Zeit für Wachstum: </color><color=#8B0000>120 Sekunden</color></size>

original.name: 阳光寒冰菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>在花园里，阳光寒冰菇就像是北极的太阳一样少见，他把所有的心思都放在了自己的事业上。他研发的阳光甜橙味冰棍，无论是在植物还是僵尸中都大受欢迎，即便被冻到体内仅存的热量都挥发出去，这些僵尸也趋之若鹜。</color>
original.info:
随着时间逐步消融，分阶段释放寒气与阳光。

<color=#3D1400>阳光产量：</color><color=red>25/25秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>生产阳光时，使每个冻结的僵尸掉落15阳光</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>前2次生产阳光时，释放寒冰菇效果，但只施加寒冷状态，不造成冻结</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>第3次生产阳光时，释放寒冰菇效果，然后消失</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>向日葵+寒冰菇</color>

english.name: Sundae-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>As rare as a polar sunrise, this frosty innovator spends all his time perfecting his craft of dessert-making. His signature sundae is the Sunny Orange Delight, loved by plants and zombies alike (even if it drains the last of their warmth).</color>
english.info:
<size=36>When Sundae-shroom produces sun, it chills all zombies on screen, eventually disappearing and freezing zombies on screen after enough production.

<color=black>Sun Output: </color><color=#8B0000>25/25s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> At each sun production, makes all frozen zombies drop 15 sun.
<color=black>•</color> For the first two sun production cycles, triggers Ice-shroom effects that inflict chill but don't freeze. On the third cycle, triggers full Ice-shroom effect, then disappears.</color>

german.name: Eiscremepilz
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>As rare as a polar sunrise, this frosty innovator spends all his time perfecting his craft of dessert-making. His signature sundae is the Sunny Orange Delight, loved by plants and zombies alike (even if it drains the last of their warmth).</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Gradually melts, releasing cold and sunlight in stages.

<color=black>Sun Output: </color><color=#8B0000>25/25s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> At each sun production, makes all frozen zombies drop 15 sun.
<color=black>•</color> For the first two sun production cycles, triggers Ice-shroom effects that inflict chill but don't freeze. On the third cycle, triggers full Ice-shroom effect, then disappears.</color>

original.name: 阳光南瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>阳光南瓜最近喜欢上了野营：“伙计们，野营真是世界上最好的事物，我可以用自己的身躯保护别人，还能充当小太阳！”话说的不错，在野营时常常有阴天下雨和僵尸的进攻，植物们最喜欢和他在一起。</color>
original.info:
生产阳光的南瓜，利用光合作用增强防护。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>阳光产量：</color><color=red>25/25秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>生产阳光时，使本格所有植物获得50点护盾</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>南瓜（底座）+向日葵</color>

english.name: Sunny Pumpkin
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Recently obsessed with camping, Sunny Pumpkin beams: "Camping's the best! I get to shield everyone and be their little sun!" Rain or zombies, her teammates love having her around.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Sunny Pumpkin gives shield to itself and the plant inside every time it produces sun!

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000 + ?</color>
<color=black>Sun Output: </color><color=#8B0000>25/25s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000> Gives 50 HP as Shield to all plants in her tile every time she produces Sun. The total Shield value has no upper cap.</color>

german.name: Sonnenkürbis
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Recently obsessed with camping, Sunny Pumpkin beams: "Camping's the best! I get to shield everyone and be their little sun!" Rain or zombies, her teammates love having her around.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Generates Sun while reinforcing plants.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000 + ?</color>
<color=black>Sun Output: </color><color=#8B0000>25/25s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000> Gives 50 HP as Shield to all plants in her tile every time she produces Sun. The total Shield value has no upper cap.</color>

original.name: 阳光胆小菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>阳光胆小菇最近新学了一套新的吐纳法，能帮助他加速排出体内令他讨厌的阳光，只是……“哇，有僵尸！”阳光胆小菇瑟瑟发抖着，蜷缩着不敢呼吸。至于吐纳法？等僵尸走了之后再慢慢琢磨吧。</color>
original.info:
胆小的阳光生产者，努力赶工生产，但害怕时会恢复原样。

<color=#3D1400>阳光产量：</color><color=red>25/25秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>每次生产阳光时，产光间隔减少(0.5×本轮产光用时)秒，间隔最低为10秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>如果在蹲伏状态生产阳光，则产光间隔变回25秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>向日葵+胆小菇</color>

english.name: Sunny-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Sunny-shroom's been working on a new breathing method to quickly vent all that awful sunlight. But… "Ahh! Zombies!!" And just like that, he's curled up, trembling, forgetting everything. As for the breathing method? He'll figure it out when the zombies walk away.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Sunny-shroom produces sun faster and faster until they become scared again.

<color=black>Sun Output: </color><color=#8B0000>25/25s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Production interval gradually shortens to 10s.
<color=black>•</color> Cowers in fear when zombies approach, resetting interval back to 25s and producing 25 Sun immediately.</color>

german.name: Angsthasensonne
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Sunny-shroom's been working on a new breathing method to quickly vent all that awful sunlight. But… "Ahh! Zombies!!" And just like that, he's curled up, trembling, forgetting everything. As for the breathing method? He'll figure it out when the zombies walk away.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>A timid sun producer that tries to work faster until it panics.

<color=black>Sun Output: </color><color=#8B0000>25/25s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Production interval gradually shortens to 10s.
<color=black>•</color> Cowers in fear when zombies approach, resetting interval back to 25s and producing 25 Sun immediately.</color>

original.name: 阳光大蘑菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>阳光大蘑菇是一名资历深厚的银行家，将阳光存入他的银行可以得到较高的利息，“我们的银行是定期存款，你还不能取出你的阳光”阳光大蘑菇对前来取出阳光的阳光帝果如此说道。</color>
original.info:
有远见的阳光生产者，吸收附近的阳光并增值储蓄，生产时批量提取。

<color=#3D1400>阳光产量：</color><color=red>25/20秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>吸收5×5范围内的阳光，将其增幅30%并储存</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>生产阳光时，以25为单位尽可能提取储存的阳光</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>向日葵+大喷菇</color>

english.name: Sunrise-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>A seasoned sunlight banker, Sunrise-shroom offers high interest on your deposits."You chose a time deposit," he says sternly to a frustrated Twin Solar-nut. "Withdrawals aren't allowed just yet."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Sunrise-shroom takes in sun from around itself and gives it back later with some extra interest!

<color=black>Sun Output: </color><color=#8B0000>25/20s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Absorbs dropped Sun within a 5×5 area, multiplies their value by ×1.3, and stores them.
<color=black>•</color> Releases as much Sun as possible in batches of 25 along with the next production.</color>

german.name: Sommersonnenpilz
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>A seasoned sunlight banker, Sunrise-shroom offers high interest on your deposits."You chose a time deposit," he says sternly to a frustrated Twin Solar-nut. "Withdrawals aren't allowed just yet."</color>
german.info:
<size=36>A visionary sun producer that absorbs and multiplies nearby sun, paying out in bursts.

<color=black>Sun Output: </color><color=#8B0000>25/20s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Absorbs dropped Sun within a 5×5 area, multiplies their value by ×1.3, and stores them.
<color=black>•</color> Releases as much Sun as possible in batches of 25 along with the next production.</color>

original.name: 阳光海蘑菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“遗憾的是，我是蘑菇，而不是一朵花，所以，我不能算是海花之类的，有时我会因此有些沮丧，但是请你不要在意。”阳光海蘑菇说，“我不是一株向日葵，我是一个蘑菇，但我依然可以在水中利用各种物理作用和化学作用为你制造阳光。”</color>
original.info:
水生的阳光菇，长大后生产更多阳光，可长大两次。

<color=#3D1400>阳光产量：</color><color=red>15/15秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>水生，低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>出场20秒后长大，生产的阳光变为25；再过40秒后再次长大，生产的阳光变为50</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>海蘑菇（底座）+向日葵</color>

english.name: Sunset-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Sadly, I am a mushroom, not a flower, so I can't be called a sea flower or anything similar," Sunset-shroom admitted. "At times, this brings me down, but don't let it bother you. I may not be a sunflower, yet I can still use different physical and chemical reactions in the water to bring you sunshine!"</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Sunset-shroom produces increasing amounts of Sun as it grows.

<color=black>Sun Output: </color><color=#8B0000>15 → 25 → 50/15s</color>
<color=black>Growth Time: </color><color=#8B0000>20 Seconds → 40s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).</color></size>

german.name: Meersonnenpilz
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>„Leider bin ich ein Pilz und keine Blume, daher kann ich nicht als Meeresblume oder Ähnliches bezeichnet werden“, gab Meersonnenpilz zu. „Manchmal macht mich das traurig, aber lasst euch davon nicht stören. Ich mag keine Sonnenblume sein, doch ich kann trotzdem verschiedene physikalische und chemische Reaktionen im Wasser nutzen, um euch Sonnenlicht zu bringen!“</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Produziert mit zunehmendem Wachstum immer mehr Sonne.

<color=black>Sonnenproduktion: </color><color=#8B0000>15 → 25 → 50 / 15 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Zeit für Wachstum: </color><color=#8B0000>20 Sekunden → 40 Sekunden</color></size>

original.name: 寒冰刺豚菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“嘿，离我远一点，让我一个人安安静静地呆着，要不然我就用冰刺扎你们！”寒冰刺豚菇膨胀起来，想吓走迎面而来的敌人。看着逐渐逼近僵尸的冰刺，观战的植物们不由得思考一个问题：到底是谁接近谁呢？</color>
original.info:
吸食海蘑菇后，会膨胀身体，然后向周围鼓出寒气。

<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>水生，低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>对其使用海蘑菇卡牌后，对3×3范围内的僵尸造成20伤害并冻结4秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>海蘑菇（底座）+寒冰菇</color>

english.name: Swell-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Hey, stay away from me! Let me be alone quietly, or I'll stab you with ice spikes!" Swell-shroom inflates to scare approaching enemies. Watching the ice spikes protruding out towards the zombies, the other plants can't help but wonder: who's really approaching whom?</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Swell-shroom inflates after consuming Sea-shrooms, emitting cold air around himself.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles). Loses the ability to attack. Using a Sea-shroom seed packet on him makes him swell up and freeze all zombies in a 3×3 area, applying chill and dealing 20 damage.</color>

german.name: Eisblähpilz
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Hey, stay away from me! Let me be alone quietly, or I'll stab you with ice spikes!" Swell-shroom inflates to scare approaching enemies. Watching the ice spikes protruding out towards the zombies, the other plants can't help but wonder: who's really approaching whom?</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Inflates after consuming Sea-shrooms, emitting cold air around himself.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles). Loses the ability to attack. Using a Sea-shroom seed packet on him makes him swell up and freeze all zombies in a 3×3 area, applying chill and dealing 20 damage.</color>

original.name: 玉米卷投手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>戴夫没有玉米卷饼时的代餐。</color>
original.info:
投出可以弹跳的玉米卷或黄油卷。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>玉米卷命中僵尸后会弹射2次。有25%概率投出黄油卷，造成60伤害并定身4秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>卷心菜投手+玉米投手</color>

english.name: Taco-pult
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Taco-pult always wonders why, despite learning skills from Kernel-pult and performing well on the battlefield, Dave finds it hard to look at him and even avoids him. In truth, it's because Taco-pult resembles a taco too much, and every time Dave sees him, he just wants to pick him up and eat him.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Taco-pult launches tacos that can bounce once, and can also throw butter, which can also bounce.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/3s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Projectiles bounce once. Has a 1/4 chance to throw butter, dealing 60 damage and immobilizing zombies for 4s.</color>

german.name: Tacopult
german.introduce: <size=32><color=black>Tacopult fragt sich immer, warum Dave, obwohl er von Kornapult gelernt hat und gut auf dem Schlachtfeld abschneidet, Schwierigkeiten hat, ihn anzusehen und ihm sogar ausweicht. In Wahrheit liegt es daran, dass Tacopult zu sehr wie ein Taco aussieht, und jedes Mal, wenn Dave ihn sieht, möchte er ihn einfach aufheben und essen.</color>
german.info:
<size=32>Tacopult schleudert Tacos, die einmal abprallen können, und kann auch Butter werfen.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>60/3 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Projektile prallen einmal ab. Hat eine 1/4 Chance, Butter zu werfen, die 80 Schaden verursacht und Zombies für 4 Sekunden bewegungsunfähig macht.</color>

original.name: 高坚果
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>​“身高越高，能力越大”高坚果始终坚信这一点，这也是他为什么一直活跃在一线的原因。别的植物都劝他爱惜自己，他却总是笑着说“没关系，我很高的，只要你们打的快，僵尸就吃不完​​。”</color>
original.info:
难以逾越的高大坚果。
<color=#800080>需要种植在坚果上</color>

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>8000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>高大</color>
<color=#3D1400>高大植物：</color><color=red>能阻挡撑杆、跳跳、海豚骑士类僵尸的普通跳跃</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>坚果（底座）+高坚果或其卡片/肥料</color>

english.name: Tall-nut
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"People wonder if there's a rivalry between Wall-nut and Tall-nut. Tall-nut laughs a rich, baritone laugh. 'How could there be anything between us? We are brothers. If you knew what Wall-nut has done for me...' Tall-nut's voice trails off and he smiles knowingly."</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Tall-nuts are heavy-duty wall plants that can't be vaulted or jumped over.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>8000</color>
