<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Tall plant. Blocks Pole-vaulting Zombies, Dolphin Riders and Pogo Zombies. Cannot block Yeti Riders and charged Pogo jumps. Can only be placed on existing Wall-nuts.</color></size>

german.name: Hochwall-Nuss
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Viele wüssten gern, ob eine Rivalität zwischen Wall-Nuss und Hochwall-Nuss besteht. Hochwall-Nuss lacht mit tiefer Stimme: "Wieso sollten wir uns nicht verstehen? Wir sind Brüder. Ich habe Wall-Nuss viel zu verdanken..." Dann schweigt Hochwall-Nuss und lächelt.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Hochwall-Nüsse sind massive Pflanzen, die nicht übersprungen werden können.

<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>8000</color></size>

original.name: 缠绕地雷
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>这家伙原本是海上的水雷，被强大的海啸冲上了岸，半截身子埋进了土里。虽然外面的水草已经枯萎，但是内部的炸药仍然致命。</color>
original.info:
缠绕着水草的土豆雷。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>秒杀（溺死）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>出土后，秒杀接近的第一个僵尸，然后释放600伤害土豆雷的爆炸效果</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>土豆雷（底座）+缠绕水草</color>

english.name: Tangle Mine
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Originally a naval mine tossed ashore by a powerful tsunami, this fella now lies half-buried in the soil. Though the kelp outside has withered, the explosives inside remain deadly.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Tangle Mine instantly kills any zombie that touches it, similar to Tangle Kelp.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>Insta-kill (Drown)</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> When armed, insta-kills the first approaching zombie and triggers a Potato Mine explosion dealing 600 damage.</color>

german.name: Schlingmine
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Originally a naval mine tossed ashore by a powerful tsunami, this fella now lies half-buried in the soil. Though the kelp outside has withered, the explosives inside remain deadly.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Potato Mine tangled with kelp.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>Insta-kill (Drown)</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> When armed, insta-kills the first approaching zombie and triggers a Potato Mine explosion.</color>

original.name: 缠绕地刺
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>缠绕地刺是水足疗法的创始人，他的足疗产业蒸蒸日上、连锁店开遍各地。为了适应日益繁荣的车辆交通，他还开发了车辆按摩，这使他的生意更加火爆。</color>
original.info:
攻击时可以赋予陆地水草值的地刺。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20/1秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>攻击赋予1点陆地水草值（附加的伤害为对应水草值的1/3）</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>地刺（底座）+缠绕水草</color>

english.name: Tangle Weed
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Founder of the now-famous aquatic foot massage empire, Tangle Weed has redefined spa therapy. With branches in every biome and a new line of vehicular massage lanes, business is booming—especially with traffic this bad.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Tangle Weed applies Tangle Value to zombies, even though it is on land.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Attacks add 1 land Tangle Value (1/3 the efficacy of aquatic Tangle Value).</color>

german.name: Tangle Weed
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Founder of the now-famous aquatic foot massage empire, Tangle Weed has redefined spa therapy. With branches in every biome and a new line of vehicular massage lanes, business is booming—especially with traffic this bad.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Spikeweed that tangles zombies even on land.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Attacks add 1 land Tangle Value (1/3 the efficacy of aquatic Tangle Value).</color>

original.name: 水草坚果
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>众人都说他性情孤僻，难题缠身如乱麻难解，心肠坚硬难以接近。但谁能否认他对独处的渴望呢？除了猫尾草——它有时会误把他当作一团毛线球，嬉戏玩闹。</color>
original.info:
柔韧的水生坚果，身上的水草能起到阻拦索作用。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>水生</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>被啃咬时赋予啃咬者1点水草值</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>免疫碾压的即死效果。被碾压时，每0.02秒受伤50以赋予碾压者1点水草值</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>缠绕水草（底座）+坚果</color>

english.name: Tangle-nut
english.introduce:
<align=left><size=36><color=black>Everyone says Tangle-nut is very reclusive, with such tangled problems that it is difficult to unravel to reach such a hard heart. But who can deny his desire for solitude? No one, except Cattail, who sometimes mistakes him for a ball of string to play with.

-Written by Ultra Badlander</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Tangle-nut applies Tangle Value onto zombies that hurt it.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000> When bitten, inflicts 1 Tangle value on the attacker. When crushed, loses 50 HP every 0.02s and inflicts 1 Tangle value each time.</color>

german.name: Schlingnuss
german.introduce:
<align=left><size=36><color=black>Everyone says Tangle-nut is very reclusive, with such tangled problems that it is difficult to unravel to reach such a hard heart. But who can deny his desire for solitude? No one, except Cattail, who sometimes mistakes him for a ball of string to play with.

-Written by Ultra Badlander</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Applies Tangle value as retaliation.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000> When bitten, inflicts 1 Tangle value on the attacker. When crushed, loses 50 HP every 0.02s and inflicts 1 Tangle value each time.</color>

original.name: 仙人掌坚果
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>仙人掌坚果认为自己才是地刺坚果。“看我这身刺，还有我这充满生命力的颜色！”每天不知疲倦地重复。“你说的地刺坚果到底是谁？”有天终于有人忍不住问道。</color>
original.info:
长满仙人掌针刺的坚果，能伸长高度阻击气球。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>拥有50点啃咬反伤</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>可以扎破气球</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>坚果+仙人掌</color>

english.name: Thorn-nut
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Thorn-nut proudly insists he's the true Spike-nut. "Look at these spines! This color!" he declares constantly. One day, someone finally asked, "Wait… who's Spike-nut again?"</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Thorn-nut can grow taller to block the flight of airborne zombies.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Reflects 50 damage back to zombies biting it.
<color=black>•</color> Can pop Balloons.</color>

german.name: Kaktnuss
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Thorn-nut proudly insists he's the true Spike-nut. "Look at these spines! This color!" he declares constantly. One day, someone finally asked, "Wait… who's Spike-nut again?"</color>
german.info:
<size=36>A cactus-covered nut that punishes attackers and disables balloon zombies.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Reflects 50 damage back to zombies biting it.
<color=black>•</color> Can pop Balloons.</color>

original.name: 仙人掌地刺
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>他曾经是一株仙人掌，在大象研究所工作。</color>
original.info:
能扎到空中单位的地刺。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20/1秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每次攻击向上方发射3发尖刺，普通攻击和子弹均可对空</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>地刺+仙人掌</color>

english.name: Thornweed
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>She used to be a simple Cactus working at the Elephant research institute, addressing the elephants.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Thornweed can shoot spikes upwards to attack zombies, even airborne ones!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Each attack fires 3 spikes upward; both regular attack and projectiles can hit flying zombies.</color>

german.name: Thornweed
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>She used to be a simple Cactus working at the Elephant research institute, addressing the elephants.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Thornweed can shoot spikes upwards to attack zombies, even airborne ones!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Each attack fires 3 spikes upward; both regular attack and projectiles can hit flying zombies.</color>

original.name: 仙人掌南瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>不行，最好还是不要掌击这个南瓜。</color>
original.info:
长满仙人掌针刺的南瓜。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>拥有50点啃咬反伤</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>南瓜（底座）+仙人掌</color>

english.name: Thorny Pumpkin
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Thorny Pumpkin might look like a distant relative of Pumpkin, but its current form comes from a desert adventure with Blover. Strangely enough, it doesn't seem to have visible thorns, yet plants that try to hop into it always get poked, leaving them questioning how it happens.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Thorny Pumpkin counterattacks the zombies that bite it.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Reflects 50 damage back to zombies biting it.</color></size>

german.name: Stachelkürbis
german.introduce: <size=34><color=black>Stachelkürbis sieht vielleicht aus wie ein entfernter Verwandter von Kürbis, doch seine jetzige Form stammt von einem Wüstenabenteuer mit Wehblatt. Seltsamerweise scheint er keine sichtbaren Dornen zu haben, doch Pflanzen, die versuchen, sich in ihn zu schwingen, werden immer gestochen, was sie verwirrt zurücklässt, ohne zu wissen, wie es geschieht.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=34>Wehrt sich mit einem Gegenangriff gegen die Zombies, die es beißen.

<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Angreifenden Feinden Schaden zufügen.</color></size>

original.name: “高”坚果射手
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“三个臭皮匠，赛过诸葛亮！”三个个头矮小的坚果凑到了一起，成为了形影不离的伙伴，迸发出了难以想象的能量，直到有一天，他们被红色油漆浇了个透，然后被一个一个咬了下来。</color>
original.info:
叠高高的坚果射手，在不同的高度，会吐出滚动性能不同的滚地坚果。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>12000</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>80/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>高大</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>血量首次低于某个损伤点（2/3倍韧性、1/3倍韧性）时，永久失去连体坚果中的一个，损失1/3倍初始韧性</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>子弹能穿透2次。每失去一个连体坚果，子弹伤害减少20，穿透次数增加2次</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>坚果+三线射手</color>

english.name: Three-nuts
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Three ordinary nuts together are smarter than Zhuge Liang!" Three-nuts joined forces, becoming inseparable companions and unleashing unimaginable potential. These three have a knack for physics, and apparently fluid dynamics is their strongsuit.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Three-nuts attack with a high damage nut bullet, but when one is lost, it cannot be healed back.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> (12-8k HP) 80, pierces twice;
<color=black>•</color> (8-4k HP) 60, pierces 4 times;
<color=black>•</color> (4k-0 HP) 40, pierces 6 times</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Tall plant. Has 12k HP in total. Each Small-nut has 4k HP. Losing one Small-nut permanently reduces max HP by 4k.</color>

german.name: Triple-Nuss
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Three ordinary nuts together are smarter than Zhuge Liang!" Three-nuts joined forces, becoming inseparable companions and unleashing unimaginable potential. These three have a knack for physics, and apparently fluid dynamics is their strongsuit.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Three small-nuts stacked on top of each other.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> (12-8k HP) 80, pierces twice;
<color=black>•</color> (8-4k HP) 60, pierces 4 times;
<color=black>•</color> (4k-0 HP) 40, pierces 6 times</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Tall plant. Has 12k HP in total. Each Small-nut has 4k HP. Losing one Small-nut permanently reduces max HP by 4k.</color>

original.name: 三线土豆雷
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>三线土豆雷喜欢在地下搞恶作剧。他发射的惊喜不是一个、两个，而是三个——就像个爆竹用之不尽的捣蛋鬼一样。走路小心点，否则你可能会受到三倍的爆炸，足以把你的脚炸飞。</color>
original.info:
出土后可以向三行发射子弹的土豆雷，爆炸后稍作休整便可重新出土。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>30×3/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>距离本行前方僵尸越近攻击间隔越短，最低0.3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>接触僵尸时造成5400伤害的小范围爆炸并击退1格，然后入土15秒，接触载具时不会入土</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>土豆雷+三线射手</color>

english.name: Threetato Mine
english.introduce:
<align=left><size=36><color=black>Threetato Mine loves playing tricks underground. It shoots out surprises not once, not twice, but thrice—like a cheeky prankster with a never-ending stash of boom. Watch your step, or you might get a triple whammy that’ll blow your boots off.

- Written by Mrs. Draco</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Threetato Mine resurfaces after exploding and fires potatoes across three lanes.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>30×3/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Attacks faster as zombies get closer (down to 0.5s per attack).
<color=black>•</color> When armed, explodes on contact, dealing 5400 damage, knocks back for 1 tile and retreats into the ground.
<color=black>•</color> Re-emerges 15s after exploding. Explodes and disappears immediately upon contact with vehicles.</color>

german.name: Minenfeld
german.introduce:
<align=left><size=36><color=black>Threetato Mine loves playing tricks underground. It shoots out surprises not once, not twice, but thrice—like a cheeky prankster with a never-ending stash of boom. Watch your step, or you might get a triple whammy that’ll blow your boots off.

- Written by Mrs. Draco</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Threetato Mine resurfaces after exploding and fires potatoes across three lanes.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>30×3/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Attacks faster as zombies get closer (down to 0.5s per attack).
<color=black>•</color> When armed, explodes on contact, dealing 5400 damage, knocks back for 1 tile and retreats into the ground.
<color=black>•</color> Re-emerges 15s after exploding. Explodes and disappears immediately upon contact with vehicles.</color>

original.name: 三叶海蘑菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>三叶海蘑菇掌控着来自东方的名为“风水”的力量，能让不好的东西都远离自己，不管是天上飞的还是水里游的。</color>
original.info:
扇动水流，对本行的僵尸施加阻力。

<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>水生，低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>出场时释放三叶草效果。使本行所有水中僵尸缓缓回退至底线</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>海蘑菇（底座）+三叶草</color>

english.name: Tide-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Tide-shroom has aspirations as grand as a dragon's. Mastering the ancient art of "Feng Shui" from the East, he is well aware of both lucky and unlucky positions. Understanding that wind and water complement each other, he hopes to keep misfortune at bay, whether soaring in the sky or gliding through the water.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Tide-shroom dispels fog and blows back zombies in the water.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Dispels fog and pushes the zombies in his lane to the rightmost column.
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).</color></size>

german.name: Meeresbläserpilz
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Meeresbläserpilz hat Aspirationen so groß wie die eines Drachen. Nachdem er die alte Kunst des „Feng Shui“ aus dem Osten gemeistert hat, ist er sich der glücklichen und unglücklichen Richtungen bestens bewusst. Da er versteht, dass Wind und Wasser sich ergänzen, hofft er, das Unglück fernzuhalten, sei es beim Schwingen in der Luft oder beim Gleiten durchs Wasser.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Vertreibt Nebel und bläst Zombies im Wasser zurück.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Vertreibt Nebel und wehrt Wasserzombies ab.</color></size>

original.name: 水草苗
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>小小的水草苗非常警惕，他一株水草独居，只在浅水层找食物，必要时甚至会藏在僵尸身下躲避天敌，连睡觉都睁着一只眼睛，对于只有一只眼睛的他来说，这可不是件容易的事。</color>
original.info:
接触僵尸时会破裂并附着在其身上，条件合适时重新萌发。

<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>水生，低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20×30</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>有僵尸接近本格时，爆出30发会赋予1点水草值的水草子弹，然后消失</color>
<color=#3D1400>孢子萌发：</color><color=red>僵尸被赋予水草值的攻击击杀时，会在原地生成一个水草苗</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>缠绕水草（底座）+小喷菇</color>

english.name: Tingle Kelp
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Tingle Kelp is extremely vigilant. It lives alone, foraging only in shallow waters. When necessary, it even hides beneath zombies to evade predators. It sleeps with one eye open—no easy feat for a plant with only one eye.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Tingle Kelp can spawn from the death of zombies by tangle projectiles, it bursts into a bunch of tangle projectiles of its own on contact.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20 × 30</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>When a zombie comes into contact with Tingle Kelp, it will burst into 30 kelp projectiles that inflict 1 Tangle value before disappearing. If a zombie is killed by a kelp projectile, an extra Tingle Kelp will spawn on that tile (if possible).</color>

german.name: Klein-Tang
german.introduce: <color=#3D1400>Tingle Kelp is extremely vigilant. It lives alone, foraging only in shallow waters. When necessary, it even hides beneath zombies to evade predators. It sleeps with one eye open—no easy feat for a plant with only one eye.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>When coming in contact with a zombie, Tingle Kelp explodes and attaches itself to other zombies to multiply.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20 × 30</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>When a zombie comes into contact with Tingle Kelp, it will burst into 30 kelp projectiles that inflict 1 Tangle value before disappearing. If a zombie is killed by the kelp projectile, an extra Tingle Kelp will spawn on that tile (if possible).</color>

original.name: 火炬向日葵
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>火炬向日葵总是非常开朗，甚至连博士论文都能笑着完成。“成为阳光，而不只是寻找阳光。”她在文章结尾的致谢中如是说到。</color>
original.info:
能将周围子弹熔炼为阳光的向日葵。

<color=#3D1400>阳光产量：</color><color=red>25/25秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>生产阳光时，将半径1.5格内的每个植物方子弹转化为5阳光</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>向日葵+火炬树桩</color>

english.name: Torchflower
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Torchflower is always cheerful, even able to smile through her doctoral dissertation. "Become the sunshine you have always been looking for." she wrote in the acknowledgments at the end of her paper.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Torchflower periodically turns nearby projectiles into Sun!

<color=black>Sun Output: </color><color=#8B0000>25/25s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Each time she produces Sun, converts all plant (and hypnotized zombie) projectiles in a 1.5 tile radius into Sun at a rate of 5 Sun per projectile.</color>

german.name: Zundersonne
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Torchflower is always cheerful, even able to smile through her doctoral dissertation. "Become the sunshine you have always been looking for." she wrote in the acknowledgments at the end of her paper.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Melts nearby projectiles into Sun!

<color=black>Sun Output: </color><color=#8B0000>25/25s</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Each time she produces Sun, converts all plant (and hypnotized zombie) projectiles in a 1.5 tile radius into Sun at a rate of 5 Sun per projectile.</color>

original.name: 三线火炬树桩
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>植物们总是羡慕三线火炬为什么如此富有。“这没什么大不了的。”三线火炬从头发里变出三颗豌豆，“其实，我曾经是马戏团的兼职魔术师。”</color>
original.info:
开裂的火炬树桩，将经过的一颗豌豆变为多颗火焰豌豆。

<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>只能点燃豌豆，第1次正常点燃，第2次点燃分裂成上下2行各1个，第3次点燃分裂成3行各1个，依次循环</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>三线射手+火炬树桩</color>

english.name: Torchthree
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Why is Torchthree so rich?" the plants frequently pondered. "Oh, it's no big deal," he shrugged. Torchthree then produced three peas from his hair and added, "I used to work as a magician in a circus."</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Torchthree turns incoming projectiles into flaming peas and splits them across multiple lanes!

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
Ignites peas:
<color=black>•</color> 1st ignition is exactly like Torchwood;
<color=black>•</color> 2nd ignition splits into two peas on the rows above and below;
<color=black>•</color> 3rd ignition splits into three peas across all three rows;
<color=black>•</color> The cycle repeats.</color></size>

german.name: Dreifachfackel
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>„Warum ist Dreifachfackel so reich?“, fragten sich die Pflanzen häufig. „Ach, nichts Besonderes“, zuckte er mit den Schultern. Dreifachfackel holte dann drei Erbsen aus seinem Haar und fügte hinzu: „Ich habe früher als Magier in einem Zirkus gearbeitet.“</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Dreifachfackel kann eine Erbse in drei brennende Erbsen verwandeln.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Spaltet die Erbsen, die hindurchgehen, in 3 kleine flammende Erbsen, die 30 Spritzschaden verursachen.</color></size>

original.name: 火炬地刺
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“我是火炬地刺，僵尸们的‘热情烤肉师’。点燃小豌豆，我就能给他们来个‘烧烤派对’，不过别担心，我是专业级的，保证外焦里嫩！”</color>
original.info:
旺盛燃烧的地刺，能点燃小豌豆，还能生成焰光地刺。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40/1秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>火焰伤害。能攻击空中的气球</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>影响经过的特定子弹</color>
<color=#A86A44>·小豌豆：</color><color=red>点燃，伤害+20</color>
<color=#A86A44>·滚地坚果：</color><color=red>伤害×2，重置穿透次数</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>每影响超过100个子弹，在前方生成一个不能用于融合的焰光地刺</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>地刺+火炬树桩</color>

english.name: Torchweed
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I'm Torchweed, the zombies' passionate barbecue chef! Ignite that little pea, and I'll throw them an unforgettable barbecue party. Rest assured, I'm a professional—I guarantee it will be crispy on the outside and tender on the inside!"</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Torchweed can ignite small peas and puncture vehicles.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Ignite small peas for increased, and splashed, damage.
<color=black>•</color> For every 100 small peas lit, a Roasted Spikeweed is spawned in front.
<color=black>•</color> Can also pop the balloons of regular Balloon Zombies.</color></size>

german.name: Zunderkraut
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>„Ich bin Zunderkraut, der leidenschaftliche Grillmeister der Zombies! Entzünde diese kleine Erbse, und ich werde ihnen eine unvergessliche Grillparty servieren. Keine Sorge, ich bin ein Profi – ich garantiere, dass sie außen knusprig und innen zart sein wird!“</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Zunderkraut kann kleine Erbsen entzünden und Fahrzeuge durchbohren.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Zünde kleine Erbsen an, um den Schaden zu erhöhen und zu spritzen. Jedes Mal, wenn 100 kleine Erbsen angezündet werden, wird ein Stachelkraut davor gepflanzt.</color></size>

original.name: 三线花盆
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>三线花盆的店铺始终好评如潮，他自第一次卖豌豆子弹时便举行“买一送二”的活动，豌豆们兴高采烈地下了单，直到射击时才发觉赠品全是纸糊的。不过考虑到实惠的价格，也就没人在意这件事了。</color>
original.info:
作为射击基座，为三线射手增幅火力，为豌豆射手拓展弹道。 

<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮，可种裸地，载体</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>通过融合来生成时，额外返还100阳光</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>上方的三线射手类植物获得20%攻击力加成</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>上方的豌豆射手类植物每攻击6次，就在上下邻行分别按攻击力的50%攻击一次，此攻击享受边路补偿</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>花盆（底座）+三线射手</color>

english.name: Tri-pot
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Tri-pot's shop has always received glowing reviews. Ever since he first sold pea projectiles, he has held a "buy one, get two free" promotion. The peas happily placed their orders, only to discover during firing that the freebies were all made of paper. However, considering the affordable price, nobody really minded.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Tri-pot boosts the attack of Threepeater-type plants and expands the lane coverage of Peashooter-type plants.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant. Returns an extra 100 Sun on fusion.
<color=black>•</color> Threepeater-type plants placed above gain 20% attack power bonus.
<color=black>•</color> Peashooter-type plants placed above attack once in each adjacent lane after every 6 attacks, dealing 50% of their attack power. This attack benefits from edge lane compensation.</color>

german.name: Tri-pot
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Tri-pot's shop has always received glowing reviews. Ever since he first sold pea projectiles, he has held a "buy one, get two free" promotion. The peas happily placed their orders, only to discover during firing that the freebies were all made of paper. However, considering the affordable price, nobody really minded.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Tri-pot boosts the attack of Threepeater-type plants and expands the lane coverage of Peashooter-type plants.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant. Returns an extra 100 Sun on fusion.
<color=black>•</color> Threepeater-type plants placed above gain 20% attack power bonus.
<color=black>•</color> Peashooter-type plants placed above attack once in each adjacent lane after every 6 attacks, dealing 50% of their attack power. This attack benefits from edge lane compensation.</color>

original.name: 樱桃大喷菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>为了提高樱桃子弹流水线的生产效率，樱桃大喷菇制造出了一种全新的染料，这样的染料同时兼具快速风干、染色方便、不易掉色等特点，可以说除了会爆炸以外找不出任何缺点。</color>
original.info:
喷出的烟雾会将粉樱桃催化成爆炸樱桃。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>攻击时，将前方5.5格内最多4发平射的粉樱桃或火焰粉樱桃子弹转化为爆炸樱桃，转化粉樱桃时使其伤害翻倍</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>转化范围内有可以转化的子弹时，也会进行攻击</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大喷菇+樱桃炸弹</color>

english.name: Trigger-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>To improve the efficiency of the cherry projectile production line, Trigger-shroom created a brand-new dye. It dries quickly, is easy to apply, and does not fade easily. It is practically flawless, except for the fact that it is also highly volatile.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Trigger-shroom's fumes catalyze Pink Cherries into Exploding Cherries.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> When attacking, converts up to 4 straight-firing cherry projectiles or ignited cherry projectiles within 5.5 tiles ahead into explosive cherries. Converted cherries deal double damage.
<color=black>•</color> If there are convertible projectiles within range, it will attack even without a zombie.</color>

german.name: Trigger-shroom
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>To improve the efficiency of the cherry projectile production line, Trigger-shroom created a brand-new dye. It dries quickly, is easy to apply, and does not fade easily. It is practically flawless, except for the fact that it is also highly volatile.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Trigger-shroom's fumes catalyze Pink Cherries into Exploding Cherries.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> When attacking, converts up to 4 straight-firing cherry projectiles or ignited cherry projectiles within 5.5 tiles ahead into explosive cherries. Converted cherries deal double damage.
<color=black>•</color> If there are convertible projectiles within range, it will attack even without a zombie.</color>

original.name: 三线路灯花
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>三线路灯花最喜欢的数字是3，三倍的光明，三倍的视力，就连每个月的工资都是三倍的，富裕的存款让他能买三倍的零食、储存在自己的三个灯箱里面。</color>
original.info:
提供普通路灯花三倍的光照，能将激光分束为三道。

<color=#3D1400>光照范围：</color><color=red>3×3,3级</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>流光大灯菇的激光/流光仙人掌的对地激光会在穿过时，额外在本行产生两束伤害30的激光</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>路灯花+三线射手</color>

english.name: Triplantern
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Triplantern's favorite number is three. Triple the light, triple the vision, even triple the salary. With savings that generous, he can afford triple the snacks, neatly stored in his triple lamp cases. The triple things that he hates are triple the zombies, triple the waves and triple the gacha levels.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Triplantern provides triple the Lumos of a normal Plantern and splits lasers into three.

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Provides 3 Lumos levels in a 3×3 area.
<color=black>•</color> Lumos Cactus and Ray-shroom anti-ground lasers that pass through will create two additional lasers in the same lane, each dealing 30 damage.</color>

german.name: Triplanterne
german.introduce: <color=#3D1400>Triplantern's favorite number is three. Triple the light, triple the vision, even triple the salary. With savings that generous, he can afford triple the snacks, neatly stored in his triple lamp cases. The triple things that he hates are triple the zombies, triple the waves and triple the gacha levels.</color>
german.info:
Provides triple the Lumos of a normal Plantern and splits lasers into three.

<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Provides 3 Lumos levels in a 3×3 area.
<color=black>•</color> Lumos Cactus and Ray-shroom anti-ground lasers that pass through will create two additional lasers in the same lane, each dealing 30 damage.</color>

original.name: 双子金盏花
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“该产生金币了！”双子金盏花中的一朵叫到。而另一朵坚持认为，“这个时候就应该产出一枚银币！”因为她们总是争执不下，所以干脆都独自去产出自己的的那一份，也许这样对她们来讲也是一件好事。“双倍的意见，双倍的效率。难道不是吗？”</color>
original.info:
金钱产量是金盏花的两倍还多。

<color=#3D1400>金钱产量：</color><color=red>2次/20秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>有75%概率生产银币（100金钱）、20%概率生产金币（300金钱）、5%概率生产钻石（1000金钱）</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>金盏花×2</color>

english.name: Twin Marigold
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"It's time to make gold coins!" one of the Twin Marigold sister declares. But the other sister insists, "Now's the perfect time for a silver coin!" Since they can never agree, they each produce their own share independently, which might actually be for the best. "Double opinions, double efficiency—isn't that right?"</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Twin Marigold produces double the amount of money!

<color=black>Coin Output: </color><color=#8B0000>Generates Coins twice every 20 seconds, otherwise identical to Marigold.</color>

german.name: Doppelringelblume
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>„Es ist Zeit, Goldmünzen zu machen!“, erklärt eine der Doppelringelblumen-Schwestern. Aber die andere Schwester besteht darauf: „Jetzt ist der perfekte Zeitpunkt für eine Silbermünze!“ Da sie sich nie einigen können, produziert jede ihren eigenen Anteil unabhängig, was vielleicht tatsächlich das Beste ist. „Doppelte Meinungen, doppelte Effizienz – oder nicht?“</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Erzeugt doppelt so viele Münzen!

<color=black>Coin Output: </color><color=#8B0000>Erzeugt zweimal alle 20 Sekunden Münzen, ansonsten identisch mit Ringelblume.</color>

original.name: 阳光帝果
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>阳光帝果是公认的光合作用专家，他不仅能将僵尸啃咬的动能转化为光能，还实现了光能-质量转换这一重大科研成果。“感谢向日葵、阳光菇在一次次和火红莲等前辈在光学领域的探索，”采访中，阳光帝果十分谦虚的回答道:我只是站在了巨人的肩膀上。</color>
original.info:
受击时将血量转化为阳光，可用于点击时回血，并生成巨型保龄球。

<color=#3D1400>使用条件：</color><color=red>旅行模式</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>阳光坚果+坚果</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>受击时，免疫该伤害，固定受伤50并掉落15阳光</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>点击会消耗500阳光，然后：
·回复1倍韧性的血量
·在前方生成1个巨型阳光坚果，停止点击1秒后滚动；若在其滚动前继续点击，则仅增幅其体型和伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>巨型阳光坚果：</color><color=red>直线滚动，伤害为600/0.02秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条1：</color><color=red>无关痛痒：固定受伤减至10点；解锁亚种火焰帝果</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条2：</color><color=red>妙手回春：点击消耗的阳光降低至200点</color>

english.name: Twin Solar-nut
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Twin Solar-nut, a photosynthesis master, revolutionized light energy-mass conversion, minimizing energy loss through recycling. He humbly credits the pioneers: "I'm just standing on the shoulders of giants."</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Twin Solar-nut produces Sun every time it is injured, and can summon a reinforcement with a click!

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Tapping on it:
- Spends 500 Sun.
- Restores his Toughness to full.
- Summons a Giant Solar-nut 1 tile ahead.
- Improves an existing Giant Solar-nut by enlarging its size and damage (higher base damage yields less bonus, down to 60%).
- After not tapping for 1s, the existing Giant Solar-nut will roll forward, crushing zombies. Damage per 0.02s is 600/1200/1644 for 1/2/3 taps respectively.<color=black>
•</color> Regardless of the damage type, each damage it receives will reduce a set 50 Toughness. Produces 15 Sun after every such hit.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
</color><color=#8B0000>1. Click Cost 500 → 200 Sun | Effects also apply to SP variants
2. Twin Solar-nut: Toughness reduces by 10 for each hit instead of 50 | Twin Inferno-nut Subspecies Unlocked | Effects also apply to SP variants</color></size>

german.name: Doppelsolar-Nuss
german.introduce: <size=28><color=black>Doppelsolar-Nuss, ein Meister der Photosynthese, revolutionierte die Umwandlung von Lichtenergie in Masse, indem er den Energieverlust durch Recycling minimierte. Bescheiden würdigt er die Pioniere: „Ich stehe nur auf den Schultern von Giganten.“</color></size>
german.info:
<size=28>Doppelsolar-Nuss produziert Sonnen, jedes Mal wenn sie verletzt wird.

<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Unabhängig von der Schadensart reduziert jeder Angriff auf ihn nur 50 Ausdauer. Erzeugt nach jedem Treffer 15 Sun. Ein Klick auf ihn verbraucht 500 Sun, lässt eine Riesen-Nuss herunterrollen und stellt 1500 Ausdauer wieder her.</color>
<color=black>Odyssee Verbesserung:
</color><color=#8B0000>1. Stattdessen volle Ausdauer wiederherstellen
2. Ausdauer pro Treffer reduziert → 10</color></size>

original.name: 双子向日葵
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>这是一个疯狂的夜晚，禁忌的科学技术，让双子向日葵来到了这个世界。电闪雷鸣，狂风怒吼，整个世界都对它的到来表示抗议。但是这一切都于事无补，双子向日葵仍然高调地活着！​</color>
original.info:
阳光产量是向日葵的两倍还多。

<color=#3D1400>阳光产量：</color><color=red>25×2/20秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>向日葵×2</color>

english.name: Twin Sunflower
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The Twin Sunflower are known as sisters, always working behind the scenes rather than on the battlefield's front lines. Their role is to support everyone from the rear, but make no mistake—you must protect them. If they're harmed, many plants will quietly shed tears.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Twin Sunflowers give twice as much sun as a normal sunflower.

<color=black>Sun Output: </color><color=#8B0000>25×2/20s</color></size>

german.name: Doppelsonnenblume
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Doppelsonnenblume entstand bei einem verunglückten Experiment mitten in der Nacht. Donner krachte, seltsame Lichter flackerten, und sogar der heulende Wind schien seinem Unmut Luft zu machen. Doch vergeblich. Doppelsonnenblume lebte, SIE LEBTE!</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Doppelsonnenblumen erzeugen doppelt so viele Sonnen wie normale Sonnenblumen.

<color=black>Sonnenproduktion: </color><color=#8B0000>25*2/20 Sekunden</color></size>

original.name: 杨桃小蘑菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>杨桃小蘑菇会出现在戴夫家的各个角落，地上、桌子上、餐盘里——戴夫总是把大夫的提醒忘在脑后——管他呢，反正黛西是挺喜欢这款维生素软糖的</color>
original.info:
形似杨桃的小蘑菇，慢慢发射星星。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20×5/2.25秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮，可密植</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>小喷菇（底座）+杨桃</color>

english.name: Twinkle-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Twinkle-shroom would be all over Dave's house, on the floor, on the table, on the dinner plate - Dave always forgot about the Doc's reminder - who cares, Daisy loved the gummy vitamins anyway!</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Twinkle-shroom is a small mushroom that shoots mini-stars.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20×5/2.25 Seconds (Equivalent to the DPS of 10 Peashooters) </color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).</color>

german.name: Funkelpilz
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Twinkle-shroom would be all over Dave's house, on the floor, on the table, on the dinner plate - Dave always forgot about the Doc's reminder - who cares, Daisy loved the gummy vitamins anyway!</color>
german.info:
<size=36>A small mushroom that shoots mini-stars.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20×5/2.25 Seconds (Equivalent to the DPS of 10 Peashooters) </color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).</color>

original.name: 保护伞小蘑菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>像族中的其他保护伞一样，小蘑菇保护伞也有远大的抱负，并且同样愿意为了保护这个世界牺牲自己。虽然他不像其他保护伞那样高大、能保护其他植物，但是他找到了另一样自己能保护的东西——脚下这片他所热爱的土地。</color>
original.info:
用小小的身躯拼命击退敌人。

<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮，可密植</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>每30秒在本格自我繁殖1株</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>伞类击退：无伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>触发伞类击退后，自身会消失。如果目标是缩小的僵尸，则改为受伤50</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color>
<color=red>小喷菇（底座）+叶子保护伞</color>

english.name: Umbrella Cap
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Like other Umbrellas, Umbrella Caps have great ambitions and are willing to sacrifice themselves to protect the world. Though not tall enough to protect other plants, they have found something else to protect, the land they live on and love so deeply.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Umbrella Caps can reproduce themselves onto their tile, but don't do well against regular sized zombies.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>300</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Repels the first zombie on contact, then vanishes.
<color=black>•</color> Against shrunken zombies, repels them and loses 50 HP instead.
<color=black>•</color> Spawns a new Umbrella Cap in his tile every 30s.</color>

german.name: Fingerhut-Schirm
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Like other Umbrellas, Umbrella Caps have great ambitions and are willing to sacrifice themselves to protect the world. Though not tall enough to protect other plants, they have found something else to protect, the land they live on and love so deeply.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Uses their small body to desperately fend off enemies.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>300</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).
<color=black>•</color> Repels the first zombie on contact, then vanishes.
<color=black>•</color> Against shrunken zombies, repels them and loses 50 HP instead.
<color=black>•</color> Spawns a new Umbrella Cap in his tile every 30s.</color>

original.name: 大蒜保护伞
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“来，抱抱蒜伞。你只管开房车办法由蒜伞来想！房车不重要，房车里面的脑子才重要！”蒜伞说，“还有一件事，要用僵尸来打败僵尸。还有一件事，还不去给蒜伞倒杯茶？僵尸僵尸快离开，僵尸僵尸快离开！”</color>
original.info:
蒜味的保护伞，击退接近的僵尸并使其换行。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>伞类击退：伤害40，使目标随机换行</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>叶子保护伞+大蒜</color>

english.name: Umbrella Clove
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Come, give Umbrella Clove a hug. You focus on opening the door; let Umbrella Clove handle the rest! The RV doesn't matter; it's the brains inside that count!" Umbrella Clove says. "And one more thing—fight zombies with zombies! And pour some tea for Umbrella Clove while you're at it! Zombies, zombies, go away!"</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Umbrella Clove knocks back zombies and forces them to switch lanes.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>1000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Knocks back nearby zombies, dealing 40 damage, at the cost of Toughness, forcing them to change lanes. For specific self damage amounts, see Umbrella Husk.</color>

german.name: Schirmknoblauch
german.introduce: <size=32><color=black>„Komm, gib Schirmknoblauch eine Umarmung. Du kümmerst dich ums Türöffnen; Schirmknoblauch übernimmt den Rest! Der Wohnwagen ist egal; es sind die Köpfe drin, die zählen!“, sagt Schirmknoblauch. „Und noch etwas – kämpfe mit Zombies gegen Zombies! Und schenk Schirmknoblauch eine Tasse Tee ein, während du dabei bist! Zombies, Zombies, verzieht euch!“</color>
german.info:
<size=32>Schleudert Zombies zurück und zwingt sie, die Bahn zu wechseln.

<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>1000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Stößt Zombies in der Nähe zurück und zwingt sie, die Spur zu wechseln; jeder Rückstoß verringert ihre Ausdauer. Siehe Schirmhülle.</color>

original.name: 黄油保护伞
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“保护周围的植物，是我的责任。”作为一个职业coser，“黄油保护伞”精湛的cosplay技巧成功骗过了所有人，没有人看得出来，其实他是一根“顶”着黄油假发，喜欢倒立的玉米。</color>
original.info:
用覆有黄油的伞叶击退僵尸并定身。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>伞类击退：伤害40，施加2秒黄油定身</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>叶子保护伞+玉米投手</color>

english.name: Umbrella Husk
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Protecting the plants around me is my duty." As a professional cosplayer, "Umbrella Husk" is so skilled that no one realizes he's actually a corn cob with a butter wig, who loves to stand on his head.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Umbrella Husk knocks back zombies that try to approach and immobilizes them with butter.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>1000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Knocks back nearby zombies, dealing 40 damage and immobilizes them with Butter for 2s at the cost of its Toughness. 
<color=black>•</color> 1 Zombie: -100 Toughness
<color=black>•</color> 2~4 Zombies: -150 Toughness
<color=black>•</color> 5 or more Zombies: -250 Toughness</color>

german.name: Schirmhülle
german.introduce: <size=32><color=black>„Die Pflanzen um mich herum zu schützen, ist meine Pflicht.“ Als professioneller Cosplayer ist „Schirmhülle“ so geschickt, dass niemand merkt, dass er eigentlich ein Maiskolben mit einer Butterperücke ist, der es liebt, auf seinem Kopf zu stehen.</color>
german.info:
<size=32>Schirmhülle stößt Zombies zurück, die versuchen, sich zu nähern, und lähmt sie mit Butter.

<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>1000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Schlägt Zombies in der Nähe zurück und macht sie für 4 Sekunden bewegungsunfähig; Rückschläge reduzieren die Ausdauer:
1 Zombie: -100 HP
2~4 Zombies: -150 HP
5 oder mehr Zombies: -250 HP</color>

original.name: 卷心菜保护伞
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>当问到卷心菜保护伞成功的秘籍时，她说：“实际上我只是很难让球停在我的头上。”她停顿了一下，“不过其他植物都夸我顶瓜瓜。”</color>
original.info:
用弹韧的菜叶弹射并强化投手子弹。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>可以承接并弹射后方的投手子弹，使其伤害增加75%、目标改为本行水平距离最近的敌人</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>伞类击退：无伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>叶子保护伞+卷心菜投手</color>

english.name: Umbrella Kale
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>When asked about her secret to success, Umbrella Kale replied, "Actually, I just really enjoy letting balls rest on my head." She paused, "But the other plants all praise me as a top-notch protector."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Umbrella Kale can bounce catapult-type projectiles to increase their damage. 

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>1000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Prioritized by catapults for targeting. Increases projectile damage by 75%.
<color=black>•</color> If there are no zombies, it can store projectiles for a while.
<color=black>•</color> Knocks back zombies at the cost of Toughness. For specific self damage amounts, see Umbrella Husk.</color>

german.name: Schirmkohl
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Als sie nach ihrem Geheimnis für den Erfolg gefragt wurde, antwortete Schirmkohl: „Eigentlich genieße ich es einfach, Bälle auf meinem Kopf ruhen zu lassen.“ Sie pausierte. „Aber die anderen Pflanzen loben mich als hervorragenden Beschützer.“</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Kann Katapult-Projektile abprallen lassen. Wenn keine Zombies da sind, kann sie Projektile eine Weile speichern und deren Schaden erheblich steigern.

<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>1000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Wird von Katapulten beim Zielen bevorzugt und erhöht den Projektilschaden um 80%, stößt herannahende Zombies zurück und verliert jedes Mal an Ausdauer. Siehe Schirmhülle.</color>

original.name: 保护伞花盆
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>其他花盆都很疑惑保护伞花盆为什么会有那么浓密的叶子，但保护伞花盆只是说：“我只是读了《花盆的生发护理》这本书罢了。”</color>
original.info:
帮助上方伞类植物更好地舒展身躯。

<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>可种裸地，低矮，载体</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>提升上方保护伞类植物的效果</color>
<color=#3D1400>①</color><color=red>伞类大招/含有大蒜的保护伞类融合植物：击退距离翻倍
其他保护伞：击退距离+50%</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>卷心菜保护伞/绿宝石伞：弹射的子弹攻击范围在上下各增加一行</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>西瓜保护伞/红宝石伞：反弹和还击的子弹伤害翻倍</color>
<color=#3D1400>④</color><color=red>黄油保护伞：定身时间+2秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>
花盆（底座）+叶子保护伞</color>

english.name: Umbrella Pot
english.introduce: Other flower pots are puzzled by the dense foliage of Umbrella Pot, but Umbrella Pot simply says, "I just read the book The Pot's Guide to Hair Care."
english.info:
<size=36>Umbrella Pot enhances umbrella-type plants in unique ways!

<color=black>Umbrella Husk:</color> <color=#8B0000>+2 Seconds immobilization, +50% knockback distance</color>
<color=black>Umbrella Clove, Umbrella Ultimate Moves:</color> <color=#8B0000>Knockback distance ×2</color>
<color=black>Umbrella Rind, Aegis:</color> <color=#8B0000>Damage of reflected projectiles ×2</color>
<color=black>Umbrella Kale, Midas:</color> <color=#8B0000>Can attack zombies on adjacent lanes
<color=black>Other Umbrellas: </color><color=#8B0000>Knockback distance +50%</color></color>

german.name: Schirmtopf
german.introduce: Andere Blumentöpfe sind verwirrt über das dichte Laub des Schirmtopfs, doch der Schirmtopf sagt einfach: „Ich habe gerade das Buch Der Topfführer zur Haarpflege gelesen.“
german.info:
<size=34>Verbessert Schirmblatt-Pflanzen.

<color=black>Schirmhülle:</color> <color=#8B0000>+2 Sekunden Ruhigstellung, +50% Rückschlagdistanz</color>
<color=black>Schirmrinde:</color> <color=#8B0000>Verdoppelt den Schaden von reflektierten Geschossen</color>
<color=black>Schirmknoblauch, Silber/Gold Schirm, Diamantschirm & Smaragdschirm: </color><color=#8B0000>Verdoppelt die Rückschlagdistanz</color>
<color=black>Schirmkohl:</color> <color=#8B0000>Kann Zombies auf benachbarten Bahnen angreifen</color>

original.name: 西瓜保护伞
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>投我以木瓜，报之以琼瑶，匪报也，永以为好也。瓜伞一直很喜欢诗经里的这句话。植物每次求他办事都不必送礼，因为不管送他什么都会原封不动退回来。好吧，除了篮球，这家伙其实是不折不扣的球迷。</color>
original.info:
用弹韧的瓜皮反弹敌方子弹。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>2000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>反弹僵尸方平射子弹。反弹爆炸樱桃或余烬毁灭菇时受伤200，反弹白雪球时受伤50</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>弹走投掷物后，还击一个西瓜</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>反弹子弹或弹走投掷物后，存储等同于其反弹后伤害的能量</color>
<color=#3D1400>④</color><color=red>伞类击退：伤害80，附加等同于能量值的伤害，然后清空能量值</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>叶子保护伞+西瓜投手</color>

english.name: Umbrella Rind
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Give me a melon; I'll repay you with kindness." Umbrella Rind has always admired this saying from ancient poetry. Plants don't need to bribe him for help—whatever they give, he returns. Well, except basketballs. He's a total basketball fan.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Umbrella Rind can deflect most projectiles back at the zombies!

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>2000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Can reflect zombie projectiles except tridents (return as melons if they are lobbed projectiles); loses 200/200/50 HP when reflecting zombie explosive cherries/irritated doom shells/snow balls respectively.
<color=black>•</color> Each reflection of projectiles stores energy equal to the projectile's damage, releasing it all on zombies for extra damage when the next knockback occurs.
<color=black>•</color> Knocks back and deals 80 damage to zombies at the cost of Toughness. For specific self damage amounts, see Umbrella Husk. </color>

german.name: Schirmrinde
german.introduce: <size=28><color=black>„Gib mir eine Melone; ich werde dir mit Freundlichkeit antworten.“ Das Schirmrinde hat dieses Sprichwort aus der antiken Dichtung immer bewundert. Pflanzen müssen ihm keine Bestechungsgelder zahlen, um Hilfe zu bekommen – was immer sie ihm geben, gibt er zurück. Nun ja, mit Ausnahme von Basketballs. Er ist ein absoluter Basketball-Fan.</color>
german.info:
<size=28>Wehrt Basketballs ab und wirft einen katapultierten Melon zurück.

<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>2000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Kann Zombie-Projektile, einschließlich Explosionen, reflektieren, verliert dabei aber jedes Mal 200 Ausdauer. Jede Reflexion speichert Energie, die dem Schaden des Geschosses entspricht, und gibt sie an die Zombies ab, um zusätzlichen Schaden zu verursachen, wenn der Rückstoß erfolgt; mit jedem Rückstoß verliert er auch an Ausdauer. Siehe Schirmhülle.</color>

original.name: 坚果保护伞
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>坚果保护伞是花园里最潮的发型师，以能够在坚硬的坚果壳上设计炫酷的发型而闻名。虽然这个发型的保质期不长，但并不妨碍大家对他的喜爱——以及第六家坚果美发连锁店铺的开张。</color>
original.info:
兼具叶子保护伞和坚果的特点。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>伞类击退：伤害40</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>叶子保护伞+坚果</color>

english.name: Umbrella Shell
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Umbrella Shell is the trendiest hairstylist in the garden, known for its ability to create cool hairstyles on hard nut shells. Although the lifespan of this hairstyle is short, it doesn't stop people from loving it—and the opening of the sixth nut hair salon chain.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Umbrella Shell can knock back zombies for a long time with its high endurance!

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Has the characteristics of Umbrella Leaf and Wall-nut. Can repel approaching zombies, dealing 40 damage every time at the cost of its own health, for specific self damage amounts, see Umbrella Husk.</color>

german.name: Schirmnuss
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Umbrella Shell is the trendiest hairstylist in the garden, known for its ability to create cool hairstyles on hard nut shells. Although the lifespan of this hairstyle is short, it doesn't stop people from loving it—and the opening of the sixth nut hair salon chain.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Umbrella Shell has the traits of both his fusion ingredients.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Has the characteristics of Umbrella Leaf and Wall-nut. Can repel approaching zombies, dealing 40 damage every time.</color>

original.name: 仙人掌保护伞
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>仙人掌保护伞刚刚发行了他的新歌《带刺的仙人掌》。“也许大家可以像喜欢玫瑰一样喜欢我”，他说，“我知道，这可能需要一些时间，不过我会努力的。”</color>
original.info:
防空特化的保护伞。

<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>能扎破气球</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>伞类击退：只能击退飞行僵尸，击退飞艇类僵尸幅度只有25%</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>叶子保护伞+仙人掌</color>

english.name: Umbrella Thorn
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Umbrella Thorn just dropped his latest song, "Prickly Cactus." With a hopeful glint in his eyes, he mused, "Maybe one day, people will like me as much as they love roses. I know it won't happen overnight, but I'll keep trying my best."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Umbrella Thorn can knock down flying zombies and repel airships. 

<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Can only knock back flying zombies. Pops balloons. When repelling airships, the knockback strength is reduced by 75%. See Umbrella Husk for knockback mechanic details.</color>

german.name: Stachelschirm
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Umbrella Thorn just dropped his latest song, "Prickly Cactus." With a hopeful glint in his eyes, he mused, "Maybe one day, people will like me as much as they love roses. I know it won't happen overnight, but I'll keep trying my best."</color>
german.info: <size=36>Can shoot down flying zombies and repel airships.

original.name: 仙人掌海蘑菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>“我的家乡在纳米布沙漠”，仙人掌海蘑菇向每一位询问自己来历的植物解释道，“如果你地理学得很好，你就会知道那里的沙漠紧邻着大海。”</color>
original.info:
发射孢子或可以对空的尖刺，长大后变为4连发。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>水生，低矮</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>发射本行索敌的孢子或只对空的尖刺。出场120秒后长大，一次发射4发孢子或尖刺</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>海蘑菇（底座）+仙人掌</color>

english.name: Urchin-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"People often ask about my appearance, so let me clarify: I'm from the Namib Desert," Urchin-shroom said to anyone who inquired. "If you're familiar with geography, you'll know that a desert can be found right next to the ocean!"</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Urchin-shroom attacks flying zombies and airships from the water, growing in size after a while.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20 → 20×4/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Growth Time: </color><color=#8B0000>120s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).</color></size>

german.name: Meerdornpilz
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>„Die Leute fragen oft nach meinem Aussehen, also lasst mich das klarstellen: Ich komme aus der Namib-Wüste“, erklärte Meerdornpilz jedem, der nachfragte. „Wenn ihr euch mit Geografie auskennt, wisst ihr, dass eine Wüste direkt neben dem Ozean liegen kann!“</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Greift fliegende Zombies und Luftschiffe an und wächst nach einiger Zeit.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>20 → 20*4 / 1.5 Sekunden</color>
<color=black>Zeit für Wachstum: </color><color=#8B0000>120 Sekunden</color></size>

original.name: 坚果大蘑菇
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>坚果大蘑菇训练了一批坚果小蘑菇，却未教其战斗。小蘑菇们问：“我们该如何抵御僵尸呢？”他回答：“用坚硬外壳和必死决心！”说完便将它们发射出去。“这是我从足球中学的技巧，”坚果大蘑菇骄傲地说</color>
original.info:
顽皮的防御者，会唤来附近的坚果小蘑菇，并用脑袋撞飞。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>需要消耗3×3范围内的一个坚果小蘑菇来发射子弹，子弹会附加等于坚果小蘑菇血量的伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>子弹伤害高于目标血量时，可以穿透目标继续飞行，但减少等同于其血量的子弹伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大喷菇+坚果</color>

english.name: Wallop-shroom
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Wallop-shroom trained a batch of Nut-shrooms but didn't teach them combat. When asked, "How do we defend against zombies?" he replied: "With a hard shell and do-or-die determination!" Then he launched them at the zombies. "This is a technique I learned from baseball," he announced proudly.</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Wallop-shroom picks up nearby Nut-shrooms to attack with.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000> Picks up Nut-shrooms within a 3×3 area and bats them forward as projectiles, CD 3s. Projectile damage equals (20 + the Nut-shroom's HP) and ignores Type 2 armor. If the projectile hits a zombie and deals enough damage to kill it, the shot pierces through, with its damage reduced by the amount dealt.</color>

german.name: Dicknuss
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Wallop-shroom trained a batch of Nut-shrooms but didn't teach them combat. When asked, "How do we defend against zombies?" he replied: "With a hard shell and do-or-die determination!" Then he launched them at the zombies. "This is a technique I learned from baseball," he announced proudly.</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Picks up nearby Nut-shrooms to attack.

<color=black>Robustheit: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000> Picks up Nut-shrooms within a 3×3 area and bats them forward as projectiles. Projectile damage equals the Nut-shroom's HP and ignores Type 2 armor. If the projectile hits a zombie and deals enough damage to kill it, the shot pierces through, with its damage reduced by the amount dealt.</color>

original.name: 三叶南瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>三叶南瓜尤其在意他的发型，每次出门，三叶南瓜总要花半小时打理他头上的叶子。</color>
original.info:
定期生成三叶草的南瓜。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每30秒，在壳内或前方生成一个三叶草</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>南瓜（底座）+三叶草</color>

english.name: Windy Pumpkin
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>For Windy Pumpkin, looking good is a top priority. He never leaves home without first spending a solid half hour perfecting the leaves on his head, ensuring his style is flawless.</color></size>
english.info:
<size=36>Every so often a Blover will spawn from Windy Pumpkin blow away the fog.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Produces a Blover every 30 seconds.</color></size>

german.name: Windkürbis
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Für den Windkürbis ist es oberste Priorität, gut auszusehen. Er verlässt nie das Haus, ohne zuerst eine halbe Stunde damit zu verbringen, die Blätter auf seinem Kopf zu perfektionieren, um sicherzustellen, dass sein Stil makellos ist.</color></size>
german.info:
<size=36>Ab und zu erscheint ein Wehblatt, um den Nebel wegzublasen.

<color=black>Ausdauer: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Besonderheit: </color><color=#8B0000>Erzeugt alle 30 Sekunden ein Wehblatt.</color></size>

original.name: 冰瓜
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>冰西瓜对着西瓜说道：我原来并不是冰的，只是有一次我想进冰箱拿雪糕，意外被变成了冰块而已。他这么说道。</color>
original.info:
投出施加寒冷状态的寒冰西瓜。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>80/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>攻击施加寒冷状态，直击和溅射分别赋予50点和5点冻结值。对冻结的僵尸伤害x4</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>西瓜投手+寒冰菇</color>

english.name: Winter Melon
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Winter Melon once confessed to Melon-pult, "I wasn't always this frosty. I just went into the freezer for a popsicle one day, and… well, here we are." </color>
english.info:
<size=36>Winter Melon launches frosty melons that slow zombies.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>80/3s</color>
<color=#0077b6>Cryo System: </color><color=#8B0000>Applies 50 Cryo points to zombies hit. Zombies hit in the splash area gain 5 Cryo points. Deals 4x damage to Frozen zombies.</color>

german.name: Wintermelone
german.introduce: <size=36><color=black>Wintermelone versucht sich zu beruhigen. Er hört herannahende Zombies. Wird er es schaffen? Wird irgendwer es schaffen?</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Verursachen großen Schaden, verlangsamen Gruppen von Zombies.

<color=black>Schaden: </color><color=#8B0000>80/3 Sekunden</color>
<color=#0077b6>Kryo-System: </color><color=#8B0000>Verleiht den getroffenen Zombies 50 Kryo-Punkte. Zombies, die im Spritzerbereich getroffen werden, erhalten 5 Kryo-Punkte. Verursacht 4x Schaden an gefrorenen Zombies.</color>

original.name: 寒冰杨桃
original.introduce: <color=#3D1400>让众多星星以不同的轨道围绕着自己旋转，这听起来并不像是什么容易的魔术，但作为这种魔术的创造者，寒冰杨桃只是淡淡地说道：“这对于五星级魔术师来讲，并不是什么难事。”</color>
original.info:
发射会螺旋扩散在自身周围的寒冰星星。

<color=#3D1400>索敌范围：</color><color=red>全场地表</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20×5/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>子弹命中时施加寒冷状态，赋予10冻结值，对冻结的僵尸伤害×4</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>杨桃+寒冰菇</color>

english.name: Winter Starfruit
english.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Making countless stars spiral out along different trajectories doesn't sound like an easy trick. But as the creator of this magic, Winter Starfruit simply says, "For a five-star magician, it's no big deal."</color>
english.info:
<size=36>Winter Starfruit fires icy stars that spiral outward around itself.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20×5/1.5s</color>
<color=#0077b6>Cryo System: </color><color=#8B0000>Attacks inflict Chill, add 10 Cryo points and deal ×4 damage to frozen zombies.</color>

german.name: Winter Starfruit
german.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Making countless stars spiral out along different trajectories doesn't sound like an easy trick. But as the creator of this magic, Winter Starfruit simply says, "For a five-star magician, it's no big deal."</color>
german.info:
<size=36>Winter Starfruit fires icy stars that spiral outward around itself.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20×5/1.5s</color>
<color=#0077b6>Cryo System: </color><color=#8B0000>Attacks inflict Chill, add 10 Cryo points and deal ×4 damage to frozen zombies.</color>
